Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about press reports that ICCO staff had for years brought asylum seekers to the Netherlands, including the number of cases, government knowledge, subsidy use and repayment. The state secretary answered that ICCO denied knowledge of such practices and had demanded rectification, gave the approximate annual subsidy, agreed that such selection by an aid organisation is undesirable, and referred back to the answer on the earlier questions for the remaining points.
ICCO has indicated that it is not aware of practices such as those mentioned in the articles you cite.
ICCO heeft aangegeven niet bekend te zijn met praktijken zoals die worden genoemd in de door u aangehaalde artikelen.
Vragen van het lid Dijkhoff (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de online campagne van Cordaid voor Zuid-Soedan (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

An MP asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about Cordaid's online campaign for South Sudan, in which most donations reportedly went to website operators and the costs exceeded the 25% fundraising norm, and whether public subsidy was involved. The State Secretary answered that no ministry subsidy funds the campaign, that responsibility lies with Cordaid's supervisory board and management, and that Cordaid itself reports its fundraising costs fall within the CBF limit.
It is the responsibility of Cordaid's Supervisory Board and Management to determine which fundraising actions are appropriate, since no government subsidy is used.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de Raad van Toezicht en de Directie van Cordaid om te bepalen welke wervingsacties gepast zijn, aangezien er geen overheidssubsidie gebruikt wordt.

Vragen van de leden Dikkers (PvdA), Voordewind (CU), Ouwerhand (PvdD) en Dijkhoff (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris voor Buitenlandse Zaken over het rapport van Human Rights Watch over de situatie in Burundi (ingezonden 26 n

MPs asked the Dutch government about a Human Rights Watch report on crackdowns on rights in Burundi, including whether it was unacceptable, whether it affects Dutch development aid, whether civil society should be supported, and the role of the Netherlands in the Great Lakes region. The government said it shares the concerns, has raised them bilaterally and multilaterally, will continue its security-sector and civil-society support, and will inform parliament in spring 2011 about its focus countries.
We share the concerns expressed in the report about the arrests of journalists, the documented cases of torture and the restriction of freedom for opposition parties and civil society.

Wij delen de in het rapport geuite zorgen over arrestaties van journalisten, de geconstateerde gevallen van marteling en de beperking van de vrijheid voor oppositiepartijen en het maatschappelijk middenveld.

Vragen van het lid Dijkhoff (VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over begrotingssteun aan Rwanda in relatie tot de rol van Rwanda bij de gewelddadigheden in Congo (ingezonden 12 oktober 2010).

An MP asked whether the UN report on serious human rights violations in the DRC, which implicates Rwanda, should lead the government to end or reconsider its budget support to Rwanda and to press for the same in the EU. The state secretary welcomed the report, said unilateral steps now would pre-empt follow-up, and said the future of the Rwanda development relationship will be addressed in the integrated policy review and communicated to parliament.
The House will be informed in writing of the outcomes of this assessment before the legislative consultation.
De Kamer zal schriftelijk worden geïnformeerd over de uitkomsten van deze afweging voor het Wetgevingsoverleg.

Vragen van het lid Dijkhoff (VVD) aan staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de gevangenneming van de Rwandese oppositieleidster Victoire Ingabire Umuhoza op 14 oktober (ingezonden 20 oktober 2010).

Dijkhoff (VVD) asked the Foreign Minister about the October 2010 arrest of Rwandan opposition leader Victoire Ingabire Umuhoza, whether the embassy had acted, and whether Dutch budget support to Rwanda should be halted. Minister Rosenthal answered that the embassy follows the public trial and raises human rights bilaterally and in EU dialogue, but declined for now to end budget support pending the integrated development policy review.
The Netherlands and the international community will closely follow this process to ensure that there is a fair trial.
Nederland en de internationale gemeenschap zullen dit proces nauwgezet volgen om zich ervan te verzekeren dat er sprake is van een eerlijk proces.

Vragen van de leden Nicolaï, Ten Broeke en Dijkhoff (allen VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de belangen van Iran in het buitenland in verband met zijn nucleaire ambities (ingezonden 27 oktober 2010).

VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Iran's stake in the Rössing uranium mine in Namibia, whether UN Security Council resolution 1929 bans such stakes, Iran's uranium import needs, Dutch steps to hinder Iran's uranium sourcing, and Iranian students gaining nuclear know-how in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the Iranian stake dates from the 1970s and falls outside resolution 1929's non-retroactive scope, that the Netherlands will keep pressing for compliance with UN resolutions, and that the education rules were adjusted after a court ruling, with the appeal still pending.
The Netherlands will continue to vigorously press for compliance by the international community with all relevant UN Security Council resolutions targeting Iran.
Nederland zal zich krachtig blijven inzetten voor naleving door de internationale gemeenschap van alle relevante resoluties van de VN Veiligheidsraad gericht op Iran.
Vragen van het lid Dijkhoff (VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de arrestatie in Iran van de Nederlands-Iraanse Zahra Bahrami (ingezonden 24 augustus 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister about the arrest in Iran of dual Dutch-Iranian national Zahra Bahrami, her charges, consular access, legal assistance and risk of the death penalty. The minister answered that Iran refuses to recognise her Dutch nationality, denies consular access, and that Dutch diplomats have repeatedly protested and urged a fair trial and access to a lawyer, while pledging to act against any execution.
The Iranian Ministry also indicated that it does not permit the embassy to provide consular assistance.
Het Iraanse Ministerie liet eveneens weten dat het de ambassade niet toestaat consulaire bijstand te verlenen.

Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Dikkers (beiden PvdA), Pechtold (D66), Peters (GroenLinks), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Dijkhoff (VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de detentie van de Venezolaanse rechter A

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the detention of Venezuelan judge María Lourdes Afiuni, whether it has raised concerns with Venezuela, and whether it will raise the case at EU level. The minister called the detention an infringement on judicial independence, supported the UN call for her release, said the Netherlands will follow the case in UN and EU contexts and will ask the High Representative to raise it with Venezuelan authorities.
I will check whether High Representative Ashton has raised this with the Venezuelan authorities, and advocate that she does.
Ik zal nagaan of Hoge Vertegenwoordiger Ashton dit bij de Venezolaanse autoriteiten heeft aangekaart, en bepleiten dat zij dat doet.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht in de NRC dat de zorg aan kwetsbare gezinnen onder druk staat

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries whether municipalities may buy youth protection and probation care below cost, whether a realistic tariff will be ensured, and how continuity of care for about 420 families will be guaranteed after a tariff dispute. The government answered that municipalities bear responsibility under the decentralised system, that a cost-price study with VNG is planned for April 2018, and that continuity in the Zuid-Holland Zuid region has been arranged, while referring many detailed questions to municipalities or lacking the data.
It is up to municipalities and institutions themselves to conduct research into the cost price where necessary.
Het is dan ook aan gemeenten en instellingen zelf om zo nodig onderzoek te doen naar de kostprijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Lacin over het bericht dat op station Amsterdam Centraal slimme reclameborden worden ingezet

MPs Hijink and Lacin asked about smart advertising boards at Amsterdam Centraal that reportedly track when and how long people look at them, including how many such boards exist, what data they collect, and whether companies and state holdings must obtain opt-in consent or seek advice from the Dutch data protection authority. The government answered that it cannot confirm whether personal data is processed, that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (Dutch DPA) is looking into it and has jurisdiction, that the operator Exterion is itself responsible for legal compliance and has temporarily switched off the cameras, and that it sees no need to require DPA advice beyond what the law prescribes.
We do not know how many of the advertising boards referred to in the report are used by Exterion and other operators in the Netherlands, nor what data and techniques are used for this.

Het is ons niet bekend hoeveel van de in het bericht bedoelde type reclameborden worden gebruikt door Exterion en eventuele andere exploitanten in Nederland, noch welke data en technieken hiervoor worden gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Jetten over het bericht ‘Reclameborden op A'dam CS weten wanneer en hoelang jij kijkt’

MPs Verhoeven and Jetten asked the government about reports that cameras in advertising billboards at Dutch railway stations, including Amsterdam Centraal, collect viewer data. The government answered that NS and operator Exterion Media turned off the cameras and software after the publicity, claimed only anonymous statistical counts were generated, and noted the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is asking questions.

Following the conversation, it was decided to switch off the cameras and underlying software on the billboards, even though according to Exterion Media it falls within all applicable laws and regulations.

Naar aanleiding van het gesprek is besloten om de camera’s en achterliggende software op de borden uit te zetten, ondanks het feit dat het volgens Exterion Media binnen alle geldende wet- en regelgeving valt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over helikoptertaken in Mali

An MP asked the Defence Minister why the operational pause in Mali was extended, how long it would last, and about grounding and technical problems of the German NH-90 and Tiger helicopters used for medevac and escalation dominance, including why parliament was not informed sooner. The minister answered that full operations were resumed except in Kidal pending UN guarantees on medevac, and referred to a separate letter on the NH-90 for the technical details.
See the letter from the Minister of Defence 'NATO helicopter project NH-90' of 25 October 2017 (Parliamentary paper 25 928, no. 74) for the answers to questions 2, 3 and 5.
Zie de brief van de Minister van Defensie « Navo helikopterproject NH-90 » van 25 oktober 2017 (Kamerstuk 25 928, nr. 74 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Groothuizen over de Nederlandse transporteur die stopt met ritten naar Engeland vanwege problemen met vluchtelingen die als verstekeling meereizen

MPs Jetten and Groothuizen asked the government what it has done about stowaway migrants in Calais threatening Dutch truck drivers, and whether a European approach and insurance measures are in hand. The minister replied that the Calais security situation is the responsibility of the French authorities, that the government raises it in European and bilateral channels, and that it works with the transport sector, without committing to new concrete steps.
The security situation in Calais falls under the responsibility of the French authorities.
De veiligheidssituatie in Calais valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de Franse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het gescheiden uitzetten van gezinnen

MPs Jasper van Dijk and others asked why a family was separated for deportation after nine years of proceedings, how the Dienst Terugkeer en Vertrek handles incomplete families, the weight of children's best interests and the role of Nidos. The Secretary of State declined to discuss the individual case for privacy reasons, described general procedural accelerations and stated that separating families is permitted under procedure, refusing a temporary deportation stop.
For reasons of privacy and the safety of the young children in this case, I will not address the individual circumstances or the individual residence procedures.
Omwille van de privacy en de veiligheid van de jonge kinderen in deze zaak ga ik niet in op de individuele omstandigheden of de individuele verblijfsrechtelijke procedures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de bewapening van de Luchtverdedigings- en Commandofregatten (LC-fregatten)

An SP MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether NATO's missile defence and possible SM-3 acquisition for the LCF frigates disturb the strategic balance and could fuel proliferation. The Defence Minister replied that the NATO BMD system does not disturb the strategic balance, that the SMART-L radar software was tested in Formidable Shield, that no decision on SM-3 acquisition has been taken, and that proliferation is a different question.
The NATO BMD system therefore does not disturb the strategic balance in Europe.
Het BMD-systeem van de Navo verstoort het strategische evenwicht in Europa dan ook niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over mensenhandel met het oogmerk van orgaanverwijdering

An MP asks the government about reports of migrants in Egypt, Libya and Niger being forced to give up organs, whether asylum seekers in the Netherlands reported such coercion and how that was investigated, and about police capacity and cooperation with transit countries. The State Secretary answers that no such cases of forced donation in the Netherlands are known, that signals of threatened organ removal were investigated but led to no prosecutions, and that cooperation with the region on smuggling and migrant rescue will be continued and expanded.
There are no known cases of asylum seekers in the Netherlands who stated during their asylum procedure that they had been forced to give up their organs.
Er zijn geen gevallen bekend van asielzoekers die in Nederland tijdens hun asielprocedure hebben verklaard dat zij onder dwang hun organen hebben moeten afstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat gezinshereniging voor Eritrese asielzoekers vrijwel onmogelijk is

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the rejection rate for Eritrean family reunification applications (27% granted, versus 69% overall) and the handling of DNA tests and interviews indicate obstruction of family reunification. The State Secretary answered that rejections do not by themselves signal excessive hurdles, that policy is the same for all nationalities, that DNA tests are offered when identity is accepted or evidence distress is found, and that the IND relies on its Eritrea country report, which the ministry keeps improving.
The policy and implementing rules for family reunification applications are the same for all nationalities.
Het beleid en de uitvoeringsregels voor nareisaanvragen zijn voor alle nationaliteiten gelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Bosch over het bericht “Hacker steelt Australische JSF-bestanden”

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that a hacker stole Australian F-35 project files, including whether national security is at risk and what cybersecurity safeguards apply. The government answered that the stolen data was unclassified, the breach was at a commercial supplier, Dutch security requirements are met, and it cannot discuss the investigation into the perpetrator for security reasons.
For security reasons I cannot address this question and refer to the answer to question 5.
Om veiligheidsredenen kan ik niet op deze vraag ingaan en verwijs ik naar het antwoord op vraag 5.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘IND gelooft (ondanks bewijs) verhalen van gevluchte Egyptenaren niet’

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that the IND disbelieves political asylum accounts of Egyptians despite evidence, whether comparison material is lacking, whether an updated Egypt country report exists, and whether individual country reports should be used more. The State Secretary answered that credibility is assessed on all evidence with judicial review available, that lack of comparison material is never the sole reason for refusal, that no new Egypt report is planned given limited inflow and other sources, and that individual reports are weighed case by case.
This assessment is reasoned and this reasoning can be reviewed by the judge at the request of the foreign national.
Dit oordeel wordt gemotiveerd uiteen gezet en deze motivering kan op verzoek van de vreemdeling worden getoetst door de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Steekpartij Breda: opnieuw misdrijf van J.B. onder toezicht reclassering'

An MP asked the Minister why a suspect under reclassering supervision could commit a stabbing, whether the reclassering director should resign, and whether longer prison sentences rather than ankle monitors should be used. The Minister defended supervision with conditions and partner cooperation, declined to comment on the personal demand, and argued that conditions and monitoring reduce recidivism better than imprisonment.
I regret that the efforts of the reclassering and its partners could not prevent the person concerned from being suspected of stabbing a 31-year-old woman.
Ik betreur dat de inzet en inspanningen van de reclassering en haar partners niet hebben kunnen voorkomen dat de betrokkene wordt verdacht van het neersteken van een 31-jarige vrouw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Werkdruk justitiële inrichtingen vier keer hoger dan rest van werkend Nederland’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about an FNV survey finding workplace pressure in prisons four times higher than elsewhere, and whether DJI will invest in more staff and respond to the survey's recommendations. The minister acknowledged the findings, described a recruitment campaign and interim measures such as concentrating detainees and staff, and said talks with the works council are ongoing without committing to a specific timeline or full point-by-point response.
It is being considered how the FNV research can be incorporated into the various recommendations from the Mto.
Bezien wordt hoe het FNV onderzoek kan worden betrokken bij de verschillende aanbevelingen uit het Mto.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over het bericht “Vloggen in de bajes”

An MP asked the minister about a report of prison staff being filmed and corrupt staff smuggling mobile phones, and about the use of private security staff in prisons. The minister said mobile phones are banned, staff are screened and checked, disciplinary measures apply, and an improvement study with DJI is under way.

As you may have read in my policy response to the Inspectorate report 'Binnen de muren niet toegestaan', I am examining together with DJI the options to improve policy and the current approach to smuggling contraband into prisons.

Zoals u in mijn beleidsreactie op het Inspectierapport «Binnen de muren niet toegestaan 2 » heeft kunnen lezen, onderzoek ik samen met DJI de mogelijkheden om het beleid en de huidige aanpak tegen het binnenbrengen van contrabande te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de situatie op Lesbos

An SP MP asked the government about conditions in the Lesbos migrant camps, access rules, EU funding, monitoring of spending, relocation and the EU-Turkey deal. The minister answered that conditions need continued attention, access is controlled by Greek authorities, EU funds exceed 880 million euros, and that deals with third countries must meet European standards.

The European Commission monitors the situation closely, supported by the European Asylum Support Office (EASO), with the Greek authorities ultimately responsible for implementing asylum rules in line with European and international standards.

De Europese Commissie monitort de situatie dan ook nauwlettend, daarbij ondersteund door het Europees Ondersteuningsbureau voor asielzaken (EASO), waarbij de Griekse autoriteiten uiteindelijk verantwoordelijk zijn voor de uitvoering van de asielregelgeving conform Europese en internationale standaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en De Graaf over de berichtgeving dat de Syrische terrorist Yahyah Farroukh onlangs in Nederland was

PVV MPs asked whether suspect Yahyah Farroukh visited family in the Netherlands, how he passed screening, and whether Syrian asylum permits should be revoked given Syria's supposed safety. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, stated the person is no longer a suspect, defended asylum protection for those the IND finds in need, and refused to revoke Syrian asylum permits.
I generally do not make statements about individual cases.
Over individuele zaken doe ik in de regel geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat trauma’s bij vluchtelingen slecht worden opgemerkt

An SP MP asked the government whether refugee trauma is poorly recognised and what is done about it, including training of IND, COA and Vluchtelingenwerk staff, interpreter availability, funding of Psychiaters Zonder Grenzen and follow-up on a pilot of EMDR therapy for refugee children. The Minister answers that medical care is the responsibility of VWS, describes training and signalling procedures, says no specific trauma provision exists in integration courses, and reports a pilot with EMDR that was hampered by the location and is being extended.
Those trainings also pay attention to referral.
Ook bij die trainingen wordt aandacht besteed aan doorverwijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over misstanden in Sri Lanka inzake adoptie

An MP asked the minister about malpractice in 1980s adoptions from Sri Lanka by Dutch parents, following a Zembla broadcast, including what support adoptees and parents can get and whether adoption agencies committed document fraud. The minister acknowledged the problems, described coordination with Sri Lankan authorities and Dutch bodies and a forthcoming overview of government roles, declined to judge fraud (reserved for prosecutors and courts), and said broader measures would cover other countries and periods.
I am currently having an inventory made of how the roles and responsibilities in the Netherlands were divided at that time.
Momenteel laat ik inventariseren hoe destijds de rollen en verantwoordelijkheden in Nederland waren verdeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over misstanden in Sri Lanka inzake adoptie

An MP asked the government about misconduct in intercountry adoption from Sri Lanka in the 1980s and about the status of promised measures to improve adoption care and quality. The minister outlined the historical division of roles, said a fuller inventory will follow later this year, and reported some international steps taken while noting that concrete legislative changes are on hold pending the controversial-designation debate.
I expect to have a more detailed inventory ready within a few weeks. It will go into more specifically how roles and responsibilities were arranged at the time.
Ik verwacht een nadere inventarisatie binnen enkele weken gereed te hebben. Hierin zal specifieker worden ingegaan op hoe de rollen en verantwoordelijkheden destijds geregeld waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de zorg voor zieken en mensen met een beperking in asielzoekerscentra

An MP asked how asylum centres and municipalities handle asylum seekers and status holders with serious illness or disabilities, including the case of a seriously ill child whose parents were separated from him, and how long housing takes. The minister answered in general terms without discussing the individual case, describing care options, COA facilities, and that municipalities decide on suitable housing and the wait for adapted housing is not systematically tracked.
As you know, I do not go into individual cases.
Zoals u weet ga ik niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Markuszower over het bericht “Terreurvader Bunschoten vrij met enkelband”

PVV MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether an ankle monitor and location ban are sufficient to protect the children of a suspect in a child abuse case, after he was released from preventive custody. The State Secretary answered that the independent judge decided on the release under strict conditions, that sentencing is for the courts, and that the government does not decide on pre-trial detention.
The independent judge, and not the government, decides in the Netherlands whether suspects must await their trial in custody.
De onafhankelijke rechter, en dus niet de regering, beslist in Nederland of verdachten hun berechting in de cel moeten afwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Keijzer en Van Toorenburg over het bericht “Albanese maffia slaat hier zijn tentakels uit”

MPs Omtzigt, Keijzer and Van Toorenburg asked about reports of Albanian organised crime in the Netherlands, including whether a visa requirement should be reintroduced under EU rules and whether Albania should keep candidate status. The minister answered that Albanian-national suspects rose to about 700 in 2016, that the government will await the Commission's Western Balkans monitor before considering the EU emergency brake, and that the answers were delayed beyond the two-week target.
I will make this report available for confidential inspection by your House until the end of the year.
Deze rapportage leg ik tot het einde van het jaar ter vertrouwelijke inzage in uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Verhoeven over OV-chipkaartbedrijf Translink dat de reisgegevens van honderden studenten heeft doorgegeven aan de Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs

MPs Jetten and Verhoeven asked how Translink could hand travel data of hundreds of students to DUO, on what legal basis, and whether travellers are notified. The government answered that DUO relied on general supervisory powers and data protection provisions, that the Hague court has since ruled these insufficient and transfers stopped, and it declined to address pending appeal questions while promising limited follow-up on privacy and information sharing.

The Hague District Court ruled in its judgment of 8 May that Articles 5:16 and 5:17 of the General Administrative Law Act do not in themselves provide a sufficiently specific legal basis for the data processing.

De rechtbank Den Haag heeft echter in haar uitspraak van 8 mei jl. geoordeeld dat de artikelen 5:16 en 5:17 van de Awb als zodanig geen voldoende specifieke wettelijke grondslag bieden voor de gegevensverwerking
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma en Maeijer over door NGO's gefaciliteerde asielinvasie naar Europese Unie

Two PVV MPs asked whether NGO sea rescue operations facilitate people smuggling and whether Dutch public money funds such NGOs, and urged closing the borders. The government answered that no Dutch subsidies go to Mediterranean rescue operations, that Italian criminal investigations must be awaited, and that closing borders is not a realistic solution.

As also exchanged in previous answers and during various General Consultations, the Dutch government does not provide subsidies or other forms of financing to organisations for rescue operations in the Mediterranean Sea.

Zoals ook in eerdere beantwoording en tijdens verschillende Algemene Overleggen is gewisseld, verstrekt de Nederlandse overheid geen subsidies of andere vormen van financiering aan organisaties voor reddingsoperaties op de Middellandse Zee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Maeijer en Wilders over het bericht dat Italië weer wordt overspoeld met migranten

Opposition MPs from the PVV asked the government about reports of large migrant arrivals in Italy via Libya, the role of NGOs and Dutch-flagged ships, IOM funding, and calls to close borders. The government answered that arrivals were only slightly up on last year, described EU and Italian measures, said NGO funding and flag-state links require further investigation, and rejected a national border closure as discriminatory and unrealistic.
As far as the cabinet is aware, only in the case of the Iuventa is it currently established that this is an NGO ship sailing under the Dutch flag between Libya and Italy.
Voor zover het kabinet bekend, staat op dit moment alleen ten aanzien van de «Iuventa» vast
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Meer doden door code voor redders op zee’

An MP asked whether the Italian code of conduct for NGO sea rescues would prohibit switching off transponders, contact with smugglers and rescues in Libyan waters, and whether it would increase drowning deaths. The government confirmed the code's main terms, said it aims to improve cooperation and intelligence against smugglers, and stated that the effect on drownings is not known in advance.
The effect of the code of conduct on the number of people who drown is not known in advance.
Het effect van de gedragscode op het aantal mensen dat verdrinkt, is niet op voorhand bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht dat criminele vreemdelingen zelden worden uitgezet

PVV MPs asked why criminal foreigners often keep residence permits, how often this happens, and whether the state will close borders to asylum seekers and migrants from Islamic countries. The Secretary of State explained the graduated-scale test for revoking permits, said the IND cannot say how many cases involve insufficient sentences, and rejected a categorical border closure as unrealistic.
Based on the data available at the IND, it cannot be stated in how many cases an imposed sentence is insufficient to proceed to revocation of a residence permit.
Op basis van de bij de IND beschikbare gegevens is niet aan te geven in hoeveel gevallen een opgelegde straf onvoldoende is om over te gaan tot intrekking van een verblijfsvergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en De Graaf over een in Brunssum opgepakte Syrische terreurverdachte met een verblijfsvergunning

PVV MPs asked how a Syrian asylum seeker with a residence permit, suspected of terrorism, passed screening, how many asylum seekers are suspected of terrorist links, why migration continues, whether such suspects will be deported, and when borders will close to Muslim-country nationals. The state secretary replied that the suspect was wrongly linked to terrorism, that authorities stay alert but cannot guarantee abuse is impossible, that deportation or residence/nationality measures are considered when a conviction or intelligence report exists, and rejected closing borders.
The Public Prosecution Service does not register by residence status.
Het OM registreert niet op verblijfstatus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de brandbrieven van de centrale ondernemingsraad Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen aan de directie van de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen (DJI)

An MP asks the state secretary about works council letters warning of high workload, sickness absence, violence and unsafe conditions in prisons, and what will be done about staffing and safety. The secretary acknowledges the problems, points to dialogue with the works council, a recruitment campaign for 250 fte, extra funding and safety measures, while rejecting claims that the prison system is out of control.
The director-general of DJI indicated to the central works council that it takes the content of the letters seriously.
Daarnaast heeft de hoofddirecteur van DJI aan de COR DJI aangegeven de inhoud van de brieven serieus te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over migratie via Niger

MPs Van Dijk and Karabulut asked the government about migration through Niger, EU missions, funding, smuggling laws and prosecutions, economic alternatives for smugglers, and migrants abandoned in the desert. The minister answered in detail on each question, describing EUCAP and EU funding, Niger's laws and arrests, and economic alternatives, but gave no firm new commitments.
The Netherlands is urging the Red Cross and IOM to register that information better, so that left-behind family members can also be informed.
Nederland dringt er bij het Rode Kruis en de IOM op aan om die informatie beter te registreren, zodat ook achtergebleven familieleden geïnformeerd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het betalen door data te delen en de verkoop van consumentendata aan bedrijven en de overheid

An SP MP asked the ministers whether consumers should be allowed to obtain products or services free or discounted in exchange for sharing personal and social media data, and whether consumers are adequately informed about data sold to companies or government, including smart appliances. The minister answered that consumers must receive clear, complete information, that personal data processing requires consent under the Wbp and upcoming AVG, that the AP and ACM supervise compliance, and that government access to such data would require a formal legal basis.

If the government wants insight into the same information about the living environment of the home, Article 10(1) of the Constitution requires a statutory provision granting the government such a power.

Wil de overheid inzicht in diezelfde informatie over de leefomgeving van de woning, dan dient krachtens artikel 10, eerste lid, van de Grondwet, een wettelijke bepaling te bestaan die de overheid een dergelijke bevoegdheid toekent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het gescheiden uitzetten van ouders en kinderen

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether the separate deportation of an Armenian mother from her children, who remain in the Netherlands, is consistent with the child rights convention, and how often such separations occur. The State Secretary answered that separation is not the aim, that courts found the procedure lawful, that the children have been found and a guardianship process via Nidos is underway, and that separate deportations are exceptional but can be justified.
The DT&V information system cannot establish how often in the past cabinet period a parent was deported while the children remained behind.
Uit het informatiesysteem van de DT&V kan niet worden herleid hoe vaak het in de afgelopen kabinetsperiode is voorgekomen dat een ouder wordt uitgezet en de kinderen achterblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het falen van het kinderpardon

Dutch MP Jasper van Dijk asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about the expulsion of a mother without her children and the child-pardon (kinderpardon) rules, citing the best-interests-of-the-child principle and a motion calling for a more generous pardon. The State Secretary defended the expulsion as lawful under court rulings, said the children were found and are being supervised by Nidos, and refused to adopt a moratorium on expulsions pending a new cabinet.
The DT&V information system cannot establish how often a parent has been expelled and the children left behind during the past cabinet period.
Uit het informatiesysteem van de DT&V kan niet worden herleid hoe vaak het in de afgelopen kabinetsperiode is voorgekomen dat een ouder wordt uitgezet en de kinderen achterblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Van Toorenburg over het bericht 'COA informeert Nijmegen over aso-asielzoeker'

MPs Keijzer and Van Toorenburg asked whether the mayor of Nijmegen was not informed in advance about the placement of nuisance-causing asylum seekers, and whether all mayors should be notified beforehand. The Secretary of State said there is no direct prior notification, but local cooperation structures exist, and Nijmegen agreed with the police and the asylum chain on intensified information sharing, with two extra supervised locations opening in autumn.
Therefore the municipality of Nijmegen, the police and the asylum chain have made agreements on intensifying the integrated approach and the necessary information exchange.
Daarom hebben de gemeente Nijmegen, de politie en de vreemdelingenketen afspraken gemaakt over de intensivering van de geïntegreerde aanpak en de noodzakelijke informatieuitwisseling hierbij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Buitenweg en Jasper van Dijk over tralies bij de vluchtelingenopvang in de voormalige Bijlmerbajes

MPs asked whether the former Bijlmerbajes prison, used as a refugee shelter until December 2017, should have its bars removed given its detention character and the trauma of residents. The State Secretary answered that detention features were largely removed, the bars remain as external shading serving climate control, and COA sees no reason for further changes.
The bars now serve only as external shading and have not been removed, because they play an important role in climate control in the building.
De tralies dienen nu nog louter als externe zonwering en zijn niet verwijderd, omdat deze een belangrijke functie vervullen bij de klimaatbeheersing in het gebouw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over de berichten ‘Drugs en telefoons via luier baby de gevangenis in’ en ‘Modernisering om smokkelwaar’

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports of drugs and phones being smuggled into prison, asking whether promised measures are being taken and whether the inmate should be punished and denied leave. The State Secretary replied that a bill criminalising bringing prohibited objects into prisons is in consultation, that existing disciplinary sanctions apply, and that the prison director decides sanctions in individual cases.
The director of the institution determines which sanction is imposed; it is not appropriate for me to comment on individual cases.
De directeur van de inrichting bepaalt welke sanctie wordt opgelegd, het past mij niet uitspraken te doen over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht 'Krachtige luchtpistolen zomaar in de winkel'

An SP MP asked why powerful air weapons above 80 joules remain freely available and why the threshold is not lower, and questioned the lack of advertising limits. The State Secretary answered that a permit requirement for air weapons above 80 joules is planned, that advertising is not restricted beyond the Dutch Advertising Code, and that the 80-joule limit balances sport shooting needs and practical burdens.
I intend to amend the Wwm so that air weapons with a muzzle energy above 80 joules are added to article 2, Category III of the Wwm.
Ik ben voornemens om de Wwm zodanig te wijzigen dat luchtdrukwapens met een schotkracht hoger dan 80 joule, worden toegevoegd aan artikel 2, Categorie III van de Wwm.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Helder en Wilders over een aanranding door een Somalische asielzoeker in Hoorn

PVV MPs asked why a Somali asylum seeker was arrested only months after a sexual assault in Hoorn despite the victim's early tip, why he kept a residence permit while already a suspect, and whether his permit will be revoked. The state secretary explained the DNA-based arrest timeline, said the permit will be reviewed for withdrawal now that the conviction is final, and rejected calls to close borders.
Now that the judgment in this case has become final, the IND will examine whether the residence permit of the person concerned can be withdrawn.
Nu in deze zaak het vonnis onherroepelijk is geworden, zal de IND onderzoeken of de verblijfsvergunning van de betrokkene kan worden ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht “Twaalf verboden relaties medewerkers en patiënten in tbs-klinieken”

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of twelve prohibited relationships between staff and patients in forensic psychiatric (tbs) clinics, including whether young inexperienced staff make key decisions and how many leave days were granted in such cases. The state secretary answered that such relations are unacceptable, that decisions are taken collectively in multidisciplinary consultation with independent leave review, and that four staff members lost their jobs.
Antwoord op aanvullende vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht “Tbs’er pleegt zedenmisdrijf tijdens verlof”

MP Markuszower asks whether the State Secretary's use of the term 'patiënten' for tbs detainees is offensive and whether he will instead call them 'convicted criminals'. The State Secretary rejects both, stating that tbs detainees are patients because they have psychiatric disorders and receive medical treatment.
No. A patient is someone who is offered medical help in case of injury, illness or a disorder.
Nee. Een patiënt is iemand aan wie medische hulp wordt geboden in geval van letsel, ziekte of een aandoening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Raemakers over de toegenomen weigeringen van Verklaringen omtrent gedrag

MPs Groothuizen and Raemakers asked why VOG refusals rose from 0.35% to 0.4% in 2016, how many refusals concerned young people and work or internships, and whether a youth information campaign had started. The state secretary answered that the rise is within normal yearly fluctuation, gave refusal figures for under-23s, and described the new youth website, films, letters and festival outreach.
The share of refused VOG applications fluctuates somewhat each year, because the Justis Service assesses each application on its merits and does not steer towards refusal percentages.
Het aandeel geweigerde VOG-aanvragen fluctueert jaarlijks enigszins, omdat de Dienst Justis elke aanvraag inhoudelijk beoordeelt en niet stuurt op weigeringspercentages.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Maeijer over de 22 miljard euro die door de EU uitgetrokken is voor de migratiecrisis

MPs Fritsma and Maeijer asked about the EU's 22 billion euro for the migration crisis, including whether the Turkey deal is included, which recipients receive funds and for what purpose, results achieved, and rescue and return numbers. The minister answered in detail on budget categories, funding instruments, Frontex and EASO, rescue figures, and IOM voluntary return numbers, while noting that the Commission does not break down the 22 billion figure and that return figures for the Netherlands will follow later.
However, the Commission does not give in detail how it arrived at these amounts in the factsheet.
De Commissie geeft in het factsheet echter niet in detail aan hoe men tot deze bedragen is gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over uitzettingen van kinderen en jongvolwassenen naar Afghanistan in de demissionaire periode

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether child, young adult and vulnerable deportations to Afghanistan should be halted during the caretaker period, and how returnees are supported at Kabul airport. The State Secretary replied that the caretaker status gives no reason to stop existing policy, that returns follow careful procedures with individual assessment, and that voluntary return and reintegration support (IOM, ERIN Post Arrival Assistance) are available.
I see no reason in the caretaker status of the cabinet to stop implementing the existing policy.
Ik zie in de demissionaire status van het kabinet geen aanleiding om te stoppen met het effectueren van het bestaande beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over het bericht “Organisaties: Nederland doet te weinig voor Tsjetsjeense homo’s”

MPs Groothuizen and Sjoerdsma asked whether the Netherlands is doing enough for LGBTI people persecuted in Chechnya, including whether it funded shelters, how it treated an asylum-seeking journalist, and whether it will press Russia. The government answered that it has taken an international lead, funds small-scale first-line shelter in Russia, denies sending the journalist away, does not register asylum claims by sexual orientation, and will continue to raise the issue with Russia.
I cannot answer this question: the IND does not keep records of applications based on sexual orientation or ethnicity, or of applications based on conversion.
Op deze vraag kan ik geen antwoord geven: de IND houdt geen registratie bij van aanvragen op grond van seksuele gerichtheid of etniciteit dan wel van aanvragen op grond van bekering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Keijzer en Van Helvert over het bericht dat Nederland op het spoor is van contacten tussen hulporganisaties en smokkelbendes

MPs Knops, Keijzer and Van Helvert asked the ministers about reports that Dutch and German intelligence were tracking contacts between aid organisations and smuggling networks in the Mediterranean, and about EU operation Sophia and a near-collision with the Libyan coast guard. The government declined to discuss intelligence operations, said it awaits the outcome of an Italian fact-finding investigation, and noted that Sophia's mandate does not cover combating contacts between aid organisations and smugglers.
No public statements are made about operations of the Dutch intelligence services or about the exchange of information with partners.
Over operaties van de Nederlandse inlichtingendiensten en het uitwisselen van informatie met partners worden in het openbaar geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Jong, Fritsma en Wilders over 'Meer mensen in de bijstand'

PVV MPs asked whether rising welfare receipt among non-Western migrants, the welfare costs of immigration from Muslim countries, a ten-year residence requirement for social security, and closing borders to asylum seekers are justified. The government confirmed the trend, rejected the cost framing, said a welfare residence requirement would be disproportionate to its goals, and refused an asylum stop as contrary to international obligations.
The cabinet aims for a reasonable balance between preventing a pull effect on the one hand and income protection for those who have been in the Netherlands longer on the other.
Het kabinet streeft naar een redelijk evenwicht tussen het voorkomen van een aanzuigende werking enerzijds en inkomensbescherming voor degenen die al langer in Nederland zijn anderzijds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Maximaal 2 jaar cel'

An MP from the PVV asks why juveniles who commit serious murders can receive at most two years of youth detention, and whether adult criminal law should apply to 14-to-17-year-olds. The State Secretary defends the separate juvenile justice system, notes that adult law applies to 16-17-year-olds in only 45 cases in 2016, and rejects life sentences for minors, while pointing to intensive closed treatment (PIJ measure) as the tool for serious cases.
No, I do not share that view.
Nee, die mening deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Dode celbrand Scheveningen zat op psychiatrische afdeling'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security whether a prisoner set the fatal cell fire in Scheveningen and how contraband could enter the prison. The State Secretary corrected that the person was held in an ISD unit rather than a psychiatric ward, declined to discuss the cause citing security and privacy, pointed to internal calamity and security investigations shared with the Inspectorate, and said no link between contraband and fire has been shown.
Due to security within the penitentiary institution and privacy rights, I cannot go into the circumstances of the incident.
In verband met de veiligheid binnen de penitentiaire inrichting (PI) en het privacyrecht kan ik niet ingaan op de toedracht van het incident.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Doodrijder peuter liever in cel dan kliniek’

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about a news report that a fatal child-killing driver preferred prison to a psychiatric clinic, asking whether prison regimes should be made harsher, whether treatment refusers can be held in custody, whether 18 months' imprisonment is too lenient, and when minimum sentences will be introduced. The State Secretary answered that the regimes serve different purposes and no change is seen, that breaching probation conditions can lead to serving the remaining sentence, that compulsory admission under the Wet Bopz is possible, declined to judge a court ruling, and said minimum sentences are undesirable under the coalition agreement.
It is not appropriate for me to give a judgment on the ruling of an independent judge.
Het past mij niet een oordeel te geven over de uitspraak van een onafhankelijke rechter.
Vragen van het lid Markuszower (PVV) aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Tbs’er pleegt zedenmisdrijf tijdens verlof» (ingezonden 19 juni 2017).

The MP asked the state secretary about a tbs patient who committed a sex offence while on leave, whether he will be prosecuted, whether leave should have been granted, how many escapes and offences occurred, and whether tbs should be abolished. The state secretary confirmed the suspect is being prosecuted, defended the leave assessment procedure as thorough and independent, noted 32 escapes in 2016 and that leave is suspended for a year after an offence, and rejected abolishing tbs.

Every leave application is, in accordance with the rules, thoroughly assessed by an internal leave review committee of a tbs clinic and then by the Advisory Committee on Tbs Leave Assessment (AVT), which consists of experts and is fully independent.

Elke verlofaanvraag wordt, conform de regels, grondig getoetst door een interne verloftoetsingscommissie van een Tbs-kliniek en vervolgens door het Adviescollege Verloftoetsing Tbs (AVT), dat bestaat uit deskundigen en geheel onafhankelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat gezinshereniging voor Eritrese asielzoekers bijna onmogelijk is

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that family reunification for Eritrean asylum seekers has become nearly impossible, including long waiting times, documentation requirements and the IND's DNA/interview policy. The State Secretary answers largely by referring to earlier answers, gives average processing durations, states that the policy is careful rather than too strict, and denies a substantive change in grant rates.

The average duration between the grant of a provisional residence permit for family reunification (MVV) and the entry of a family member of a permit holder into the Netherlands cannot be generated from the IND systems.

De gemiddelde duur tussen de inwilliging van een machtiging tot voorlopig verblijf nareis (MVV) en de inreis van een familielid van een vergunninghouder in Nederland valt niet uit de IND-systemen te genereren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Tbs'er Mike J. in 2018 buiten de kliniek'

An MP from the PVV asked whether tbs (forensic psychiatric detention) patients suspected of high reoffending risk, such as a convicted murderer seen outside a clinic on leave, should never receive leave, and whether tbs should be abolished in favour of prison. The State Secretary rejected both demands, defending leave as a carefully assessed, phased resocialisation step and tbs as better at reducing reoffending than imprisonment.

Leave during tbs treatment is only possible after thorough assessment of the application by various parties, including the clinic's behavioural experts and the independent Advisory Committee on Tbs Leave Review (AVT).

Verlof tijdens de tbs-behandeling is alleen mogelijk na uitvoerige beoordeling van de aanvraag door verschillende partijen, waaronder de gedragsdeskundigen van de kliniek en het onafhankelijke Adviescollege Verloftoetsing Tbs (AVT).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat boetes aan buitenlandse goksites niet geïnd worden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice why administrative fines imposed on foreign online gambling sites go uncollected, how collection is blocked, and whether non-payment will count against future licence applications. The State Secretary answered that collection abroad is practically very difficult due to lack of international legal basis, that non-payment will weigh in future licence decisions, and that criminal enforcement and other measures are used, while denying that enforcement is deprioritised.
That certainly does not mean that such fines imposed have no consequences, because they can be weighed in a future licence application to offer remote gambling.

Dat betekent zeker niet dat dergelijke boetes die zijn opgelegd geen consequentie hebben, omdat deze kunnen worden meegewogen bij een toekomstige vergunningaanvraag om kansspelen op afstand aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Groothuizen over de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad dat vergaand onderzoek in smartphones privacy rechten schendt

MPs Groothuizen and Verhoeven asked how the Supreme Court's 4 April 2017 ruling on smartphone searches affects criminal investigations, whether it differs from the Computer Crime III bill, and whether a prompt statutory regime is needed. The minister answered that prosecutor authorisation is now generally required for searching seized phones, that the bill covers remote access rather than seizure, and that existing provisions suffice in most cases while new Code of Criminal Procedure rules are under consultation.

Following the Supreme Court ruling, from 4 April 2017 the main rule in criminal investigations is that, where the police seize independently, examining a seized smartphone or other electronic data carrier requires the prosecutor's authorisation.

Naar aanleiding van het arrest van de Hoge Raad geldt in strafrechtelijke onderzoeken vanaf 4 april 2017 als hoofdregel dat, indien sprake is van zelfstandig beslag door de opsporingsambtenaar, er voor het doen van onderzoek aan een inbeslaggenomen smartphone of andere elektronische gegevensdrager of geautomatiseerd werk, de toestemming van de officier van justitie voor dat onderzoek vereist is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht dat een levenslang gestrafte op verlof mag

An MP asked whether a life-sentenced murderer may be granted leave and why the government would not resist a tribunal ruling allowing it. The state secretary answered that his refusal of leave was overturned by the RSJ appeals commission, a new decision was issued, and leave will only be considered after September 2017 reports; he also said he cannot override the RSJ, which is the highest penitentiary court.
The RSJ is the highest court in penitentiary matters. No appeal lies against a ruling of this court.
De RSJ is de hoogste rechter in penitentiaire zaken. Tegen een uitspraak van deze rechter staat geen hoger beroep open.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de toename van het aantal afgewezen asielzoekers dat van de radar verdwijnt

An SP MP asks the State Secretary about the rise in rejected asylum seekers disappearing from view, the effect of cutting return support on Morocco and Algeria, and steps to secure forced returns. The government answers that departures without supervision cannot be equated with unlawful stay, that it prefers controlled return and is working with Morocco and Algeria, and that it wants more room for detention in EU rules.
By the nature of the matter, this cannot be ascertained.
Naar de aard van het vraagstuk is dit niet te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het terugsturen van kinderen naar Afghanistan

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice why children are being deported to Afghanistan despite a deteriorating security situation, high detention numbers of Afghan children, low asylum approval rates, the Joint Way Forward agreement, and the treatment of Hazara minors. The State Secretary largely defended the policy, stating that individual assessments ensure safe return, that the travel advice is aimed at Dutch travellers, that no exceptional situation exists under the Qualification Directive, and that no change to the policy is planned.
I see no reason to immediately stop deporting vulnerable groups to Afghanistan.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om direct te stoppen met het uitzetten van kwetsbare groepen naar Afghanistan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Jasper van Dijk over de beoordeling van homoseksualiteit door de IND

MPs Buitenweg and Van Dijk asked whether the IND's assessment of asylum claims based on homosexuality is fair, given that questioning about the origins of feelings and taboo conditions in countries of origin may be inappropriate. The State Secretary defended the IND's working instructions as consistent with case law and said they already account for taboos, while declining to change them.
I see no reason to amend the working instruction and the method based on it.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de werkinstructie en de daarop gebaseerde werkwijze aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over ernstige gezondheidsklachten bij medewerkers van het AZC in Ter Apel

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked the State Secretary and Health Minister about health complaints among COA staff at the Ter Apel asylum centre, including calls for deeper investigation and doubts about soil research. The State Secretary answered that 17 staff are currently on sick leave, that an independent commission of external experts has been set up to investigate the causes, and that soil studies found no contamination capable of causing the complaints.
The COA board has decided to set up an independent investigation committee with external experts.
Het bestuur van het COA heeft besloten tot het instellen van een onafhankelijke onderzoekscommissie met externe deskundigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Voortvluchtige criminelen ontlopen gevangenisstraf’

The MP asks whether convicted criminals who evade their prison sentences can be tracked down, whether execution limitation periods and a mandatory appearance at sentencing should be introduced, and whether the self-reporting procedure should be stricter and more police capacity provided. The Secretary of State says that all convicted persons must serve their sentence, explains the tracing and signalling approach and the differentiated limitation periods, rejects a statutory duty to appear and stricter sentencing for non-reporting, and promises a progress letter in summer 2017 and a new chain-management table with the police.
Yes, I share the view that no convicted criminal should evade their sentence.
Ja, ik deel het standpunt dat geen enkele veroordeelde crimineel zijn straf dient te ontlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over het bericht dat tientallen medewerkers van het asielzoekerscentrum Ter Apel al maanden thuiszitten

MPs Van Dijk and Laçin asked why only parts of the former NAVO terrain at the Ter Apel asylum centre were remediated, whether soil was tested when the centre was built, and whether COA, IND and other bodies should be ordered to carry out medical research into sick staff. The State Secretary answered that earlier soil studies found no health-relevant contamination, that a recent survey found none either, that COA has set up an independent commission, and that no broader medical study is currently planned.
For now I see no reason to instruct all other bodies working in or around the asylum centre to carry out such a study.
Vooralsnog zie ik geen aanleiding om alle andere instanties die werkzaam zijn in of rondom het asielzoekerscentrum op te dragen een dergelijk onderzoek te laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, De Graaf en Wilders over de berichtgeving dat er fouten zijn gemaakt bij de vrijstelling voor het inburgeringsvereiste

MPs Fritsma, De Graaf and Wilders asked why the IND failed to apply new rules, wrongly exempting thousands of migrants from the civic integration exam, and questioned the cost, grounds for not revoking permits, and the government's immigration policy. The State Secretary acknowledged the error, said the IND took corrective steps, defended that permits cannot be revoked for legal certainty reasons, and rejected the claim that the errors add burdens on public resources.
I regret that the IND did not test applications for a stronger residence right against the stricter civic integration requirements.
Ik betreur dat de IND bij verblijfsaanvragen om een sterker verblijfsrecht niet aan de verzwaarde inburgeringseisen heeft getoetst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het uitzetten van homoseksuele asielzoekers naar Irak

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice why gay asylum seekers from Iraq are being deported and whether IND assessment of sexual orientation is fair. The government defends its prima facie policy and the existing IND working instruction, rejects changing the burden of proof or creating a binding external commission, and does not commit to new action.
I do not share the view of the chairman of LGBT Asylum Support.
Ik deel de mening van de voorzitter van LGBT Asylum Support niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over de concentratiekampen voor homoseksuelen in Tsjetsjenië

MPs Karabulut and Jasper van Dijk asked the government how it responds to reports of concentration camps for gay men in Chechnya, including casualty figures, contacts with Russian authorities, Kremlin statements, asylum treatment of LGBTI refugees and Dutch leadership on LGBTI rights. The minister condemns the reports, describes Dutch diplomatic and multilateral efforts (EU, OSCE, Equal Rights Coalition, talks with Lavrov and the UN) and notes that LGBTI asylum seekers from Russia are treated as a risk group, while resettlement is a UNHCR decision.
Precise figures are not known, but various media and NGOs speak of 160 persons detained and at least 3 men who died during or after their detention.
Precieze cijfers zijn niet bekend maar verschillende media en ngo's spreken van 160 personen die gevangen zijn gezet en minimaal 3 mannen die tijdens of na hun gevangenschap zijn overleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat vluchtelingenkinderen in Griekenland geen andere uitweg zien dan seks voor geld

An MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice how the government responds to reports that refugee children in Greece and the Balkans are sexually exploited, and what is being done about the Harvard and Save the Children reports. The State Secretary answered that primary responsibility lies with Greece, that Dutch standards are high, that Nederland is pressing other member states on relocation including unaccompanied minors, and described EMPACT cooperation, while noting no cooperation with Greece on trafficking.
It is therefore in the first instance up to the Greek government to respond to this.
Het is in eerste instantie dan ook aan de Griekse overheid om hierop te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de behandeling van verzoeken tot gezinshereniging door de IND

MP Voordewind asked the State Secretary about long processing times, missed statutory deadlines, default-penalty notices, and refusals of family reunification applications by the IND. The State Secretary answered with processing-time and caseload figures, attributed delays mainly to case complexity and the high asylum inflow, and gave counts of notices and refusals while stating that refusal grounds could not be fully generated from IND systems.

The grounds for refusal in regular MVV-TEV family reunification cases include, among others, failure to meet the civic integration requirement, the income requirement, the passport requirement, public order, etc.
De afwijzingsgronden in reguliere MVV-TEV gezinsherenigingszaken zijn onder meer het niet voldoen aan het inburgeringsvereiste, het inkomensvereiste, paspoortvereiste, openbare orde etc.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Boodschappen doen op afstand in gevangenis Nieuwegein’

An MP asked the state secretary why prisoners in Nieuwegein can order groceries remotely and whether this undermines the purpose of imprisonment, and asked for measures to restrict such freedoms. The government replied that prisoners can only order from a government-set product list via internal prison shops, that the purchasing system will move to Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen from July 2017, and that it will not change the current rules.
In view of the foregoing, I do not intend to change the current rules regarding the purchase of necessities in penal institutions.
Gelet op het voorgaande ben ik niet voornemens om de huidige regels ten aanzien van het kopen van benodigdheden in Penitentiaire Inrichtingen te veranderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht dat er een dief met enkelband is opgepakt voor verkrachting

An MP asked the State Secretary whether an ankle-monitored offender who allegedly raped a woman should have served his sentence in prison, how the monitor failed, and whether minimum sentences and an end to early release should be introduced. The State Secretary replied that the ankle tag is a supervisory aid rather than a punishment, that it was not triggered because the offender did not breach his location order, that the government will not stop using tags, that early release is under review, and that imposing minimum sentences is undesirable.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Helder over twijfels bij het overlijden van een jongen in een instelling

MPs Agema and Helder asked about the death of a boy in an institution, the discontinued NODO procedure for investigating child deaths, its funding and responsibility, and 20 reported suspicious deaths submitted by relatives. The government answered that NODO was ended in 2014 after evaluation, replaced by the NODOK scheme focused on parents' grief, that in this case a non-natural death was established, and that further investigation would follow regular criminal procedures, without giving case details for privacy reasons.
Regarding further investigation in this specific situation, we cannot make any statements, in view of the privacy of the next of kin.
Over nader onderzoek in deze specifieke situatie kunnen wij, in het kader van de privacy van de nabestaanden, geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Laçin over de ICT-storing in het systeem van Amadeus waardoor overal ter wereld reserveringssystemen voor de luchtvaart uitvielen

MPs Hijink and Laçin asked about a worldwide Amadeus reservation system outage, its cause, possible data exposure, economic damage and cybersecurity safeguards. The government answered that a local hardware fault, not a hack, caused a brief outage with no data loss, and pointed to contractual arrangements and the forthcoming NIS directive implementation.
Resolving outages is of course the responsibility of the owner of the systems concerned, such as Amadeus.
Het verhelpen van storingen is uiteraard de verantwoordelijkheid van de eigenaar van desbetreffende systemen, zoals Amadeus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Fritsma over de handel in gestolen spullen door asielzoekers

Wilders and Fritsma asked the State Secretary why asylum seekers at the Delfzijl reception centre can trade stolen goods, why they are not arrested and deported, and whether the borders should be closed. The State Secretary answered that such trade is unacceptable, that COA has no concrete signals so far, that COA was asked to inform residents and enforce the visitor rules, and that he will not close the borders but will act against abuse of asylum law.
I have asked COA to remind residents of the opvanglocaties of the Dutch rules on selling stolen goods.
Ik heb het COA gevraagd om bewoners van de opvanglocaties te wijzen op de in Nederland geldende regels over de verkoop van gestolen goederen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de digitale veiligheid van bedrijven

MP Hijink (SP) asked the ministers whether companies are doing enough on digital security, what powers exist to enforce cybersecurity duties of care and whether self-regulation suffices. The government answers that it will actively promote the Cyber Security Raad handreiking, that enforcement is split between the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, civil courts and the ACM, that no data exist on negligent firms, and that stimulating duties of care is judged more effective than strict enforcement.
There is no insight into the number of companies that knowingly ignore their cybersecurity responsibilities or use exemption clauses.
Er bestaat geen inzicht in het aantal bedrijven dat hun verantwoordelijkheid voor wat betreft cybersecurity bewust negeert of ontsnappingsclausules hanteert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een mogelijke Libiëdeal

MP Van Dijk asked whether an EU deal with Libya comparable to the Turkey deal is being pursued, and about EU funds for the Libyan coast guard, mistreatment of migrants, detention conditions and an Italian deal with militias in southern Libya. The State Secretary answered that there is no deal like the Turkey statement, that EU cooperation aims to strengthen migration management and improve reception conditions, and that monitoring of funds and Italian bilateral efforts will be followed, without new binding commitments.
Due to the complex situation in Libya, however, it is not always possible to adequately verify such signals.
Door de complexe situatie in Libië is het echter niet altijd mogelijk om dergelijke signalen adequaat te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie vele afgewezen asielzoekers toch trakteert op een verblijfsvergunning

An MP from the PVV asked whether the state secretary granted residence permits in 31% of discretionary cases involving rejected asylum seekers, and whether this amounts to a covert general pardon that rewards overstaying and attracts asylum migration. The state secretary denied any general pardon policy, said each case is judged on its merits and the 31% is a snapshot, and said he uses the discretionary power only in specific, distressing circumstances, while noting that MPs sometimes initiate or support such requests.
I assess each individual case on its own merits.
Elke individuele zaak beoordeel ik op de eigen merites.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht dat een tv-programma over internationale kinderontvoering kinderbelangen zou opofferen aan kijkcijfers

An MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about reports that the TV programme RTL-Ontvoerd sacrificed children's interests for ratings, including whether the return of abducted children was assessed for their best interests and whether government cooperated with the programme. The State Secretary answered that the Central Authority only gave general information and held talks with the programme's makers, warned about risks of interfering in pending legal cases, and did not verify causal links to children's psychological problems.
In my view it would be too much to qualify this as "cooperation" with the programme.
In mijn ogen is het te zwaar om dit te kwalificeren als «medewerking» aan het programma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het programma Ontvoerd

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked whether the ministries of Foreign Affairs and Justice cooperated with the RTL programme Ontvoerd on child abduction, and raised concerns about child harm, due process and media interests. The state secretary answered that the Central Authority gave only general information in three meetings in 2012–2013, that the ministries were not involved in producing the programme, and that broadcasting and participation decisions rest with the broadcaster and parents.
As I indicated in answer to questions 1, 10 and 11, three meetings took place in 2012 and 2013 between officials of the Central Authority and the editorial team of RTL-Ontvoerd.
Zoals ik heb aangegeven in antwoord op de vragen 1, 10 en 11 hebben in 2012 en 2013 drie gesprekken plaatsgevonden tussen ambtenaren van de Centrale autoriteit en de redactie van RTL-Ontvoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht ‘smokkel in gevangeniswezen’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that prison staff are alarmed by smuggled phones, weapons and drugs, staff shortages and rising workload, and whether incidents are monitored. The State Secretary answered that a bill criminalising bringing prohibited items into prisons is in preparation, listed existing controls and staffing measures, said incident data is recorded but not centrally counted for inspections, and noted an Inspectorate report on contraband would be published soon.
Figures on the number of (un)performed cell inspections are not kept centrally.
Cijfers over het aantal (niet) uitgevoerde celinspecties worden niet centraal bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Bruins Slot over het bericht ‘Hoe criminelen Kluivert in de val lokten’

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a Volkskrant report on a betting syndicate that lured footballer Kluivert, asking about the syndicate's identity, licensing and enforcement by the Kansspelautoriteit. The government declined to give details citing an ongoing criminal investigation, stated that only reliable operators will be licensed, and said that rules restrict sponsorship and advertising targeting young people.
The syndicate you refer to is the subject of a criminal investigation by the Public Prosecution Service (investigation Feniks, see also answer 6).
Het syndicaat waar u in uw vraag naar verwijst is onderwerp van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie (onderzoek Feniks, zie ook antwoord 6).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht 'Drugsgebruik tbs-kliniek niet meer toegestaan'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether drug use is tolerated in tbs clinics, who is responsible, how it will be sanctioned, and when all clinics will be drug-free, and asked why tbs is not abolished. The government answered that drugs are not tolerated inside tbs clinics, that drug use is addressed in treatment plans and affects leave, that the inspectorates' follow-up on FPK De Woenselse Poort shows the drug policy was tightened, and that tbs is kept as a protective and treatment measure.
Within the walls of the tbs clinics in the Netherlands, drugs are not tolerated.
Binnen de muren van de tbs-klinieken in Nederland worden drugs niet gedoogd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Fritsma over het bericht dat al een miljoen Afrikanen onderweg zijn naar Europa

PVV MPs Wilders and Fritsma asked whether a reported million Africans en route to Europe, the projected growth of Africa's population, and calls to close Dutch borders to migrants from Islamic countries warranted action. State Secretary Dijkhoff answered that the cabinet lacks comparable figures, rejects closing borders as discriminatory and unrealistic, and describes EU and bilateral measures to address migration root causes and strengthen external borders.
The cabinet does not currently have comparable figures to those on which the former British ambassador based his claim.
Het kabinet beschikt op dit moment niet over vergelijkbare cijfers als die waarop de voormalige Britse ambassadeur zich baseert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Gesmokkelde telefoons kwamen via andere gevangenis’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports that smuggled phones entered a prison via another facility, and whether extra anti-smuggling measures (such as detection gates) should be applied in every prison. The State Secretary answered that prison directors decide on contraband measures, announced a bill criminalising bringing prohibited items into prisons, listed measures against continued criminal activity in detention, and promised to send an Inspectorate report with a policy response.
I will send this report, accompanied by a policy response, to your House soon.
Ik zal dit rapport vergezeld van een beleidsreactie snel aan uw Kamer toezenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Dat een levenslanggestrafte opheldering krijgt over gratie

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether reports that a life-sentenced prisoner would receive clarification about pardon should be stopped, and whether life sentences can be kept absolute despite European human rights case law. The State Secretary answered that under ECHR article 3 and the Dutch Supreme Court's 2016 ruling, life prisoners must have a real prospect of release, and that a new policy framework will keep life sentences imposable and enforceable while refusing to denounce the treaties.
To meet the ruling of the highest penitentiary judge, the ministerial regulation on temporary leave from the institution needs amending. I therefore intend to amend the regulation on that point.

Om tegemoet te komen aan het oordeel van de hoogste penitentiaire rechter behoeft de ministeriële Regeling tijdelijk verlaten van de inrichting aanpassing. Ik ben dan ook voornemens de regeling op dat punt aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders over het niet samengaan van massa-immigratie en onze verzorgingsstaat

The PVV MPs Fritsma and Wilders asked the State Secretary whether open borders are unsustainable given claims about welfare costs of immigration, and why the government does not publish the cost of migration by group, plus questions on Africa and closing borders to Islamic countries. The State Secretary declined to publish group-level cost accounts, pointed to earlier answers and existing policy, and refused to close the borders to asylum seekers from Islamic countries, citing international obligations.
The government does not evaluate citizens, but policy.
De overheid evalueert geen burgers, maar beleid.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld van het lid Voordewind over over het bericht dat vluchtelingen worden mishandeld langs en binnen de grenzen van de Europese Unie

MP Voordewind asked the ministers about an Oxfam Novib report on pushbacks and abuse of migrants at EU borders, asking whether the government would press Croatia, Hungary, Bulgaria, Serbia and Macedonia on rights and abuses and support more safe asylum routes.
