The government condemned violence against refugees, said enforcement of EU law rests primarily with the Commission, said Bulgaria's border protection does not imply abuse was state policy, and pointed to existing support for Serbia and Macedonia and to resettlement as the preferred route.
The cabinet condemns all forms of violence against refugees.
Het kabinet veroordeelt iedere vorm van geweld tegen vluchtelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer, Fritsma en Wilders over EU watertaxi’s die 8500 migranten redden

PVV MPs asked about reports that 8,500 migrants were rescued off Libya over Easter weekend, including how many were picked up by Frontex, Italy, NGOs and merchant ships, where they were landed, whether they are held in closed centres, whether terrorists could be among them, whether EU policy creates a pull effect, and whether the Netherlands will close its borders. The government confirmed the figures, said it lacks detailed data on each rescue, described hotspot screening and Europol checks, rejected border closure as neither a complete solution nor clearly feasible, and pointed to a broader EU approach with Libya.
The cabinet does not have detailed information on all rescue operations carried out by various vessels over the Easter weekend.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over gedetailleerde informatie over alle reddingsoperaties die in het paasweekend door verschillende schepen zijn uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Fritsma over de berichten 'Cijfers onder de pet' en 'Stempel nationale veiligheid excuus'

PVV MPs asked why police refused to share data on crimes by asylum seekers after a Telegraaf FOIA request, and whether this undermines police and mayors' information. The minister says the police initially interpreted the request narrowly, is re-assessing it with priority, and that information is shared with local authorities though no separate registration of asylum seekers' crimes exists.
In response to the Telegraaf's FOIA request, the police replied that they do not record the residence status of persons when arresting or stopping them.
Op het WOB-verzoek van de Telegraaf heeft de politie geantwoord dat zij bij aanhoudingen en staandehoudingen de verblijfstatus van betrokkenen niet registreert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Azmani over het bericht dat hulporganisaties mensensmokkelaars faciliteren

Two MPs from CDA and VVD asked whether NGOs rescuing migrants at sea cooperate with smugglers, whether Dutch organisations or subsidised groups are involved, and whether the government will act against such aid. The government says it has no evidence of direct contact between some NGOs and smugglers, welcomes Italian investigations, names Dutch NGOs without state subsidy, and says it will continue dialogue while stressing that the discussion belongs at EU level.
The cabinet has no indications that there is direct contact between some aid organisations and criminal smuggling networks.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over aanwijzingen dat er sprake zou zijn van rechtstreeks contact tussen sommige hulporganisaties en criminele smokkelbendes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat er generaties in Nederland geboren Molukkers stateloos zijn

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice how Moluccans born in the Netherlands can hold a Dutch passport without Dutch nationality, what the status and disadvantages of the facilities passport are, how many people are affected, and whether they can be informed and given free naturalisation. The government explains that the Facilities Act treats this group as Dutch, that since 1991 holders can obtain a passport stating Dutch nationality, that 1,289 people are registered as treated as Dutch, that the third-generation rule and free option/naturalisation exist, and that it will ask municipalities to inform applicants but will not actively contact the group.

To this end, municipalities and other passport-issuing authorities will, where necessary, be told to inform applicants who are registered as being treated as Dutch of this fact and ask whether they want a passport showing that treatment.

Met het oog daarop zullen de gemeenten en de andere paspoortverstrekkende autoriteiten er, voor zover nodig, op worden gewezen dat zij aanvragers die blijkens de basisregistratie personen als Nederlander worden behandeld, van dit feit op de hoogte stellen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over vakantievierende Eritreeërs

An MP from the PVV asked whether Eritrean refugees with asylum permits who travel back to Eritrea for holidays have had their permits revoked, what has been done to find them, and whether borders should be closed to all asylum seekers. The Secretary of State answered that checks since mid-2015 have revoked some tens of permits, none involving Eritreans among about 100 examined, that intensified checks will follow, and that the Netherlands will keep offering protection on moral and legal grounds.
In the coming period, checks will again be carried out more intensively on whether Eritreans are travelling back.
De komende tijd zal opnieuw intensiever worden gecontroleerd of er sprake is van terugreizende Eritreeërs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht dat Eritrese vluchtelingen op vakantie gaan naar Eritrea

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that Eritrean refugees holiday in Eritrea, whether this shows they no longer fear persecution, and what checks exist on returning refugees. The State Secretary explains that residence permits for limited-term refugees are normally revoked after return visits, that checks found no Eritreans among those examined, and that cross-border information exchange with Belgium and Germany has started, but declines to change asylum policy for Eritrea now.
When it is established that aliens holding an asylum permit for a limited period have visited their country of origin, the IND generally starts a revocation procedure.
Als wordt geconstateerd dat vreemdelingen met een asielvergunning voor bepaalde tijd hun herkomstland hebben bezocht dan start de IND in de regel een intrekkingsprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer, Sjoerdsma en Bisschop over het bericht "Zorgeloos in Eritrea"

MPs asked whether Eritrean refugees holding asylum status who travel back to Eritrea should lose their status, how often this is checked and enforced, and whether travel can be traced. The State Secretary says such travel can trigger review or withdrawal of temporary permits, reports withdrawals of a few dozen permits, no Eritreans among checked cases, and that tracing all Eritrean travellers is not possible.
It is not possible to determine how many Eritreans from the Netherlands have travelled to Eritrea or neighbouring countries in recent years.
Het is niet mogelijk om te achterhalen hoeveel Eritreeërs uit Nederland de afgelopen jaren naar Eritrea of omringende landen zijn gereisd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het bericht dat de VN-vluchtelingenorganisatie UNHCR wil dat Europese lidstaten stoppen met het terugsturen van asielzoekers naar Hongarije

MP Buitenweg (GroenLinks) asked the State Secretary whether the Netherlands still returns asylum seekers to Hungary under the Dublin rules after UNHCR urged suspension of such transfers, and how the government is pressing Hungary to comply with EU and international law. The State Secretary answered that the Netherlands currently transfers no asylum seekers to Hungary, citing a Council of State ruling and Hungarian interpretation issues, and said the Commission is handling Hungary's compliance while the Netherlands raises the issue bilaterally and supports reform of the common European asylum system.
The Netherlands currently does not transfer asylum seekers to Hungary under the Dublin Regulation.
Nederland draagt momenteel geen asielzoekers over aan Hongarije, in het kader van de Dublinverordening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over 1 jaar Turkijedeal

An MP asked the State Secretary about the state of the EU-Turkey deal one year on, including the amount of the promised funds disbursed, the situation of refugees stuck in Greece, the use of EU funds for reception in Greece, and allegations of corruption raised by a whistleblower. The government answered that the deal has significantly reduced crossings and drownings, that EUR 777 million of the first EUR 3 billion tranche has been disbursed and the Netherlands has contributed EUR 93.9 million, and that it monitors fund use through the Commission, which handles any suspected irregularities via OLAF.
I am not aware of contacts the interviewed former official may have had with the President of the European Commission.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van contacten die de geïnterviewde oud-ambtenaar zou hebben gehad met de voorzitter van de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Verdachte hotelmoord voortvluchtige TBS’er’

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a fugitive TBS (forced psychiatric treatment) patient suspected of a hotel killing in Arnhem, including how leave is granted, the Adviescollege Verloftoetsing's failures, and whether the TBS system should be abolished. The State Secretary answered that leave is assessed carefully by the clinic, the AVT and the Minister, that the case is under investigation by the prosecutor and an internal review by the clinic, that the police search was regrettable, and that the government sees no reason to abolish TBS, citing recidivism figures.
The investigation into the bodies found on 23 March 2017 in the vacant hotel in Arnhem is still ongoing. I first want to await the outcomes of these investigations.
Het onderzoek naar de op 23 maart 2017 aangetroffen lichamen in het leegstaande hotel in Arnhem is nog in volle gang. Ik wil de uitkomsten van deze onderzoeken eerst afwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de integratie van nieuwkomers

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment and the State Secretary of Security and Justice about delays in integrating asylum seekers and recognised refugees, including whether language and integration training could start earlier. The Minister replied that the government is accelerating integration through earlier voorinburgering, better municipal matching, regional coordinators, and a cohort study, while acknowledging the 2015 backlog and emergency-shelter problems.
Newcomers who are allowed to stay must participate as quickly as possible.
Nieuwkomers die mogen blijven moeten zo snel mogelijk meedoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over een nieuwe lokatie voor illegalenopvang in Groningen

An MP asks the state secretary why municipalities may keep sheltering migrants without a right to stay, undermining return policy, and whether he will stop a new shelter in Groningen and cut the municipal fund. The state secretary declines to block the Groningen shelter or cut the municipal fund, since no legal norm prohibits such shelter, while he is exploring legal means and says the state no longer funds it since December 2016.
Neither the Aliens Act nor any other legislation or regulation currently prohibits municipalities from providing shelter to foreigners who no longer lawfully reside in the Netherlands.
De vreemdelingenwet, noch andere wet- en regelgeving kent op dit moment een verbod op opvang door gemeenten van vreemdelingen die niet langer rechtmatig in Nederland verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht “Uitzettingen lopen spaak”

PVV MP Fritsma asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice how he assesses the reported stalling of deportations of rejected asylum seekers through repeated applications and appeals, how many remain in the Netherlands as a result, and whether he will close the borders. The State Secretary Dijkhoff answered that appeals rose 66% in 2016 mainly due to higher rejection rates and IND output, that second and later applications fell 15%, pointed to targeted measures and a pilot, and rejected an asylum stop as contrary to international obligations.
I attach importance to a careful asylum procedure that offers protection to those who need it.
Ik hecht aan een zorgvuldige asielprocedure die bescherming biedt aan degenen die dat nodig hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Verdachte van verkrachting meisje komt niet opdagen, zaak uitgesteld’

An MP asked why a suspect in a child rape case was released after the court refused pre-trial detention, and what the minister would do about the judge's decision. The minister said it is not for the minister to comment on decisions of an independent court, and that the criminal investigation is ongoing so no statements can be made.
It is not for me as Minister of Security and Justice to intervene in decisions taken by an independent judicial body.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie om te treden in beslissingen genomen door een onafhankelijk rechterlijk college.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Van Nispen over de aanstaande voorkeurspeiling onder gedetineerden voor de vaststelling van het aanbod van geestelijke verzorging binnen justitiële inrichtingen

MPs Verhoeven and Van Nispen asked whether the new preference survey among detainees on prison chaplaincy would reflect their real needs, including non-religious care, and whether the humanist option should be labelled non-religious. The Secretary of State answered that all detainees receive the survey in 14 languages with an information leaflet explaining the options, that humanist care is described as non-religious there, and that results will be discussed with DJI and reported to the House.
Yes, I will discuss the results of the preference survey with DJI and then inform the House.
Ja, ik zal de resultaten van de voorkeurspeiling met DJI bespreken en daarna de Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voortman, Voordewind en Sjoerdsma over de voorgestelde versobering van opvang van asielzoekers in Griekenland

Four MPs asked the State Secretary about a proposed tightening of reception for asylum seekers in Greece under the EU-Turkey deal Joint Action Plan, and Human Rights Watch's criticism. The government answered that the JAP aims to speed up asylum procedures and improve safety and reception capacity, denied that Greece is a policy laboratory, and said it expects no worse conditions or longer stays on the islands.

The government does not expect a severe deterioration of conditions for people on the Greek islands or longer stays, because the JAP also works on faster and more efficient Greek asylum procedures and more regular returns to Turkey.

Het kabinet verwacht geen grove verslechtering van de situatie voor de mensen of een langere verblijfsduur op de Griekse eilanden, omdat onder het JAP ook wordt gewerkt aan bijvoorbeeld het sneller en efficiënter verlopen van de Griekse asielprocedures en terugkeer naar Turkije op regelmatiger basis.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat Duitsland voorstellen heeft gedaan om minder rekening te houden met mensenrechten zodat migranten kunnen worden teruggestuurd naar Noord-Afrikaanse landen om d

MP Voortman (GroenLinks) asked the ministers whether they knew of German proposals to weaken human-rights safeguards so migrants could be returned to North African countries to await asylum decisions, and whether the government would oppose such proposals. The state secretary replied that the government was aware, that international and European human-rights obligations frame the German proposal, that it would review safe-third-country conditions critically, and that it would keep international migration law central, without committing to any specific step against the proposal.

The government is of the view that the situation in a third country must always be assessed to determine whether that country, now or in future, can be considered safe in accordance with the applicable European and international legal frameworks.

Het kabinet is van mening dat steeds op basis van de situatie in een derde land moet worden bezien of dit land, nu of in de toekomst, als veilig kan worden bestempeld conform de geldende Europees- en internationaalrechtelijke kaders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie over humanitaire visa

MP Voordewind asked the State Secretary about the CJEU ruling of 7 March 2017 on humanitarian visas, which says member states are not obliged to issue them under the Visa Code, and asked which states issue them, whether the Netherlands has such a procedure, and whether it will issue them to Syrians in Turkey. The government answered that the Netherlands issues no territorially limited short-stay humanitarian visas for stays over 90 days, that such a procedure existed only until 2003, and that resettlement via UNHCR and the EU-Turkey statement is the preferred route, with about 710 Syrians resettled from April 2016 to March 2017.
The Netherlands therefore does not issue territorially limited short-stay visas to persons who wish to stay here for longer than 90 days.
Nederland verstrekt daarom geen territoriaal beperkte visa voor kort verblijf aan personen die hier langer dan 90 dagen willen verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over het bericht dat medische zorg op Lesbos ondermaats is

MP Maij (PvdA) asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about reports that medical care for migrants on Lesbos is inadequate, and whether the government would act on the situation and press EU partners to send asylum experts and share the burden. The government answered that it had received no direct signals of shortages, pointed to existing medical providers and EU emergency funding, said Greece bears primary responsibility, and reported that it was pressing other member states for more relocations and EASO/Frontex capacity.
The cabinet has not received any direct signals regarding shortages of medical care, medicines and treating doctors in the reception facilities.
Het kabinet heeft geen directe signalen ontvangen met betrekking tot de tekorten aan medische zorg, medicijnen en behandelend artsen in de opvangfaciliteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over gezinshereniging voor Surinaamse ouderen

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the 2012 abolition of the family reunification scheme for elderly people left behind in Suriname disproportionately affects Surinamese elderly, whether the scheme should be restored, and how many such applications were made. The State Secretary said there is no nationality distinction, that Article 8 ECHR and discretionary appeals remain available, that no reintroduction is planned, and that 20 applications by Surinamese aged 65+ were filed in 2015-2016.
However, I cannot estimate the size of the group of Surinamese single elderly aged 65 or older who have not submitted an application.
Ik kan echter geen inschatting geven van de omvang van de groep Surinaamse alleenstaande ouderen van 65 jaar of ouder die geen aanvraag hebben ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de berichten dat Hongarije en Oostenrijk buiten de EU om immigratiebeleid willen gaan voeren

MP Voortman asked whether the government knows of Hungary's plans to detain asylum seekers and of Austria's proposal to process asylum claims outside the EU, and how it will respond. The State Secretary confirmed awareness, said the Commission will examine Hungary's law and the government is concerned, and pointed to the Commission and Malta's presidency as the channels for EU-wide asylum reform, without committing to new national steps.
It is up to the European Commission to monitor compliance with EU law and regulations.
Het is aan de Europese Commissie om toe te zien op de naleving van EU wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het vragen naar de geaardheid van asielzoekers door het COA

An SP MP asked whether COA staff question asylum seekers about their sexual orientation, after reports from LHBT residents at Ter Apel. The State Secretary replied that no formal complaints were received, that such questions are not customary but may arise in sensitive individual conversations, and that COA has no task to collect information on sexual orientation.
COA has not received any formal complaints from LHBT residents of the Ter Apel asylum centre about COA conduct regarding their sexual orientation.
Het COA heeft geen formele klachten ontvangen van LHBT-bewoners van het asielzoekerscentrum in Ter Apel over gedragingen van het COA met betrekking tot hun geaardheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over naturalisatie van kinderen van RANOV vergunninghouders

An MP asked the State Secretary about naturalisation of children of RANOV permit holders, including identity document requirements and the Swedish model. The government answered that Dutch rules balance identity checks with flexibility, rejected easing for children of pardon-permit holders, and declined to adopt the Swedish approach while noting case-by-case exceptions.

I assess the Dutch regulations as sufficiently balanced between the foreigner's interest in obtaining Dutch nationality and preventing, as far as possible, naturalisation based on incorrect personal details and/or incorrect nationality.

Ik beoordeel de Nederlandse regelgeving als voldoende afgewogen tussen het belang van de vreemdeling op het verkrijgen van de Nederlandse nationaliteit en het zo veel mogelijk voorkomen dat naturalisatie tot Nederlander plaats vindt op onjuiste persoonsgegevens en/of onjuiste nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Voortman, Sjoerdsma en Gesthuizen over de 9e rapportage van de Europese Commissie over relocatie en hervestiging van vluchtelingen

MPs asked the State Secretary about the Commission's 9th relocation report, including the number of asylum seekers eligible for relocation from Greece and how Dutch refusals were justified. The State Secretary answered that about 20,000 relocation candidates are now present in Greece, that roughly 20 cases were refused on public order or national security grounds, and that the 10th report will clarify figures.
That is why the Cabinet considers it important to communicate about this consistently and unambiguously.
Daarom vindt het Kabinet het belangrijk om hier steeds helder en eenduidig over te communiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat er gesjoemeld wordt bij de reclassering

An MP asked whether the state secretary would release the results of investigations into alleged misconduct at Reclassering Den Haag and whether the probation service's financial audit was external. The state secretary replied that two independent investigations (KPMG and the DJI integrity bureau) found no sign of informal trade, but the reports belong to Reclassering Nederland and will not be released by the ministry.
RN is the commissioning party and owner of the reports; therefore I do not possess the investigation reports and it is not for me to make them public.
RN is opdrachtgever en eigenaar van de rapporten; zodoende ben ik niet in het bezit van de onderzoeksrapporten en is het niet aan mij deze openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Vuurwapen en munitie in cel gedetineerde” en het bericht “Drie overvallen tijdens verlof met enkelband

An MP asked why a convicted murderer was moved to a half-open facility with weekend leave, how a gun and ammunition got into his cell, and whether an ankle monitor is adequate given reported robberies during leave. The Secretary of State defended the placement rules and the monitoring, said the incident is regretted, and declined to confirm the suspicion but promised to send answers after an ongoing internal investigation.
Given the ongoing investigation and the privacy of the person concerned, I will not comment on this.
Gelet op het lopende onderzoek en de levenssfeer van de betrokkene doe ik hierover geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Gevangene heeft wapen met munitie in zijn cel’

MP Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether a prisoner on leave under electronic monitoring could commit armed robberies, and how a firearm and ammunition were found in his cell and a Kalashnikov in his car. The State Secretary declined to confirm the arrest or comment on the ongoing investigation, said he regretted the events, pointed to an ongoing DJI security investigation at Ter Peel, and rejected tightening conditional release rules because the prisoner was not on conditional release.
DJI is currently conducting a security investigation at ZBBI Ter Peel. Depending on the outcome of the investigation, it will be considered whether procedures need to be revised or tightened.
Momenteel voert DJI een veiligheidsonderzoek uit in de ZBBI Ter Peel. Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek wordt bezien of er procedures herzien of aangescherpt moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het terugsturen van kinderen naar Afghanistan

The SP MP Gesthuizen asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about returning Afghan children to Afghanistan, including the Joint Way Forward agreement, the child-rights risks, adequate reception, return interviews and protection of unaccompanied minors from exploitation. The State Secretary Dijkhoff answered that the agreement sets no numbers, that the asylum procedure protects those in need, that adequate reception is assessed case by case, and that EU cooperation addresses trafficking, while promising to answer each question separately.
The Joint Way Forward contains no agreements on numbers of returnees.
De Joint Way Forward bevat geen afspraken over aantallen terugkeerders.
Antwoord op vragen die van de leden Voordewind, Voortman , Sjoerdsma en Gesthuizen (SP) over de motie inzake de Regeling langdurig verblijvende kinderen

MPs asked whether the government would accept that citing the coalition agreement does not justify ignoring an adopted motion, and whether it would impose a deportation stop for long-resident asylum children until a new cabinet forms. The Secretary of State says the coalition agreement was not decisive, but declines to amend the Regeling or impose a deportation stop, citing disruption of removal procedures and raised expectations.
However, I did not want to leave out of the letter my observation that the motion is at odds with the coalition agreement.
Ik heb echter de constatering dat de motie op gespannen voet staat met het regeerakkoord niet achterwege willen laten in de brief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Van Tongeren over de registratie van geweld tegen vluchtelingen

MPs Voortman and Van Tongeren asked whether figures on violence against refugees and asylum seekers exist, whether police will record the victim's status, and how reporting is encouraged. The Minister answered that police record whether an offence is discriminatory, that the 2015 discrimination figures were sent to parliament, that efforts to raise reporting willingness continue, and rejected the claim that racist violence is structurally under-recognised.
Police officers must record all reports and complaints of discrimination and incidents in which a discriminatory aspect may be present.
Politieagenten dienen alle aangiften en meldingen van discriminatie en van incidenten waarin mogelijk een discriminatoir aspect aanwezig is, te registreren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat de EASO onervaren uitzendkrachten inzet in Griekenland, omdat de EU-landen hun belofte om voldoende asielexperts te leveren nog steeds niet nakomen

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary about reports that EASO deploys inexperienced temporary staff in Greece because EU states have not supplied enough asylum experts, and about the Dutch contribution to Frontex and EASO. The State Secretary answered that Greece is primarily responsible, that EASO is recruiting local staff, that the Netherlands is among the top contributors and that other member states must increase their contributions.
The cabinet will continue to raise this issue with other member states, both in bilateral contacts and during the Council meetings.
Het kabinet zal hiervoor aandacht blijven vragen bij andere lidstaten, zowel in bilaterale contacten als tijdens de Raden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Keijzer en Ten Broeke over uitspraken van de president van Mali over terugname van uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers en illegalen

MPs from CDA and VVD asked the ministers whether Mali's president's statements that Mali would never sign a readmission agreement undermined the EU-Mali migration deal and whether Mali was cooperating enough on returning its nationals, and whether pressure or aid conditionality should be used. The government answered that the joint declaration remains valid, that Mali is bound by international law to cooperate on returns, that only about ten Malians returned voluntarily since 2014 and none forcibly, and that it prefers a broad pragmatic approach over negative incentives such as cutting aid.
The cabinet is of the view that measures to encourage this cooperation are most effective when they are part of a broader package.
Het kabinet is van mening dat maatregelen om deze medewerking te stimuleren het effectiefst zijn als zij onderdeel zijn van een breder pakket.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Voordewind over het bericht dat de UNHCR gehinderd wordt door Turkije in de monitoring van de vluchtelingendeal

MPs Gesthuizen and Voordewind asked about reports that UNHCR lacks unhindered access to Turkish reception centres and to monitor returned migrants under the EU-Turkey deal, and about deaths at the Syrian border. The minister replied that access is a recurring topic with Turkey and the Commission, that there is no systematic refusal, that the government cannot confirm the reported shooting deaths, and that it will keep raising access in the Commission's regular reporting.
The Netherlands will therefore continue to press the Commission that regular access forms part of the joint approach, and that this receives attention in the regular reporting.
Nederland zal dan ook bij de Commissie blijven bepleiten dat regelmatige toegang deel uitmaakt van de gezamenlijke aanpak, en dat daarvoor bij de reguliere rapportage aandacht bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Van Nispen over het onterechte gijzelen van wanbetalers van boetes

MPs Recourt and Van Nispen asked whether debtors who cannot pay fines are wrongly subjected to imprisonment (gijzeling) and whether the prosecution uses it as a pressure tool, citing a critical column and the Ombudsman report. The State Secretary replied that gijzeling should target only those able but unwilling to pay, that the new prosecution approach has reduced and better-motivated claims, and that the CJIB and prosecution are improving referral and payment arrangements.
The OM and CJIB are working to further improve the process and will inform me further about the new approach and the outcomes.
Het OM en het CJIB werken aan het verder verbeteren van het proces en zullen mij over de nieuwe werkwijze en de uitkomsten nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voortman, Sjoerdsma en Voordewind over het illegaal de grens overzetten van migranten naar Servië

MPs from SP, GroenLinks, D66 and ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary about reports that migrants are illegally pushed back across the border from Hungary and Croatia into Serbia, with police violence, and about reception shortfalls in Serbia, EU responsibility and safe routes. The government condemns violence against refugees, says the Commission is primarily responsible for enforcing EU law and that Serbia has enough reception capacity, and declines to start resettlement from Serbia or to take a new EU initiative.
The cabinet condemns all forms of violence against refugees.
Het kabinet veroordeelt iedere vorm van geweld tegen vluchtelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het terugsturen van kinderen naar Afghanistan

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about returning Afghan children (including unaccompanied minors) under the EU-Afghanistan Joint Way Forward, given child rights violations, adequate reception, and trafficking risks. The State Secretary answered that the arrangement sets operational terms without quotas, that return of unaccompanied minors prioritises family reunification with adequate reception as a condition, that DT&V uses regular return counsellors and interpreters, and that EU cooperation against trafficking continues, without committing to new measures.
The document contains no agreements on numbers of returnees.
Het document bevat geen afspraken over aantallen terugkeerders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de aanpak van matchfixing in het tennis

MP Van Dekken asked the ministers whether the national matchfixing platform is adequate, whether the Public Prosecution Service should take a more active role given the limits of sports-body disciplinary rules, and whether betting on lower-tier Future tournaments should be banned. The minister defended the platform as a structured information-sharing forum, rejected a change in prosecution approach citing no signals of inadequacy, and said the risk exists at all levels and will be limited through rules under the online gambling bill.
I have committed to informing you further on this before summer 2017.
Ik heb toegezegd u hier voor de zomer 2017 nader over te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht “Forse kritiek op uitspraak Raad van State inzake Iraanse bekeerling”

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about criticism of a Council of State ruling on an Iranian convert, including the claim that the Rambo model was wrongly treated as the sole basis for assessing conversion and whether experts are sufficiently consulted. The State Secretary replied that the IND uses a broader set of insights than the Rambo model, consults experts where needed, and is not obliged under the Procedures Directive to consult experts routinely.
The IND has previously been in contact with Ms Van Saane and will continue to do so in the future.
De IND heeft eerder contact gehad met mevrouw Van Saane en zal dat in de toekomst ook blijven doen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de uitspraak van de Vreemdelingenkamer van de Raad van State van 30 december 2016, over een Iraanse vreemdeling die bekering tot het christendom aanvoerde als reden om te vr

An MP asked the State Secretary how the IND handles conversion claims in asylum cases, whether asylum seekers can use experts, and why the IND did not commission its own expert after a Council of State ruling on an Iranian convert. The State Secretary answered that the IND draws on expert and church input, that asylum seekers may consult experts and submit reports, and that the IND weighs such reports but may still find a conversion not credible with proper reasoning.
The European Court of Human Rights has classified the investigative method used by the IND as surrounded by sufficient safeguards and careful.
Het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens (EHRM) heeft de onderzoeksmethode die de IND hanteert, aangemerkt als met voldoende waarborgen omkleed en zorgvuldig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat burgemeesters af willen van kansloze asielzoekers

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security how to respond to reports that mayors want to be rid of rejected asylum seekers causing nuisance, including Dublin procedure risks, EU pressure on origin countries, numbers of nuisance-causing asylum seekers, and mayors' powers. The State Secretary answered that a package of tougher measures, case-based local cooperation and EU-level pressure on origin countries are in place or being pursued, while acknowledging returns cooperation with Morocco and Algeria is limited and complex.
As communicated to your House on 17 January 2017, during the New Year's period a total of 340 immigration-law measures, area bans, were imposed on nuisance-causing asylum seekers.

Zoals op 17 januari 2017 aan uw Kamer is gecommuniceerd, is er tijdens de jaarwisseling uiteindelijk 340 maal een vreemdelingrechtelijke maatregel – gebiedsgebod- opgelegd aan overlastgevende asielzoekers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Maij over het bericht dat het COA niks zou doen tegen homo-hatende asielzoekers

Two MPs asked the State Secretary whether COA staff fail to intervene against asylum seekers who threaten LGBT residents, and how such conduct is addressed, protected and prevented. The government denies the picture, describes its sanctions, reporting and staff-coordination measures, and sees no reason for additional measures.
The picture that COA staff would not intervene against residents threatening LGBT residents is, however, not one I recognise.
Het beeld dat medewerkers van het Centraal Orgaan opvang asielzoekers (COA) niet zouden ingrijpen richting bewoners die LHBT-bewoners bedreigen herken ik echter niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over Eritrese ambassades (Herdruk)

MPs Gesthuizen asked whether the Eritrean embassy's requirements (a repentance form and 2% diaspora tax) for passport renewal, and refusals to help Eritrean women, were acceptable and what the government would do. The State Secretary answered that the government considers linking consular services to repentance forms objectionable, has raised the issue with Eritrea and adopted a sanctions-based ban on tax collection involving coercion, and will raise concerns with European partners.
The Cabinet considers linking consular services to signing repentance forms objectionable.
Het Kabinet acht de koppeling van consulaire dienstverlening aan het tekenen van spijtbetuigingsformulieren laakbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de petitie ‘Breng onze kinderen terug: Farhiya, Sabarina, Safa, Saidomar en Sajwah’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the Dublin transfer of a mother of five to Italy after seven years in the Netherlands, and why cooperation criteria apply to child-pardon claims when no cooperation is needed for Dublin transfers, plus whether the best interests of the child are adequately safeguarded. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case for privacy reasons, said the asylum seeker must actively cooperate with transfer, and stated the definitive children's regulation is deliberately restrictive while the best interests of the child are one interest weighed against others.
For privacy reasons I cannot go into the individual circumstances of this case.
Vanwege privacyaspecten kan ik niet ingaan op de individuele omstandigheden in deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Kooiman over alleenstaande minderjarige vreemdelingen die slachtoffer worden van mensenhandel en uitbuiting

MPs Gesthuizen and Kooiman asked about the Save the Children report on unaccompanied minor victims of trafficking in Italy, the rise in Nigerian minors arriving via Italy, whether the Netherlands bears special responsibility, Albania's EU accession and anti-trafficking cooperation with Italy and the Balkans. The Minister described the figures as worrying, pointed to EMPACT THB cooperation, liaison officers and joint investigations, and said Albania is not yet ready to open accession negotiations.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over het bericht dat door de extreme kou in vluchtelingenkampen, de situatie onhoudbaar is geworden

An MP from the Labour Party asked the State Secretary whether the government would act urgently on reports that cold weather had made conditions in Greek refugee camps unbearable, and what Dutch and EU support was being provided. The government answered that the Netherlands contributes through the EU emergency aid instrument (part of EUR 198 million in 2016) plus an extra EUR 100,000 to local Greek NGOs, and that the European Commission and UNHCR are working on shelter for vulnerable migrants.
The Netherlands contributes via the European emergency aid instrument to the reception of migrants in Greece.
Nederland draagt via het Europese noodhulpinstrument bij aan de opvang van migranten in Griekenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Grashoff over het bericht dat de Griekse asielopvang verre van winterbestendig is

MPs Voortman and Grashoff asked about reports that Greek asylum reception is not winter-proof, including Dutch support, conditions in Serbia, tents on Greek islands, relocation delays for unaccompanied minors and the Dutch relocation share. The State Secretary answered that Netherlands contributed funds via EU and bilateral channels, that Greece and Serbia are improving winter shelter, that relocation time limits apply, and that Dutch relocation share grows up to the Council maxima.
The cabinet considers it important that member states, like the Netherlands, respect this maximum period.
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk dat lidstaten, net als Nederland, deze maximale termijn respecteren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over het online aanbieden van kansspelen door Holland Casino

An MP asked whether Holland Casino's promotional 'five card draw' online game, linked from advertising, constitutes an unlicensed online gambling offer and whether it complies with advertising rules and the Kansspelautoriteit has investigated. The State Secretary answered that it is a promotional game under the Gedragscode promotionele kansspelen with no stake required, that the Kansspelautoriteit saw no reason for further investigation, and that online gambling requires the separate Wet kansspelen op afstand which is not yet in force.
The Kansspelautoriteit (ksa) has taken note of this promotional action by Holland Casino and has informed me that it sees no reason for further investigation.
De Kansspelautoriteit (ksa) heeft kennisgenomen van deze promotionele actie van Holland Casino en heeft mij laten weten geen aanleiding te zien tot nader onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht "Asielcheck totaal fiasco"

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister and State Secretary of Security and Justice why the promised inspection report on asylum identification was delayed until December, why phone and data-carrier checks are not always fully carried out due to time, capacity and equipment limits, and whether the registration process can detect trafficking and terrorism signals. The government answers that the inspection finds the process now carefully executed with some improvement points, that devices are largely in order, that the delay was due to a procedural cycle with a publication on 21 December, and that further measures and a follow-up inspection on signal handling are underway.

With this, the commitment made by the Minister of Security and Justice during the General Consultation on Counterterrorism of 24 November 2016 to send the Inspection report with policy response to the House of Representatives before the Christmas recess has been fulfilled.

Daarmee is voldaan aan de toezegging van de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie tijdens het Algemeen Overleg Terrorismebestrijding van 24 november 2016 om het Inspectierapport met beleidsreactie nog voor het kerstreces aan de Tweede Kamer te zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over reclasseringswerkers die de regels overtreden

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports of reclassering staff selling offender-made furniture off the books and letting an offender work on a private project, and about management's handling of earlier whistleblower complaints. The State Secretary confirmed that external investigations found cash sales against agreements, said staff were re-instructed, saw no grounds to doubt the director's conduct, and pointed to existing integrity codes and whistleblower channels.
I have no reason to doubt the conduct of the director of RN in this matter.
Ik heb geen aanleiding te twijfelen aan het handelen van de directeur van RN in dezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over reclasseringsmedewerkers die de regels overtreden

MP Kooiman asked about reclassering staff allegedly selling furniture made by community-service offenders for cash in breach of rules, whether oversight existed, why earlier whistleblower complaints (2010-2014) were rejected, and whether rehabilitation or Huis voor Klokkenluiders involvement is warranted. The Secretary of State answered that Reclassering Nederland commissioned external investigations finding no evidence of informal sales, that cash payments breached rules and staff were re-instructed, that earlier complaints had been investigated and the Raad van Toezicht saw no reason for further inquiry, and that rehabilitation is not currently at issue.
RN has informed me that these recordings were not provided to RN despite repeated requests, and I too have been unable to view these recordings.
RN heeft mij laten weten dat deze beelden, ondanks herhaald verzoek hiertoe, niet aan RN zijn verstrekt, en ook ik heb geen kennis kunnen nemen van deze opnames.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch over het bericht "Spoedoverleg over zakkenrollende asielzoekers"

PvdA MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked the State Secretary about a mayor's call for faster deportation of asylum seekers from safe countries who commit pickpocketing and other offences, and whether these offenders work in organised groups. The State Secretary answered that such persons should be rejected and removed quickly, that local authorities act and detain offenders, that organised-group cooperation could not be established, and referred to letters of 17 November and 13 December for the measures taken.
I share your view that persons who invoke the asylum procedure and related facilities on improper grounds should be rejected as quickly as possible and then leave the Netherlands.

Ik deel uw mening dat personen die op oneigenlijke gronden een beroep doen op de asielprocedure en de daarbij behorende voorzieningen, zo snel mogelijk moeten worden afgewezen en vervolgens Nederland moeten verlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg  en Kooiman over het bericht ‘Nabestaanden twijfelen aan zelfmoord gevangene Nieuwegein’

MPs Van Toorenburg and Kooiman asked whether relatives doubting a prisoner's suicide in Nieuwegein prison should be able to halt the cremation, and whether the Rijksrecherche should investigate. The State Secretary replied that the cremation was not scheduled for 5 December and needed no postponement, and that the Public Prosecution Service is already investigating, with relatives to be informed of the outcome.
The Public Prosecution Service, the police and also DJI take the signals from relatives who doubt the cause of death of a family member very seriously.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM), de politie en ook DJI nemen de signalen van nabestaanden die twijfelen over de doodsoorzaak van een familielid zeer serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over staatloosheid

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about a UN complaint by a stateless child born in the Netherlands, the status of the statelessness determination bill, the protection of stateless people in the meantime, the lack of a humanitarian (buitenschuld) residence permit for them, and whether years registered as 'nationality unknown' count toward naturalisation. The State Secretary said the complaint is in UN procedure and will be summarised in the annual report if it reaches the government, that the bill goes to the Council of State around early 2017, that stateless people have access to schooling, youth care and legal aid, and that return impossibility can qualify for a buitenschuld permit while years registered as unknown are not relevant for naturalisation.
The petition has not been forwarded to the government for response by the Human Rights Committee. Should that happen in future, the procedure must first run its course.
Het verzoekschrift is door het Mensenrechtencomité niet voor reactie aan de regering toegezonden. Mocht dat in de toekomst gebeuren, dan zal eerst de procedure zijn beloop moeten krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over afspraken binnen de EU over het herplaatsen van migranten uit Griekenland

An MP asked the State Secretary why the Netherlands would only need to relocate about 1,400 migrants from Greece instead of the 3,797 originally agreed, and how the eligibility criteria and the 24,000 eligible-candidate estimate were established. The government explained that the original EU distribution key was based on an allocation of 66,400 relocations, that the lower number reflects the Commission's estimate of 24,000 eligible candidates, and that the individual figures depend on registration and asylum procedures.
Set against that figure of 24,000, a proportionate Dutch share amounts to the relocation of approximately 1,400 persons.
Afgezet tegen dat aantal van 24.000 komt een evenredig Nederlands aandeel neer op de herplaatsing van ongeveer 1.400 personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de uitzetting van een “haatimam” van België naar Nederland

MP Marcouch asked the Justice Minister whether Belgium's expulsion of a Dutch-Moroccan imam, who has a Dutch nationality, is unwelcome and how his return to the Netherlands could be prevented or monitored. The minister answered that Dutch nationals cannot be refused entry or expelled, that no Dutch national-security threat is known, and that municipalities, police and prosecutors will closely monitor him and act against incitement.
I cannot go into how they do that.
Ik kan hier niet in gaan op welke wijze zij dat doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Kooiman over de reactie van de Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie op de plannen van de Woenselse Poort naar aanleiding van misstanden aldaar

MPs Van Toorenburg and Kooiman asked why the minister did not mention the Inspectorate's critical letter on the Woenselse Poort action plan during a November 2016 debate on TBS, and asked for the Inspectorate's concerns on drug use, vacancies and staffing. The Secretary of State confirmed receipt, said the letter was published and that the plan now addresses the Inspectorate's points, and promised to await the final report and a return visit in early 2017.
The inspectorate informed me that the action plan presented by the clinic De Woenselse Poort broadly addresses the identified shortcomings.
De inspectie heeft mij geïnformeerd dat het actieplan dat de kliniek De Woenselse Poort heeft gepresenteerd, op hoofdlijnen ingaat op de geconstateerde tekortkomingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Apple haalt tientallen gokapps uit Nederlandse App Store’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about Apple removing dozens of gambling apps from the Dutch App Store at the request of the Gambling Authority, including how long removal took and whether Unibet, a persistent illegal offeror, can still obtain a licence. The State Secretary declined to name the 55 companies, said the requested removals were completed in time, and stated that persistent illegal offerors may be excluded from a licence and could face a financial sanction, leaving those decisions to the Gambling Authority.

The Gambling Authority informed me, when asked, that it does not wish to publish this information; in principle it does not make the names of individual companies public unless an administrative sanction underlies them.

De kansspelautoriteit heeft mij desgevraagd aangegeven deze informatie niet te publiceren; zij maakt in beginsel geen namen van (individuele) bedrijven openbaar tenzij daar een bestuurlijke sanctie aan ten grondslag ligt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azmani en Arno Rutte over het bericht dat Marokkaanse asielzoekers rovend door de stad Groningen trekken

Two VVD MPs asked why asylum seekers from safe countries, reportedly including Moroccans, are allowed to commit robberies in Groningen without being returned, how they are dealt with, and whether talks with Morocco are planned. The State Secretary answered that the government works on both the inflow and the nuisance through administrative and criminal approaches, and that Nederland wants to reach agreements with Morocco on taking back unlawfully staying nationals, with priority to be given.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat het bed, bad en brood overleg is geklapt

MP Sjoerdsma asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether the lack of clarity on who cannot return to their country of origin through no fault of their own keeps rejected asylum seekers stuck in municipal bed-bath-bread shelters, how many buitenschuld (no-fault) residence permits were granted or refused in 2014-2016, and what the procedure requires and how it could be improved. The State Secretary replied that returnees generally can leave, described the evidentiary requirements and the 2013 policy, stated the policy is well balanced and will not be changed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de leegstand en het personeelstekort bij de PI Haaglanden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice why PI Haaglanden Zoetermeer is concentrating vacancies, closing its prison wing and ISD unit, and relocating staff and detainees amid a staff shortage, and whether this undermines the parliamentary motion against prison closures. The State Secretary replied that these are temporary concentration measures, not closures, that the ZBBI regime is moved rather than abolished, and that staffing and external-hiring choices are driven by declining capacity needs.
There is no question of wholly or partially closing PIs.
Er is geen sprake van het geheel of gedeeltelijk sluiten van PI's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Helder over het bericht “Asielkraak kost goud”

PVV MPs Fritsma and Helder asked why a group of undocumented migrants squatting buildings in Amsterdam has not been deported or stopped, and whether squatting bans and bed-bath-and-bread provision will be enforced or ended. The State Secretary replied that deportation depends on cooperation from countries of origin, that evictions of such squats have been carried out and upheld in court, that the financial compensation to municipalities for bed-bath-and-bread will be stopped, but refused an asylum stop while announcing targeted measures.
I informed your House on 21 November that I am ending the financial compensation for the bed, bath and bread provisions offered by municipalities.
Ik heb uw Kamer op 21 november geïnformeerd dat ik de financiële vergoeding voor de door gemeenten geboden bed, bad en broodvoorzieningen stopzet
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht 'Schendingen mensenrechten bij opvang vluchtelingen Italië'

An MP from the PvdA asked the State Secretary whether the human rights abuses against migrants in Italian reception and hotspot facilities reported by Amnesty International were caused by EU pressure, what controls exist, and whether they affect relocation arrangements. The government answered that UNHCR, IOM, the European Commission and Italian authorities did not recognise the allegations, that EU registration rules and a fingerprinting guideline apply, and that the findings do not change the hotspot approach or relocation agreements.
I have had inquiries made accordingly, but I have received no signals from the various parties involved that confirm this conclusion.
Ik heb me navenant laten informeren, maar van de diverse betrokken partijen geen signalen gekregen die deze conclusie bevestigen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het niet inzetten van registertolken bij de Immigratie- en Naturalisatiedienst en de Nationale Politie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the failure to use registered sworn interpreters at the IND and police, the use of unsworn interpreters and short interrogations, and oversight by courts. The Minister said the Wbtv permits exceptions, that the legal framework and court review suffice, and that the Raad voor de Rechtspraak will be asked to address stricter control of registered interpreter use.
I will bring the aspect of the mandatory use of registered interpreters and the recording of deviating use to the attention of the Raad voor de Rechtspraak.
Ik zal het aspect van het verplichte gebruik van geregistreerde tolken en het vastleggen van een afwijkend gebruik bij de Raad voor de Rechtspraak onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de taakstelling huisvesting statushouders en de aanpak sociaal domein in Den Haag

The MP asks why 144 housing places for status holders in The Hague remain unfilled, why the 1466 target differs from the 144 matchable holders, and whether The Hague's approach can be applied nationally. The Secretary of State attributes the shortfall to lower asylum inflow, notes catch-up obligations and recent matchings, and says housing is a municipal task while promising to share successful approaches.
The housing of permit holders is an independent task of the municipalities.
De huisvesting van vergunninghouders is een eigenstandige taak van de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de plannen om burgers met satellieten vanuit de ruimte te gaan bespieden

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a market consultation on using satellites for investigation and other purposes, including scope, legal basis, data sharing with the FIOD, costs, and foreign precedents. The minister answered that the consultation is exploratory within an innovation programme, no tender is planned, satellite use is limited to incidental, technically feasible tasks under existing rules, and no costs or specific applications are yet known.
There is currently no intention to place our own satellites in orbit around the earth.
Er is op dit moment geen voornemen om eigen satellieten in een baan om de aarde te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het leeftijdsonderzoek bij alleenstaande minderjarige vreemdelingen

An MP asked the State Secretary about oversight of age assessment for unaccompanied minor asylum seekers, court rulings on age shouldering, scientific research, EASO guidance on guardians, legal remedies and contra-expertise. The State Secretary explained the division of inspection roles, the revised IND viewing procedure, ongoing research into alternative imaging methods, the existing guardian and information arrangements, that age-test outcomes are challengeable only via a negative residence decision, and that contra-expertise remains possible with ongoing consultation on expert availability.
Following the case law you refer to, the IND has critically reviewed its working method and decided to draw up further instructions.
Naar aanleiding van de jurisprudentie waar u aan refereert, heeft de IND zijn werkwijze kritisch in ogenschouw genomen en besloten nadere instructies op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van Meenen over het bericht “meer uitkeringen door Syriërs en en Wajongeren”

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Meenen asked about reports of rising benefit claims by Syrians and Wajong recipients, including data on Syrian welfare recipients, costs, language training and diploma recognition. The minister answered with CBS figures, describes pre-integration courses and volunteer training, and says a letter on the motion for language lessons from day one will follow before the budget debate.
The realised costs of increased welfare benefits for Syrians are not registered separately.
De gerealiseerde kosten van toegenomen bijstand door Syriërs worden niet afzonderlijk geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brouwer en Recourt over ouderen in de gevangenis

MPs Brouwer and Recourt asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about elderly prisoners, including numbers of over-60s and over-75s sentenced and detained, special prison wings for seniors, and a special senior criminal law. The State Secretary answered that no special detention units for over-60s are needed since care follows health needs rather than age, that a vision on sanction enforcement will address older prisoners, and that existing law already allows judges to take age into account, so a separate senior criminal law is unnecessary.
Given all existing possibilities, I am of the view that introducing a special criminal law for seniors would add no value.
Ik ben, gezien alle bestaande mogelijkheden, van mening dat invoering van een speciaal strafrecht voor senioren niet van toegevoegde waarde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir, Gesthuizen en Jasper van Dijk over jonge statushouders die gaan studeren

MPs Bashir, Gesthuizen and Van Dijk asked the Minister about poor coordination between COA and municipalities that leaves student housing for young refugees underused, and about how the gaps in study guidance and information will be addressed. The Minister replied that municipalities are responsible for housing, that the Rijk has introduced early screening of refugees' education and work background, and that study guidance is a task of the educational institutions, with specialised support from UAF.
Municipalities are responsible for the housing of refugee status holders.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de huisvesting van statushouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het besluit- en vertrekmoratorium voor asielzoekers uit Jemen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the decision and departure moratorium for Yemeni asylum seekers had expired, whether it would be extended, what has changed in Yemen, and whether repeated extensions create an uncertain situation for asylum seekers. The State Secretary confirmed it expired on 11 August 2016 and cannot be extended again, promised to inform parliament after a Foreign Affairs report on Yemen's security situation, and rejected the claim that repeated moratoria harm asylum seekers.
The decision and departure moratorium for asylum seekers from Yemen expired on 11 August 2016.
Het besluit- en vertrekmoratorium voor asielzoekers uit Jemen is op 11 augustus 2016 afgelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Kuiken over het bericht dat de Hongaarse regering vluchtelingen mishandelt en hen maandenlang zonder redenen opsluit

MPs Maij and Kuiken asked the government about reports that Hungary abuses and arbitrarily detains refugees, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The government called the reports worrying, said Hungary must respect European and international obligations, noted that the Commission has opened an infringement procedure whose outcome is expected in September 2017, and referred to its earlier assessment instead of a separate one.

The cabinet's position that the treatment of refugees must be in line with European treaties and agreements, including the European Convention on Human Rights, the European acquis and international refugee law, remains unchanged.

Het kabinetsstandpunt dat de behandeling van vluchtelingen in lijn moet zijn met Europese verdragen en afspraken, waaronder het Europees Verdrag voor de Rechten van de Mens en het Europese acquis, evenals internationaal vluchtelingenrecht, blijft onveranderd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Karabulut over het afschaffen van de logeerregeling voor statushouders

SP MPs Gesthuizen and Karabulut asked the State Secretary about abolishing the guest-family arrangement for status holders, including usage numbers, costs, integration effects, and confusion over whether the scheme was ended. The State Secretary answered that the scheme remains open, the self-care arrangement ended by law, no data exists on integration effects, and the scheme's future is under review.
No data is available on the effect that a status holder's stay with a guest family has on their civic integration.
Er zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar over het effect dat het verblijf van een vergunninghouder in een gastgezin heeft op zijn/haar inburgering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Recourt, Sjoerdsma, Gesthuizen en Voortman over de uitlevering van verdachten aan Rwanda

Five MPs asked whether the Netherlands is extraditing two genocide suspects to Rwanda despite expert doubts about fair trials there, and whether this should be suspended pending independent review. The minister confirmed the extradition proceeds after appeal courts found no real risk of an unfair trial, argued trial in the country of the crime is preferred, and refused to suspend extradition or commission new independent research.
I am therefore not willing to suspend the extradition.
Ik ben dan ook niet bereid de uitlevering op te schorten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Beertema over het bericht dat Brussel haast heeft om visumvrij reizen voor Turken mogelijk te maken

PVV MPs asked why the EU is rushing visa-free travel for Turks despite unmet conditions, whether the government will oppose the Turkey deal, and whether it supports leaving the EU. The minister replied that visa liberalisation is conditional on all benchmarks being met, that the deal reduced irregular inflows, and that the government does not favour leaving the EU.
Only when it is established that all criteria have been met will there be full visa exemption, as repeatedly stated.
Pas wanneer geconstateerd wordt dat is voldaan aan alle criteria zal sprake zijn van volledige visumvrijstelling, zoals bij herhaling aangegeven.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat Nederland in EU verband heeft gelobbyd om als unie een afzwakking van een absoluut verbod op de opsluiting van minderjarigen voor te stellen op de Algemene Ver

An MP asked whether the Netherlands lobbied within the EU to soften a ban on detaining minors at the UN General Assembly, and about child immigration detention generally. The minister denied aiming to weaken the text, said child detention is a last resort limited to two weeks in the Zeist family facility, and reported roughly 130 children detained in 2015 and 80 in 2016.

The Netherlands consistently argued during the negotiations that immigration detention of children should only be used as a last resort and that the best interests of the child should always be weighed.

Nederland heeft zich er tijdens de onderhandelingen steeds voor ingezet dat vreemdelingenbewaring van kinderen alleen in het uiterste geval wordt ingezet en het belang van het kind daarbij steeds wordt meegewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over verwijzingen naar abortusklinieken in AZC’s

MPs asked how pregnant asylum seekers in reception centres are cared for, whether COA policy on unplanned pregnancies includes independent counselling on alternatives to abortion, and whether they are being referred to abortion clinics with standard referral letters, with calls for independent investigation. The government answered that asylum seekers have the same maternity care rights as Dutch citizens, that GC A follows NHG standards with referral to clinics or counselling bodies possible, that it finds such steering unacceptable, has received no such signals, and sees no reason for an investigation at present.
At this moment there is no reason for me to conduct an investigation.
Op dit moment is er voor mij geen aanleiding voor een onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de kosten van het verzoek om Nederlander te worden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice to explain how the naturalisation fees (single, multiple, child, stateless/asylum and option applications) are built up and why they differ, and whether lower fees could be introduced for less wealthy applicants. The government answered that fees aim to cover IND and municipal costs with cross-subsidisation, that differentiation reflects workload, and that it will not investigate a lower tariff for less wealthy people.
I am not willing to investigate the possibility of allowing less wealthy people to qualify for a lower tariff.
Ik ben niet bereid tot het onderzoeken van de mogelijkheid om minder vermogende mensen in aanmerking te laten komen voor een lager tarief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Kuiken, Gesthuizen, Voortman en Sjoerdsma over de brand in het vreemdelingendetentiecentrum Rotterdam

MPs asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a fire at the Rotterdam immigration detention centre, including the lack of aftercare, isolation and searches of detainees, the non-central unlocking of doors, and why the Inspectorate did not investigate earlier. The State Secretary answered that the Inspectorate will investigate the events, expected to finish by late November 2016, and will report to parliament afterwards, and that it has now decided to open a further inquiry since the Amnesty account covers different facts.
The Inspectorate of Security and Justice will carry out an investigation into the course of events surrounding the fire.
Inspectie VenJ) zal onderzoek verrichten naar de gang van zaken rond de brand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht “300 medewerkers bij de IND weg”

An MP asked why the IND is dismissing 300 temporary staff while asylum backlogs and waiting times remain a concern, and about the status of the five-track asylum policy and family reunification delays. The state secretary answered that lower-than-forecast inflow lets the IND manage with fewer staff, that waiting times should fall to about eight weeks from October, and provided track-distribution figures and family reunification processing times, while correcting an earlier figure.
From October, the IND expects waiting times to be reduced to about eight weeks, and the 300 externally hired staff will be phased out.
Vanaf oktober zijn naar de verwachting van de IND de wachttijden teruggebracht tot ca. acht weken en worden de 300 extern ingehuurde krachten gefaseerd afgebouwd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht “Meer kinderen, minder mannen naar Nederland”

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports of long family reunification procedures and whether General Comment 14 of the UN Children's Rights Committee and Articles 5(5) and 17 of the Family Reunification Directive should be explicitly applied in policy. The government answered that waiting times are being addressed through extra capacity, that no change to the assessment framework is needed, and that the current IND practice complies with the directive, the ECHR and treaty obligations.
As already indicated in my letter to the House of 29 October 2014, the implementation of the directive proceeded on the basis that explicitly naming Article 17 in the regulations is not necessary.

Antwoord 6, 7, 8 Zoals reeds aangegeven in mijn brief aan uw Kamer van 29 oktober 2014 6 is bij de implementatie van de richtlijn ervan uitgegaan dat het apart benoemen van artikel 17 in de regelgeving niet noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Kuiken over de vestiging van een asielzoekerscentrum in Maastricht

Two PvdA MPs asked whether the sale and lease of a Maastricht property for an asylum centre, reportedly linked to a suspect owner, showed integrity risks and whether the COA should have checked the buyer's integrity under the Bibob Act. The minister acknowledged factual inaccuracies in the press report, said the government should be restrained in such deals and that integrity checks are warranted, explained that the COA ran a notarial check finding no link to the owner, and noted the COA lacks Bibob powers but a change is being prepared.
The Minister of Justice and Security is currently examining how the Bibob authority for the COA can be realised in the short term by amending the Bibob Decree.
Momenteel beziet de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie hoe de Bibob-bevoegdheid voor het COA, door middel van een aanpassing van het Besluit Bibob, op korte termijn kan worden gerealiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Omtzigt over de huur van panden voor een azc in Maastricht

MPs Keijzer and Omtzigt asked about the COA's lease of Parkweg 20 and Blekerij 52 in Maastricht for an asylum centre, including the rent, the transaction history, vetting of the owner, and links to an FIOD investigation. The State Secretary answered that rents are not disclosed for commercial reasons, that the COA checked the owner via a notary who found no links, and that the FIOD does not inform other bodies about its investigations.
The COA does not make lease contracts public. A lease contract contains information that affects the economic and financial interests of the COA.
Het COA maakt geen huurcontracten openbaar. Een huurcontract bevat informatie die de economische en financiële belangen van het COA raken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de inzet van militairen op Schiphol

An MP asked the government about deploying Royal Netherlands Marechaussee support and army infantry at Schiphol, whether the promised 85 new marechaussees were truly additional, and why a structural solution was still pending. The minister answered that army support was a temporary, ended measure, that the 85 recruits were redirected from regular intake and phased in, and that a capacity needs assessment would be sent to parliament in autumn.
This autumn I will inform you further.
Dit najaar zal ik u nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de reactie van de staatssecretaris op het inspectierapport: Het overlijden van een Irakese asielzoeker in de noodopvang in Alphen aan de Rijn

MP Voordewind asked the State Secretary about information provision to asylum seekers in emergency shelters, IOM support for voluntary return, financial allowances, suicide-risk handling and meal arrangements following an inspection report on a death in Alphen aan den Rijn. The State Secretary answered that information duties are shared among agencies, that the letter was not handed out in Goes due to unrest, that policy on allowances and cooking has been partly adjusted, and that current coordination is adequate, while committing to ongoing optimisation with partners.
In addition, COA and IND are working with Vluchtelingen Werk Nederland and Rode Kruis Nederland to further optimise information provision at all locations.
Daarnaast werken COA en IND samen met Vluchtelingen Werk Nederland en Rode Kruis Nederland om de informatievoorziening op alle locaties verder te optimaliseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht “Inburgeren vrijblijvend”

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that newcomers are not informed that failing integration requirements can lead to loss of residence permits, and whether national and international rules prevent such revocation. The government answered that newcomers are informed via IND and DUO materials, that no permits have yet been revoked for non-compliance, and that EVRM and the Family Reunification Directive limit revocation for some groups, referring to an earlier letter.
No, this is not correct. Newcomers are informed through various channels about the (residence-law) consequences of failing to meet the integration obligation.
Nee, dit klopt niet. Nieuwkomers worden via diverse kanalen geïnformeerd over de (verblijfsrechtelijke) gevolgen bij het niet voldoen aan de inburgeringsplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en De Graaf over (Integratie) over de kosten van asiel en immigratie

MPs Wilders, Fritsma and De Graaf asked for year-by-year net costs of asylum and immigrant groups, and the costs of the 2014-2015 asylum cohort over 30 years including family migration. The State Secretary refused both, stating the government does not keep accounts of costs and benefits by group or origin and only evaluates policy, not citizens.
This cabinet also does not keep accounts of (groups of) citizens.
Ook dit kabinet houdt geen boekhouding van (groepen) burgers bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Kuiken over kindermisbruik in Griekse vluchtelingenkampen

Two MPs asked the government about reports of rising child and women abuse in Greek refugee camps, the Red Cross's role, and what Netherlands and the EU will do to protect residents and deport perpetrators. The minister said Greece is responsible, the issue was raised with Greek authorities and at EU level, EU funding has been given to improve camps, and the Greek government denies abuse reports were filed, without giving exact figures.
The Greek government is responsible for the reception of migrants, in line with European legislation and international law.
De Griekse overheid is verantwoordelijk voor de opvang van migranten, in lijn met Europese wetgeving en het internationaal recht.
Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het terugsturen van asielzoekers naar Burundi (ingezonden 23 mei 2016).

An MP asked the state secretary about the continuing violence in Burundi, the number of Burundians in asylum procedures and the number liable to removal, and whether removals and a new country report are planned. The government corrected earlier wrong figures, reporting about 50 pending asylum applications and 60 people in the return caseload, and says a decision and departure moratorium has been introduced.
In answering question four, the number of actual removals was reported instead of the number of Burundians liable to removal.
Bij het antwoord op vraag vier is gemeld hoeveel daadwerkelijke uitzettingen er hebben plaatsgevonden i.p.v. het aantal uitzetbare Burundezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over gezinshereniging van broers en zussen van alleenstaande minderjarige vreemdelingen

An MP asked whether unmarried adult siblings of unaccompanied minor refugees, who are refused family reunification, should be treated like adult children of refugee parents under the May 2015 policy. The State Secretary acknowledged the omission, said it was unintended, and committed to amending the framework so such requests are assessed individually under Article 8 ECHR.
Because it is undesirable that a 19-year-old brother or sister ultimately has to remain as the only family member in a refugee camp, I will remedy this omission.
Omdat het onwenselijk is dat een 19-jarige broer of zus uiteindelijk als enig gezinslid in een vluchtelingenkamp moet achterblijven, zal ik deze omissie herstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voortman, Voordewind en Sjoerdsma over de rechten van alleen-staande minderjarige vreemdelingen

MPs Gesthuizen, Voortman, Voordewind and Sjoerdsma asked the State Secretary about the rights of unaccompanied minor asylum seekers (AMVs): how many special building-exception residence permit requests were made and refused, long-term prospects, the revised Dublin Regulation, the COA improvement plan, and placement procedures. The State Secretary answered that about ten such requests were filed and all refused, stressed family reunification and child-interest considerations, committed to monitoring and a possible evaluation, supported the best-interests principle in Dublin revision, and promised the COA improvement letter before the summer recess ends.
