No permits have been issued ex officio under the building-exception policy either. The reason for this is not recorded in the IND's automated system.
Ook zijn er geen ambtshalve vergunningen verstrekt op grond van het buitenschuldbeleid. De reden hiervoor wordt niet in het geautomatiseerde systeem van de IND geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van Dekken over het bericht ‘Kinderen verdwenen uit azc Ter Apel; verdachten kinderuitbuiting opgepakt’

MPs Kuiken and Van Dekken asked about reports that children had disappeared from the Ter Apel asylum centre and that suspects in child exploitation were arrested, asking about the children's status, Dublin procedures, and police tracing and European cooperation. The minister confirmed awareness of the arrests but declined to discuss the individual children on privacy and safety grounds, stated no links were seen to other disappearances, and referred to an earlier answer for tracing and cooperation measures.
For reasons of privacy and the safety of the young people, I will not go into the individual circumstances of this case.
Omwille van de privacy en de veiligheid van de jongeren ga ik niet in op de individuele omstandigheden in deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Fritsma over het nieuwe Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland (DTN)

PVV MPs Wilders and Fritsma asked whether the government takes seriously reports that IS terrorists used the refugee flow to reach Europe, and whether borders and asylum centres should be closed. The minister rejected the claim that asylum intake alone threatens security, said all asylum seekers are identified and registered, acknowledged that misuse cannot be excluded, and said full border closure is neither possible nor the chosen approach.
The cabinet rejects the suggestion that merely admitting asylum seekers would pose a threat to national security.
Het kabinet verwerpt de suggestie dat enkel het binnenlaten van asielzoekers een bedreiging zou vormen voor de nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Maij en Marcouch over het bericht “Frontman Pegida Nederland jaagt in Bulgarije op vluchtelingen”

MPs Kuiken, Maij and Marcouch asked whether a Dutch Pegida frontman hunting refugees in Bulgaria is a matter for private citizens, whether his conduct is punishable, whether a private army is criminal, and whether a passport ban could apply. The minister replied that border control is for the competent authorities, he has no knowledge beyond media reports, Dutch criminal law may apply extraterritorially under article 7 Sr, and he sees no current grounds for passport revocation.
I am not aware of the activities of the Dutch man mentioned in the report, other than what emerges from media coverage.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van de activiteiten van de in het bericht genoemde Nederlandse man, anders dan uit de berichtgeving in de media naar voren komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Sjoerdsma over mishandeling van migranten door de Libische kustwacht

MPs Voortman and Sjoerdsma asked whether the EU and Dutch support to the Libyan coast guard, including the Sophia mission, makes them complicit in abuses of migrants reported by Amnesty International, and what follow-up is planned. The minister acknowledged the situation, described Dutch-funded IOM projects and EU mandate changes, and said the EU training phase has not started and that human rights will be raised with Libyan authorities, without accepting responsibility or changing course.
The Netherlands will work to discuss international human rights standards with the Libyan authorities and to include them in the training curriculum.
Nederland zal zich inzetten voor bespreking van de internationale mensenrechtennormen met de Libische autoriteiten en voor opneming ervan in het curriculum van de trainingen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Kooiman over “het bericht dat steeds meer ouderen door armoede in de cel belanden na een verkeersboete”

MP Kooiman asked whether older people are increasingly jailed for unpaid traffic fines due to poverty, and how CJIB and the prosecution account for financial hardship. The state secretary said the absolute number of older detainees rose slightly, that detentions for unpaid fines among over-50s fell from 72 in 2013 to 12 in mid-2016 after a person-focused assessment was introduced, and described the financial checks and debt-relief referral steps taken.
A request for detention for non-payment is in principle only filed against persons for whom, on the basis of the available information, there is no inability to pay.
Het indienen van een vordering gijzeling gebeurt in beginsel alleen bij personen voor wie geldt dat – op basis van de beschikbare informatie – geen sprake is van betalingsonmacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het DNA-verwantschapsonderzoek dat het OM laat uitvoeren bij een te vondeling gelegde baby

An MP asked whether the public prosecution service may use the national forensic DNA database to find the parents of a foundling baby, and whether a hielprik (heel-prick) register could be used. The minister answered that DNA kinship research is legally permitted here under the attempted-murder charge, that it is not available for abandonment under article 256 Sr alone, that RIVM invoked medical confidentiality, and that a court-authorised judicial-commissioner order is required, and committed to considering a legal amendment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het illegaal aanbieden van kansspelen

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the Gambling Authority knows that illegal online gambling operators redirect Dutch visitors from .nl sites to .eu or .com sites, whether this continues, and how a motion to refuse licences to persistent illegal operators will be implemented. The State Secretary confirmed the Authority is aware, acknowledged such redirection exists, and said the Authority will assess this among other factors when judging licence applicants' reliability and suitability.
The assessment of the reliability and suitability of individual licence applicants is for the Gambling Authority.
Het oordeel over de betrouwbaarheid en geschiktheid van individuele vergunningaanvragers is aan de kansspelautoriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Keijzer en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Azc's krijgen vertrouwenspersonen voor homoseksuele asielzoekers’

MPs Van der Staaij, Keijzer and Voordewind asked whether asylum reception centres have dedicated confidants for vulnerable groups such as gay asylum seekers and Christians, about prosecution of crimes against vulnerable groups, and about cameras protecting them. The State Secretary answered that a coordinating confidant function and staff confidants serve all residents without targeting specific groups, that training is being shaped with NGOs, that a new report will show incident-to-prosecution figures without group breakdown, and that cameras are used under an internal framework.
The registration does not break down cases by specific target groups.
In de registratie wordt geen uitsplitsing gemaakt naar specifieke doelgroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brouwer over de aanwezigheid van contrabande in tbs-klinieken

An MP asked the State Secretary whether he knew of internal reports of contraband (drugs, child pornography, phones) in TBS clinics, how it enters, what sanctions apply, and what action plan exists. The State Secretary confirmed knowledge of incident reports from 2012-2016 that are normally not shared with parliament, disclosed them after a Wob request, described the inspectorate-based action plan, and said effectiveness cannot yet be judged.
This type of internal report is generally not reported to your House or otherwise made public.
Dit soort interne meldingen wordt in de regel niet aan uw Kamer gemeld of anderszins openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Grashoff over het terugsturen van vluchtelingen naar Eritrea

MPs Voortman and Grashoff asked the government about the UN Commission of Inquiry on Eritrea, EU and Dutch development aid to Eritrea, reports of Eritreans being returned from Sudan, and Sudan's border assistance under the Khartoum process. The government answered that it supports ICC referral only via the UN Security Council, keeps Eritrea in the DGGF and backs an EU programme with conditions, deems Sudanese returns possible refoulement, and says aid to Eritrean and Sudanese border authorities will be monitored and kept restrained without commitment to new binding limits.
The Netherlands will also oversee this via its involvement in the EUTF and will also work for restrained use of EU ODA funds for border control in this context.
Nederland zal hiertoe via betrokkenheid bij het EUTF ook op toezien en zich eveneens inzetten voor een terughoudend gebruik van EU ODA-middelen voor grensbewaking in dit kader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat Turkije Syrische vluchtelingen niet laat uitreizen

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that Turkey is blocking 52 Syrian refugees holding German visas from leaving, and about selection criteria and numbers for resettlement from Turkey under the EU-Turkey statement. The State Secretary answered that the people remain in Turkey while bilateral talks continue, declined to provide education or medical data per individual, stated that education level should not be a selection criterion, and gave resettlement figures and a planned monthly quota of about 100 for the Netherlands.
No, I do not have such detailed data on the German cases.
Nee, ik beschik niet over dergelijke gedetailleerde gegevens over de Duitse zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over de screening van asielzoekers in 2015 naar aanleiding van een enquête onder 800 politieagenten in Europa door de Europese Politievakbond

The MP Keijzer asked whether the government accepts the screening deficiencies flagged in an EU police union survey and the Inspectorate report, whether the 58,000 asylum seekers of 2015 were fully registered and checked, and where they now reside. The government admits the 2015 registration was basic and backlogged but says all were registered, checked against security databases without findings, and that tracking is limited because the group is not followed as a cohort.

It is not easy to establish how many of the more than 58,000 asylum seekers in the immigration chain systems have a known residence in the Netherlands, because this group is not tracked as a group (cohort approach).

Het is niet eenvoudig in beeld te brengen van hoeveel van de ruim 58.000 asielzoekers in de systemen van de vreemdelingenketen een verblijfplaats in Nederland bekend is omdat deze groep niet als een groep wordt gevolgd (cohortbenadering).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over gevangenissen die toch dicht gaan

An MP asked whether prisons would be emptied and closed this cabinet term despite the parliamentary motion against closures, and whether housing asylum seekers in prisons circumvents that motion. The State Secretary replied that no prisons are being closed now, that the motion stands, and that temporary use of prison buildings for asylum seekers is possible only with municipal consent, while the prison's formal purpose is retained.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten over het bericht dat ggz-patiënten (patiënten in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg) vaker in een tbs-kliniek zitten

MPs Kooiman and Leijten asked the ministers how BOPZ psychiatric patients can be transferred to a TBS clinic without a judge's involvement, why suitable GGZ places are lacking, and whether the bed reduction is to blame. The government answered that transfers are based on BOPZ article 55 with a copy to the judge, are rare (about 0.24% of BOPZ patients, 38 people), are made by the medical director on psychiatric indication, and that a broader study and IGZ talks will follow.
These are BOPZ patients whose judicial measure is converted into a BOPZ authorisation.
Het gaat hierbij om BOPZ-patiënten van wie de justitiële maatregel wordt omgezet in een BOPZ-machtiging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman, Van Toorenburg en Swinkels over het in weerwil van een Kamermotie sluiten van gevangenissen

MPs Kooiman, Van Toorenburg and Swinkels asked whether preparations to close prisons after the March 2017 elections, and the concentration of vacant cells, conflict with a Chamber motion stating that closing prisons is not on the agenda. The Secretary of State replied that he is implementing the motion, closes no prisons, and that concentrating vacancies is internal operational management, with DJI mapping consequences in consultation with staff and promising to inform the Chamber later.
I am implementing this motion accordingly.
Ik voer deze motie dienovereenkomstig uit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat asielkinderen wegkwijnen in grootschalige opvang

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that unaccompanied minor asylum seekers in large-scale reception centres receive too little psychological care, face substance use, and see their guardians only briefly, and about measures to improve reception and prevent disappearances. The State Secretary answered that care is available via the centre's health clinic, that a verbal improvement plan from COA has been reviewed by the Inspectorates, and that the government will inform parliament before summer recess.

At the General Consultation of 26 May I committed to inform your House before the 2016 summer recess about the measures COA has taken to improve the quality of protected reception for unaccompanied minors.

Tijdens het Algemeen Overleg van 26 mei jl. heb ik toegezegd om voor het zomerreces 2016 uw Kamer te informeren over de door het COA doorgevoerde maatregelen om de kwaliteit te verbeteren van de beschermde opvang voor amv's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat er met amv’ers wordt gesleept

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that 28 unaccompanied minor asylum seekers would be moved, whether Nidos may make exceptions to its small-scale reception policy, and whether jongeren turning 18 can stay longer in reception. The State Secretary replied that the new small-scale model is in force, Purmerend's parties reached agreements on housing, and exceptions for 18-year-olds are ruled out, while relocations will be reviewed.
As also recently indicated to various civil society organisations during a meeting on children in reception, the number of relocations will be examined further.
Zoals ook recent richting diverse maatschappelijke organisaties is aangegeven tijdens een bijeenkomst over kinderen in de opvang, zal nader worden gekeken naar het aantal verhuisbewegingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht dat een Curaçaose loterij het ook goed doet in Nederland

MPs Bosman and Van Wijngaarden asked whether illegal sales of Curaçao lottery tickets in the Netherlands are undesirable, whether kansspelbelasting should be paid, and what enforcement exists and is used. The government agrees the sales are undesirable and that tax should be paid, describes administrative and criminal enforcement tools, says the Kansspelautoriteit so far used only informal measures such as warnings because cases were not large-scale, and says the minister will raise internet gambling oversight with Curaçao at the JVO.
The investigation by the Kansspelautoriteit led to intervention and to the ending of the violations.
Het onderzoek van de Kansspelautoriteit heeft geleid tot interventie en tot het beëindigen van de overtredingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de veiligheidssituatie van onlangs door Nederland uitgezette kinderen in Burundi

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the safety of a family recently deported from the Netherlands to Burundi, and whether other deportations had occurred. The State Secretary said the embassy checked on the family and found their safety was not at stake, that the family was the only one deported to Burundi this year, and that a six-month deportation and return moratorium was imposed with a general country report requested.
The family is the only one deported to Burundi this year.
Het gezin is het enige dat dit jaar is uitgezet naar Burundi.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat het COA mensen op straat laat slapen

An SP MP asked whether COA made asylum seekers sleep on the street as punishment after a fight, whether this is policy, and how often it occurs. The Staatssecretaris confirmed awareness of the report and explained that the COA's ROV regulation allows withholding allowances or temporarily denying reception, with 243 such denials in 2015 ranging from one week to three months.
As a measure, financial allowances may be withheld or reception facilities may be denied, temporarily or otherwise.
Als maatregel kunnen financiële verstrekkingen worden ingehouden of opvangvoorzieningen, al dan niet tijdelijk, worden ontzegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Gesthuizen, Kuiken, Voortman en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat opvang wordt geweigerd aan (zieke) vreemdelingen die bereid zijn om het land te verlaten

MPs from several parties asked the state secretary whether asylum seekers willing to leave the Netherlands are being refused shelter at Ter Apel, including sick ones, and why the buitenschuld regime and the motions on voluntary return and bed-bad-brood arrangements are not reflected. The state secretary denied the premise, explained that shelter is conditional on demonstrated active cooperation with return, and stated that medically necessary care is available with a possible deferral of departure under article 64 Vw.
It is generally correct that not all foreigners who request shelter at the VBL are actually admitted to the VBL.
Het is in algemene zin juist dat niet alle vreemdelingen die verzoeken om onderdak in de VBL daadwerkelijk tot de VBL worden toegelaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het terugsturen van asielzoekers naar Burundi

MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether returns of asylum seekers to Burundi remain safe given escalating violence and UN warnings of possible civil war, and how many Burundians are in asylum or return procedures. The State Secretary answered that fewer than 10 Burundians are in each procedure, that a six-month decision and departure moratorium has been introduced, and that a new general country report has been requested from Foreign Affairs.
I have informed your House today that I am introducing a decision and departure moratorium for Burundi for a period of six months.
Ik heb uw Kamer heden geïnformeerd dat ik voor Burundi een besluit- en vertrekmoratorium instel voor de duur van zes maanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Volp over de medische (tandarts-) zorg in penitentiaire inrichtingen (PI’s)

An MP asks the State Secretary of Security and Justice about dental care in Dutch prisons, following a TV report on a case, the prioritisation and referral rules for dental treatment, extractions, complaints and the Inspectorate's (IGZ) involvement and 2009 findings. The State Secretary answers that a dentist attends about one day a week under service contracts with prioritised access, that the case details cannot be shared for privacy reasons, that two complaints were upheld by the RSJ in 2014, and that the IGZ was involved in only one report in five years, with follow-up measures after the 2009 IGZ report.
I cannot provide information about the content of the treatment without the consent of the person concerned.
Over de inhoud van de behandeling kan ik u geen informatie verstrekken zonder toestemming van de betrokkene.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over het feit dat Holland Casino op straat klanten werft en gratis speelgeld weggeeft

An MP asked the State Secretary whether Holland Casino's street campaign giving away free play money and a chance to win 20,000 euros falls under gambling promotion rules and needs a licence, and what tools exist to review it. The State Secretary answered that the campaign falls under the promotional gambling code, not the licensing duties of the Gambling Act, that the Gambling Authority can enforce it if violated, and that the code will be evaluated.
The promotional gambling code will be evaluated soon.
De gedragscode promotionele kansspelen zal binnenkort worden geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Van Toorenburg over de 24/7 opening van Holland Casino in Rotterdam

MPs Segers and Van Toorenburg asked whether Holland Casino's 24/7 opening in Rotterdam is acceptable given gambling-addiction risks, whether mayors have say over opening hours, and whether a trial could be stopped or monitored. The State Secretary answered that opening hours are a local matter, the operator's duty of care applies at all hours, the Gaming Authority was not informed of the trial, and existing monitoring suffices.
When asked, the Gaming Authority indicated to me that it was not informed in advance.
Desgevraagd heeft de Kansspelautoriteit aan mij aangegeven niet tevoren geïnformeerd te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over Ethiopische vluchtelingen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about Ethiopian asylum seekers: lack of birth registration, OLF document authenticity, detention and release, and Eritrean nationality proof. The State Secretary answered that no OLF document has been rejected as forged, that few Ethiopians are detained and returns are possible, and that case-by-case attention applies to undocumented asylum seekers.
In not a single case has this led to the conclusion that the documents cannot be accepted as genuine.
In geen enkel geval heeft dit geleid tot de conclusie dat de documenten niet als echt kunnen worden geaccepteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over €10.000 aan shoptegoed voor asielzoekers

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why refugee families in Oisterwijk receive EUR 10,000 in shopping credit from the municipality without repayment, whether a national guideline with lower costs and loans should be set, and whether Australian-style regional-only reception should be adopted. The State Secretary answered that individual special assistance is a municipal competence accountable to the municipal council, the ministry has no overview of municipalities above EUR 2,000, and regional reception is part of the cabinet's migration approach.
The granting of special assistance is decentralised both in policy and financially to the mayors and aldermen (colleges of B&W).
De verlening van bijzondere bijstand is zowel beleidsmatig als financieel gedecentraliseerd aan de colleges van burgemeester en wethouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht ‘VVD: ‘Diefstal komt niet bij politie, dat lost het COA op’

MP De Graaf (PVV) asked the State Secretary whether a VVD MP's remarks that theft by asylum seekers is covered by the COA showed the need for further investigation, possibly by the Rijksrecherche. The State Secretary answered that compensating shopkeepers for asylum-seeker theft is not COA policy, that no such cases are known, that COA checked and found no concrete cases, and that no grounds for further investigation exist.
I therefore see no grounds for further investigation.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanknopingspunten voor verder onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de aanval op een cipier van de Penitentiaire Inrichting (PI) Vught

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a stabbing attack on a prison guard at PI Vught with a sharpened toothbrush, including whether the incident was concealed, whether the Inspectorate investigated, staffing levels, aftercare, and whether budget cuts endanger safety. The state secretary answered that the incident was reported under internal procedures, that the Inspectorate found the PI handled it correctly, that staffing was not short, and that the Masterplan cuts did not increase aggression.
There is no question of concealing this incident.
Er is geen sprake van stilhouden van dit incident.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Karabulut over strafrechtelijke boetes in de schuldhulpverlening

MPs Van Nispen and Karabulut asked about a Rotterdam court ruling forcing the CJIB into a debt-settlement arrangement, the inability to include recent versus nearly-expired criminal fines in voluntary debt schemes, and whether this would lead to more forced settlements. The State Secretary defended the enforcement of criminal fines, citing installment options, clemency, and the statute of limitations extension, and said he finds widespread final debt relief undesirable.
For Wahv sanctions, as stated in the answer to question 2, since 1 January 2016 further collection of outstanding Wahv sanctions is ended after a successfully completed voluntary debt settlement.

Voor de Wahv-sancties geldt dat, zoals in antwoord op vraag 2 gemeld, sinds 1 januari 2016 de verdere inning van openstaande Wahv-sancties wordt beëindigd na een succesvol afgeronde minnelijke schuldregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het bericht dat de verdachte van de liquidatie in IJsselstein op voorwaarden vrij was

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked how a suspect in an IJsselstein killing could evade reclassering supervision while on conditional release, and whether TBS and PIJ leave should be abolished. The state secretary said supervision was carried out properly according to the Inspectie, and defended PIJ and TBS leave as necessary for resocialisation, declining to abolish it.
Because this is an individual case, I cannot go into the arrangement of the supervision in this specific case.
Omdat het een individuele casus betreft kan ik niet ingaan op de invulling van het toezicht in dit specifieke geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Gevangenisoproer in België’

The MP asked whether the state secretary was aware of the Belgian prison riot and whether the Netherlands would again discuss keeping the Tilburg prison open for Belgian inmates before its planned closure. The state secretary confirmed awareness and said the Netherlands remains willing to keep Tilburg available, but Belgium has not changed its decision to phase out use of the facility.
I have informed Minister Geens that the willingness on the Dutch side remains.
Ik heb Minister Geens laten weten dat de bereidheid aan Nederlandse zijde blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van Toorenburg over de gesubsidieerde milieurechtsbijstand

Two CDA MPs asked why legal-aid policy charges legal persons in environmental cases only 25% of the highest contribution, whether this rule was evaluated, and whether members' private wealth is considered. The minister explained the 2008 rule was meant to prevent exclusion of environmental groups, said no evaluation occurred and that the Raad voor rechtsbijstand will review it, provided usage figures, and held that members' private means are not relevant to the legal person's means test.
I will ask the Legal Aid Board to examine whether this measure, given its original objective, should be maintained.
Ik zal de raad voor rechtsbijstand verzoeken te onderzoeken of deze maatregel, gelet op de oorspronkelijke doelstelling daarvan, moet worden gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over een uitspraak van de Raad voor Strafrechtstoepassing en Jeugdbescherming (RSJ) op 25 februari 2016

An MP asks the State Secretary about an RSJ ruling that a prison director's order to segregate a prisoner, based on GRIP intelligence, was not reasonable beyond one day because no verification was shown, and whether directors should better argue their case before the RSJ. The State Secretary answers that the ruling was based on an administrative error where no defence was filed, that procedures have been adjusted, and that attending hearings is up to the director, with no new awareness campaign planned.
Procedures in appeal cases have since been adjusted by the institution concerned, so that repetition is prevented.
Inmiddels zijn de procedures in beroepszaken door de betreffende penitentiaire inrichting aangepast, zodat herhaling wordt voorkomen.
Antwoord op het vragen van lid Voortman over het bericht dat EU-diplomaten onderhandelen over een vluchtelingendeal met een van de Libische regeringen

An MP asked the government about reports that EU diplomats were negotiating a migration deal with a Libyan government, and about the Dutch role, the prospects of such a deal given Libya's instability, and rescue capacity on the Italy route. The minister replied that no broad migration agreement is under negotiation, that Libya cannot yet be a safe third country, that Dutch support is limited to coast guard and migration projects, and that EU operations already contribute to rescues.
There is, however, no question of negotiations on a broad migration agreement between the EU and Libya.
Er is echter geen sprake van onderhandelingen over een breed migratie-akkoord tussen de EU en Libië.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht dat het COA winkeliers compenseert voor door asielzoekers gestolen goederen

MP De Graaf asked the State Secretary whether reports that the COA compensates shopkeepers for goods stolen by asylum seekers are true, and how many shopkeepers and how much money were involved since early 2015. The State Secretary answered that the COA does not recognise this signal, would find it highly undesirable, and will actively check the origin of the rumour.
Inquiries with the COA show that it does not recognise this signal, and it would of course find it highly undesirable if this were the case.
Uit navraag bij het COA blijkt dat het zich niet in dit signaal herkent, en het uiteraard ook zeer onwenselijk zou vinden als hier sprake van zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Gemeenten en Rijk ruziën nog steeds over bed-bad-brood’

An MP asks the State Secretary about the stalled negotiations with municipalities over a governance agreement on shelter for irregular migrants, which municipalities resist, sanctions, and whether continued shelter attracts asylum seekers. The State Secretary answers that talks are ongoing, declines to name opposing municipalities or discuss sanctions, and confirms a temporary financial contribution continues pending the agreement.
At this stage of the negotiations I will not go into the content of these discussions.
Ik ga in deze fase van de onderhandelingen niet in op de inhoud van deze gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Wat mis kan gaan bij een uitzetting; 3.165 vluchten geboekt 1.225 geannuleerd. Uitzetten vreemdelingen mislukt steeds vaker’

MP Azmani asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that many deportation flights were cancelled, and about causes such as procedural delays, administrative errors, uncooperative countries and FRONTEX participation. The State Secretary confirmed the rise in cancellations, attributed it partly to Dublin implementation limiting pre-departure detention, and outlined EU efforts to revise procedures while noting that only a small share of cancellations stemmed from administrative errors.
How often this happens as a result of administrative errors or delays en route is not tracked separately.
Hoe vaak dit gebeurt als gevolg van administratieve fouten of vertraging onderweg wordt niet apart bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht "Bijna 40 procent uitzettingen mislukt"

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice to confirm a report that nearly 40 percent of deportations fail, and whether the chain's return procedures are undermined, along with questions on last-minute asylum applications, notice periods, source-country cooperation and departures without supervision. The State Secretary says the 40 percent refers to cancelled booked flights (not all forced departures), argues that rising self-departure shows return is improving, and promises further analysis of EU rules and the revision of the Dublin and Procedures Directives.
The 40% figure is correct, but it does not refer to the number of failed deportations as the headline suggests, but to the number of booked flights that are cancelled.
Het percentage van 40% is correct, maar ziet niet op het aantal mislukte uitzettingen zoals de titel van het bericht doet vermoeden, maar op het aantal geboekte vluchten dat wordt geannuleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Keijzer en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Gave: ook christenen in Nederlandse azc’s bedreigd’

MPs from SGP, CDA and ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that Christians in asylum centres are threatened, including comparisons with Germany and reporting and information measures. The State Secretary declined to make quantitative comparisons with other countries, said each incident requires a firm approach, and pointed to earlier letter measures on reporting encouragement, safety across locations and information for asylum seekers.
I do not have information on the basis of which I can make such quantitative comparisons with Germany or another country.
Ik beschik niet over informatie op basis waarvan ik dergelijke kwantitatieve vergelijkingen kan maken met Duitsland of een ander land.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Help! Mijn demente ouders worden beroofd’

An MP asked the minister how court-appointed professional administrators (bewindvoerders) for vulnerable people can abuse their role despite judicial supervision, whether judges are overstretched, and what research and complaint procedures exist. The minister said the 2016 law evaluation will examine supervision and information to judges, no structural abuses have been shown, a further study of growth in administration cases is under way, and complaint procedures and judicial supervision exist.

As mentioned in answer to questions 6, 7 and 9 from MP Krol, the evaluation of the law will specifically pay attention to the supervision of administrators and enforcement of quality requirements, including information provided to the judge.

Zoals onder meer genoemd in antwoord op de vragen 6, 7 en 9 van het lid Krol zal aan de controle op bewindvoerders en de handhaving van de kwaliteitseisen die worden gesteld aan professionele bewindvoerders nadrukkelijk aandacht worden besteed bij de wetsevaluatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht ‘COA geeft met opzet teveel uit’

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that the COA deliberately overspent on costly contractors and event halls for asylum reception, and which contracts were signed since 2015. The State Secretary denied knowledge of a specific 20 million euro extra cost, pointed to COA's 2015 annual report irregularities, listed contract types and cost increases without listing individual contracts or values, and rejected closing the borders to all asylum seekers.
An additional cost of 20 million euros is not known to me.
Een extra kostenpost van 20 miljoen euro is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Azmani over het rapport ‘Rotterdamse aanpak statushouders, 2016 – 2020’ van het Rotterdamse college van burgemeester en wethouders

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a Rotterdam report attributing its backlog in housing status holders to problems with IND documents, BSN numbers and file completeness. The government answered that it does not share that conclusion, outlined the registration and information-exchange arrangements and existing support teams, and gave the number of permit holders awaiting housing.
No, I do not share that conclusion.
Nee, die conclusie deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel over de situatie van Bhutanese vluchtelingen in Nederland

Two SP MPs asked whether the Netherlands had promised to resettle 500 Bhutanese refugees from Nepal, whether resettlement missions continue, how illiterate refugees can complete integration, whether naturalised refugees can travel to Bhutan, and how many political prisoners Bhutan holds. The government said no numerical promise was made, resettlement missions ran 2008–2011 and were halted after Nepal and Bhutan failed to act, integration allows extended deadlines, refugee travel documents exclude the home country, and no reliable information on political prisoners exists.
There is no unambiguous, reliable information about the presence of political prisoners in Bhutan.
Er is geen eenduidige, betrouwbare informatie over de aanwezigheid van politieke gevangenen in Bhutan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel over het bericht dat op Sheremetyevo Airport een vluchteling vast zit in de transit-zone

SP MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that a Syrian asylum seeker is stranded in Sheremetyevo airport's transit zone, including Russia's asylum practice, passport handling, how common such stranding is, and whether the Netherlands will intervene. The minister confirmed the case, said Russia rarely grants formal asylum but more often temporary status, described passport handling as standard practice, and said the Dutch embassy works through UNHCR rather than direct action on the specific case.
The Dutch embassy regularly has contact with the local UNHCR office in Moscow on refugee and migration matters.
De Nederlandse ambassade heeft regelmatig contact met het lokale kantoor van UNHCR in Moskou over vluchtelingen- en migratiezaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp, Fokke en Yücel over het mogelijk moeten sluiten van gevangenis De Karelskamp te Almelo

Three PvdA MPs asked whether prison De Karelskamp in Almelo might be closed, what the status of the reported closure plans is, and whether this would cost jobs in a shrinkage region. The Staatssecretaris answered that DJI is drafting a plan in response to falling capacity needs, that no definitive closure decision has been taken, that shrinkage regions are one weighted factor, and that a political decision will follow after new WODC research and a second opinion.
I have instructed the Custodial Institutions Agency (DJI) to develop a plan on how to deal with the declining capacity requirement.
Ik heb de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen (DJI) de opdracht gegeven een plan te ontwikkelen hoe om te gaan met de dalende capaciteitsbehoefte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de grote bezwaren tegen de komst van honderden extra asielzoekers naar Maastricht

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about strong local objections to hundreds of extra asylum seekers in Maastricht and whether municipalities should hold referendums before asylum centres are opened. The State Secretary confirmed the numbers, described local consultation and information evenings, and said regional reception remains a key principle while international obligations still apply.
The municipal government decides on the arrival of an asylum centre.
Het gemeentebestuur besluit over de komst van een asielzoekerscentrum.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het tegen de wil van de bevolking in doordrukken van een Asielzoekerscentrum (AZC) in Witmarsum

An MP asks the State Secretary why an asylum reception centre for 200 asylum seekers is being imposed on Witmarsum despite a village survey showing residents oppose it, and whether he will halt it and close the borders. The State Secretary replies that municipalities decide on reception centres in consultation with COA and that he neither forces nor blocks the centre there, and that Dutch international obligations to protect asylum seekers remain.
The municipal government decides on the arrival of an asylum reception centre.
Het gemeentebestuur besluit over de komst van een asielzoekerscentrum.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Karabulut over het bericht dat de afgelopen maanden 60 kindbruiden Nederland zijn binnengekomen

MPs Gesthuizen and Karabulut asked about reports that around 60 child brides had entered the Netherlands in recent months, the number of Syrian child brides, and how minors' safety and registration would be ensured. The state secretary confirmed roughly 60 married minor girls entered independently between September 2015 and January 2016, said the IND would not separately register child marriages, and described existing guardianship and reception measures while declining to discuss individual cases for privacy reasons.
For privacy reasons I cannot go into the individual circumstances.
Vanwege privacyaspecten kan ik niet ingaan op de individuele omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Yücel en Volp over het bericht dat Syrische kindbruiden in Nederland uit beeld dreigen te raken

MPs Kuiken, Yücel and Volp asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that Syrian child brides risk disappearing from view in the Netherlands, including whether children are vanishing from reception centres and how COA and Nidos protect them. The State Secretary answered that no reports of disappearances of married minor girls are known, that one minor entered wrongly under a residence permit, and described existing monitoring and guardianship arrangements, while a separate investigation into other vanished youths is ongoing.
The National Public Prosecution Service has therefore started an investigation into these young people following signals from COA and Nidos.
Het Landelijk Parket van het OM is dan ook naar aanleiding van de signalen van het COA en Nidos een onderzoek gestart naar deze jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het inhuren van detentietoezichthouders via een extern beveiligingsbedrijf

MP Kooiman asked why the Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen hires detention supervisors via an external security firm while staff are being dismissed under the Masterplan, and why this is cheaper than retaining or retraining own staff. The state secretary answered that shortages in the security job group trigger first internal mobility, then temporary external hiring under a framework agreement in force since 2013, that no reorganisation dismissals have occurred, that own staff have priority for structural vacancies, and that cost plays no decisive role.
External hiring takes place only if vacancies cannot be filled in time by qualified DJI staff.
Er wordt alleen extern ingehuurd indien de vacatures niet tijdig kunnen worden vervuld door gekwalificeerd DJI-personeel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Van Dekken over het mogelijk moeten sluiten van gevangenissen

MPs Volp and Van Dekken asked whether eight prisons and three youth institutions would close, whether staff had been informed, and how the government would respect the De Vries motion on regional job losses. The State Secretary answered that a WODC study and second opinion on the forecasting model are underway, DJI has been asked to draft a flexibility plan to be discussed with mayors, and the motion is one criterion in that assessment.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Keijzer over het bericht ‘Lastpak naar aso-azc’

MPs Van Toorenburg and Keijzer asked whether the state secretary had examined using the former PI Tilburg or the Zeist detention centre as a stricter facility for rule-breaking asylum seekers, and about the regime, timing, and pros and cons. The state secretary answered that the Tilburg option was not linked to the planned separate facility, that COA is exploring suitable locations (requiring local consent) and a stricter regime not based on immigration detention, and that a criminal investigation follows any offence as usual.
This exploration is currently ongoing, and I will inform your House about it at a later moment.
Momenteel is deze verkenning gaande waarover ik uw Kamer op een later moment zalinformeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat er een voedseltekort is in het vluchtelingenkamp op Lesbos

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of a food shortage at the Lesbos refugee camp, the humane implementation of the EU-Turkey deal, Commission measures to make the overcrowded Moria camp livable, and attention to vulnerable people and children. The answer refers the MP to a letter on the reporting and does not address the questions on substance.
The written questions from MP Kuiken (PvdA), question number 2016Z07174, have been answered by means of the letter 'Response to the reporting on food shortage in refugee camp Lesbos'.

Mededeling De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA), vraagnummer 2016Z07174 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie over de berichtgeving over voedseltekort in vluchtelingenkamp Lesbos, (Kamerstuk 32 317, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht ‘Veel meer asielaanvragen uit de Balkan, IND ‘verrast’

An MP asked why asylum applications from safe countries rose in 2015, whether Dutch law invites such applications, how the IND prioritises them, and what lessons to draw from Bavaria's border procedure. The State Secretary answered that no separate study exists, outlined the new fast-track 'spoor 2' procedure with detention and removal steps, and said Dutch capacity for detention is sufficient, while not answering on the timing of the requested Tilburg prison study.
There is no separate study into the causes of this.
Er is geen separaat onderzoek naar de oorzaken hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Van Toorenburg, Leijten en Dik-Faber over de tariefverhoging van de Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag en de gevolgen hiervan voor vrijwilligerswerk

MPs from CDA, SP and ChristenUnie asked the government to explain the 38% fee increase for the Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) and its impact on volunteer organisations, and to reconcile it with earlier statements. The state secretary attributed the increase mainly to cost-recovery of Justis integrity products, said 7.5% covers the free VOG scheme, declined to commission an impact study on volunteer organisations, and said no consultation with VWS took place.
I am not willing to conduct research into the consequences of the fee increase for volunteers and their organisations.
Ik ben niet bereid onderzoek te verrichten naar de gevolgen van de tariefverhoging op het effect voor vrijwilligers en hun organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ypma over het rapport ‘Wachten op je toekomst’ over asielkinderen in de noodopvang

MPs Kuiken and Ypma asked the state secretaries about the Children's Ombudsman report on asylum children in emergency shelters, including living conditions, forced relocations, access to mental health care, school continuity and support for schools. The government replied that conditions are acceptable given the high pressure on reception, that relocations cannot be fully avoided, that the IGZ is examining health care for foreigners, and that OCW will report later on school registration and school-attendance figures.
I believe the number of relocations of families with children and unaccompanied children should be kept as limited as possible.
Ik vind dat het aantal verhuisbewegingen van gezinnen met kinderen en alleenstaande kinderen zo beperkt mogelijk zou moeten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van Toorenburg over binaire opties

MPs Ronnes and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked whether binary options should be treated as games of chance rather than financial products, given their prize-like payout, the broker's opposite interest, and possible refusal of successful traders. The Minister of Finance replied that binary options are classed as financial instruments under MiFID and the AFM supervises them, that a court case on the gambling question is pending, and that no new measures are planned for now.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over bijzonder bijkomende kosten voor kinderen onder voogdij en residentiële instellingen

An SP MP asks the State Secretaries whether municipalities are refusing to pay special additional costs for children under guardianship or in residential care, whether this reflects procurement pressure and the costs dispute the Children's Ombudsman reported, and whether financial barriers prevent parental contact. The Minister replies that no concrete signals of municipal refusal are known, that a factsheet with the VNG and Jeugdzorg Nederland will clarify the scheme, that special assistance is not the right route, that travel costs can be reimbursed, and that parental contributions were abolished, but commits to no new structural measures beyond the factsheet.
I am not aware of any concrete signals that municipalities would no longer be willing to pay for special costs.
Er zijn mij geen concrete signalen bekend dat gemeenten niet meer bereid zouden zijn om te betalen voor bijzondere kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat sluiting van nog meer gevangenissen dreigt

An MP asks the Secretary of State whether prison closures are threatened because recorded crime is falling, and whether this reflects cuts to prosecution and police rather than real crime levels. The Secretary acknowledges prognoses point to falling cell demand, orders a preparation plan, denies that cuts are impairing investigation, and promises a WODC study and an Inspectorate report.
I have therefore asked the WODC to start a study on this matter.
Ik heb daarom het WODC gevraagd dienaangaande een onderzoek te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Drugs- en wapensmokkel Woenselse Poort kinderlijk eenvoudig’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretaries of Security and Justice and of Health about a broadcast showing easy drug and weapon smuggling into the Woenselse Poort forensic psychiatric clinic, including the effectiveness of security measures after a firearm-related suicide and whether inspection oversight is ongoing. The State Secretary answered in detail: no firearm was found in five years, security measures were described, internal and Inspectorate investigations are underway, and the outcome is expected within weeks.
The police are currently investigating the origin of the weapon.
Door de politie wordt momenteel onderzoek gedaan naar de herkomst van het wapen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het sluiten van gevangenissen

MP Kooiman (SP) asks whether the government will close more prisons, whether further cuts at Justice are wise, what the scenarios discussed with prison directors involve, and what happens if the PMJ prison-capacity forecasts do not materialise. The State Secretary says the measures stem from aligning capacity with forecast need rather than a new budget cut, that DJI is preparing a plan with no final decisions yet, and that the 2017 budget implications will be presented on Prinsjesdag.
At this stage, however, no definitive decisions have yet been taken on this.
In dit stadium zijn hierover echter nog geen definitieve beslissingen genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Opstand Vught neergeslagen’

Mr Van Toorenburg asked the State Secretary about reports of a riot in the Vught prison terrorism wing and the IBT intervention, including injuries to staff, incident frequency, staff safety and radicalisation. The State Secretary answered that the IBT was deployed on 19 December 2015 (not January 2016), one officer was lightly injured, two incidents occurred in 2015, staffing is adequate, and a new risk assessment tool and differentiated placement policy are being studied.
One member of the IBT was lightly injured on 19 December 2015.
Er is één lid van het IBT lichtgewond geraakt op 19 december 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over celdeuren die van binnenuit afgesloten kunnen worden door gedetineerden

An MP asks the State Secretary whether cell doors that prisoners can lock from inside should be replaced after reports of dangerous situations for prison staff and a fatal incident. The State Secretary answers that an inventory found the doors need no replacement, only some bolts or locking plates adjusted, and that staff instructions were reinforced.
Based on this inventory, it appears that the cell doors do not need to be adjusted.
Op basis van deze inventarisatie blijkt dat de celdeuren niet aangepast hoeven te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Bende in de bajes’

An MP asked whether violent incidents in prisons are rising, whether guards get enough risk information from police, how incidents are reported, and whether the state will reduce violence. The Secretary of State replied that 258 physical assaults on staff occurred in 2015, down from 5.5 to 3 per 100 places since 2010, and that no extra measures beyond existing ones are planned.
Given this declining trend, I see no reason to take extra measures beyond all the known preventive and repressive measures already being taken.
Ik zie gelet op deze dalende tendens geen aanleiding om extra maatregelen te treffen bovenop alle bekende preventieve en repressieve maatregelen die al worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, van Haersma Buma en Pechtold over onduidelijkheden rond het door de regering gevoerde asielbeleid

Opposition MPs from GroenLinks, CDA and D66 asked the Prime Minister and State Secretary of Security and Justice about unclear targets, forecasts, budgets, border controls and information on the asylum intake of 2016. The State Secretary answered at length, often stating that effects cannot be quantified in advance, that a 58,000 intake target is assumed for the budget while contingency planning uses the 93,600 forecast, and that some information is not available in the requested form.
Because the causes of migration are strongly influenced by external factors, it is not possible to quantify the effects of these measures in advance.
Doordat de oorzaken van migratie sterk beïnvloed worden door externe factoren is het niet mogelijk om effecten van deze maatregelen vooraf te kwantificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Marcouch en Servaes over het bericht dat Eritrese intimidatie in Nederland zich uit breidt

PvdA MPs asked whether Eritrean regime-linked intimidation and extortion of diaspora members in the Netherlands is known, what action is taken, and whether the Eritrean embassy was confronted and funds traced. The minister answered that the government knows of the reports, has not found evidence of Eritrean support to Al-Shabaab, held a warning meeting with the Eritrean ambassador, and that police and prosecutors investigate concrete suspicions of crimes, while no overview of incidents exists.
There is no overview of the number of incidents in relation to the Eritrean regime.
Er is geen overzicht van het aantal incidenten in relatie tot het Eritrese regime.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Voordewind over het bericht 'Eritrese intimidatie in Nederland breidt zich uit'

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked about reports of intimidation of Eritrean regime critics in the Netherlands, including threats at asylum locations and whether IND interpreters are linked to the regime. The government said it has no specific registration of such incidents, pointed to police and prosecution duties, outlined vetting and a code of conduct for IND interpreters with two interpreters dropped and an external audit, and referred back to earlier answers on regime levies.
The Public Prosecution Service and the police do not specifically record in their systems the link between offences and the Eritrean regime.
Het Openbaar Ministerie en de politie registeren niet specifiek in de systemen op de relatie van delicten met het Eritrese regime.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over de brandstichting in een cel in de penitentiaire inrichting (PI) Vught

MP Van Toorenburg asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about the death of a detainee after a cell fire at PI Vught, the prevention measures for suicide, the number of unnatural deaths there, and the timing of an inspection report on a 2015 suicide. The State Secretary answered that internal DJI investigations are not published, that suicide prevention measures are described generally, that personal information about the deceased's care cannot be shared, and that the Inspectorate did not investigate the 2015 death, with an IGZ review finding the care structure in order.
As usual, these are not made public because these reports contain personal data and information about procedures within the institution.
Zoals gebruikelijk worden deze niet openbaar gemaakt omdat deze rapporten persoonsgegevens én informatie over handelwijzen binnen de inrichting bevatten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Volp over het bericht van Europol over minstens 10 duizend vermiste vluchtelingenkinderen

MPs Kuiken and Volp asked the State Secretary about a reported Europol claim that over 10,000 refugee children have gone missing after registration, and what the government is doing to monitor and protect them. The State Secretary said the figure is unverified, outlined EU and national measures including SIS alerts and a new coordination platform, and described procedures for unaccompanied minors who leave care, while committing to propose further SIS-based steps to the EU.
Europol has indicated that it is not an official Europol report.
Europol heeft aangegeven dat het niet om een officieel bericht van Europol gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over het artikel “Cipier met mes aangevallen”

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports of guards being attacked with knives and smuggling in prisons, including Alphen aan den Rijn, and about integrity, contraband controls and staff complaint channels. The State Secretary answered that the incidents occurred, that the Inspectorate was asked to speed up its integrity investigation, and that existing measures (screening, searches, complaint channels, sanctions) are considered sufficient, with no new measures planned.
Although the claims made in these articles are not recognised within my organisation, I nonetheless asked the Inspectorate of Security and Justice to bring forward its integrity investigation.
Hoewel de in deze artikelen geuite beweringen niet worden herkend in mijn organisatie, heb ik de Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie (IVenJ) toch gevraagd haar onderzoek naar integriteit te vervroegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de berichten ‘Cipiers aangevallen’ en ‘Wapens en drugs in gevangenis Alphen’

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports of guards being attacked and weapons and drugs found in Alphen prison, including how a bread knife reached a cell and claims experts warned of dangers. The State Secretary confirms the reports, explains the item was a blunt cell-inventory knife, and states that safety has top priority and that warning signals are taken seriously, without accepting that problems were ignored.
There is no question of signals about risky situations having been ignored.
Er is geen sprake van dat signalen over risicovolle situaties zouden zijn genegeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat er meer aanwijzingen zijn voor asieltolken met banden met het dictatoriale regime in Eritrea

MPs Voortman and Sjoerdsma asked about reports that IND interpreters for asylum procedures may have ties to the Eritrean regime, and about the BV&I report, prior IND investigations, AIVD involvement, handling of other interpreters, notification of other employers, and the adequacy of IND selection and controls. The State Secretary declined to share individual dossiers, said the IND followed the code of conduct in 2014, reported that other Eritrean interpreters were invited for interviews with further investigation ongoing, and announced an external review of the integrity process.

As I already explained during the committee meeting of 12 November, I do not consider it correct to share dossiers on individual persons with whom a working relationship exists or has existed with the House.

Zoals ik tijdens het AO van 12 november jl. reeds heb toegelicht, acht ik het niet correct om dossiers over individuele personen met wie een werkrelatie bestaat, of heeft bestaan, met de Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over jongeren die worden omgekocht in jeugdgevangenissen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice how he views reports that detained youths' complaints are bought off with compensation such as phone credit, and whether the informal complaint procedure should be changed. The State Secretary says bribery is unacceptable and that a joint policy response to the Children's Ombudsman will be sent to parliament, deferring the detailed answers to that response.
Bribery is absolutely undesirable and does not belong in the practice of the complaints right for young people in closed custody.
Omkopen is volstrekt onwenselijk en behoort niet thuis in de praktijk van het klachtrecht voor jeugdigen in geslotenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Kooiman over de dood van een Eritrese asielzoeker

MPs Gesthuizen and Kooiman asked whether police and prosecutors would investigate the disappearance and death of an Eritrean asylum seeker, why COA and police information was not shared with German authorities, and whether a conflict with a roommate was reported. The minister replied that the German authorities handled and closed the investigation, that the COA reported a roommate dispute but no threat, that the person was moved to another room, and that the COA's notice to the EMM was not passed on under standard procedure, while promising to inform relatives if new insight arises.
The investigation into the death of the Eritrean asylum seeker, Mr. Mekonen, falls under the competence of the German authorities.
Het onderzoek naar het overlijden van de Eritrese asielzoeker, de heer Mekonen, valt onder de bevoegdheid van de Duitse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Gesthuizen over het bericht dat gevluchte Eritrese vrouwen zijn gedwongen tot seks

Two SP MPs asked the government about reports that Eritrean refugee women were forced into sex, including how many are pregnant and whether they are in asylum centres. The minister answers that about 25 women report unwanted pregnancy and three report rape, that COA took preventive measures and reported signals to police, and that no formal complaints have yet been filed and no criminal offences established.
COA cannot assess the seriousness and truthfulness of these signals and has reported them to the police and the Expertise Centre on Human Trafficking and Smuggling (EMM).
Het COA kan de ernst en het waarheidsgehalte van deze signalen niet inschatten en heeft deze signalen gemeld bij de politie en Expertisecentrum Mensenhandel en Mensensmokkel (EMM).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over boeven die de baas zijn in de bajes

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that long-sentenced prisoners dominate prisons, including claims about cell inspections finding weapons and phones, integrity of guards, whistleblower channels, and police intelligence awareness. The State Secretary said staff did not recognise the criticism, asked the Inspectorate to bring forward an integrity and contraband investigation, described inspection and integrity procedures and whistleblower options, and declined to confirm or deny the intelligence question.

Nevertheless, given these different signals and the great importance of integrity in an organisation like DJI, I have asked the Inspectorate of Security and Justice to bring forward its announced investigation into contraband and integrity issues in the prison system.

Toch heb ik gelet op deze verschillende geluiden en het grote belang van integriteit in een organisatie als DJI, de Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie (IVenJ) verzocht haar reeds in haar werkprogramma 2016 aangekondigde onderzoek in het gevangeniswezen naar contrabande en integriteitskwesties, naar voren te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat boeven de baas zijn in de bajes

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary whether influential prisoners rule certain wings instead of staff, whether corrupt prison guards enable weapons, phones and drugs, and what measures will be taken. The State Secretary says staff do not recognise the criticism, asked the Inspectorate to bring forward its integrity and contraband investigation, and points to existing screening and integrity measures without adding new ones for now.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Boeven de baas in bajes’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about press reports that prison staff at PI Alphen a/d Rijn and PI Ter Peel had lost control over the regime, including weapons, contraband, integrity breaches and staff cuts. The State Secretary said staff did not recognise the criticism, brought forward an Inspectorate investigation into contraband and integrity, reported two staff access bans and ongoing integrity investigations, and answered the staffing and death-in-custody questions without new structural commitments.

Nevertheless, given these different voices and the great importance of integrity in an organisation like DJI, I have asked the Inspectorate of Security and Justice to bring forward its announced investigation into contraband and integrity issues in the prison system.

Toch heb ik gelet op deze verschillende geluiden en het grote belang van integriteit in een organisatie als DJI, de Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie (IVenJ) verzocht haar reeds in haar werkprogramma 2016 aangekondigde onderzoek in het gevangeniswezen naar contrabande en integriteitskwesties, naar voren te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over boeven die de baas zijn in de bajes

MP Kooiman (SP) asked about reports that long-sentenced prisoners run the wing in PI Alphen aan den Rijn and PI De Schie, smuggling of phones and anabolics by staff, and integrity checks. The State Secretary denied the De Schie claims, reported cell inspections and an access ban for one staff member, described the VOG and integrity bureau system, and said the Inspectorate was already asked to examine contraband and integrity.

As I also indicated in the answers to the questions from MPs Helder (PVV) and Van Toorenburg (CDA), I have asked the Inspectorate of Security and Justice to examine contraband and integrity issues in the prison system.

Zoals ik ook heb aangegeven in de antwoorden op de vragen die zijn gesteld door het lid Helder (PVV)(Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2015–2016, nr. 1782 ) en Van Toorenburg (CDA)(Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2015–2016, nr. 1784 ) heb ik de IVenJ verzocht haar onderzoek in het gevangeniswezen naar contrabande en integriteitskwesties.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van de leden Siderius en Gesthuizen inzake de problemen rond de huisvesting van de Internationale Schakelklas (ISK)

MPs Siderius and Gesthuizen asked the state secretaries about problems finding adequate school housing for asylum-seeker children in the International Transition Class, and about funding and a possible national contribution. The government answered that municipalities are responsible for school housing, acknowledged difficulties in some cases, said a national scheme for secondary education is being explored, and is in talks with affected municipalities and school boards.

For secondary education, the possibility is being examined of quickly designing a scheme, modelled on the OHBA scheme for primary education with standard amounts, that addresses school housing problems in municipalities.
Voor het voortgezet onderwijs wordt de mogelijkheid onderzocht om op korte termijn een regeling te ontwerpen, die naar analogie aan de OHBA-regeling voor het primair onderwijs met normbedragen werkt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat COA-personeel een asielzoeker heeft ontmoedigd om aangifte te doen van discriminatie en bedreiging

MP Voortman asked the State Secretary about reports that COA staff discouraged an asylum seeker from reporting discrimination and threats, and about oversight of COA staff conduct, complaint procedures, and sanctions against troublesome residents. The State Secretary denied that staff discouraged reporting, described COA codes of conduct, complaint rules and inspection oversight, rejected a separate confidant for vulnerable groups, and reported 7,470 sanctions imposed in 2015 with a stricter sanctions approach promised for March.
Enquiries with the COA have shown me that there was no question of discouraging the filing of a report.
Uit navraag bij het COA is mij gebleken dat hier geen sprake is geweest van het ontmoedigen van het doen van aangifte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de oproep van burgemeesters om kleinschalige opvang van asielzoekers zelf te regelen

An MP asked the State Secretary whether small-scale asylum reception could be left to mayors, whether small locations are not feasible, and whether small municipalities could experiment with integration. The State Secretary said small locations suit recognised refugees, that the government cannot refuse any location given urgent capacity needs, and that COA and OTAV will support municipalities' new initiatives.
Given the asylum inflow and the urgent need for reception capacity, I am not in a position to refuse locations.
Gelet op de asielinstroom en de dringende behoefte aan opvangcapaciteit bevind ik mij niet in de luxepositie om locaties te kunnen weigeren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma en Bergkamp over het bericht dat ‘Eritrese meisjes moeten wegblijven uit deze kerk’ en ‘Twintig Eritrese vluchtelingen uit Oranje zwanger na bezoeken aan Rotterdamse kerk?’

MPs Sjoerdsma and Bergkamp asked about reports that Eritrean girls should stay away from a Rotterdam church after about twenty Eritrean asylum seekers became pregnant, and what COA and Nidos did with warning signals. The government answered that COA received unverified signals, took precautionary measures such as banning unaccompanied minors from visiting the church, reported to police, and that police and prosecutors found no criminal suspicion so far, while withholding details of individual pregnancies under medical confidentiality.

The National Prosecutor's Office will explore the possibilities to examine the signals of possible abuses within the Eritrean community in the Netherlands at national level and in a multidisciplinary manner.

Het Landelijk Parket van het OM zal de mogelijkheden verkennen om de signalen van mogelijke misstanden binnen de Eritrese gemeenschap in Nederland op landelijk niveau en op multidisciplinaire wijze nader te bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Volp over het bericht dat uit Eritrea gevluchte vrouwen mogelijk zijn gedwongen tot seks rondom een bezoek aan de Eritrees-orthodoxe kerk

MPs Kuiken and Volp asked the State Secretary about reports that Eritrean women and minors may have been coerced into sex around visits to an Eritrean Orthodox church in Rotterdam, and about COA's response, protection, reporting and victim support. The State Secretary answered that COA reported signals to police and EMM, took preventive measures and that police/prosecutors found no complaints or suspected offences so far, while noting that the signals' seriousness cannot be assessed.

The National Prosecutor's Office will explore the possibilities to examine the signals of possible abuses within the Eritrean community in the Netherlands at national level and in a multidisciplinary way.

Het Landelijk Parket van het OM zal de mogelijkheden verkennen om de signalen van mogelijke misstanden binnen de Eritrese gemeenschap in Nederland op landelijk niveau en op multidisciplinaire wijze nader te bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Maij over het mogelijk strafbaar stellen van vrijwilligerswerk ten behoeve van asielzoekers op Griekse eilanden

Two MPs asked whether a leaked EU Council draft on migrant smuggling would criminalise NGOs and volunteers helping asylum seekers on Greek islands, and whether the Netherlands would act against such criminalisation. The State Secretary replied that the draft conclusions contain no new legislation, do not criminalise humanitarian volunteers, and that existing EU law allows member states an exemption clause for humanitarian assistance, with no further action needed.
The accusation that the Council Conclusions on migrant smuggling lead to the criminalisation of NGOs and volunteers is incorrect.
Het verwijt dat de Raadsconclusies inzake mensensmokkel tot criminalisering van NGO’s en vrijwilligers leidt is onjuist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het rapport van het College van de Rechten voor de Mens over de situatie in Heumensoord

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the CRM report on the Heumensoord asylum shelter, including protection of LGBT and vulnerable residents, small-scale locations, boredom and stress, unclear procedures and whether the report's recommendations would be adopted. The State Secretary said discrimination is not tolerated, pointed to planned information on tougher measures and COA dialogue, noted measures already taken on safety and activities, and said he would study the recommendations while the Inspectorate had been asked to examine shelter risks.
I consider it important that organisations such as the CRM and the National Ombudsman critically review matters, and I will study the recommendations to see what we can learn from them.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat organisaties zoals het CRM en de Nationale ombudsman kritisch meekijken en ik zal de aanbevelingen bestuderen om te bezien wat we hiervan kunnen leren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Kuiken over een dreigend tekort van menskracht bij de GGD door de toestroom van vluchtelingen

MPs Wolbert and Kuiken asked whether the influx of refugees will cause a staff shortage at the GGD public health services and what the government will do to prevent it. The Secretary of State said the staffing impact is hard to predict, that municipalities are responsible for adequate GGD capacity, and that a working group with the VNG was set up to address the issues.
As a result, it cannot be stated in advance whether a staff shortage will arise at the GGDs.
Daardoor is het op voorhand niet aan te geven of er zich een tekort aan menskracht bij GGD'en gaat voordoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Voortman en Van der Staaij over voorlichting aan asielzoekers in Nederland

MPs Voordewind, Voortman and Van der Staaij asked whether information for asylum seekers in reception centres is limited to LHBT groups, whether incidents involving asylum seekers are registered, whether incidents are more frequent in emergency reception locations, and whether an independent confidential person should be appointed. The minister answered that COA is consulting on broader information covering Christians, atheists and other minorities, that incidents are not registered by asylum status or sexual orientation, that the data do not show more incidents in larger locations, and that the government sees no added value in a separate confidential person.
The sexual orientation of a resident is not registered in COA's systems.
De seksuele gerichtheid van een bewoner wordt in de systemen van het COA niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de registratie van criminele asielzoekers

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the ministry lacks central oversight of how many criminal asylum seekers lose or are denied residence permits, and whether a central register will be created. The State Secretary rejected the premise of missing central oversight, explained that the IND assesses these cases and that rules were recently tightened, and noted that public order can now be recorded as a refusal or withdrawal ground.
I do not share the picture described regarding the absence of oversight in the registration of criminal asylum seekers.
Het geschetste beeld met betrekking tot het ontbreken van regie op het vlak van registratie van criminele asielzoekers deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Kuiken over de moeilijke positie van LHBT in de asielopvang

MPs Gesthuizen and Kuiken asked about a reported suicide attempt by a gay asylum seeker in Alphen aan den Rijn linked to LHBT insecurity, reports of abuse of LHBT residents in reception centres, low reporting of crimes, and whether separate shelter or a dedicated contact person should be provided. The Secretary of State said the resident was moved at his own request, rejected a separate inquiry, said discrimination is not tolerated and the COA will pursue perpetrators, declined separate categorical shelter and a dedicated LHBT contact person, and promised a letter by March 2016 on stricter enforcement plus a study meeting to improve information on rights and reporting.
I therefore see no reason to have a further investigation carried out into the circumstances.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om een nader onderzoek te laten doen naar de toedracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders over het door het Centraal orgaan Opvang Asielzoekers (COA) verzorgen van huur- en zorgtoeslag voor statushouders

MPs Fritsma and Wilders asked why status holders receive urgent rent and care allowance handling through COA while Dutch citizens do not, and whether this unequal treatment and priority housing for asylum seekers will end. The State Secretary answered that it is a pilot to reduce errors and speed exit from reception, that the identification step is simply done by COA staff, that all citizens can use Toeslagenservicepunten, and that a bill to remove housing priority for permit holders is being prepared.
There is no question of priority or acceleration for holders of a residence permit compared with Dutch nationals.
Er is geen sprake van voorrang of versnelling van houders van een verblijfsvergunning ten opzichte van Nederlanders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat door redders wordt toegekeken bij het verdrinken van vluchtelingen uit angst voor vervolging

An MP from GroenLinks asked whether prosecution of volunteers rescuing refugees in Turkish waters off Greece is EU policy, and whether the government will press for it to stop and use its Council presidency to remove legal obstacles to rescues. The Secretary of State replied that no such EU or Turkey agreements exist, that Greece has prosecuted volunteers for people smuggling, that existing EU law has a humanitarian exemption, and that rescues can proceed under the current framework.
No agreements have been made within the EU or with Turkey on prosecuting persons who voluntarily rescue refugees in distress in Turkish waters.
Er zijn geen afspraken gemaakt binnen de EU of met Turkije over het vervolgen van personen die op vrijwillige basis vluchtelingen in nood redden in Turkse wateren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Eritrese intimidatie in Nederland breidt zich uit’
