MP Azmani asked the State Secretary whether asylum applications from Eritreans are checked for regime affiliation, whether deportation is possible and whether IND is informed of regime ties, and whether safe third-country arrangements can be made. The government answered that IND considers regime ties, that deportation is not currently on the agenda, that AIVD information can be shared case by case without public comment, and that EU partnership programmes are underway but safe third-country status is not yet achievable.
I do not make public statements about individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen doe ik in het openbaar geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Fritsma over groepen van vooral Arabische mannen die tientallen jonge vrouwen hebben aangerand, beroofd en verkracht in Duitsland

PVV MPs asked the government whether it shares the view that New Year's Eve sexual assaults by groups of mostly Arab men in German cities reflect imported violence from migrants, and whether it will close borders. The State Secretary answered that sexual violence against women must be combated, that the Cologne events were serious and the investigation ongoing, and declined to speculate on causes or to adopt the rhetoric, without committing to border changes.
For completeness, I note that the investigation into the events in Cologne is still ongoing; I therefore do not think it appropriate to speculate about possible underlying causes.
Volledigheidshalve merk ik op dat het onderzoek naar de gebeurtenissen in Keulen nog loopt; ik vind het daarom niet gepast om te speculeren over mogelijke onderliggende oorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Fokke over het bericht dat bestuurders in de buurt meetellen bij de planning van asielzoekerscentra

MPs Kuiken and Fokke asked whether officials at the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf were right to check which local administrators live near a possible asylum site, and why. The minister answered that COA, not the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, is responsible for finding locations, that the wording in the email suggests such considerations can and may not matter, and that COA does not use a social map and no sites were rejected on this basis; the answers to earlier questions were referred to.
The wording of the email, as reported in the Algemeen Dagblad, creates the suggestion that the presence of administrators could make a difference. That cannot and may not be the case.
Het taalgebruik uit de e-mail, zoals gemeld in het Algemeen Dagblad, wekt de suggestie dat de aanwezigheid van bestuurders verschil kan maken. Dat kan en mag niet het geval zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht “Bestuurder in de buurt weegt mee bij locatie AZC”

An MP asked whether a list of 36 residents near the Prinses Julianakazerne, some of them officials, was compiled as part of a site assessment for an asylum centre and whether locations were rejected because administrators lived nearby. The government answered that the list was an inventory linked to a possible change of use, that the presence of administrators is not a relevant factor for the COA, and that no locations were rejected for that reason.
That may not and cannot be the case.
Dat kan en mag niet het geval zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de toedracht van de moord in PI Zoetermeer

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the handling of prisoners with psychiatric disorders following a fatal prison incident in PI Zoetermeer, including placement in PPC and EZV units, transfers, and investigations. The State Secretary answered that existing care and placement arrangements are adequate, that investigations will reveal the circumstances, and that internal reports will not be published, though inspection reports are.
I do not consider it desirable to make these public, because these reports contain personal data and information on procedures within the institution.
Ik acht het niet wenselijk om deze openbaar te maken, omdat deze rapporten persoonsgegevens én informatie over handelwijzen binnen de inrichting bevatten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Jadnanansing over het bericht dat scholen steeds vaker een VOG vragen om moeilijke leerlingen te weren

MPs Volp and Jadnanansing asked whether schools increasingly require a certificate of good conduct (VOG) to exclude difficult students, and whether youths with criminal records are blocked from education and internships as a result. The government answered that the qualitative study cannot support claims about trends or numbers, that no data exist on schools requiring VOGs, and that it intends to address the issue through communication, local initiatives and further research, with a letter to parliament planned for mid-2016.
No figures exist on educational institutions that require their students to obtain a VOG, or that otherwise discourage people with a criminal record from enrolling in a course or study.

Er bestaan geen cijfers van onderwijsinstellingen die hun studenten om een VOG vragen, of personen met een justitieel verleden anderszins ontmoedigen om zich in te schrijven voor een opleiding of studie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het geweld, intimidatie en pestgedrag tegen homoseksuele asielzoekers in asielzoekerscentra

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about harassment, bullying and violence against gay asylum seekers in reception centres, and whether victims' reluctance to file complaints and the lack of separate safehouses were addressed. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, said COA sanctions and criminal prosecution will be set out in a letter by March, and maintained that separate reception for vulnerable groups is not the answer, offering instead relocation of perpetrators and a safe place within the centre for victims.
In case of incidents, the COA takes (punitive) measures and encourages residents, in case of possible criminal offences, to file a complaint.
Het COA neemt in geval van incidenten (straf)maatregelen en stimuleert bewoners, in geval van mogelijk strafbare feiten, tot het doen van aangifte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Kuiken over de penibele situatie van gestrande migranten bij de Griekse grensplaats Idomeni

Two PvdA MPs asked the government about stranded migrants at Idomeni on the Greek-Macedonian border, including lack of shelter, whether a closed Greek camp could be reopened, and EU hotspot implementation. The government answered that it monitors the fluid situation, the camp has reopened, Dutch humanitarian funding has been provided, and it is working on hotspots and coordination within the EU.
The cabinet is attentive to the situation in Idomeni, which is very fluid, and follows developments closely.
Het kabinet heeft aandacht voor de situatie in Idomeni, die zeer fluïde is, en volgt de ontwikkelingen op de voet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Bruins over de zienswijze en opstelling van de gemeente Rotterdam inzake leerplicht en kinderbescherming

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister whether a Rotterdam municipal position, treating parents' use of the Leerplichtwet exemption as grounds for a Raad voor de Kinderbescherming investigation, is acceptable and consistent with legal certainty. The minister answered that children need education under the IVRK, that municipalities may file a verzoek tot onderzoek when development is threatened, that parents have no legal remedy to stop such an investigation, and that the filing is not an administrative decision.
Parents have no legal remedies available to prevent an investigation by the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming into whether a child's development is threatened.
Ouders staan geen rechtsmiddelen ter beschikking om een onderzoek door de Raad voor de Kinderbescherming om te zien of de ontwikkeling van een kind wordt bedreigd af te wenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat rechtsbijstand aan slachtoffers van misdrijven in gevaar komt

An MP asked whether victims' lawyers are underpaid by the Legal Aid Board, leading to reduced willingness to take victim cases, and whether the government will ensure fair fees. The minister denied underpayment, cited quality rules and low numbers of refused extra-hours requests, and said the Commission-Wolfsen recommendation on fee recalibration will be addressed in a spring 2016 reply.
In its recently published final report, the Commission-Wolfsen recommends recalibrating the flat-rate point allocation, including the threshold for extra hours.
In haar onlangs verschenen eindrapportage doet de Commissie-Wolfsen de aanbeveling de forfaitaire puntentoekenning te herijken, ook ten aanzien van de grens voor extra uren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat Veilig Thuis tekort schiet in haar taken

An MP asked whether Veilig Thuis (domestic violence reporting centres) falls short in its tasks, including long waiting lists that may include high-priority cases and whether acute cases get contact, and what is being done. The state secretary acknowledged inspection signals, said municipalities added funds and organisations are preparing improvement plans, and stated that not all centres meet legal requirements and that some high-priority cases are on waiting lists.
I expect the final inspection report at the end of February 2016. As soon as I have received this report, I will send it to you within the usual timeframes.
Het eindrapport van de inspecties verwacht ik eind februari 2016. Zodra ik dit rapport heb ontvangen, zal ik het binnen de gebruikelijke termijnen aan u sturen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een van groepsverkrachting verdachte asielzoeker

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about an asylum seeker suspected of group rape, including his status, his reception centre, whether such offenders always forfeit residence, and how EU border travel is controlled. The State Secretary answered that the suspect is a family member of an admitted asylum seeker, that stricter criminal-conviction thresholds apply and the IND will await court outcomes, and that Schengen alerts would ensure his return and prosecution.
The IND will, where necessary, wait as long as legally permitted to decide on the asylum application until the court's ruling in any criminal case is known.
De IND wacht, indien nodig, zo lang als wettelijk toegestaan met de beslissing op de asielaanvraag tot de uitspraak van de rechter in een eventuele strafzaak bekend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het succesvolle ontmoedigingsbeleid van België

Two MPs asked whether the government will adopt a Belgian- and Danish-style discouragement campaign aimed at asylum seekers to reduce inflows. The State Secretary answered that the government supports providing accurate information about the asylum process and reception conditions, but sees no reason to expect higher inflows from other countries' policies and therefore no additional measures.
I have no reason to assume that the countries mentioned choose to paint an incorrect picture in their information provision.
Ik heb geen redenen om te veronderstellen dat de genoemde landen er voor kiezen een onjuist beeld te schetsen in hun informatievoorziening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de druk op de beveiliging in asielzoekerscentra groot is

SP MPs asked whether reports of high pressure on security at asylum reception centres were accurate, how many violent incidents occurred, whether training and police support were adequate, and how staff safety is ensured. The Secretary of State answered that incidents rose in number but are not disproportionate, that contracted security is certified, that a mantle agreement with the security firm covers staff safety, and that police support is available, while stating that incidents with weapons are not separately registered and that the COA could not split its figures by location type.
Incidents involving weapons are not registered separately.
Incidenten waarbij wapens betrokken zijn worden niet apart geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya en Bergkamp over mesthuwelijken

MPs Koşer Kaya and Bergkamp asked whether limiting transfer of the dairy phosphate reference to relatives in the first to third degree forces farms to shrink, whether it encourages sham marriages or adoptions, and how this fits modern family forms. The government replied that the limit already applies since 1 January 2015 under the Fertilisers Act, does not force shrinkage but may raise manure-processing costs, follows the Dutch civil code definition of blood and affinal relatives, and that it has no concrete signals of 'manure marriages' or problematic adoptions.
I have no concrete signals of the occurrence of so-called manure marriages.
Ik heb geen concrete signalen over het voorkomen van zogenaamde mesthuwelijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het bericht ‘In Nederland dreigt nieuwe onderklasse van vluchtelingen te ontstaan’

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the government how it will prevent a new underclass of refugees, including waiting times, early language and labour-market preparation, and allowing work or study during the asylum procedure. The minister replies by pointing to existing letters on integration, early language courses, and an expanded pre-integration programme, without committing to new measures such as working during the procedure.
Are you willing, for the integration of newcomers, to let asylum migrants work and study already during their procedure?
Bent u bereid, ten behoeve van de integratie van de nieuwkomers, asielmigranten al tijdens hun procedure te laten werken en studeren?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Ronnes over het bericht dat Eritrese vluchtelingen in Boxtel tijdelijk naar het azc in Oisterwijk moeten verhuizen

MPs Keijzer and Ronnes asked whether about thirty Eritrean teenage girls in Boxtel must move to the Oisterwijk reception centre, a distance of about 13-14 km, and why that move is needed when they are already in a safe environment. The State Secretary confirms the move is due to closing the Boxtel crisis emergency shelter under the new agreement between national and municipal government, that safety plays no role, and that the centre has specialised staff for unaccompanied minors.
The agreement between national government and municipalities in the recently concluded administrative agreement is that the CNO is to be phased out as quickly as possible.
De afspraak tussen Rijk en gemeenten in het recent gesloten bestuursakkoord is dat de CNO zo snel als mogelijk wordt afgebouwd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de bedreiging van christenen op AZC’s

An MP asked the State Secretary whether reported threats against Christians in asylum centres are serious, why COA says no concrete reports exist, and whether an independent confidant, closer cooperation with advocacy groups, or a new study of safety and reporting willingness will be introduced. The State Secretary answered that threats are serious, that residents do report incidents to COA staff, that COA cooperates with stichting Gave, but declined an independent confidant and a new study.
No. COA has indicated that since the Deloitte report it has paid more attention to the problems of vulnerable groups.
Nee. Het COA heeft aangegeven sinds het rapport van Deloitte meer aandacht te hebben voor de problematiek van kwetsbare groepen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Yücel over de situatie van LHBT’ers in het AZC in Alphen aan den Rijn

MPs Kuiken and Yücel asked the State Secretary about bedreigingen and harassment of LGBT asylum seekers in the Alphen aan den Rijn reception centre, the threshold for 'acute emergency' relocation, sanctions on perpetrators, and why no complaints were filed. The State Secretary answered that victims can be moved on request, perpetrators are sanctioned, COA encourages complaints but the group declined to file, and the hunger-strike protocol is adequate.
I want to emphasise that if the safety of a resident is at stake, COA arranges other housing, if the victim wishes so.
Ik wil benadrukken dat, als de veiligheid van een bewoner in het geding is, door het COA andere huisvesting geregeld wordt, als het slachtoffer dat wenst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Maij over de detentie en deportatie van vluchtelingen in Turkije

MPs Kuiken and Maij asked the state secretary about reports by Amnesty International of detention and deportation of Syrian and Iraqi refugees by Turkey, including chaining and mistreatment, and whether the EU-Turkey action plan funds such centres and whether Turkey's geographic limitation breaches the Refugee Convention. The government answered that it is aware of the reports, the EU delegation in Ankara has asked Turkish authorities for an investigation, it will await that investigation before judging legal compliance, EU support in the past funded some detention centres, and it does not share the view that Turkey's geographic limitation justifies the returns.

The EU delegation in Ankara is in close contact with the Turkish authorities and Amnesty International to clarify the abuses described in the report, and has asked the Turkish authorities to launch an investigation.

De EU-delegatie in Ankara staat in nauw contact met de Turkse autoriteiten en Amnesty International om opheldering te krijgen over de in het rapport beschreven misstanden en heeft de Turkse autoriteiten verzocht een onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de rellen rond een raadsvergadering over de komst van een asielzoekerscentrum in Geldermalsen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice how the riots around a council meeting on an asylum centre in Geldermalsen could have happened, whether police and riot units were adequately prepared, and what measures are planned to protect politicians and officials. The minister answered that the mayor and police had assessed risks as low beforehand, that the riot unit arrived in time, that a criminal investigation into a threat against a councillor is ongoing, and that guidance tools exist and the council will evaluate the events.
As usual, I cannot say whether threat and risk have given (or given cause) to take security measures in relation to the councillor and his family.
Zoals gebruikelijk kan ik geen mededelingen doen over de vraag of dreiging en risico aanleiding zijn (geweest) tot het nemen van beveiligingsmaatregelen in relatie tot het raadslid en zijn gezin.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht dat de Nationale Ombudsman te kennen heeft gegeven dat zijns inziens burgers, die hun boetes niet kunnen betalen omdat ze te krap bij kas zitten, onterecht van hun vr

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the National Ombudsman's view that people unable to pay fines due to lack of money are wrongly deprived of liberty through detention (gijzeling), and whether this should be addressed earlier through personal payment or debt-relief arrangements. The State Secretary agrees detention should not be used against people genuinely unable to pay, says fines must still be paid, points to a separate letter on the Ombudsman's report and to measures already taken, and says the cost of detention cannot be unambiguously stated.
Detention must, however, be targeted at persuading persons to pay where they can pay a fine but do not want to.
Gijzeling moet echter gericht worden ingezet om personen tot betaling te bewegen indien zij een boete wel kunnen betalen, maar dit niet willen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over “het onderzoek naar het gijzelen van mensen die verkeersboetes niet betalen”

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice how the government responds to the Ombudsman's report on imprisoning people who cannot pay traffic fines, including how the OM justifies unwillingness to pay, how it selects cases for detention, and whether instalment payments and a threshold amount will be examined. The State Secretary answered that the OM and CJIB now assess cases individually, will improve motivation of detention claims, introduce instalment payments and a contact step for possible inability to pay, and that the RDW notification process and the instalment threshold are being evaluated, with further measures set out in a separate letter.
In this way, evidently unreasonable situations should be prevented as much as possible.
Hiermee dienen evident onredelijke situaties zo veel mogelijk te worden voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Gesthuizen over het besluit de gefinancierde rechtsbijstand voor bepaalde groepen asielzoekers af te schaffen

MPs Voordewind and Gesthuizen asked whether asylum seekers need a lawyer from the first decision stage, and questioned the planned removal of state-funded legal aid for an asylum group expected to be granted, plus the speed, documentation and security screening of that track. Secretary Dijkhoff answered that the procedure keeps sufficient safeguards, that legal aid is removed only where a grant is foreseeable, and that the rest of the questions are addressed through consultation and implementation, while refusing to postpone the measure.
Only asylum seekers who belong to the designated group and for whom a grant is foreseeable will no longer receive subsidised legal aid.
Enkel de asielzoekers die behoren tot de aangewezen doelgroep en waarvan voorzienbaar is dat de aanvraag zich leent voor inwilliging krijgen niet langer gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug, Van Dekken, Mei Li Vos en Jasper van Dijk over de economische positie van makers van reclamedeuntjes

MPs asked whether the economic position of jingle composers is weakened by a near-monopoly of a few advertising music firms and by practices of Buma/Stemra and broadcasters, and what the Auteurswet and Buma/Stemra could do about it. The government answered that competition law and the new author-contract law provide remedies, that complaints must come from the makers themselves, and that the law will be evaluated within five years.
Buma/Stemra is not a party to the agreement that composers and lyricists conclude with a client.
Buma/Stemra is geen partij bij de overeenkomst die componisten en tekstschrijvers sluiten met een opdrachtgever.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Fritsma en Wilders over het bericht ‘Vluchtelingen ingezet voor nijpend personeelstekort’

PVV MPs asked why a project placing refugees in jobs against a staff shortage does not consider unemployed Dutch workers, whether it should be ended, and whether borders should be closed to asylum seekers. The minister replied that the shortages are sector-specific and long-standing, that refugees with residence permits bring useful skills, that the project fits government policy, and that asylum claims are assessed individually.
I do not intend to end this project, because it fits government policy of having refugees contribute to society.
Ik ben niet van plan dit project te laten beëindigen, want het past binnen het kabinetsbeleid om vluchtelingen een bijdrage te laten leveren aan de samenleving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over financiering van verhoorbijstand

An SP MP asked the Dutch government about the implementation of police interrogation assistance for suspects, including room adaptations, staffing of about 200 FTE, the basis of the 11.5 million euro estimate, interrogation durations, and whether lawyers would remain available. The minister answered that room assessments were due in Q1 2016, staffing would come from existing capacity pending an impact analysis, the cost estimate used 1-2 lawyer points, and no exact duration data exist, with no evidence yet of fewer available duty lawyers.
When this is completed, it will of course be shared with your House in the context of the treatment of the bill.
Wanneer deze is afgerond, zal deze in het kader van de behandeling van het wetsvoorstel uiteraard met uw Kamer worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Volp over het van binnenuit kunnen vergrendelen van celdeuren

MPs Kooiman and Volp asked whether prison staff at PI Sittard are instructed to force open cell doors blocked from inside, and whether cell locks should be changed after a fatal stabbing at PI Zoetermeer. The State Secretary confirmed the instruction was re-circulated but declined to explain the method for security reasons, and said a national inventory found no need to replace cell doors, only some bolts and lock housings.
For security reasons, however, the manner in which a (blocked) cell door can be opened from outside cannot be discussed.
Om veiligheidsredenen kan echter niet worden ingegaan op de wijze waarop een (geblokkeerde) celdeur van buitenaf kan worden geopend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over de aanhouding van een Syrische asielzoeker in Den Haag op grond van deelname aan een terroristische organisatie

Fritsma (PVV) asks about the arrest of a Syrian asylum seeker in The Hague on suspicion of participation in a terrorist organisation and whether the government has sufficient insight into who enters the Netherlands without papers, and asks it to close asylum centres and borders. Staatssecretaris Dijkhoff replies that identification and screening procedures and a signal reporting structure are in place, that individual restrictions are possible when risks arise, and that border closure is not the government's approach, which instead focuses on European measures.
I note that despite all measures, a full guarantee of security cannot ultimately be given.
Ik merk hierbij op dat ondanks alle maatregelen een volledige veiligheidsgarantie uiteindelijk niet is te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Toorenburg over de prijsverhoging van de Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) in 2016

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Toorenburg asked why the VOG fee would rise in 2016 and whether volunteer organisations had been consulted, and asked the government to reconsider eligibility rules and make VOGs free for all volunteers working with minors. The Secretary of State confirmed the fee rise, said the cost of the free VOG scheme was built in, refused to change eligibility conditions, and declined to extend free VOGs beyond the existing 100,000-per-year scheme citing budget limits.
No, I am not willing to change the existing conditions.
Nee, ik ben niet bereid om bestaande voorwaarden te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het pleidooi van NOV om de prijsverhoging van de VOG niet voor vrijwilligers te laten gelden

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether the planned VOG fee increase should exempt volunteers, given the NOV's appeal, and whether a quick scan of its financial effects would be done. The State Secretary acknowledged the increase may be a setback but refused to widen the free VOG scheme or conduct a quick scan, citing budget limits and that the effects cannot yet be known.
I see no room in my ministry's budget to make the free VOG available to millions of volunteers.
Ik zie geen ruimte op de begroting van mijn ministerie om voor miljoenen vrijwilligers de gratis VOG ter beschikking te stellen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Oskam over binaire opties

MPs Ronnes and Oskam (CDA) asked the Finance and Justice ministers about binary options, whether they should fall under gambling law rather than securities supervision, and the status of the AFM court case and warnings. The government answered that binary options are financial instruments under MiFID and the Wft, that the AFM's appeal is pending before the CBb, that the AFM has warned investors but imposed no sanctions, and that it will push for harmonised cross-border supervision.
Due to supervisory confidentiality, the AFM cannot address whether investigations into specific parties are ongoing or whether it intends to impose measures on such a party.

Vanwege toezichtvertrouwelijkheid kan de AFM niet ingaan op de vraag of er nog onderzoeken naar specifieke partijen lopen of dat er een voornemen is tot het opleggen van maatregelen aan een dergelijke partij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de schending van privacy door gemeenten in de jeugdzorg

Voortman (GreenLeft) asked the State Secretaries whether municipalities breach privacy in youth care by sharing medical files via post or unsecured email and letting non-medical officials view children's medical records. The government answered that municipalities are primarily responsible for compliance, that the Cbp supervises, and that only necessary data may be shared, but it gave no concrete sanctions and largely pointed to existing guidance and responsibilities of councils and the Cbp.
The municipal executive is primarily responsible for ensuring the municipality complies with the legal and agreed requirements on information security and privacy protection.

Het college van B&W is primair verantwoordelijk om er voor te zorgen dat de gemeente voldoet aan de (wettelijke en in de gemeente afgesproken) vereisten ten aanzien van informatiebeveiliging en privacybescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat gebruikers van Popcorn Time schadeclaims kunnen verwachten

An SP MP asked the Minister whether users of Popcorn Time face copyright damage claims, whether such claims are rising, and whether downloading should be punished. The Minister answered that enforcement is largely a private matter, that individual rightsholders may sue users only via court orders against internet providers, that no such claims against end users are known in the past five years, and that the government supports legal online offerings and awareness campaigns.
I do not have information from which it can be quantified to what extent this has led to an increase in illegally exchanged films and series.
Ik beschik niet over informatie aan de hand waarvan kan worden gekwantificeerd in hoeverre dit tot een toename van illegaal uitgewisselde films en series heeft geleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Harbers over het bericht ‘De enorme interesse voor vergunningen voor internetgokken in Nederland’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Harbers asked about the expected size of the online gambling market, the revenue impact of uniform gambling tax rates of 24% or 25%, expected channelling rates and enforcement options. The government estimated the 2014 market at about 232 million euros, reported a lower revenue estimate than previously assumed if uniform rates were adopted, and said full enforcement against illegal online operators is unrealistic, so successful initial channelling is crucial.
At my request, three trade associations of online gambling operators made a closer estimate of the size of the Dutch online gambling market in 2014.

Op mijn verzoek hebben drie brancheorganisaties van online kansspelaanbieders, Speel Verantwoord, European Gaming and Betting Association en Remote Gaming Association, een nadere inschatting gemaakt van de omvang van de Nederlandse markt voor online kansspelen in 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het nareisbeleid ten aanzien van Tibetanen

An MP asked the government about family reunification for Tibetans, including whether the permanent residence requirement, the Chinese passport problem, the lack of biometric capacity at the Nepal honorary consulate and UNHCR registration in India create special circumstances warranting exemptions. The government answered that the IND does not count how often the requirement is applied, that it accepts individual exemptions on humanitarian grounds and does not usually apply the requirement to family members of refugees, but it did not commit to a general exemption.
The IND does not record how often the permanent residence requirement is cited as a ground for refusal in MVV procedures.
De IND registreert niet hoe vaak het bestendigheidsvereiste als afwijzingsgrond wordt tegengeworpen bij MVV-procedures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de van terrorisme verdachte asielzoeker

Two MPs asked the government about an asylum seeker arrested on terrorism suspicion, whether other suspects exist, and how screening failed to detect him at intake. The State Secretary said the case is under investigation, no confirmed cases of asylum seekers joining the stream for terrorist motives exist per the NCTV threat assessment, and no decision on the asylum claim will be made until the investigation concludes.
Until then, no decision is taken on the asylum application.
Tot die tijd wordt niet op de asielaanvraag beslist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Kuiken over de mogelijke oprichting van een ‘mini-Schengen’ zone

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about reported plans for a 'mini-Schengen' zone, including its cause, progress, design and the EU decision-making process. The State Secretary answered that the high asylum influx is straining Schengen, that informal talks with similarly pressured countries are ongoing on border control and returns, and that the matter will be discussed at the 4 December JHA Council and reported on through the usual agendas.
As usual, I will inform you of European developments via the annotated agendas and reports of the JHA Council.
Zoals gebruikelijk zal ik u informeren over de Europese ontwikkelingen via de geannoteerde agenda's en verslagen van de JBZ-raad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Recourt over het afluisteren van gesprekken tussen advocaat en gedetineerde

MPs Volp and Recourt asked the State Secretary about recordings and surveillance of confidential lawyer-client conversations in prison meeting rooms, including GVM-list detainees. The State Secretary answered that confidentiality is guaranteed by law and by agreement with the Dutch Bar, that recording equipment is used only in some rooms and switched off with notice, and that the rules were not breached.
This thereby guarantees the confidentiality of conversations between a detainee and his lawyer.
Daarmee is de vertrouwelijkheid van gesprekken tussen een gedetineerde en zijn advocaat gewaarborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het voornemen een noodopvang-locatie neer te zetten in een joodse wijk in Amstelveen

Two MPs asked the State Secretary about plans to place an emergency asylum shelter for up to 400 refugees in a Jewish-associated area of Amstelveen, and whether antisemitism risks from migrants were being addressed. The government answered that the location is acceptable, that Amstelveen and COA will take measures such as community dialogue and house rules banning discrimination, and that regional reception is part of its migration strategy.
At the same time, I also believe that the population makeup of a neighbourhood should not in itself be a reason to refrain from reception at that location.
Tegelijkertijd vind ik ook dat de bevolkingssamenstelling van een buurt op zich geen aanleiding mag zijn om af te zien van opvang op die locatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de opvang van asielzoekers op een landgoed voor psychiatrische patiënten

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the municipality of Den Bosch's preference to house asylum seekers on a estate used by psychiatric patients was a concern, and whether the Secretary of State would advise against it. The Secretary said talks between the municipality, COA and the mental health institution are at an early stage with no agreement yet, that a COA site existed there before without problems, and that he sees no reason the site could not be used.
At this moment I have no reason to assume that a COA reception location could not be established on this site because of the combination of the groups of residents.
Op dit moment heb ik geen aanleiding om aan te nemen dat er op dit terrein geen COA-opvanglocatie zou kunnen komen vanwege de combinatie van de groepen bewoners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de migratiestroom vanuit het Rifgebied

MP Kuiken asked the government about reports of thousands of young Moroccans from the Rif attempting to reach Greece and claiming Syrian refugee status, and whether this strains the asylum system and whether root causes and identification should be addressed. The State Secretary acknowledged the reports, described EU hotspot registration and Frontex/EASO support, explained the IND's nationality checks, and said root-cause action with Morocco was pursued through the Valletta summit and partnerships, without any binding new commitment.
If the foreigner has submitted no documents or a false document, or there are otherwise signs that the stated nationality should be doubted, this is grounds for further investigation.

Heeft de vreemdeling geen documenten of een vals document overgelegd, of zijn er anderszins signalen dat getwijfeld moet worden aan de gestelde nationaliteit, dan is dit aanleiding om nader onderzoek te verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het onderzoeken van signalen van mensensmokkel

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about signals of human smuggling and trafficking linked to the death of an Eritrean asylum seeker, Kahsay Mekonen, and whether police investigated, shared information with German authorities and gave the family access to records. The minister answered that police and prosecutors found no concrete trafficking signals, that the German authorities ruled the death a suicide, that a wiretap was shared with Germany, and that the file would not be reopened, though the police will review any evidence Argos provides.
If the police investigation is not reopened, are you willing to nonetheless grant access and openness regarding documents, including in the IBIS system, concerning Mekonen?
Indien het politieonderzoek niet heropend wordt, bent u bereid alsnog inzage en openheid te geven inzake documenten in onder meer het IBIS-systeem rondom Mekonen?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de verwachte lange termijnkosten van de asielinstroom

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about child benefit paid to refugees, the expected share of Syrian and Iraqi asylum seekers who will stay permanently, and long-term costs of asylum inflow. The minister answered that child benefit went to about 9,000 households in Q2 2015 (around EUR 4.6 million), that long-term stay cannot be forecast so no long-term cost estimate is possible, and that benefits from participation should also be considered.
Because the development of that situation cannot be predicted, no quantitative calculation can be made either.
Omdat de ontwikkeling van die situatie niet valt te voorspellen, kan evenmin daarover een cijfermatige doorrekening plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de sluiting van de Penitentiaire Inrichting (PI) Tilburg

An MP asks why the Tilburg prison (PI Tilburg) must close after Belgium decided not to extend its lease, and whether a one-year extension was possible, and whether the building could house asylum seekers or foreign detainees. The State Secretary answers that the rental was always temporary, Belgium declined any extension and no negotiations took place, that DJI will close the prison and terminate the lease after 1 January 2017, that reuse for asylum reception requires local government consent, and that he will thank staff in person.
Of course I am willing to discuss the possibilities for continuing the provision of the facility if there is a need on the Belgian side.
Natuurlijk ben ik bereid het gesprek te voeren over de mogelijkheden tot voortzetting van de terbeschikkingstelling als daar van Belgische zijde behoefte aan is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het afbouwen van de subsidie voor de Stichting Geschillencommissies voor Consumentenzaken

MP Van Nispen asks why the government is phasing out subsidy to the Stichting Geschillencommissies voor Consumentenzaken (SGC), whether this threatens EU-compliant consumer dispute resolution, and whether the Commissie-Wolfsen findings should be awaited first. The minister answers that budget priorities and private financing justify the gradual phase-out, that the SGC is expected to continue, and that no definitive decision will be taken before consulting the SGC.
As I have communicated to the SGC, I will turn the intention to phase out the subsidy into a definitive decision after a careful process in which the SGC's views will be taken into account.
Zoals ik aan de SGC heb meegedeeld zal ik het voornemen de subsidie af te bouwen omzetten in een definitief besluit na een zorgvuldig proces, waarin de zienswijze van de SGC zal worden betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de pilots zelfredzaamheid gedetineerden

An MP asked the State Secretary about the evaluation of pilots giving prisoners more self-reliance and staff more self-direction, which projects are continuing or stopped, and whether successful projects like Dutch Celldogs and self-cooking will continue. The State Secretary responded that the pilots are promising, that projects are generally not stopped but considered for further development, that Bad Boys Brand is stopped for marketing reasons while self-cooking has a future where facilities allow.
These projects are in principle not stopped; it is being considered whether they can be further developed and rolled out, whether or not within other prison institutions.
Deze projecten worden in beginsel niet stopgezet, bezien wordt of deze verder kunnen worden ontwikkeld en uitgerold – al dan niet binnen andere PI’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Kuiken over de mogelijkheid tot het inzetten van mensenrechtenambassadeurs op AZC’s

MPs Yücel and Kuiken asked whether human rights ambassadors could be deployed in asylum centres to explain Dutch fundamental values, after reports of threats to religious freedom and safety for vulnerable residents. Minister Asscher answered that COA receives such signals, applies rules on religious practice and discrimination, provides civic information, and is discussing with organisations how to expand this, including the VON proposal.
COA therefore willingly enters into discussion with VON to explore the possible contribution these human rights ambassadors could make.
Het COA gaat daarom graag het gesprek aan met VON om te bespreken welke mogelijke bijdrage de genoemde mensenrechtenambassadeurs kunnen leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de invoering van grenscontroles tijdens de Klimaattop in Parijs

An MP asked whether France's temporary reintroduction of border controls during the Paris climate summit was meant to block demonstrators and whether the Netherlands would press France to protect peaceful protest. The government answered that France notified the Commission under Schengen Borders Code Article 23 for threats to public order and security, that the Netherlands did the same for a 2014 summit, and that it trusts France to respect the right to protest.
I trust that France will abide by its international legal obligations and will not restrict the right to peaceful protest.
Ik vertrouw erop dat Frankrijk zich aan zijn internationaalrechtelijke verplichtingen zal houden en het recht op vreedzaam protest niet zal inperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Karabulut over minderjarige Syrische bruiden

MPs Gesthuizen and Karabulut asked how the government will prevent forced child marriages of Syrian girls who come to the Netherlands to reunite with husbands, what steps follow arrival, how many child brides have arrived, and what support is offered. The government answered that the Wet Huwelijksdwang will set the minimum marriage and recognition age at 18, that Nidos, IND and COA watch for signs of forced marriage, that research on informal marriages is underway, and that tailored psychological support and specialist shelter are available.
Child brides are not separately registered in the IND registration system.
Kindbruiden worden niet apart geregistreerd in het IND-registratiesysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Voortman over de gesloten gezinsvoorziening in Kamp Zeist

MPs Gesthuizen and Voortman asked the State Secretary why the temporary closed family facility at Kamp Zeist is becoming permanent, how it differs and is child-friendly, how it fits 2013 rules on families, and how many children were detained and deported. The State Secretary answered that the facility becomes structural, with child-friendly design, and gave detention and removal figures for 2013-2015, while referring some points to earlier letters and not fully answering whether families can await removal at their previous location.

As indicated in the letter of 13 September 2013 you cite, asylum applications from families with minor children arriving at the external border are not processed in the closed extended asylum procedure.

Zoals in de door u aangehaalde brief van 13 september 2013 is aangegeven worden asielaanvragen van gezinnen met minderjarige kinderen, die aankomen aan de buitengrens, niet in de gesloten verlengde asielprocedure behandeld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Nispen, Oskam, Swinkels en Van Der Staaij over de geruchten dat er extra geld vrijkomt om de gaten in de begroting van Veiligheid en Justitie te dichten en de door de bezuin

MPs from SP, CDA, D66 and SGP asked whether extra money is available for the Justice and Security budget for 2016, how it would be allocated across police, prosecution, judiciary, forensics, probation and prisons, and whether it should be decoupled from the Eerste Kamer risk on fee and legal aid measures. The answer refers the MPs to the government's budget letter for the 2016 Justice and Security budget (Kamerstuk 34 300 VI, nr. 23) rather than answering each question directly.

Further answer: the written questions from MPs Kooiman and Van Nispen (both SP), Oskam (CDA), Swinkels (D66) and Van Der Staaij (SGP) have been answered by way of the letter 'Draft budget 2016 Security and Justice'.

Nader antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Nispen (beiden SP), Oskam (CDA), Swinkels (D66) en Van Der Staaij (SGP) Van Oosten (VVD) vraagnummer 2015Z21968 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Ontwerpbegroting 2016 Veiligheid en Justitie»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Yücel over de veiligheid van Lesbische, Homoseksuele, Biseksuele en Transgender (LHBT) asielzoekers in opvanglocaties

MPs Kuiken and Yücel asked about reports of threats and bullying against LHBT asylum seekers in reception centres and whether protective measures such as separate housing or a trusted person are planned. The State Secretary answered that incidents were few before the surge in arrivals, that COA staff are trained to act as trusted persons, and that separate LHBT housing is not desirable.
I consider it important that all COA staff in the reception centres have sufficient skills to act as a trusted person and therefore see no added value in a separate trusted person.

Ik vind het van belang dat alle COA medewerkers in de opvang voldoende vaardigheden hebben om als vertrouwenspersoon op te treden en zie daarmee geen meerwaarde in een afzonderlijke vertrouwenspersoon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Albert de Vries over de gebrekkige doorstroming van statushouders in Arnhem

MPs Kuiken and De Vries asked why suitable rental homes in Arnhem remain empty while no refugees with status are placed there, and whether bureaucracy is the cause. The State Secretary disputes that no status holders can be found, notes 40 of 132 lack a citizen service number due to registration backlogs managed by municipalities, and announces a registration 'BRP-straat' and a support team for municipalities.
Due to the high inflow of asylum seekers a backlog has arisen, and municipalities are suffering from it.
Door de hoge instroom van asielzoekers is hierbij een achterstand ontstaan en daar hebben gemeenten last van.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de gezondheidsscreening van asielzoekers

Christian Union MP Voordewind asked whether the April 2015 tuberculosis screening protocol for asylum seekers is being followed, given signals that screening is far from optimal, and how coverage and responsibility are monitored. The state secretary answered that screening of Syrians was temporarily suspended due to low TB prevalence, that over 900 people had not yet been screened in mid-October but the backlog is being cleared, and that GGD and COA share coordination, with COA records used for monitoring and changes to crisis emergency shelter procedures announced.
Following the high influx, the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport decided to (temporarily) suspend the screening of asylum seekers from Syria.
Naar aanleiding van de hoge instroom heeft het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (VWS) besloten de screening van asielzoekers uit Syrië (tijdelijk) op te schorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht dat meer dan 10.000 vluchtelingen vast komen te zitten in Servië en een tekort aan humanitaire hulp ontstaat in landen op de ‘Balkanroute’

An MP asked the ministers about reports that over 10,000 refugees were stranded in Serbia and that aid shortages were emerging along the Balkan route after border closures, and asked what the EU and the Netherlands were doing. The minister answered that the Netherlands is engaging EU partners, that EU emergency funding and 50,000 extra reception places in Greece and 50,000 along the route were agreed, and that hotspots are key to implementing the relocation agreements, without any institutional change to executive oversight.
In addition, the Netherlands has made 100 camp beds and 10 light towers available to Slovenia, following a Slovenian request for more materials to better organise the reception of the many refugees.

Daarnaast heeft Nederland 100 veldbedden en 10 lichttorens ter beschikking gesteld aan Slovenië, naar aanleiding van een oproep van Slovenië voor meer materialen om de opvang van de vele vluchtelingen beter te kunnen organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over chique buurten die worden ontzien bij de opvang van asielzoekers

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the State Secretary whether asylum reception is concentrated in working-class neighbourhoods, whether municipalities should be advised to place reception where electoral support exists, whether a maximum number of asylum seekers should be set, and whether Schengen border controls should be reopened. The State Secretary replied that COA does not observe a link between neighbourhood prosperity and support, that COA does not differentiate locations by neighbourhood, that no fixed numbers are used, and referred to an earlier letter on border controls.
COA makes no distinction when recruiting reception locations and also does not advise municipalities regarding neighbourhoods where a reception location is realised.
Het COA maakt geen onderscheid als het gaat om het werven van opvanglocaties en adviseert gemeenten ook niet met betrekking tot buurten waar een opvanglocatie gerealiseerd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Kooiman over de steekpartij in PI Zoetermeer

MPs Volp and Kooiman asked the State Secretary about a fatal stabbing of an 82-year-old inmate in the Zoetermeer prison, including how the suspect obtained a weapon, prior inspections and staffing, and whether the incident was preventable. The State Secretary answered that investigations are ongoing and an internal security review has produced recommendations to be implemented, denied receiving signals of unsafe conditions, said staffing was fully on strength, and promised to inform parliament if structural shortcomings are found.
If the research results show that the incident is attributable to structural shortcomings at PI Haaglanden, location Zoetermeer, I will of course inform you about this.
Indien uit de onderzoeksresultaten blijkt dat het incident is toe te schrijven aan structurele tekortkomingen in PI Haaglanden, locatie Zoetermeer, zal ik u hierover uiteraard informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over vermoedens van malversaties bij Vluchtelingenwerk Nederland

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked about alleged misconduct at Vluchtelingenwerk Nederland, including unfair competition, the director's salary, a possible monopoly, volunteers in language courses and a cooperation with a commercial firm. Minister Asscher answered that the allegations are disputed, the salary follows the Balkenende norm, there is no monopoly, volunteers only complement paid teachers, and the cooperation is not unfair.
I do not share your concern.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Segers over het onterecht in rekening brengen van informatie- en executiekosten door gerechtsdeurwaarders

MPs asked whether bailiffs wrongly charge information and execution costs, including unjustified bank attachments, and how often tax-authority attachments are pointless. The minister answered that the KBvG reported four disciplinary complaints and the BFT three investigations in five years, that no further consultation is needed, and that roughly 130,000 to 135,000 attachments are levied yearly with electronic information requests and the VISH index used to reduce pointless attachments.
In view of the information provided by the BFT and the KBvG, I see no reason to enter into additional discussions on this matter.
Gelet op de verstrekte informatie van het BFT en de KBvG zie ik geen aanleiding aanvullende gesprekken hierover aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat meer dan een half miljoen illegalen Europa zijn binnengekomen

Two MPs asked the government whether it was aware of reports that over 600,000 illegal migrants had entered Europe, what the ratio of legal to illegal migrants is, how many are heading to the Netherlands, and what measures will prevent this. The government answered that it is working on Europe-wide and national solutions, that no data exist on legal or illegal entries as such (Frontex counted 425,167 illegal border crossings from June 2014 to June 2015, often by the same people), and that where these migrants went cannot be established with certainty, referring to IND reports.
Where these foreigners went cannot be established with certainty.
Waar deze vreemdelingen naar toe zijn gegaan valt niet met zekerheid te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over dat de Haagse politie quota invoert om meer allochtone agenten in dienst te krijgen

An MP from the PVV asked the minister whether The Hague police would introduce ethnic quotas for recruiting officers, and why the mayor would discriminate against native officers and ignore recruitment requirements. The minister answered that there is no quota, only diversity targets set by the police chief, that quality remains paramount, and that the police will improve explanations of ID checks following an Ombudsman recommendation.
There is neither for the Den Haag unit nor for the force as a whole any quota for the number of officers with an immigrant background.
Er is noch voor de eenheid Den Haag noch voor het korps als geheel sprake van een quotum voor het aantal agenten met een allochtone achtergrond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman, Klein en Sjoerdsma over het EU-Turkije actieplan migratie

MPs Voortman, Klein and Sjoerdsma asked about the sequencing, financing, Turkish commitments, Frontex data exchange, accession talks and migration law reform under the EU-Turkey migration action plan. The minister answered that the plan sets no sequence or fixed amounts, that Dutch funding awaits further talks, and that details will be worked out later with Turkey.
Neither the action plan nor the European Council conclusions contain target amounts or worked-out agreements on financing and spending.
Het actieplan noch de ER-conclusies bevatten streefbedragen of uitgewerkte afspraken over financiering en besteding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de falende kabinetslobby inzake terugkeer asielzoekers

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the State Secretary whether the cabinet's lobbying for return of rejected asylum seekers is failing, citing an advisory commission finding that export and business contracts weigh more heavily than forced return, and asked how ministries will be made to prioritise return and where the 7,000+ non-removed foreigners are. The government answered by referring to its letter on the ACVZ report on the strategic country approach and the migration and development progress report, rather than answering each question directly.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Gesthuizen inzake onderwijs aan meerderjarige vreemdelingen

MPs Siderius and Gesthuizen asked whether the government's rules denying adult foreigners without a residence permit the ability to start or switch education are desirable, and whether they conflict with the European Convention on Human Rights. The minister answered that residence-permit applicants and those with lawful stay can enrol, that unlawfully staying adults may only finish courses already begun under the Koppelingswet's aims, and that no legislative change is planned.
The cabinet sees no need to take further measures.
Het kabinet ziet geen noodzaak om verdere maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat Achmea premiekorting biedt in ruil voor privédata

MPs Verhoeven and Pia Dijkstra asked whether Achmea's offer of premium discounts in exchange for private driving and health-related data is acceptable, and how it complies with privacy law. The minister answered that insurers may use behavioural data within the Wbp framework, that the DPA is responsible for enforcement, that Achmea has not yet submitted the plan to the DPA, and that sharing with third parties is not Achmea's intent, while declining to judge the desirability of such practices.
It is not my place to pass judgment on the way insurers treat their customers.
Het ligt niet op mijn weg om een oordeel te geven over de manier waarop verzekeraars hun klanten tegemoet treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over Syrische kindbruiden in asielzoekerscentra

The MP asks about Syrian child brides arriving at asylum centres, whether there is a tolerance policy on recognising such marriages, and about reproductive care, child trafficking and FGM in asylum centres. The State Secretary denies a tolerance policy, says the minimum recognition age is being raised to 18 by a bill, describes existing protection and reporting arrangements, and declines a new study on sexual health access.
FGM is not separately registered in the systems of the IND and COA.
FGM wordt niet apart geregistreerd in de systemen van IND en COA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat slachtoffers van loverboys niet de noodzakelijke hulp krijgen

An SP MP asked whether loverboy victims in the Rotterdam region are not getting the specialist help they need, after Fier Fryslân reported falling referrals. The Secretary of State answered that financial arrangements under the Jeugdwet and Wmo 2015 designate specialist providers, that causes of the fall are unclear and under review with Rotterdam and the VNG, and that a quality framework and further talks with the VNG are planned.
To clarify what is going on, both the municipality of Rotterdam and Fier Fryslân are looking into this matter.
Om helder te krijgen wat er aan de hand is buigen zowel gemeente Rotterdam als Fier Fryslân zich over deze kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het ontmoedigen van asielzoekers naar Nederland te komen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government will discourage asylum seekers from coming to the Netherlands, following Belgian and Danish examples, including via cuts to allowances and removing housing priority for status holders. The State Secretary answered that the government will provide accurate information about the asylum process and housing, but rejects a maximum reception number and frames housing priority changes as aimed at freeing housing rather than deterrence.
The cabinet considers it important to provide correct and complete information about the asylum process and the expectations people may have of it.
Het kabinet acht het van belang om juiste en volledige informatie te verstrekken over het asielproces en de verwachtingen die mensen daarover mogen hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat het sluiten van tbs-klinieken voor agressie en frustratie zorgt

The SP MP Kooiman asks the State Secretary about lawyers' concerns that closing forensic psychiatric clinics and relocating about 370 TBS patients harms resocialisation, including lost leave permits, delayed treatment and differing judicial practice. The State Secretary answers that relocations are necessary to avoid empty capacity, that leave permits are reissued through an expedited procedure, that about 5% of patients are normally transferred, and that an evaluation will follow.
After the approximately 370 relocations, an evaluation will be carried out that also takes into account their effect on treatment and resocialisation.
Na afloop van de ongeveer 370 overplaatsingen wordt een evaluatie verricht, waarin ook het effect hiervan op de behandeling en resocialisatie wordt meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de toegang tot seksuele gezondheidszorg in asielzoekerscentra

An MP asked the State Secretary about reproductive and sexual health access in asylum reception centres, minors' safety, forced marriage, FGM, and whether a national study should be launched. The State Secretary answered that existing arrangements are adequate and declined to commission a new study.
I therefore see no reason to have research carried out on this.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om hier onderzoek naar te laten doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de aanhouding van een PIJ-er voor een roofoverval met dodelijke afloop

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice why a youth-PIJ detainee, given leave against the rules and then linked to a fatal robbery, was released, and whether the PIJ measure and its high recidivism should be reconsidered. The State Secretary declined to discuss the pending case, defended the leave system and PIJ measure with recidivism figures, rejected reviewing the measure, and said an investigation into the case would be carried out.
Given the seriousness of this situation, I am having an investigation into this case carried out.
Gezien de ernst van deze situatie laat ik een onderzoek naar deze casus uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Volp over een tbs-er die vanuit zijn kliniek via internet contact heeft kunnen leggen met jonge vrouwen

An MP asked whether a tbs patient convicted of multiple sex offences was able to contact young women online from his clinic, and how this was possible. The State Secretary confirmed the contacts may have occurred during the resocialisation phase when internet access was permitted under conditions, and said the facility has been asked for a report to decide whether policy needs adjusting.
The relevant FPK has been asked to prepare a report on the circumstances and the stay of the person concerned.
De betreffende FPK is verzocht om een verslag op te maken van de omstandigheden en het verblijf van betrokkene.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over gezinshereniging

Ms Voortman (GroenLinks) asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about long waiting times for family reunification, whether the IND is understaffed, and whether more budget will be made available. The State Secretary confirmed the reports, said the average processing time is 134 days, that the IND will increasingly be unable to decide within the statutory term, and that the IND has hired additional capacity, without committing to extra budget.
Given the current circumstances with the unprecedentedly high inflow, the IND will increasingly be unable to decide within the statutory term.
Gezien de huidige omstandigheden met de ongekend hoge instroom, zal de IND in toenemende mate niet kunnen beslissen binnen de wettelijke termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Volp over de aanhouding van een PIJ-er voor een roofoverval met dodelijke afloop

An MP asked the State Secretary whether a juvenile PIJ detainee on leave was suspected of a fatal robbery, how the decision to allow leave was made, and how many unauthorised absences occurred. The State Secretary confirmed an arrest but declined substantive comment because the case is before the court, described the risk-assessment process in general terms, announced an investigation into the case, and gave absence statistics with a commitment to answer before a committee meeting.
Given the seriousness of this situation, I am having an investigation carried out into this case.
Gezien de ernst van deze situatie laat ik een onderzoek naar deze casus uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over weer 700 extra asielzoekers voor het Drentse dorpje Oranje

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why the government plans to house another 700 asylum seekers in the small village of Oranje despite earlier agreements with the municipality and province, and whether it will limit asylum to regional reception and close borders. The state secretary referred to a letter of 13 October, said the government is pursuing humane but sober reception and regional solutions, and did not commit to closing borders or dropping the proposed measures.
For an answer to this question I refer to the letter to your House of 13 October.
Voor antwoord op deze vraag verwijs ik naar de brief aan uw Kamer van 13 oktober jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over een ex-tbs’er die in Leeuwarden een vrouw doodde

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether legal means exist to protect society from a former TBS patient known as dangerous, the limits the ECHR Van der Velden ruling places on extending TBS, and whether the mayor's powers could be widened. The answer refers the MP to a separate letter responding to the same news report, without answering the questions on substance.
The written questions from MP Van Oosten (VVD), question number 2015Z19655, have been answered by means of the letter 'Response to report Dangerous TBS patient should not have been released'.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van Oosten (VVD) vraagnummer 2015Z19655 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op bericht «Gevaarlijke tbs'er had niet vrij hoeven komen»»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het asielbeleid

An MP from GroenLinks asked the state secretary whether the Netherlands is returning asylum seekers to Hungary under Dublin, whether it considers Hungarian reception conditions inhumane, and how this fits with non-refoulement, Dublin reform and a durable solution. The state secretary confirmed Dublin transfers, said responsibility lies first with the European Commission and Hungarian courts, maintained the mutual trust principle, and declined to change the Dublin regulation, while noting that a Council of State appeal on Hungary was pending.
On 23 September the Division, in two cases, indicated that the person concerned may not be transferred to Hungary until the appeal they lodged has been decided.
Op 23 september jl. heeft de Afdeling, in twee zaken, aangegeven dat de betrokkene niet overgedragen mag worden naar Hongarije, totdat op het door hen ingestelde hoger beroep is beslist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Maij over de erbarmelijke omstandigheden voor vluchtelingen in Hongarije

MPs Kuiken and Maij asked the State Secretary and Foreign Minister about degrading conditions for refugees in Hungary, including police food-throwing, detention conditions, and whether the Netherlands should stop Dublin transfers there. The government answered that the situation is worrying, that Dublin transfers remain possible under individual case review by the IND and courts, that the Commission is monitoring Hungary, and that it has raised concerns bilaterally.
From the above it appears that individual Dublin procedures contain sufficient safeguards to carefully examine the admissibility of the transfer.
Uit het vorenstaande blijkt dat er in een individuele Dublinprocedure voldoende waarborgen zijn ingebouwd om de toelaatbaarheid van de overdracht zorgvuldig te toetsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Sjoerdsma en Voordewind over Dublin overdrachten naar Hongarije

MPs Gesthuizen, Sjoerdsma and Voordewind asked about reports of poor reception conditions in Hungary, continued Dublin transfers there, and whether transfers should be suspended. The State Secretary answered that Dublin transfers to Hungary continue under the mutual trust principle, that the matter is before the Council of State, and that no concrete suspension is planned.
As answered to the questions from MPs Voortman, Kuiken and Maij, I maintain the principle of inter-state trust towards Hungary and see insufficient reason to suspend Dublin transfers.

Zoals geantwoord op de vragen van de leden Voortman, Kuiken en Maij houd ik vast aan het interstatelijke vertrouwensbeginsel ten opzichte van Hongarije en zie ik onvoldoende aanleiding om Dublinoverdrachten op te schorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de tekorten bij Frontex

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice and the Minister of Defence about reported shortages of border guards and equipment at Frontex, why many member states have not responded to its calls, and whether the Netherlands has made an extra contribution. The government confirmed the shortages, said member states decide their own contributions, and listed Dutch additional personnel and equipment for 2015 while noting it has no overview of other states' pledges.
I have no overview of the total deployment or the additional pledges made by individual member states to Frontex in 2015.
Ik heb geen overzicht van de totale inzet of de extra toezeggingen die afzonderlijke lidstaten in 2015 aan Frontex hebben gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de huisuitzetting van studenten ten behoeve van asielzoekers

An MP asked whether students were being evicted from Houthavens container housing to make room for asylum seekers, and why status holders get priority in social housing. The minister denies students are displaced by asylum seekers, says the units were rented on a temporary basis and are being reused, and states the priority rule for status holders will be scrapped.
For that reason, the priority arrangement for residence-entitled persons is being removed from the Housing Act.
Om die reden wordt de voorrangsregeling voor verblijfsgerechtigden uit de Huisvestingswet geschrapt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Ypma over onveilige uitwisseling van gegevens tussen gemeenten en behandelaars in de jeugd-ggz

MPs Oosenbrug and Ypma asked whether youth mental health providers exchange sensitive client data with municipalities over unsecured channels, and how the government monitors and enforces information security in the social domain. The Secretary of State acknowledged that not all providers use secure channels yet, pointed to legal duties, the BIG security baseline, and supervision by municipal councils, the Cbp and the Inspectorates, and gave a partial overview without committing to new concrete steps beyond a progress report in spring.
We do not have a complete view of the varied message traffic between providers and municipalities.
Wij hebben geen volledig zicht op het veelzijdig berichtenverkeer tussen aanbieders en gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Fritsma over het opschorten van de screening op TBC bij Syrische asielzoekers

MPs Klever and Fritsma asked why TB screening of Syrian asylum seekers was suspended, whether the minister considered passport fraud, how many unscreened asylum seekers remain, for how long, and whether no asylum seeker should be admitted. The minister answered that screening is risk-based, Syrian TB risk is low, about 3,000 unregistered people were present with roughly 900 non-Syrians unscreened, the backlog should be cleared in about two weeks, and asylum seekers able to find protection in the region should be returned there.
Parties involved in infectious disease control have indicated they will work to clear this backlog as soon as possible.
Partijen betrokken bij de infectieziektebestrijding hebben aangegeven zich in te zullen spannen om deze achterstand zo spoedig mogelijk weg te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘aantal vechtscheidingen groeit explosief’

An MP asked whether the government will act on reports that high-conflict divorces are rising sharply, including calls for mandatory mediation, appointment of special guardians (bijzondere curatoren), municipal responsibility under the Jeugdwet, and family group plans. The government answered that it monitors the trend but finds mandatory mediation ineffective in all cases, promised ongoing work on special guardians, municipal pilots and mediation legislation, and said the Jeugdwet choices are for municipalities.
I therefore do not consider it effective to make mediation mandatory.
Ik acht het daarom niet effectief om mediation verplicht te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de herinvoering van grenscontroles door Duitsland

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether Germany's reintroduction of border checks would be followed by Dutch checks, how long they would last, and whether the Netherlands would support Germany and push to abandon Schengen. The government answered that Germany acted under the Schengen Border Code, that the Dutch had intensified targeted checks and could reintroduce border controls if public order required, and that no change to Schengen rules was currently needed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Zijlstra en Azmani inzake ‘aanranding Almeerse door drie asielzoekers’ en ‘Kans op geweld tegen christenen is 100 procent’

MPs Zijlstra and Azmani asked the State Secretary about an assault on an 18-year-old woman in Almere by three asylum seekers and reports of violence against Christians in reception centres, asking whether asylum applications of those not respecting Dutch norms should be rejected and expelled. The State Secretary condemned such conduct, said COA house rules and police intervene, and promised to inform parliament on tightening national rules so asylum permits can be refused or withdrawn more readily after criminal convictions.

In the general consultation with your House of 30 September on, among other things, the increased inflow, I committed to your House to come with further proposals on how, within existing EU frameworks, national rules on this point can be tightened.

In het algemeen overleg met uw Kamer van 30 september jl. over onder meer de verhoogde instroom heb ik uw Kamer toegezegd met nadere voorstellen te komen hoe binnen de bestaande EU-kaders een aanscherping van de nationale regelgeving op dit punt kan worden gerealiseerd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat er een aanmeldstop is bij een jeugd-GGZ praktijk

An MP asked the state secretaries about a reported intake stop at a youth mental health practice in Den Bosch, allegedly caused by budget cuts, and what would be done for affected children and whether other municipalities face similar stops. The government replied that the 20% cut claim is incorrect (3% macro cut for 2015), that municipalities are responsible for providing youth care and for dealing with budget exhaustion, that Den Bosch is in talks with the provider, and that national monitoring does not separately track such stops, while declining to answer before the scheduled debate.
It is up to municipalities to ensure that all children who need youth care receive it.
Het is aan gemeenten om ervoor te zorgen dat alle kinderen die jeugdhulp nodig hebben, deze krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het Deense ontmoedigingsbeleid

Two MPs asked whether the government would adopt Denmark's policy of discouraging asylum seekers, such as cutting allowances and funding for recreational courses, and whether it would actively deter asylum seekers and publicize this in the region. The government answered that information campaigns may be used where migration flows stem from misperceptions, but that it distinguishes this from admission policy, and it acknowledged that a new group of migrants will require attention on integration and participation.
A distinction must be made between informing migrants about the actual situation and the admission policy to be pursued.
Er dient een onderscheid te worden gemaakt tussen het informeren van migranten over de feitelijke situatie en het te voeren toelatingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind en Voortman over scheiding van gezinnen vanwege tegenwerping 1F

MPs Gesthuizen, Voordewind and Voortman asked whether families separated by an Article 1F exclusion would have the exclusion re-examined, whether the government could guarantee the utmost care, and which countries still prosecute alleged war crimes. The State Secretary replied that Article 1F is assessed in the asylum procedure separately from family life under Article 8 ECHR, that the exclusion is examined with all safeguards, that the choice to leave lies with family members, and that prosecution abroad is a separate matter that the Public Prosecution Service monitors.
Can you guarantee the Chamber that, where a family's situation is so serious, the Article 1F exclusion will be examined with the utmost care to determine whether it can stand?

Vraag 2 Kunt u de Kamer garanderen dat, indien sprake is van een voor een gezin dusdanig ernstige situatie, met de groots mogelijke zorgvuldigheid wordt onderzocht of de 1F-tegenwerping stand moet houden?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Segers over de mogelijkheid in een handomdraai aan een vals Syrisch paspoort te komen

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the government about a press report that a forged official Syrian passport could be obtained easily, and whether Dutch services detect such documents and cooperate with intelligence services. The government answered that Syrian documents are checked extra thoroughly, that the damaged document cannot be examined for detection purposes, and that the IND cooperates with the AIVD and MIVD and with European partners.
The document described in the article was rendered unusable by the journalist.
Het document waar in het artikel over wordt geschreven is door de journalist onbruikbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de Beroepsorganisatie kindbehartiger

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary about the Beroepsorganisatie kindbehartiger, the profile of bijzondere curators, and whether expertise requirements and registration criteria exist. The State Secretary answered that anyone can act as bijzondere curator, that the judge decides case by case, and that the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand is developing expertise requirements expected in the first half of 2016.
