The judge appoints in individual cases a bijzondere curator whom he or she considers suitable for this role.
De rechter benoemt in individuele zaken een bijzondere curator die hij of zij hiertoe geschikt acht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn en Van Wijngaarden over "de beveiliging van SUWInet"

MPs Schut-Welkzijn and Van Wijngaarden asked about security of SUWInet, which holds sensitive personal data, including whether burgomasters should be alerted, how citizens can check and restrict access, and whether debt collectors can access it. The State Secretary acknowledged risks identified in a privacy impact assessment, outlined an escalation protocol and audit duties for municipalities, and rejected direct SUWInet access for debt collectors while promising letters to municipalities and a progress update in October.
The escalation protocol, which I will send to you this autumn, contains a number of steps, with disconnecting an organisation from SUWInet as the ultimum remedium.
Het escalatieprotocol, dat ik u dit najaar toestuur, omvat een aantal stappen met als ultimum remedium het afsluiten van een organisatie van het SUWInet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de zorgelijke berichten over de zorg van “hulporganisatie” stichting Stoploverboys.nu

An SP MP asked whether the private foundation Stoploverboys.nu, which provides shelter and care to young loverboy victims with possibly unqualified staff, is acceptable and what oversight exists. The government answered that the foundation is not a legally recognised youth care provider, so the Inspectie Jeugdzorg has no supervisory power over it, and that the municipality has no subsidy relation with it, while a draft law on youth residences would bring such facilities under municipal supervision.
As we indicated above, the Inspectie Jeugdzorg currently cannot take any steps against private care providers such as the foundation Stoploverboys.nu.
Zoals wij hierboven reeds aangaven kan de Inspectie Jeugdzorg op dit moment geen stappen ondernemen tegen particuliere zorgaanbieders, zoals de stichting Stoploverboys.nu.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over hordes gelukszoekers die Nederland overspoelen

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice twelve questions about asylum seekers, housing, islam and border policy, several in highly polemical terms. The State Secretary answered most questions briefly, rejected the premises of several, and committed to tackling people smugglers and to returning asylum seekers from regions with safe shelter.

As set out in the letter to your House of 8 September on the European asylum problem, the cabinet holds that where sufficient safe reception exists in the region, asylum seekers from that region who still reach the Netherlands on their own should be returned to safe reception in the region.

Zoals aan uw kamer uiteengezet in de brief aan uw Kamer over de Europese asielproblematiek d.d. 8 september jl. is het kabinet van mening dat bij het aanwezig zijn van voldoende veilige opvang in de regio en onder de voorwaarden zoals in de brief vermeld, asielzoekers uit die regio die alsnog op eigen gelegenheid Nederland bereiken, teruggebracht dienen te worden naar de veilige opvang in de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Fritsma over toenemende onveiligheid door gewelddadige gelukszoekers

PVV MPs Wilders and Fritsma asked why the government keeps admitting asylum seekers they describe as violent, endangering Dutch citizens, and asked whether reception centres will be closed and borders shut. The State Secretary rejected the generalisation, said incidents are assessed individually, noted efforts to limit inflow and support regional reception, and answered the questions together.
My services are of course always alert to possible contra-indications in every individual case and take this into account in their actions and decision-making.
Mijn diensten zijn uiteraard steeds alert op mogelijke contra-indicaties in elke individuele zaak en betrekken dit bij het handelen en de besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de psychotherapeute die een relatie heeft met een gedetineerde

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about a freelance psychotherapist who produces pro Justitia reports for the NIFP and had a relationship with, and married, a detainee, questioning her impartiality and whether staff unrest and conflict of interest were addressed. The State Secretary answered that the NIFP sees no integrity problem, that the relationship was self-reported ten years ago, and that agreed safeguards (no assignments in the region or prison where her ex-husband is) are sufficient, with no further measures planned.
It has been agreed that she will no longer produce pro Justitia reports in the parts of the country where her ex-husband resides and will not conduct examinations in the prison where he is detained.
Zo is afgesproken dat zij geen pro Justitia rapportages meer verricht in die delen van het land waar haar ex-man verblijft en geen onderzoeken verricht in de PI waar hij zich bevindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “TBS'er op verlof steekt vrouw in gezicht”

An MP from the PVV asked how a TBS patient on authorised leave could escape his escort and obtain a weapon to stab a woman, and whether the state should use physical restraints during leave and circulate his description to police. The State Secretary answered that the clinic is investigating and that leave is granted only after expert assessment, that restraints and police circulation are rejected or left to police and prosecutors, and that the suspect has been arrested and brought before an investigating judge.
I have asked the TBS clinic where the TBS patient resides to conduct an investigation into the events and report back to me.
Ik heb de tbs-kliniek waar tbs-gestelde verblijft gevraagd een onderzoek in te stellen naar de gebeurtenissen en mij hierover te berichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over het bericht dat oud-cliënten van Boriz BV onder druk worden gezet om hun klachten in te trekken

MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked about reports that Boriz BV pressured former clients to withdraw complaints, whether housing tied to care is acceptable, what happens to clients' rights, and whether the board structure complies with the WNT pay law. The State Secretary condemned such pressure, pointed to a Menzis investigation, said clients can switch care providers, and asked the CIBG to investigate the missing WNT reporting in Boriz's 2014 accounts.
I have asked the CIBG, as the responsible supervisory body, to carry out further investigation.
Ik heb het CIBG, als verantwoordelijk toezichthouder, verzocht nader onderzoek uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over grootschalige identiteitsfraude bij pardonners

Fritsma (PVV) asked whether the 2007 pardon scheme, which allowed asylum seekers to correct identity data once without consequences, should be reversed, and how fraudsters can be prevented from naturalising or bringing family members. Staatssecretaris Dijkhoff rejected the premise of mass fraud, refused to scrap the child pardon, and described existing tools (permit revocation, naturalisation withdrawal within twelve years, IND fraud reporting) as adequate.
Under current laws and regulations, adequate action can be taken against fraudsters.
Op basis van de huidige wet- en regelgeving kan adequaat worden opgetreden tegen fraudeurs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Duizenden asielzoekers fraudeerden voor generaal pardon’

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary whether large-scale identity fraude occurred among asylum seekers who obtained permits under the 2007-2008 general pardon, and how the IND and municipalities handle identity correction and revocation. The State Secretary rejected the claim of large-scale fraud, reported 160 revocations from 1360 procedures (only about ten for changed personal data), and refused to reopen the pardon cases or create a special naturalisation regime for pardon holders.
As I indicated in answer 1, I do not recognise the picture painted in the reporting.
Zoals ik in antwoord 1 heb aangegeven, herken ik het beeld dat in de berichtgeving wordt geschetst niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de duizenden fraude-gevallen bij het generaal pardon

Two MPs asked how many of the roughly 28,000 asylum seekers under the 2007-2008 general pardon committed identity fraud, which municipalities helped amend identity data, and what action would be taken against them. The State Secretary denied large-scale identity fraud, reporting only ten residence permits revoked for personal-data fraud in two years, and said municipalities apply the BRP law on their own, so no measures against them were needed.
The picture painted in the reporting, namely that foreigners are seeking to change their personal details on a large scale, is not one I recognise.
Het beeld dat in de berichtgeving wordt geschetst namelijk dat vreemdelingen op grote schaal hun persoonsgegevens willen wijzigen herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman, Sjoerdsma en Gesthuizen over het bericht van de uitzetting van twee kinderen

MPs Voortman, Sjoerdsma and Gesthuizen asked the State Secretary why a family including two children was detained in a closed family facility, whether the children should await appeal in the Netherlands, and whether the 10-year policy for relatives of 1F persons applies to the Children's Pardon. The State Secretary declined to discuss individual cases, noted the family has been released, said the children's pardon scheme excludes relatives of 1F persons, and said the appeal rule applies only when the claim is upheld.
Beyond that, I will not go into the considerations in individual cases.
Voor het overige ga ik niet in op (de afwegingen in) individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Thieme en Voortman over de Europese migratieproblematiek.

MPs Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Thieme and Voortman asked the government about the European migration crisis, including limits of reception capacity, funding for regional refugee aid, safe third country returns, relocation quotas and Dublin rules. The state secretary answered largely on substance, describing the planned approach and noting that many details remain to be negotiated with the EU and third countries.
Once the ideas take more concrete shape at European level, we can further develop the plans together with relevant reception countries, such as Syria's neighbours.
Zodra in Europees verband de ideeën concreter vorm krijgen, kunnen we de plannen verder uitwerken samen met relevante opvanglanden, zoals de buurlanden van Syrië.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over mogelijk kindermisbruik in een asielzoekerscentrum

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether four children were sexually abused at the Bellingwolde asylum centre and whether the perpetrator's asylum procedure should be halted and he be barred from the country, and asked for the number of reported child sexual abuse cases at asylum centres. The State Secretary confirmed the police are investigating, declined further comment on the case, said perpetrators are prosecuted like others and criminal records feed into asylum decisions, and reported seven (2014) and nine (2015) reports nationwide without naming locations.
In the context of this ongoing investigation, no further statements can be made about this.
In het kader van dit lopende onderzoek kunnen hierover geen verdere mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Gesthuizen over de omgang met sociale media in (geestelijke gezondheids) zorginstellingen

MPs Leijten and Gesthuizen asked the health minister how mental health institutions handle patients' social media use and whether family can be involved in treatment after a mother complained in Metro. The minister answered that no similar signals are known, that self-determination limits restrictions unless a patient is involuntarily admitted under the Bopz, and that family policy and a new family support module are being developed.
It is important that providers are alert to translating the policy into day-to-day practice.
Het is wel van belang dat aanbieders alert zijn op het doorvertalen van het beleid naar de werkvloer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Teeven over de financiering van het verjaardagsfeestje van de VARA door het vfonds

MPs Bruins Slot and Teeven asked whether the vfonds, an independent foundation for veterans, funded the VARA's 90th anniversary party and a half-million-euro TV series on labour history, and whether this fits its mandate and was coordinated with Defence. The Minister replied that the vfonds is independent with its own spending authority, confirmed the subsidy, declined to judge the foundation's guidelines, and said she held no consultation because the subsidy does not affect veteran care funding.
The National Fund for Peace, Freedom and Veterans Care (vfonds) is an independent foundation with autonomous control over its expenditure.
Het Nationaal Fonds voor Vrede, Vrijheid en Veteranenzorg (vfonds) is een onafhankelijke stichting, met autonome zeggenschap over haar uitgaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber inzake verkoop van krasloten en gokverslaving

MPs Segers and Dik-Faber asked the State Secretary about scratch-card sales, gambling addiction prevalence, and whether a daily purchase limit or registration card should be introduced. The State Secretary answered that the WODC estimates show a declining trend, that the Kansspelautoriteit sees no signals requiring a change, and that no new consultation with Belgium or the regulator is deemed necessary.
The Kansspelautoriteit has no signals that gambling addiction is increasing in scope as a result of scratch-card sales.
Er zijn bij de Kansspelautoriteit geen signalen bekend dat gokverslaving in omvang toeneemt als gevolg van verkoop van krasloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Azmani over verstekelingen die zich verstoppen in vrachtwagens, mede naar aanleiding van een werkbezoek aan Calais

MPs Visser and Azmani asked the government about stowaways hiding in lorries near Calais, the damage to Dutch transport, and whether France and the UK enforce EU asylum and immigration rules. The government answered that the damage is evident, that a meeting with French authorities and TLN is postponed to autumn, that extra Franco-British measures and joint enforcement commitments were agreed, and that it will raise secondary migration with France.
In my meeting with the French authorities this autumn I will raise attention to combating secondary illegal migration flows.
In mijn gesprek met de Franse autoriteiten dit najaar zal ik aandacht vragen voor de bestrijding van secundaire illegale migratiestromen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat jeugdzorg niet toegerust is op Syriëgangers

Two D66 MPs asked whether youth care institutions are equipped to treat young people who attempted to travel to Syria, including the role of closed youth care, parents, foster care and monitoring. The State Secretary answered that treatment is still being developed case by case, that closed placement may be needed to prevent departure, that an Exit facility and a family support point are being set up, and that no known radicalised minors travelled to the Middle East after closed placement.
In the first place it is up to municipalities together with youth care institutions to give content to this.
Het is in de eerste plaats aan gemeenten samen met de jeugdhulpinstellingen hier inhoud aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over een schietgrage crimineel die uit een inrichting is ontsnapt

An MP asked why a dangerous criminal escaped from a forensic psychiatric unit in Den Dolder, why he was there rather than in prison, and what security measures apply when such detainees are placed in care. The State Secretary explained the placement criteria, said the escape was reported to police, and noted he was arrested in Spain and returned to the Netherlands.
I am of the opinion that this process is careful and I see no reason to change it.
Ik ben van mening dat dit proces zorgvuldig is en zie geen aanleiding om dit aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind en Voortman over de scheiding van een gezin vanwege tegenwerping 1F

MPs asked the State Secretary whether the 1F exclusion (Refugee Convention) against a father, which has split his family, could be re-examined, and why the Public Prosecution Service did not prosecute. The State Secretary confidentially provided the court and Council of State rulings, declined to comment on prosecution, and refused to reopen the 1F assessment because the Council of State had already confirmed it.
I cannot inform your House. The Public Prosecution Service does not make statements about this individual case.
Ik kan uw kamer niet informeren. Het Openbaar Ministerie doet geen mededelingen over dit individuele geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over de gevolgen van ongewenst verklaring van personen tijdens tbs

An MP asks the State Secretary about the consequences for foreign nationals in TBS (forensic psychiatric treatment) whose residence rights end during treatment, leading to revoked leave and interrupted resocialisation, and how often this happens. The State Secretary answers that return to the country of origin is the policy framework, that about eleven such cases are being sought safe alternatives, that the policy on leave after residence termination will not change, and that an inventory has been made to align immigration and criminal decisions earlier.
I do not intend to change this policy.
Ik ben niet voornemens dit beleid te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het bericht dat er te weinig geld is voor opvang loverboyslachtoffers in verband met toename problematiek

An MP asked about reports of waiting lists at specialised shelters for loverboy victims and the risk of relapse into forced prostitution. The State Secretary acknowledged victims need prompt specialised help, pointed to VNG consultations and municipal responsibility under the Wmo and Jeugdwet, and promised to follow up with Fier Fryslân and the VNG.
I have asked both the VNG and Fier Fryslân to set up an adequate procedure and to maintain regular contact so that any bottlenecks can be resolved quickly and adequately.
Ik heb zowel de VNG als Fier Fryslân gevraagd om een adequate procedure in te richten en hier regelmatig contact over te hebben zodat eventuele knelpunten snel en adequaat kunnen worden opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Bouwmeester over de bescherming van persoonsgegevens in de zorg

MPs Oosenbrug and Bouwmeester asked whether the health sector is aware of new data-protection rules (the breach-notification duty effective 1 January 2016) and whether WhatsApp is secure enough for exchanging patient data. Minister Schippers answered that sector implementation is the responsibility of healthcare providers, that the CBP will issue guidance and oversee compliance, and that the government will promote awareness and proceed with its client-rights bill, without monitoring sector preparations directly.
I do not keep track of the preparations healthcare institutions are making, because it is up to the institutions themselves to comply with the regulations.
Ik houd geen zicht op de voorbereidingen die zorginstellingen treffen, omdat het aan de zorginstellingen zelf is om aan de regelgeving te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat deurwaarders ziedend zijn over het daltarief van het CJIB

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security and the Minister of Finance about bailiffs' anger over falling CJIB fee rates, the price-setting of the CJIB tender, and possible concurrence distortion and fee cuts affecting bailiffs' finances. The government answered that fee structures changed little since 2012, defended the tender as normal market-based price setting within legal frameworks, and declined to answer many questions because the tender is subject to pending court proceedings.
Since these questions are directly related to matters that are before the court, I cannot answer these questions substantively at this time.
Aangezien dit direct verband houdt met de vraagstukken die onder de rechter zijn, kan ik deze vraag op dit moment niet inhoudelijk beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over problemen bij aanbestedingen door het COA

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about delays in the Den Helder AZC construction, whether COA faces extra costs, and why COA did not tender renovation work in Zutphen and withheld information from the procurement expert committee. The State Secretary answered that delays stem partly from a legal dispute and a separate installation tender, that costs fall on the contractor, that no tender was required in Zutphen because the building was to be delivered turn-key, and that COA sees no reason to supply the withheld information now.
COA then took the view that the information it had refused could not be obtained after all through a complaint to the Commission of Procurement Experts.
Het COA was vervolgens van oordeel dat de geweigerde informatie niet via een klacht bij de Commissie van Aanbestedingsexperts alsnog verkregen kon worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de bedreiging en intimidatie in asielzoekerscentra (AZC) door islamitische asielzoekers (vervolgvragen)

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked follow-up questions about reported threats and intimidation of Christian asylum seekers by Muslim residents in asylum centres, and whether the government's earlier answers ignored religious components. The State Secretary maintained that most tensions are between individuals rather than groups, said COA does not recognise a pattern of group intimidation, pointed to reporting-facilitation measures, and said misconduct can affect asylum procedures depending on the facts and penalty.
COA does not recognise the picture that a (majority of a) certain group intimidates, harasses and/or threatens another group.
Het beeld dat een (meerderheid van een) bepaalde groep een andere groep intimideert, lastigvalt en/of bedreigt herkent het COA niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de veiligheid van christelijke asielzoekers op Asielzoekerscentra’s (AZC’s)

Two MPs (Voordewind and Van der Staaij) asked the State Secretary about safety and intimidation of Christian asylum seekers in reception centres, including a claimed shared room and COA's implementation of Deloitte's 2011 recommendations. The State Secretary answered that COA found no hard evidence of intimidation in the individual case, that room use is regulated by COA, and that most recommendations were implemented while some (clustering groups) were not, with a follow-up plan for training and reporting.
After talks with those involved in this individual case, COA found no hard evidence of intimidation, discrimination or threats.
Het COA heeft na gesprekken met betrokkenen in dit individuele geval geen harde aanwijzingen gevonden van intimidatie, discriminatie of bedreiging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Enkelband huisarrest kan worden gekraakt’

An MP from the PVV asked whether ankle monitors used for house arrest can be hacked and whether they are used in the Netherlands. The State Secretary answered that GWG International monitors are not used in the Netherlands, that Dutch systems are continuously monitored and periodically hack-tested, and that there is no reason to stop using them.
From this it has not so far appeared that the system in the Netherlands has been hacked.
Daaruit is tot op heden niet gebleken dat het systeem in Nederland is gekraakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Verhoeven over het gebruik van software van het Hacking Team door de Nationale Politie (NP)

MPs Oosenbrug and Verhoeven asked whether the National Police had considered or used Hacking Team spyware, whether its hacking tools exceed what Dutch law allows, whether it has source-code access, and whether the government will reconsider such tools after the Hacking Team breach. The Secretary of State declined to give details on specific software, citing risks to investigative capability, stated that use is limited to lawful powers under the Code of Criminal Procedure with judicial authorisation, and said he sees no reason to change policy.
I therefore cannot provide information on this.
Ik kan hier derhalve geen informatie over verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over kritiek van de VN op Nederlands toezicht in detentie

An MP asked the state secretary about UN criticism of the Dutch National Preventive Mechanism for detention monitoring, including its relation to the National Ombudsman's earlier criticism and calls for a solid legal basis and political support. The state secretary explained the Netherlands' treaty obligations, noted the UN Subcommittee's advisory visit, and said the report will be sent to parliament in November with a policy response addressing the questions.
The Subcommittee will set out its findings from the visit in a report that will be formally presented to me in November.
Het Subcomité zal haar bevindingen naar aanleiding van het bezoek neerleggen in een rapport dat in november a.s. formeel aan mij zal worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over hordes gelukszoekers die Nederland overspoelen

Wilders asks the State Secretary, in provocative and derogatory terms, whether asylum seekers are given preferential housing and whether borders should be closed and asylum seekers returned, and whether Dutch policy makes the Netherlands a 'luilekkerland'. The State Secretary answers all questions with a single reference to an earlier letter on increased asylum inflow and measures taken, without addressing the substance.
In response to the questions, I refer to my letter of 17 August.
In reactie op de vragen verwijs ik naar mijn brief van 17 augustus jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Oskam over het bericht dat Kosovaren in toenemende mate komen asielshoppen

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary about reports that Kosovars increasingly apply for asylum mainly to obtain the return allowance, and whether this abuse is tolerable, why it was not restricted earlier, and whether Switzerland's fast procedure or a broader evaluation of the return scheme is warranted. The state secretary answered that monitoring showed a sharp rise in Kosovar asylum applications, that the allowance was likely a key reason, and that Kosovar eligibility for return support has been ended, while defending the current procedure and declining a large-scale evaluation.
Where there are indications that return support is being used improperly, measures are taken and countries can be excluded.
Daar waar er aanwijzingen zijn dat op oneigenlijk wijze gebruik wordt gemaakt van de terugkeerondersteuning, worden maatregelen getroffen en kunnen landen worden uitgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het stijgende aantal asiel aanvragen van Kosovaren in Nederland

An MP asked the State Secretary about the rise in asylum applications by Kosovars, whether the voluntary return scheme enabled misuse, and whether it should be closed to them. The State Secretary confirmed the increase since May 2015, linked it likely to return payments, and ended financial and in-kind return support for Kosovars while keeping basic REAN support.
The outcomes of this research have led me to end the possibility for Kosovars to receive financial and in-kind return support.
De uitkomsten van genoemde onderzoek hebben er toe geleid dat ik de mogelijkheid voor Kosovaren om financiële en in natura terugkeerondersteuning te ontvangen heb beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Schouw en Voortman over onnodige verhuizingen van asielkinderen

MPs Voordewind, Schouw and Voortman asked whether the planned conversion of the Almelo family location into an asylum centre, forcing about 120 residents including children to move, could be postponed, and how the government weighs the harm of repeated relocations to children. The State Secretary confirmed the conversion, said COA is consulting the municipality and residents and tries to limit the impact, but that high intake makes avoiding moves impossible.
COA is in discussion with both the municipality and the residents.
Het COA is in gesprek met zowel de gemeente als de bewoners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het vereiste inburgeringsexamen voor gezinsmigranten

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a European Court of Justice ruling requiring the Netherlands to exempt more family migrants from the civic integration exam, and whether restrictive family reunification policy would be further eroded and whether an EU opt-out on immigration and asylum could be pursued. The State Secretary replied that the cabinet remains committed to restrictive family migration policy within EU law, is still considering the consequences of the ruling, and that an opt-out is not a realistic option since it would require a treaty change.
At this moment the Cabinet is considering the consequences of the ruling.
Op dit moment beraadt het Kabinet zich op de consequenties van de uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Toorenburg over een uitspraak van de RSJ d.d. 29 april 2015

MPs Oskam and Van Toorenburg asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about a Council for Criminal Justice and Youth Protection ruling that the Van der Hoeven clinic breached privacy by publishing factual information about a TBS patient in its internal newsletter. The State Secretary confirms the ruling, explains the Article 8 ECHR test and says the clinic is looking for less far-reaching alternatives, consulting relevant parties if needed.
I agree with the RSJ that disseminating such privacy-sensitive information is only permissible when it is sufficiently justified.
Met de RSJ ben ik van mening dat het verspreiden van dergelijke privacy-gevoelige informatie alleen toelaatbaar is wanneer dit voldoende gemotiveerd is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over genitale verminking in Guinée

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the 2014 Guinea country report's claim that female genital mutilation is declining is backed by hard figures, and whether asylum policy for minor girls from Guinea should be reconsidered given that FGM persists. The government answered that the report rests on multiple sources, that the policy under the Vreemdelingencirculaire 2000 already offers protection where a real risk of FGM exists, and that a thematic country report is unnecessary.
The identity and background of the interview partners are generally not made public in order not to endanger their safety and thereby their reliability.
De identiteit en achtergrond van de gesprekspartners wordt in de regel niet openbaar gemaakt om hun veiligheid en daardoor hun betrouwbaarheid niet in gevaar te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over privacyschending door middel van nieuwe vormen van telefoonfraude

MP Kuzu asked whether spoofing apps that let callers fake their number, which enabled fraud causing about 300,000 euro in losses to companies, should be regulated, and whether a public awareness campaign or research into such apps is planned. The State Secretary replied that spoofing has legitimate uses, that prosecution is possible under article 231b for misuse, that fraud is to be tackled via police priorities and existing advice channels, and that no separate campaign or study is planned.
I do not intend to set up a separate awareness campaign.
Ik ben niet voornemens een aparte bewustwordingscampagne op te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat slachtoffers van geweld te lang moeten wachten op hulp in Gelderland

MPs Kooiman asked the State Secretaries about reports that victims of domestic violence in Gelderland face long waits before Veilig Thuis reports are handled, and about the rise in reports nationwide. The government answers that Gelderland Zuid has added temporary staff and that municipalities are responsible for addressing delays, with no extra budget planned and a review of the situation expected by end of year.
It is undesirable that victims of domestic violence have to wait too long before the Veilig Thuis organisation takes up the report.
Het is onwenselijk dat slachtoffers van geweld in huiselijke kring te lang moeten wachten voordat de Veilig Thuis-organisatie (VT-organisatie) de melding in behandeling neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het op grote schaal frauderen met gesubsidieerde rechtshulp

The MP asks how supervision of lawyers suspected of fraud with subsidised legal aid (toevoegingen) has been intensified, how the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand and bar deans exchange information and handle complaints, how complainants are informed, and whether further research into the scale of fraud is needed. The State Secretary answers that enhanced supervision is too recent to show results, that information exchange and proactive file checks have been strengthened, that only a handful of lawyers were struck off in 2012-2014, and that no further research is planned.
This does not mean, however, that fraud has always actually occurred in such cases.
Dit betekent overigens niet dat er in dergelijke gevallen ook altijd daadwerkelijk sprake is van fraude.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over het verschoningsrecht van advocaten en notarissen

MP Recourt asked the State Secretary whether lawyers and notaries are being used to withhold information from criminal investigations through professional privilege, and whether privilege rules are unclear and open to abuse. The State Secretary acknowledged the OM's concern, noted no figures exist on privilege claims, and said talks with the bar and notaries' organisation are ongoing, with results to be sent to parliament after the summer.
In line with the commitment made during the debate, the Minister will inform your House after the summer about the outcomes of this consultation.
Conform de toezegging tijdens het debat zal de Minister uw Kamer na de zomer informeren over de uitkomsten van dit overleg.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch over de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie dat het verplichte basisexamen inburgering gezinshereniging ‘onmogelijk of uiterst moeilijk’ maakt

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked the State Secretary whether the mandatory civic integration exam for family reunification, as held by the EU Court of Justice to make reunification impossible or extremely difficult, breaches EU law, and how the government will respond on the hardship clause and exam costs. Minister Asscher answered that the Council of State will decide the case after the summer, that the government will set its position afterwards, and that it is not opportune to make policy choices ahead of that outcome.
I do not consider it opportune to make a policy choice in advance of the outcome of this procedure.
Ik acht het niet opportuun om vooruitlopend op de uitkomst van deze procedure een beleidskeuze te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Keijzer over het bericht dat het kabinet lak heeft aan het medisch beroepsgeheim in de jeugdzorg

MPs Bergkamp and Keijzer asked whether the 25 June 2015 agreement on a temporary ministerial regulation for youth care billing, which lets invoices carry personal and diagnostic data, respects medical confidentiality and was a proper procedural route given a pending bill. The state secretary replied that the temporary regulation, approved by the Dutch Data Protection Authority under conditions, rests on the Youth Act and will be replaced by the Veegwet, and that the regulation will take effect as soon as possible.
The Cbp has indicated it can agree to this temporary ministerial regulation under conditions, and we will honour these conditions.
Het Cbp heeft onder voorwaarden aangegeven te kunnen instemmen met deze tijdelijke ministeriële regeling en deze voorwaarden zullen door ons worden gehonoreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de EU maritieme missie EU NAVFOR MED

An MP asks whether the EU is seeking a Chapter VII UN Security Council resolution for the EU naval mission EU NAVFOR MED against migrant smuggling from Libya, how migration could count as a threat to peace, and Libyan authorities' attitude to an EU mission in their waters. The government answers that negotiations in New York are stalled pending talks with Libya, that a draft cannot be shared confidentially, that Security Council resolutions under Chapter VII have precedent for migration-linked crises, and that the Libyan government lacks effective control in western Libya.
Due to the confidential nature of the discussions in New York, a draft version cannot be shared.
Vanwege het vertrouwelijke karakter van de besprekingen in New York kan een conceptversie niet worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het toenemende aantal vondelingenkamers

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice why the Stichting Beschermde Wieg is opening baby hatches (vondelingenkamers) in several locations, and what legal options exist for anonymous or confidential births consistent with the Children's Rights Convention. The State Secretary said the hatches are tolerated because current law gives no basis to act before a baby is placed, while confidential birth via Fiom and Siriz is preferred and prevention outreach is being expanded.
Since current legislation offers insufficient means to act actively against the baby hatches as long as no baby has been placed in them, I cannot close them.
Nu de huidige wetgeving onvoldoende mogelijkheid biedt om actief op te treden tegen de vondelingenkamers zolang daar nog geen baby in is gelegd, kan ik deze niet sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over intimidatie en bedreigingen door islamitische asielzoekers

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice whether asylum centres are dominated by Muslims who intimidate Christians and whether COA fails to act against it. The State Secretary denies that picture, acknowledges tensions between residents, describes COA house rules and sanctions, and says criminal conduct can affect asylum procedures.
COA has the possibility to impose a measure when a resident violates a house rule.
Het COA heeft de mogelijkheid om een maatregel op te leggen wanneer een bewoner een huisregel overtreedt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de veiligheid van christelijke asielzoekers op Asielzoekerscentra's (AZC’s)

Two MPs (ChristenUnie and SGP) asked the State Secretary about the safety of Christian asylum seekers in asylum centres, following a report of intimidation by Muslim residents, and asked whether staff enforced house rules, how many religion-related incidents occurred, whether complaint reporting is effectively encouraged, and whether additional measures or research are needed. The State Secretary answered that the picture is not accurate as presented, that COA staff spoke with those involved and no sanction was imposed for lack of evidence, that complaint channels and staff training have been strengthened, and that further research is not considered necessary while COA maintains ongoing consultation with partner organisations.
COA did not impose a sanctioning measure because no indications of intimidation, discrimination or threats were found at the individual level.
Het COA heeft geen sanctionerende maatregel opgelegd omdat tot op het individuele niveau geen aanwijzingen zijn gevonden van intimidatie, discriminatie of bedreiging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de bedreiging en intimidatie in asielzoekerscentra (AZC) door islamitische asielzoekers

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the State Secretary about reports that Christian asylum seekers were threatened and intimidated by Muslim asylum seekers in reception centres, why a 2011 improvement programme had not helped, whether perpetrators rather than victims should be moved, whether offenders should lose residence rights, and whether Australia's regional-only model should be adopted. The State Secretary rejected the picture as inaccurate while acknowledging tensions, described COA anti-discrimination measures and a working group, said relocations depend on the most suitable solution, noted police involvement and possible consequences for asylum procedures, and affirmed the government's regional reception policy alongside international obligations.
This picture is not consistent with the facts, though tensions between residents do certainly occur.
Dit beeld klopt niet met de feiten, wat niet wegneemt dat er wel degelijk spanningen tussen bewoners voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Azmani over verstekelingen die zich verstoppen in vrachtwagens

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about drivers being fined in the UK for stowaways found in their trucks and about the Calais migrant problem, including whether Dutch drivers are penalised twice for rest-time violations caused by queues. The minister answered that the UK fines follow the Code of Practice, the number of affected Dutch drivers is unknown, EU rest-time rules leave room for exceptional situations, the government has raised the issue with the Commission and UK/French counterparts, and it has intensified border controls and consulted the transport sector.
The number of (possibly) affected Dutch drivers in 2014 and 2015 is not known.
Het aantal (mogelijke) Nederlandse gedupeerde chauffeurs in 2014 en 2015 is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de bescherming van persoonsgegevens

MP Kuzu asks about privacy and data protection issues involving Google privacy terms, NPO tracking cookies, the education tablet provider Snappet, and apps directed at children. The government answers that the data protection regulator CBP and consumer authority ACM are responsible, that Snappet ended its violations without enforcement, and that cookie consent and parental consent rules apply under the Telecommunicatiewet and Wbp.
It is up to the Dutch Data Protection Authority (CBP) to assess whether in individual cases there is a violation of the Personal Data Protection Act (Wbp).
Het staat ter beoordeling van het College bescherming persoonsgegevens (CBP) of in individuele gevallen sprake is van overtreding van de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens (Wbp).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Visser over diverse berichten in de media de afgelopen maanden omtrent het innen van financiële sancties

MPs Van Oosten and Visser asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about media reports on collecting financial penalties, including payment arrangements, detention orders, and enforcement measures such as vehicle impoundment and licence seizure. The State Secretary answered that all penalties must be collected, outlined existing payment and enforcement instruments with statistics, and announced an interim payment-instalment measure, a follow-up study on coercive instruments, and administrative improvements.
The starting point is and remains that all financial penalties must be paid in full.
Het uitgangspunt is en blijft dat alle financiële sancties geheel moeten worden voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het rapport ‘Gezinnen in de knel’

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the Defence for Children report 'Gezinnen in de knel', which claims Dutch family migration policy breaches children's rights, and about registration, the best-interests-of-the-child principle, ECHR Article 8 review and the Family Reunification Directive. The State Secretary rejected the claim of breach, said the best interests of the child are already adequately weighed, declined to codify them separately, and refused to change the transposition of Directive articles.
I committed to the Chamber on 4 June to consider how the best interests of the child could be incorporated more explicitly in the work instruction for applying Article 8 ECHR.
Ik heb de Kamer op 4 juni jl. toegezegd te bezien op welke wijze het belang van het kind meer expliciet in de werkinstructie voor de toepassing van artikel 8 EVRM kan worden opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de kritiek op de Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about criticism that the Certificate of Conduct (VOG) is too strict, covering refusal statistics, appeal duration and costs, the four-year lookback period, the role of Justis and probation advice, and the promised vision on screening. The State Secretary rejects the claim of rigidity, gives statistics showing a low refusal rate, defends the four-year lookback period, and says the vision on screening will be sent to parliament this autumn.
I do not consider it appropriate to address individual cases in public, and therefore not the examples that came up in the Radio1 programme.
Ik vind het niet passend om in het openbaar in te gaan op individuele zaken, dus ook niet op de voorbeelden zoals die naar voren zijn gekomen in het programma van Radio1.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het gebruik van een softwarefout door de Amerikaanse inlichtingendiensten

An MP asked whether the NSA exploited the LogJam weakness in encryption protocols to intercept secure communications and how the Dutch government handles discovered vulnerabilities. The government declined to confirm or assess the NSA hypothesis, citing intelligence source protection, said it supports responsible disclosure and will inform stakeholders of significant vulnerabilities subject to legal and operational limits, and judged no major impact on government systems requiring further investigation.
Intelligence and security services do not give insight into how they collect intelligence, in connection with protecting sources, modus operandi and current knowledge level.
Inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten geven geen inzicht in de wijze waarop zij hun inlichtingen verzamelen in verband met de bescherming van bronnen, modus operandi en actueel kennisniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Hachchi over het bericht dat kwetsbaarheden in encryptiesoftware door Amerikaanse inlichtingendiensten zijn gebruikt

Two D66 MPs asked whether a research article on Diffie-Hellman weaknesses, which suggests the NSA may have used them to read VPN, SSH and TLS traffic, is credible, whether other states or non-state actors have used such weaknesses, and whether the government wants access to encrypted data or a uniform policy on zero-day vulnerabilities. The government declined to say whether the researchers' hypothesis is correct because intelligence services do not disclose their collection methods, advised longer key lengths and stronger configuration, and said it supports encryption and responsible disclosure, referring to a forthcoming letter on encryption.
Intelligence and security services do not give insight into how they collect their intelligence, in connection with protecting sources, modus operandi and current knowledge level.
Inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten geven geen inzicht in de wijze waarop zij hun inlichtingen verzamelen in verband met de bescherming van bronnen, modus operandi en actueel kennisniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de algemene voorwaarden van De Persgroep voor freelance journalisten

An MP asked ministers about De Persgroep's new terms for freelance journalists, including unilateral change with eight days' notice, competition clauses, broad exploitation rights and licence fees. The government answered that these are private civil-law contracts, that disputes are for the courts or the ACM, and that the new copyright contract law sets a 'fair remuneration' standard it cannot judge itself.
However, this concerns a civil-law contract between private parties to which the government is not a party.
Het betreft hier echter een civielrechtelijke overeenkomst tussen private partijen waarbij de overheid geen partij is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Kuiken over de ruim 3.300 alleenstaande kinderen die de afgelopen maanden de Middellandse Zee overstaken

MPs Rebel and Kuiken asked about the over 3,300 unaccompanied children who crossed the Mediterranean in 2015, including monitoring, reception, NGO involvement and EU action against trafficking. The State Secretary acknowledged the vulnerability, pointed to EU directives and shelter arrangements, and to EU migration agenda steps, but did not provide figures on trafficking victims and placed tracing of family members with individual member states.
I am not aware of how many cases involve victims of human trafficking.
Mij is niet bekend in hoeveel gevallen het gaat om slachtoffers van mensenhandel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de gevolgen van de bezuinigingen op penitentiaire bibliotheken

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the planned closure of physical prison libraries, including whether the works council was consulted, the state of the digital reading project, who will support digital reading, its costs, and the savings. The State Secretary answers that a works council advice request has been sent but no advice yet, that physical libraries will close only after the ZBJ digital system is implemented around 2016-2017, that costs are not yet known, and that the savings are EUR 2.4 million per year.
I cannot yet provide your House with information on the costs of digital reading, because no contracts have yet been concluded with suppliers.
Ik kan uw Kamer nog geen informatie verschaffen over de kosten van digitaal lezen, omdat er nog geen contracten zijn gesloten met leveranciers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Van Dekken over het minder uitbetalen voor het gebruik van online muziek aan artiesten

MPs Oosenbrug and Van Dekken asked why Buma/Stemra pays composers and lyricists less for online music streams and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary acknowledged the imbalance, blamed unlicensed competition and costly rights identification, and pointed to the forthcoming CRM implementation bill, a campaign and a planned congress.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over het bericht dat gerechtsdeurwaarders onterecht winst zouden maken

MPs Recourt asked whether bailiffs overcharge debtors for registry inquiries and whether the Stichting Netwerk Gerechtsdeurwaarders (SNG) makes profit on its fees. The State Secretary answered that bailiffs may only charge cost price for disbursements, that the BRP inquiry is charged at EUR 1.63 based on a cost study, and that the SNG reserve of about EUR 3.6 million serves as an emergency buffer.
I see no reason to assume that bailiffs make a profit on official messages.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om te veronderstellen dat gerechtsdeurwaarders winst maken op ambtsberichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht: ‘Onrust in tbs-kliniek’

An MP asked whether cuts at a private forensic psychiatric clinic (halving security staff, thinner night shifts, many violent incidents) make escapes more likely and what the government will do. The State Secretary replied that the cuts are internal decisions of the private clinic, that security levels were maintained, that no escapes were reported since January 2015, and that no action is needed because the situation is not unsafe.
The clinic's director explained on request that the cut concerns a restructuring of security staff, but certainly not a halving of the workforce.

De bestuurder van de kliniek heeft desgevraagd uiteengezet dat de genoemde bezuiniging een herstructurering van het beveiligingspersoneel betreft, doch beslist geen halvering van het personeelsbestand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Voordewind over de beoordeling door de IND van de geloofwaardigheid van Koptische asielzoekers

MPs Gesthuizen and Voordewind asked whether IND officials wrongly disbelieve Coptic asylum seekers from Egypte, whether staff have sufficient expertise and knowledge of Coptic conditions, the grant rate for Christian asylum seekers, and how abolishing the POK test affects credibility assessments. The Secretary of State replied that credibility is assessed case by case using the official country report, that staff receive training, that IND does not systematically record religion so grant rates cannot be given, and that dropping the POK test is a motivation change rather than a policy change.
The IND assesses the asylum application within the context of everything known from public, reliable sources about the country of origin.
De IND beoordeelt de asielaanvraag binnen de context van al hetgeen uit openbare, betrouwbare bronnen bekend is over het land van herkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de ontoegankelijkheid van laagdrempelige juridische hulp voor middeninkomens

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether Het Juridisch Loket's new systematic income check, which limits personal legal advice to those within Wrb income limits, leaves middle-income people without accessible help, and whether it is compatible with article 8(4) Wrb and could be reversed with funding. The State Secretary answered that the income test is required by the Wrb and the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand, that information referrals remain available to everyone, and that middle-income people can use free or low-cost alternatives, but refused to provide additional funding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over Nederland als grootproducent van neppeuken

An MP asked the State Secretary of Health about the health effects of counterfeit cigarettes, the controls on imported raw tobacco and transit through Dutch ports, and whether counterfeit production should be fought. The State Secretary answered that illegal cigarettes increase accessibility, that current data do not show a rise in domestic production, and that enforcement lies with Customs and the FIOD, with some international cooperation.
Health (VWS) has no task in combating counterfeit cigarettes. This is reserved for Customs and the FIOD.
VWS heeft geen taak op de bestrijding van namaaksigaretten. Dit is voorbehouden aan de Douane en FIOD.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat deurwaarders ziedend zijn over het daltarief van het CJIB

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether bailiffs' complaints about CJIB's low fixed fee (€0.87 to €10.33 per case) for collecting state debts are justified, and how the CJIB protects careful, independent enforcement and the bailiff's independence. The government defends the tender as a way to cluster state debt collection, says the fee is a fixed contribution and that monitoring after award will assess careful collection, and answers that bailiffs could not guarantee collection rates in the NS tender.
After definitive award, it will be monitored to what extent careful collection takes place and what the collection results are.
Na definitieve gunning zal worden gemonitord in hoeverre sprake is van een zorgvuldige incasso en wat de incassoresultaten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het tussenrapport over de kosten van de gefinancierde rechtsbijstand

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice to react to an interim report by the Dutch bar association's commission, which found no uncontrolled rise in legal aid costs, and whether the reaction could be sent before a scheduled debate. The State Secretary declined to take a position before the separate government-appointed Wolfsen commission issues its final report, noting different cost definitions and periods, and promised to decide on new measures and inform parliament after that report.

Pending the final report, I consider it neither sensible nor opportune to take a position on the conclusions of the interim report, since this concerns a matter that directly falls within the remit of that commission.

In afwachting van het eindrapport vind ik het zinvol noch opportuun om, nu het een aangelegenheid betreft die rechtstreeks de opdracht van deze commissie aan gaat, een standpunt in te nemen ten aanzien van de conclusies uit het tussenrapport
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat de Immigratie en Naturalisatie Dienst (IND) tolken inzet die banden hebben met het dictatoriale regime in Eritrea

An MP asks whether IND interpreters with ties to the Eritrean regime are acceptable, why the integrity investigation outcomes were not published, and what the consequences would be for asylum procedures. The State Secretary answers that the investigated interpreters could not be linked to the regime, that the outcomes were published after a WOB request with personal data redacted, and that the research method cannot be disclosed.
I am aware of the report.
Ik ben bekend met het bericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over een viervoudig moordenaar die, ondanks een levenslange gevangenisstraf, van de Raad voor de Strafrechttoepassing en de Jeugdbescherming (RSJ) met verlof mag

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a life-sentenced prisoner who may obtain leave despite the sentence, following an RSJ appeal ruling requiring structural incidental leave for life-sentenced prisoners. The State Secretary confirmed the ruling will be implemented and said he will consult stakeholders and report after the summer on possibly changing how life imprisonment is executed, including resocialisation and leave.
Ik zal uitvoering geven aan deze uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over een gevaarlijke killer die nachtverlof kreeg

An MP asks why a convicted killer under TBS was allowed unsupervised overnight leave despite the rules, whether the state knew in February, and whether TBS should be abolished. The State Secretary confirms that the clinic granted unauthorised overnight stays, announces a patient-admission stop, an Inspectorate investigation and a sample check of other clinics, and rejects abolishing TBS on recidivism grounds.
The Inspectorate for Security and Justice has started an investigation to be able to answer that question.
De Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie is een onderzoek begonnen teneinde die vraag te kunnen beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het aanspreken van hostingproviders door de politie op cybercrime

An MP asked about police plans to approach hosting providers about cybercrime under the 'Nederland Schoon' project, including whether content could be taken offline without a judge. The State Secretary explained the project targets cybercrime facilitated by Dutch hosting providers, that no specific content removal will be requested within the project, and that formal removal orders still require prosecutor action with investigating judge authorisation.
In the discussions within the Nederland Schoon project, hosting companies will be neither requested nor required to remove specific content from their network.
In de gesprekken binnen het project Nederland Schoon zal aan de hostingbedrijven verzocht noch gevorderd worden om specifieke content van hun netwerk te verwijderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Berndsen-Jansen over geweldsfilmpjes bij jongeren

Two MPs from D66 asked the state secretaries how to explain the reported trend of youths filming and sharing violent videos, how many youths are involved, and what measures exist to stop it. The government answered that it has no figures because filming violence is not a separate offence, that prosecution is possible where the filmers can be treated as accomplices or instigators, and that anti-bullying policy, school safety rules from August 2015 and online information campaigns are the main responses.
I do not have figures, because filming an assault or public violence is not an independent criminal offence.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers, omdat het filmen van een mishandeling of openlijke geweldpleging geen zelfstandig strafbaar feit is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over tbs’ers die langer op de kamer zitten wegens bezuinigingen bij de Pompekliniek

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about longer cell confinement of tbs patients at the Pompe clinic, attributed to budget cuts and staff shortages, and about leave arrangements, staffing, and the clinic's debt. The State Secretary answered that the clinic's measures are internal, comply with legal quality requirements, the Inspectorate oversees the clinic, and no ministerial budget cuts were imposed, while declining to reverse the measures.
This does not fall within my powers.
Dit hoort niet tot mijn bevoegdheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Holleeder regeert vanuit cel’

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary how the detained criminal Holleeder could still reach the outside world from the high-security EBI prison, whether witnesses against him are at risk, and whether his special treatment (natrium-poor bread bought outside) is true. The State Secretary answered that all contact is blocked except with his lawyer, that EBI supervision measures are strictly enforced with staff trained for this group, and that the bread claim is incorrect.
From the moment the person has been in the EBI, he has had no contact whatsoever with persons outside the institution, other than with his lawyer, not by post, telephone or visits.

Vanaf het moment dat betrokkene in de EBI verblijft, heeft hij op geen enkele wijze – anderszins dan met zijn advocaat – contact met personen buiten de inrichting gehad, niet via post, telefoon of bezoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Gesthuizen over studenten in vreemdelingendetentie

Two SP MPs asked the ministers whether students who occupied the Maagdenhuis and were held in immigration detention, some for up to nine months, were misused under immigration law and should be released. The state secretary answered that the students were released once their identity was confirmed, that the court awarded modest damages for unlawful detention but found no misuse of powers, and that police and officer training will be adjusted.
The court, however, did not rule that there was a misuse of powers.
De rechter heeft echter niet geoordeeld dat sprake is van misbruik van bevoegdheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over het in vreemdelingenbewaring nemen van bezetters Maagdenhuis

An MP asked whether detaining Maagdenhuis occupiers in immigration detention merely for refusing identification is lawful and proportionate. The Secretary of State answered that refusing identification can justify immigration detention to continue identity checks, noted the court found the police's grounds insufficient in April 2015 and awarded small damages, and said training will reflect that ruling.

The court ruled in judgments of 30 April 2015 (incl. reference AWB 15/7645) that the circumstances invoked by the police were not sufficient to justify the suspicion that foreign nationals without lawful residence were among those found at the Maagdenhuis.
De rechter heeft bij uitspraken van 30 april 2015 (o.a. kenmerk AWB 15/7645) geoordeeld dat de door de politie aangevoerde omstandigheden niet voldoende zijn om het vermoeden te rechtvaardigen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Schouw over het bericht dat veel mensen in de problemen komen na zinloze gijzeling vanwege verkeersboetes

MPs Kooiman and Schouw asked the State Secretary about reports that people face serious problems after pointless imprisonment for traffic fines, including the legal basis for payment arrangements and for coercive detention. The State Secretary answered that a legal basis is needed for instalment payments, that an interim measure is planned from 1 July 2015, that a new model for detention requests is in use, and gave 2013 and 2014 figures on detention requests and orders.
The starting point is that a detention request is only submitted if there is no indication that the person concerned cannot pay the sanction.
Het uitgangspunt is dat alleen een vordering gijzeling wordt ingediend indien er geen indicatie is dat de betrokken persoon de sanctie niet kan betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden en het lid Oosenbrug over het artikel 'Organisaties zijn banger voor reputatieschade bij schending privacy'

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Oosenbrug asked about the Dutch data protection authority CBP's call for a statutory duty to publish its investigation findings, how often publication has been blocked, the CBP's publication policy, and which other supervisors have publication duties. The Secretary of State sympathised with the workload concerns, noted that only one publication has been temporarily blocked, pointed to the existing CBP policy rules, and listed sector supervisors with or proposed to have statutory publication duties.
A statutory publication duty will also be bound by (to be specified) conditions and restrictions.
Ook een wettelijke publicatieplicht zal aan (nader te benoemen) voorwaarden en beperkingen gebonden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Schouw, Voortman en Voordewind over een verwachte uitspraak van de Raad van State

MPs from SP, D66, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary why he is awaiting a ruling on vrijheidsbeperkende locaties (VBL) rather than the pending cases on municipal bed-bad-brood shelters, and whether the expected Council of State ruling was about VBL adequacy. The State Secretary answered that he is not waiting for a ruling, that the existing system complies with treaty obligations, that the Council of State cases were withdrawn on 11 May 2015 so no ruling will follow in them, and that other related cases are pending.
First of all, I consider it important to note that I am not waiting for a court ruling.
Allereerst acht ik van belang op te merken dat ik niet wacht op een rechterlijke uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de verwachte uitspraak van de Raad van State

MP Gesthuizen asked the State Secretary whether, given the withdrawal of the lawyer's appeal before the Council of State, he would inform parliament of his next steps instead of awaiting a ruling. The State Secretary replied that he is not waiting for a ruling, will discuss additional measures with municipalities, and considers that no further obligations follow for the Dutch state from the treaties concerned.
I consider it important to emphasise that I am not waiting for a ruling.
Ik vind het van belang te benadrukken dat ik niet wacht op een uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de problemen van achterblijvers na de vermissing van een persoon

An SP MP asks the State Secretary of Security and Justice about the financial and practical problems facing relatives of missing persons, and whether a separate legal status for the missing should be created. The Minister replies that existing legal arrangements (bewindvoering, zaakwaarneming, declaration of presumed death), Slachtofferhulp Nederland support, and voluntary coulance by banks and insurers address the problems, and that a separate legal status is not a good solution.
Establishing a separate legal status for missing persons does not offer a good solution to this problem.
Het instellen van een aparte juridische status voor vermisten, biedt voor deze problematiek geen goede oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Tongeren over de wachttijd tussen tbs met voorwaarden en tbs met dwangverpleging

MPs Kooiman and Van Tongeren asked whether tbs patients whose probation-based treatment is converted to compulsory treatment can be left without care during the pending conversion procedure, using the case of C.R. The State Secretary acknowledged the conversion procedure took undesirably long, said the four-month maximum waiting-period rule does not apply to it, and pointed to Penitentiary Psychiatric Centres and planned preparation measures.
The so-called procedure for subsequent detention took undesirably long in this case.
De zogenoemde procedure tot alsnog verpleging heeft in deze casus onwenselijk lang geduurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Beertema over de kosten van asielzoekers

PVV MPs Fritsma and Beertema asked for the total 2014 cost of asylum seekers, including IND, COA, DT&V, legal aid, subsidies and education for asylum-seeker children. The government answered with itemised figures from the Justice and Education budgets, totalling roughly 0.9 billion euro, and noted that data on children without residence rights is not available.
Specific data on children without residence rights are not available and therefore cannot be provided.
Specifieke gegevens over kinderen zonder verblijfsrecht zijn niet beschikbaar en kunnen dan ook niet worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat de helft van de Somaliërs in de bijstand zit

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government shares concern about the over-representation of Somalis in welfare, schooling and crime statistics, whether current immigration and integration policy is failing, and whether Australia's immigration model should be adopted. Minister Asscher replied that integration is primarily the responsibility of immigrants, that the government keeps a restrictive asylum policy bound by international obligations, that it does not accept the policy is failing, and that regional reception is preferred but a full Australian-style model is complicated and hard to realise.

The cabinet acknowledges that migrant arrivals can bring important challenges, including in integration, but does not share that this leads to the conclusion that current immigration and integration policy is failing.

Het kabinet onderkent dat de komst van migranten belangrijke uitdagingen met zich mee kan brengen, mede op het terrein van integratie, maar deelt niet dat daaruit de conclusie kan worden getrokken dat het huidige immigratie- en integratiebeleid faalt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het proefschrift 'Captivated by fear. An evaluation of terrorism detention policy'

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a dissertation evaluating terrorism detention policy, including the separate terrorist wing, international experience, and deradicalisation programmes. The government answered that it is reviewing whether the wing regime can be tailored per case and will report before the summer recess, and that a deradicalisation exit facility will be operational in September 2015.
This exercise also looks at placing these suspects and detainees on a separate ward and whether the different types of terrorism-related detainees should and could be separated from each other.
Daarbij wordt tevens aandacht besteed aan de plaatsing van deze verdachten en gedetineerden op een afzonderlijke afdeling en de vraag of de verschillende typen TA-gedetineerden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de signalen dat de verplichting van DigiD met SMS notificatie tot problemen leidt

SP MPs asked the ministers whether mandatory DigiD with SMS notification harms access to services, notably for low-literate people and for trustees (bewindvoerders) unable to act for clients. The minister answered that DigiD is personal, that health insurers use various declaration options, and that the ministry is studying electronic support for trustees, without any concrete new commitment.

The Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations is studying, together with various ministries and implementing organisations, which forms of electronic support in situations of authorisation and (statutory) representation are desirable and possible.

Het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties onderzoekt in dit kader – in samenwerking met diverse ministeries en uitvoeringsorganisaties – welke vormen van elektronische ondersteuning in situaties van machtiging en (wettelijke) vertegenwoordiging wenselijk en mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het op grote schaal frauderen met gesubsidieerde rechtshulp

Van Nispen asks the State Secretary how the government reacts to reports that lawyers who defrauded legal aid can return as social lawyers, and whether such lawyers can be excluded from the system. The State Secretary answers that the disciplinary council imposed a 12-month suspension (9 months conditional) and that the tuchtrechter, not the government, judges sanctions; he also points to the existing removal powers, their modest use, and strengthened supervision since 2015.
It is for the independent disciplinary judge to decide on sanctioning the lawyer concerned.
Het is aan de onafhankelijke tuchtrechter te oordelen over sanctionering van de desbetreffende advocaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders over het bericht dat illegale Marokkanen niet kunnen worden uitgezet

MPs Fritsma and Wilders asked whether Morocco stopped accepting the return of illegal Moroccan nationals, why this was not communicated to parliament, and what the government would do about it. The state secretary confirmed Morocco had refused cooperation on forced returns, said Morocco has now agreed to resume cooperation, and noted a Council of State ruling limited detention of Moroccan nationals, which should become possible again once cooperation resumes.
It is not customary to actively inform your House about which countries do or do not (fully) cooperate on forced return.
Het is niet gebruikelijk uw Kamer actief te informeren over welke landen wel of niet (volledig) meewerken aan gedwongen terugkeer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het lot van Pakistaanse vluchtelingen in Thailand

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked about arbitrary detention of Pakistani asylum seekers and refugees in Thailand, including children, and Thailand's treatment of them under the Child Rights Convention. Minister Koenders answered that Thailand treats all refugees alike under immigration law, that the Netherlands raises rights violations with Thai authorities and accepted 38 Pakistani refugees for resettlement, and that UNHCR is aware of long waiting times.
The Netherlands, including within the EU, regularly raises the deteriorating human rights situation in contacts with the Thai authorities.
NL brengt, o.a. in EU-verband, de verslechterende mensenrechtensituatie met regelmaat op in contacten met Thaise autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het verzamelen van persoonsgegevens in het kader van operatie Amberlight 2015

MP Voortman asked the State Secretary about Dutch participation in EU operation Amberlight 2015 at Schiphol, including whether personal data were collected and whether rights and data protection were guaranteed, and about next steps. The State Secretary answered that only non-traceable statistical data were collected, that this complies with the Dutch data protection law, and that the Latvian presidency will publish a final report.
In this operation only statistical data were collected.
In deze operatie zijn alleen statistische data verzameld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Oskam over het bericht ‘Utrecht vreest komst Belgische martelsjeik’

Two MPs (Segers and Oskam) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that Utrecht feared a visit by a Belgian preacher and about possible blacklists, visa measures, and cooperation against hate preachers. The minister answered that the local triangle found no legal grounds to act, that no blacklist exists though an alerting list is kept, and that the answers on intelligence and foreign contacts are limited.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Merkies over bewindvoerders die door een lidmaatschapseis geen bankrekening kunnen openen

MPs Van Nispen and Merkies asked whether banks such as ABN AMRO may require court-appointed trustees (bewindvoerders) to belong to a trade association before opening a bank account, and what the earlier talks with associations and banks produced. The minister replied that the Wwft does not require membership, that banks may choose additional measures case by case, that the Wft and payment-account convention give access to basic accounts, and that talks with associations were constructive but did not resolve the problem.
The Wwft does not require banks to demand that trustees be members of a trade association.
De Wwft schrijft niet voor dat banken van bewindvoerders eisen dat zij lid zijn van een branchevereniging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold, Van Haersma Buma, Slob, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij en Roemer over het bed, bad, brood compromis

MPs from several parties asked the government to explain its reliance on the Council of Europe's Committee of Ministers resolution rejecting the ECSR findings on basic provision for irregular migrants, the conditional 'bed, bath, bread' shelter scheme tied to return cooperation, the funding and sanction mechanism for municipalities, and the buitenschuld permit system. The government answered that the ECSR findings have no basis in the treaty, that Article 3 ECHR sets the floor, that shelter in pre-VBL locations will be time-limited and tied to return efforts, and that details will be settled with the VNG.
It is not for the ECSR to pronounce on the rights of persons residing illegally in our country.
Het is dan ook niet aan het ECSR om zich uit te spreken over de rechten van illegaal in ons land verblijvende personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat vrijwilligers ingezet worden in gezinnen die een maatregel opgelegd hebben gekregen van de kinderrechter

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether volunteers deployed in families under a court-ordered child protection measure is responsible, whether they can replace professionals and be effective, and whether child safety is guaranteed. The state secretary replied that the youth-care law and quality framework allow municipalities to use volunteers as a supplement under the lead of the child protection worker, that the matter is a decentralised responsibility, and that the existing legal safeguards suffice.
I do not intend to intervene in this decentralised responsibility. The aforementioned legal safeguards are sufficient.
Ik ben niet voornemens in deze decentrale verantwoordelijkheid te treden. De eerdergenoemde wettelijke waarborgen volstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Gesthuizen over een tekort aan woningen voor statushouders (opnieuw en nu met de nagezonden tabellen)

MPs Karabulut and Gesthuizen asked the government about a shortage of social rental housing for status holders and how municipalities are meant to house them. The Minister replied that no overview exists of municipalities reporting shortages or of housing waiting lists, that the 14-week housing norm is based on a 2012 agreement, and that no budget is available for new solutions such as converting the housing tax.
There is no overview of municipalities that indicate they have too few social rental homes to house asylum seekers with a residence permit (status holders).
