The minister acknowledged the need for better cost information, pointed to ongoing initiatives with insurers and providers, and gave partial answers on which hospitals lack GP cooperation and on monitoring ED use.
The information on which hospitals have not made agreements with GPs on reducing unnecessary use of the emergency department is not known to me.
De informatie in welke ziekenhuizen geen afspraken zijn gemaakt met huisartsen over het terugdringen van het onnodig gebruik van de SEH is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Bouwmeester over het bericht “Patiënt te snel naar ziekenhuis”

MPs Bouwmeester and Wolbert asked the Minister of Health about a report that patients are sent to hospital too quickly, including the lack of understandable cost and quality information, potential premium savings, incentives for GP care, and the transparency of hospital bills and prices. The Minister replied that a cost-awareness trajectory with stakeholders is underway, that exact savings cannot be given, that GP substitution is being promoted through hoofdlijnenakkoorden, and that new price and billing information is being published, but gave no figures or binding commitments on quality transparency.
Exact amounts cannot be given for this.
Exacte bedragen zijn hiervoor niet te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Bouwmeester over ziekenhuizen die doorverwijzingen van het bevolkingsonderzoek darmkanker niet aan kunnen

Two PvdA MPs asked why referrals from the colorectal cancer screening programme were nearly triple expectations, whether hospitals could cope, and what would be done about waiting times. Minister Schippers attributed the surplus to higher uptake, starting with older cohorts and a more sensitive test, said waiting times had been cut by inviting fewer people, and announced a higher cut-off value to reduce referrals and an effectiveness evaluation.
As soon as the national appointments point signalled that waiting times were rising, the number of invitations was reduced.
Zodra in het landelijke afsprakenpunt werd gesignaleerd dat de wachttijden opliepen, is het aantal uitnodigingen teruggebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Bouwmeester over patiënten die lange wachttijden melden voor tweedelijns geestelijke gezondheidszorg

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister about long waiting times in second-line mental health care reported on TV, including the number of patients waiting, whether zorgverzekeraars are failing their zorgplicht, and what the NZa is doing. The minister said no current national waiting-list data exist, promised an NZa waiting-time measurement and a monitor, said insurers have a duty to refer patients, and committed to pressing insurers and providers on information and to reviewing the NZa information policy rule.
Currently no up-to-date national data are known about waiting lists in mental health care (GGZ).
Momenteel zijn geen actuele landelijke gegevens bekend over wachtlijsten in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (GGZ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Wolbert over HIV zelftests

MPs Bouwmeester and Wolbert asked the minister about the growing availability of HIV and STI self-tests, their reliability, and whether quality standards and oversight should be tightened. The minister answered that online self-tests often lack CE marking and may give false results, pointed to EU regulatory negotiations and the inspectorate's enforcement limits, and said a separate quality mark is not useful while tests fail existing rules.
In these negotiations and more broadly in European Commission working groups, I will specifically raise the issue of (online) self-tests.
Ik zal in deze onderhandelingen en breder in werkgroepen van de Europese Commissie specifiek aandacht vragen voor de problematiek rond de (online) zelftests.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht ‘Eigen medisch dossier inzien te moeilijk’

An MP asked the health minister about reports that patients find it difficult to access their own medical records, and whether patients should have access without obstacles. The minister said patients have a right to access under the WGBO, that the IGZ does not supervise compliance and has no figures on refusals, and that no further research is needed because patients can complain or go to court.
I have no insight into the number of refusals of access per healthcare sector and the causes thereof.
Ik heb geen inzicht in het aantal weigeringen van inzage per zorgsector en de oorzaken hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Bouwmeester over het bericht ‘Groeiende kritiek op medische uitzendingen ZVK’

MPs Van Laar and Bouwmeester asked about criticism of the medical referral system (ZVK) for patients from Caribbean Netherlands, including an open letter from Han de Bruijne that the minister says never reached her ministry. The minister partly accepts the criticism, citing complexity and bureaucracy, notes satisfaction survey results, and lists improvements under way, with a Coomeva study expected by year end.
The ZVK is currently undertaking a major improvement effort, which should be completed during 2014.
Het ZVK is momenteel met een flinke verbeterslag bezig, die in de loop van 2014 zijn beslag moet krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over de miljoenenboete van het St. Antonius Ziekenhuis na foute declaraties

An MP asked the health minister about the multi-million euro fine on St. Antonius hospital for incorrect billing, whether repayment to insurers is part of the NZa fine, the room insurers have in repayment agreements, and whether full repayment of wrongly billed costs is mandatory. The minister answered that repayment is a civil-law obligation separate from the NZa fine, that such private agreements need not be public, and that incorrect billing should be repaid.
An agreement between a health insurer and a healthcare institution on repayment of incorrect billing is a private-law agreement.
Een afspraak tussen een zorgverzekeraar en zorginstelling over de terugbetaling van foutieve declaraties is een privaatrechtelijke afspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over de rol van Zorgverzekeraars Nederland (ZN) bij de ontwikkeling van protonentherapie

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether Zorgverzekeraars Nederland's opposition to four proton therapy centres and its call for more research would delay this effective treatment, and how the impasse could be resolved. The Minister answered that insurers may contract fewer centres as long as they meet their duty of care, that the CVZ rather than the Health Council determines insured care, and that she has no reason to think insurers will not act responsibly.
Individual insurers are free to purchase proton therapy from only one or two centres, provided they have bought sufficient care to meet their duty of care.

Het staat individuele verzekeraars vrij om bijvoorbeeld slechts bij één of twee centra protonentherapie in te kopen indien zij daarmee voldoende zorg hebben ingekocht om aan hun zorgplicht te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kuzu over wanbetalers in de zorg

MPs Bouwmeester and Kuzu asked the Minister of Health about rising numbers of people who do not pay their health insurance premiums, including whether unpaid premiums are growing and what causes and measures apply. The minister confirmed about 320,000 defaulters with roughly 887 million euro outstanding, explained the debt-collection and bronheffing process, and committed to a further package of measures in summer.
I have no data on that.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Bouwmeester over de transparantie van de lobbypraktijken van Nederlandse banken

MPs Nijboer and Bouwmeester asked whether the government would adopt SOMO's recommendations on transparency of Dutch banks' lobbying, including a 'lobby paragraph' in each bill, and whether similar transparency should apply to business generally. The minister replied that banks should implement recommendations themselves, that the government supports transparent accountability of stakeholder influence, and that consultation reports already function as such a lobby paragraph.
The cabinet therefore endorses the importance of transparent accountability for the influence of stakeholders on the policy process.
Het kabinet onderschrijft derhalve het belang van transparante verantwoording over die invloed van belanghebbenden op het beleidsproces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Bouwmeester over de 5 euro die onverzekerbare vreemdelingen moeten betalen voor medicijnen

MPs Maij and Bouwmeester asked why undocumented migrants must pay EUR 5 for medicines, how it was communicated, and what safeguards exist for those unable to pay. Minister Schippers answered that the charge restores the principle that the patient pays, that pharmacies and GPs were informed, that access is not blocked in urgent cases, and that the CVZ will monitor effects in its annual report rather than in a two-month inventory.
I have asked the CVZ to address the five-euro measure in this monitor where possible, and I will include it in the annual VWS Insured Monitor I send to your House.
Ik heb het CVZ gevraagd in deze monitor zo mogelijk in te gaan op de vijf-euromaatregel en zal dit meenemen in de VWS-Verzekerdenmonitor die ik jaarlijks aan uw Kamer zend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Bruins Slot over toename openstaande rekeningen in de zorg

MPs Bouwmeester and Bruins Slot asked the Minister of Health about rising unpaid hospital bills from uninsured people, including whether EU citizens can be effectively pursued and whether CVZ should investigate. Minister Schippers answered that EU residents must be insured if they stay over three months and that CVZ's tracing is limited to registered persons, but declined to commission research, saying debt prevention is hospitals' responsibility, while only asking NVZ and NFV to map the losses.
I do not consider research into the nature, scope and causes of uninsured EU citizens failing to take out insurance a task for the CVZ, nor a task for the Dutch government as such.

Ik vind onderzoek naar de aard, omvang en oorzaak van het niet afsluiten van een verzekering door niet verzekerde EU-burgers geen taak voor het CVZ, noch een taak voor de Nederlandse overheid als zodanig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over risicoselectie door zorgverzekeraars in de basisverzekering

An MP asks the Health Minister whether risk selection by health insurers in the basic insurance is being adequately policed, citing signals from research that the NZa commissioned. The minister replies that the NZa received no reports of direct violations, that the research shows overstapping patterns it does not treat as unlawful risk selection, and that she will keep monitoring the risk equalisation system without launching a new investigation.
In practice the NZa has received no signals of direct risk selection.
In de praktijk heeft de NZa geen signalen van directe risicoselectie ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het onderzoek van de Consumentenbond dat zorgverzekeraars zeer gebrekkige of geheel verkeerde informatie aan hun verzekerden verschaffen

An MP asked the health minister how to respond to a Consumentenbond study finding that health insurers give inconsistent or wrong information to policyholders, and what instruments exist to enforce better information. The minister agreed correct information is a core duty, said she will raise it with the insurers' association, noted the NZa supervises transparency, and declined a separate broader investigation.
I therefore see no reason to take other measures, besides the consultation with ZN.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om, naast het overleg met ZN, andere maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht dat behandelingen tegen vliegangst vergoed worden uit de basisverzekering

MPs Bouwmeester and Anne Mulder asked whether treatment for fear of flying, offered by PsyQ, can be charged to the basic health insurance, and how transparency of care billing could be improved. Minister Schippers answered that such treatment is not insured GGZ care unless provided as GP care, and announced more detailed invoices from 2014 and a NZa study on showing diagnoses on invoices.
Health insurers may only charge care to the Zvw that is actually insured under the Zvw.
Zorgverzekeraars mogen alleen zorg ten laste van de Zvw brengen die ook daadwerkelijk verzekerd is onder de Zvw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over fouten van vergelijkingssites zorgverzekeraars

An MP asked the health minister whether consumers can trust health insurance comparison sites, how regulators supervise them and whether sites must disclose who pays them. The minister answered that transparency is essential, that the AFM binds such sites to a 2011 framework and will investigate further in 2014, and that the ACM is working on barriers to switching insurers.
Based on the AFM norms framework from 2011, comparison sites that mediate health insurance must be open about their revenue model.
Op basis van het AFM normenkader uit 2011 moeten vergelijkingssites die bemiddelen in zorgverzekeringen openheid geven over het verdienmodel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over de vergoeding van besnijdenis op medische indicatie

MP Bouwmeester asked the health minister about circumcision on medical grounds being excluded from the basic insurance package, about a treatment guideline, evaluation, and price differences. The minister said the medical profession (NVU) should draft a guideline, that price variation reflects free price-setting, and that exclusion from the package follows from 2005 criteria.
I call on the Dutch Association for Urology (NVU) to take the initiative in this regard.
Ik roep de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Urologie (NVU) op hiertoe het initiatief te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de het lid Bouwmeester over de vergoeding van hoortoestellen

Opposition MPs Van Laar and Bouwmeester asked Minister Schippers whether the hearing aid reimbursement system, which covers only certain categories, excludes cheaper devices and cochlear implants may be chosen as a perverse incentive, and how to optimise the system. The minister defended the current system as offering enough choice, said she would report on monitoring by the end of 2013 but needed to wait for CVZ findings, pushing the promised report to spring 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Fokke over jurisprudentie ten aanzien van de handhaving van het ingezetenencriterium voor coffeeshops

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister about case law on enforcing the residency criterion for coffeeshops, following a Maastricht ruling declaring the prosecution inadmissible. The minister summarised criminal, civil and administrative rulings (mostly upholding the criterion, with some appeals pending) and said the case law is consistent enough that no legislation is needed.
Case law so far shows that the residency criterion passes scrutiny before the criminal, civil and administrative courts alike.
Uit de jurisprudentie tot nu toe blijkt dat het ingezetenencriterium zowel bij de strafrechter als de civiele rechter als de bestuursrechter de toets der kritiek doorstaat.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Bruins Slot over de fraude met AGB-codes

MPs Bouwmeester and Bruins Slot asked the health minister about fraud with AGB provider codes, including reported fake doctors submitting false claims, NZa knowledge, Vektis responsibilities, tribunal suspensions and sanctions. The minister answered that Vektis will periodically check AGB registrations via linked public registers, that NZa is investigating, that suspended practitioners should be blocked, and that sanctions are being reviewed in a December progress report.
Vektis will check the AGB files more often in the short term.
Vektis gaat op korte termijn de AGB bestanden vaker controleren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot over de vraag “Wie controleert de dokter”?

MPs Bruins Slot and Bouwmeester asked the health minister whether patients in disciplinary proceedings against doctors should receive more support, such as IGZ assistance, the ability to amend complaints during hearings, and a reversed burden of proof. The minister said IGZ will not represent patients, that a new Zorgloket will guide complainants, that she will examine amending complaints within the Wet BIG, and that the Wkkgz will make incident documentation mandatory, shifting the burden of proof indirectly.
I support the idea behind this and will examine the proposals further in the context of amending disciplinary law in the Wet BIG.
Ik steun de gedachte hier achter en zal de voorstellen nader onderzoeken in het kader van de aanpassing van het tuchtrecht in de Wet BIG.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wolbert en Bouwmeester over onnodige sterfte door Hepatitis B en C

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister about rising mortality from hepatitis B and C, the trend after 2010, risk groups among first-generation migrants, and the China-in-the-Low-Countries pilot and Bibhep project. The minister answered that cases are similar to 2009-2010, that a screening/vaccination policy for migrant risk groups is being explored with the RIVM and may go to the Gezondheidsraad, and that the pilots are being evaluated and partly supported.
If necessary, the Health Council will be asked for advice.
Zonodig zal de Gezondheidsraad om een advies gevraagd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over aanpak zorgfraude

Labour MP Bouwmeester asked minister Schippers how healthcare fraud and erroneous billing in hospitals are to be sanctioned, whether the NZa has enough capacity, and how much can be saved. The minister answered that the NZa uses both informal and formal enforcement and plans to publish sanctions, that insurers report fraud signals to the NZa, and that an expert commission will report on the scale of fraud this autumn.
Supervision of compliance with these rules by the NZa is geared to this.
Het toezicht op de naleving hiervan door de NZa is hierop geënt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over Souvenaid

An MP asked the health minister whether Souvenaid, a medical food for early Alzheimer's, should be scientifically proven before being prescribed and reimbursed, and raised concerns about its regulation, study funding by the manufacturer Nutricia, prescribing and marketing. The minister defended the Warenwet framework, said NVWA and IGZ are examining the product, and rejected the need for a new independent body while stating that research is subject to peer review and EMA/CBG oversight.
The NVWA and the IGZ check whether communication stays within the limits of the regulations.
De NVWA en de IGZ controleren of de communicatie binnen de grenzen van de regelgeving blijft.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over de subsidieverlening aan Jellinek Curaçao

An MP asked the minister how a 90,000 euro subsidy to Jellinek Curaçao came about, whether it was a rejected hotel cost shifted on civil servants' advice, and whether the subsidy should be reclaimed given reports of poor care and links to hotel Kura Hulanda. The minister explained that the amount was freed budget from hardware costs, that quality of care is not monitored by the executing agency, and that the subsidy cannot be reclaimed because the procedure was correct.
I cannot make any statement about the period after the subsidy process under PSNA was ended.
Ik kan geen uitspraak doen over de periode nadat het subsidietraject onder PSNA werd beëindigd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over de publicatie van sterftecijfers door Nederlandse ziekenhuizen

An MP asked the health minister whether all Dutch hospitals will publish mortality figures per diagnosis and age group, including the HSMR, and whether the government will compel publication. The minister agreed transparency is important, said most hospitals still publish little or nothing and that a mandatory publication route is being explored, including under Article 38 of the Wmg, with a broad sector consultation planned for May 2013.
That is why I am looking for ways to give shape to an obligation to publish mortality figures.
Daarom zoek ik naar mogelijkheden om een verplichting tot publicatie van sterftecijfers vorm te geven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het experimenteren met medicijnen op kwetsbare mensen door de farmaceutische industrie

An MP asks whether the myTomorrows online platform giving patients access to unregistered medicines, launched with ministry and IGZ knowledge, is acceptable, and whether such access is covered by good clinical practice and whether patients or insurers pay for it. The minister says the ministry and IGZ were informed but not in advance, that this is facilitated access under the named-patient and compassionate-use rules rather than research, that no public funds pay for it, and that the arrangements are sympathetic but must stay within regulation.
The ministry and IGZ were not informed in advance of the initiative going live on 16 April.
Ministerie en IGZ waren niet vooraf op de hoogte van het «in de lucht gaan» van het initiatief op 16 april jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over de keuze voor de FOB Gold test voor bevolkingsonderzoek naar darmkanker

An MP asked the minister why the FOB Gold test was chosen over OC-Sensor for the national bowel cancer screening programme, and whether critics' research was funded by OC-Sensor's maker. The minister answered in detail on test quality, procurement criteria and validation, commits to consulting the Gezondheidsraad on a comparative study, but declines to give price details and says the transparency register does not cover medical devices.
I cannot make statements about the price of both tests as part of the procurement procedure.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over de prijs van beide testen als onderdeel van de aanbestedingsprocedure.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kuzu over de toename van betalingsachterstanden bij zorgverzekeraars

MPs Bouwmeester and Kuzu asked about rising payment arrears at health insurers, the stable number of around 300,000 registered defaulters, timely removal from the defaulter scheme, and whether insurers should be obliged to offer instalment plans and prevention. Minister Schippers answered that payment plans are a positive result of the defaulter law, committed to a bill tightening the scheme, but declined to disclose insurer-level figures on commercial-sensitivity grounds and rejected mandatory proactive instalment offers.
A breakdown of these figures by health insurer cannot be provided, as it concerns business information sensitive to the health insurers.
Een uitsplitsing van deze aantallen naar zorgverzekeraar kan ik u niet verstrekken, aangezien het hier gaat om voor de zorgverzekeraars gevoelige bedrijfsinformatie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over de toetreding van de heer Dekker tot de Raad van Bestuur van het Slotervaartziekenhuis

Parliamentary questions from MP Bouwmeester ask whether a supervisory board member becoming temporary chair of the management board of the Slotervaart hospital, and the resulting dual role, conflicts with the Dutch hospital rules and the Zorgbrede Governancecode. The minister agrees that combining these roles is not permitted under the WTZi, says the IGZ is investigating a possible breach, notes that all hospitals now subscribe to the governance codes, and promises a letter on hospital governance before summer.
Combining a role on the management board with a role on the supervisory board of the same provider is therefore incompatible.
Het combineren van een functie in de raad van bestuur met een functie in de raad van toezicht van dezelfde aanbieder is in dat licht onverenigbaar.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over onderzoek door de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) bij overlijden in zorginstelling

An MP asked the state secretary about the IGZ's handling of a patient's death in a care institution (SEIN), where the family had to supply key facts and an IGZ employee made an inappropriate remark. The state secretary acknowledged the situation was unacceptable, announced a duty to notify families of incidents, said the IGZ tightened its review method, and declined a separate independent inquiry, pointing to an ongoing IGZ improvement trajectory.
I believe care institutions should inform parents and/or other directly involved persons promptly and correctly about the circumstances of an incident and involve them in the investigation.
Ik vind dat zorginstellingen ouders en/of andere direct betrokkenen tijdig en juist dienen te informeren over de toedracht van een calamiteit en hen dienen te betrekken bij onderzoek hiernaar.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Heijnen over de sluiting van Jellinek Curaçao

MPs Bouwmeester and Heijnen asked whether the closure of Jellinek Curaçao, a rehab clinic funded under a Dutch subsidy programme, shows the project failed its aims, whether the subsidy should be reclaimed, and what lessons follow. The minister replied that the subsidy cannot be reclaimed after final settlement, that the clinic contributed while active, and that the programme's sustainability focus will be strengthened.
Reclaiming after final settlement is inconsistent with the conditions under which the subsidy was granted and is therefore legally impossible.
Terugvordering na vaststelling strookt niet met de voorwaarden waaronder de subsidieverlening is verstrekt en is dus juridisch niet mogelijk.
Vragen van de leden Bruins Slot (CDA) en Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een lijst van 1000 medische missers (ingezonden 21 februari 2013).

Two MPs asked the health minister about a list of 1000 medical errors that the Inspectorate for Health Care (IGZ) mistakenly leaked to RTL, including privacy safeguards, calamity reporting and triage quality. The minister acknowledged the leak was unacceptable and unintentional, promised improvement measures and a legal duty to inform patients of calamity reports, and committed to a Zorgloket and periodic transparency reporting.
As I have previously stated, I find it unacceptable that confidential information from the IGZ became known to RTL.
Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven, vind ik het onacceptabel dat vertrouwelijke informatie van de IGZ bij RTL bekend is geworden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Bruins Slot over diefstal van medicatie uit een ziekenhuis

MPs Bouwmeester and Bruins Slot asked the health minister about a hospital in Bergen op Zoom where morphine was handed out on a fictitious patient's name, raising protocol, oversight by the IGZ and insurer declaration questions. The minister agreed the situation was serious, said the hospital had a protocol and has tightened its procedures, and pointed to IGZ oversight and the hospital's own responsibility, while stating that individual patient medication cannot be traced from insurer declarations.
Subsequently the procedures in the hospital have been tightened. The IGZ supervises this.
Vervolgens zijn de procedures in het ziekenhuis aangescherpt. De IGZ houdt hierop toezicht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over transparantie van zorgverzekeraars met zorgaanbieders

An MP asked the minister about insurers' lack of transparency on which care providers they contract with, and the risk that patients are left exposed when contracts end mid-year. The minister acknowledged the NZa publication, pointed to the BW right to terminate after an unfavourable policy change, and said a bill amending article 13 Zvw would financially incentivise insurers to disclose contracting status six weeks before the new policy year.
I have therefore, as I indicated in the answer to question 5, submitted the bill amending article 13.
Ik heb daarom, zoals ik in het antwoord op vraag 5 heb aangegeven, het wetsvoorstel tot wijziging van artikel 13 ingediend
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over een veroordeelde arts die veroordeeld is voor kinderporno, maar nog wel in het BIG-register staat

MP Bouwmeester asks whether it is troubling that a doctor convicted of child pornography remains registered in the BIG register, and how patients can learn of such convictions and how criminal, disciplinary and civil law are linked. The minister says privacy prevents discussing the case, that courts can impose only limited professional bans, that she is consulting on widening those powers, that register entries and publication are in place, and that the prosecutor decides whether to inform the Inspectorate.
I find it unsatisfactory that health professionals who have committed serious sexual or violent offences, and who may reoffend, can (again) practise their profession.
Ik vind het onbevredigend dat beroepsbeoefenaren die ernstige zeden- of geweldsmisdrijven hebben gepleegd, en bij wie een kans op recidive aanwezig is, hun beroep (opnieuw) kunnen uitoefenen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over gebrek aan controle van ziekenhuisdeclaraties door zorgverzekeraar

An MP asked the health minister about lack of insurer checks on hospital declarations, why hospital bills are late and coded, and whether there is an NZa plan to prevent and enforce against incorrect declarations. The minister said the NZa is intensifying supervision, outlined a cross-sector analysis with action areas, explained the reasons for slow hospital billing, and described the NZa's 2013 intervention strategy and reporting.
The healthcare regulator has announced that it will further intensify its supervision.
De zorgautoriteit heeft aangekondigd dat ze haar toezicht verder gaat intensiveren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over de gevolgen voor patiënten van het niet afsluiten van een contract tussen zorgverzekeraar en zorgaanbieder

An MP asked the health minister about patient consequences of Achmea and the Slotervaart hospital failing to conclude a 2013 contract, including whether patients can switch insurers or pay higher passant tariffs. The minister said contract talks were not finished, outlined a pending bill requiring insurers to disclose contracted providers six weeks before year-end, and noted insurers can only reimburse up to the policy entitlement.
I agree that it is desirable that insured persons, when they choose their health insurer, have clarity about which care providers the insurer has contracted.
Ik deel de mening dat het wenselijk is dat verzekerden, op het moment dat zij hun zorgverzekeraar kiezen, duidelijkheid hebben over welke zorgaanbieders de verzekeraar gecontracteerd heeft.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over cosmetische chirurgie en ingrepen

An MP asked the health minister about Groupon discount deals for cosmetic surgery, industry advertising standards, consumer information, a broad action plan, and cross-border medical malpractice. The minister said the sector's Leidraad applies as a standard, Belgian rules govern the procedures, adults carry responsibility for risk, a risk-reduction plan will follow in spring, and some EU-level warning mechanisms are being pursued.
In the spring I will come with proposals for measures to reduce risks in the cosmetic sector.
In het voorjaar kom ik met voorstellen voor maatregelen om risico's in de cosmetische sector te verkleinen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over boetes voor buitenlandse studenten wegens vermeend ontbreken ziektekostenverzekering

MPs Mohandis and Bouwmeester asked whether foreign students are wrongly fined by the CVZ for allegedly lacking health insurance and how to prevent this. The minister explains that students under 30 who work alongside their studies are rightly insured under Dutch rules, while exchange and non-publicly funded students are wrongly contacted because current administration cannot screen them, and says the communication is being improved and the group may be narrowed further.
In addition, I am examining the possibilities to further limit the group of international students who are currently wrongly contacted.
Daarnaast onderzoek ik de mogelijkheden om de groep internationale studenten die nu onterecht worden aangeschreven nog verder te beperken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over de uitspraken over fusies van ziekenhuizen

An MP asks the health and economic affairs ministers whether competition authority NMa treats hospital mergers more strictly than hospital cooperation, and whether it discourages cooperation while nudging hospitals toward mergers. The minister replies that NMa is meant to target cartels, not useful cooperation, that NMa issues informal opinions only on request, and that a dedicated merger test for healthcare is being legislated.
The supervision by the NMa is aimed at combating cartels.
Het toezicht van de NMa is erop gericht om kartels tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over toezicht op zorgverzekeraars en bundeling van klachten over zorgaanbieders

An MP asked the health minister whether consumers are confused about which financial or health regulator (DNB, AFM, NZa, NMa) to contact about health insurers, whether oversight differs between basic and supplementary insurance, and whether complaints and signals should be published jointly. The minister denied receiving signals of confusion, said the NZa has limited oversight of supplementary insurance, and rejected joint publication of complaints to avoid abuse and protect confidentiality, while agreeing that clarity and cross-referral should be ensured.
The supervisors want to prevent receiving less or no information and being unable to do their work well if confidentiality is not guaranteed.
De toezichthouders willen voorkomen dat zij minder of geen informatie meer krijgen en hun werk niet meer goed kunnen doen als de geheimhouding niet is geborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Mei Li Vos over onduidelijkheid bij het terug verkrijgen van het CBF keurmerk voor goede doelen

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the unclear withdrawal and later reinstatement of the CBF quality mark for a cancer research charity without public explanation, and about progress on a convenant with the charity sector for more transparency. The State Secretary said the CBF is independent and he does not judge individual decisions, but that a public explanation would help transparency, and he described the ongoing work on a validation system due by Q4 2013.
I do not intervene in individual assessments by the CBF.
Ik treed niet in individuele beoordelingen van het CBF.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kuzu over de werkwijze van de IGZ

MPs Bouwmeester and Kuzu asked the state secretary about the Health Inspectorate's (IGZ) supervision of nursing homes after a broadcast in which staff said their complaints were ignored, including whether unannounced visits and transparency of reports could be improved. The state secretary defended the IGZ's risk-based approach, stated that a third of general inspection visits are unannounced, noted that all general and thematic reports are published, and said a policy response to two external reports will follow.
The inspectorate publishes all reports from its general and thematic supervision in elderly care on its website.
De inspectie maakt alle rapporten van haar algemene toezicht en thematisch toezicht in de ouderenzorg openbaar op haar website.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over de gezondheidsrisico's van de alternatieve behandeling chelatietherapie

Bouwmeester (PvdA) asked the health minister how the government views chelation therapy for heart and vascular disease, which the Health Council deemed unacceptable, and what the IGZ can do, the number of clinics, adverse-event reporting and disciplinary cases. Minister Schippers answered that there is no evidence of efficacy beyond metal poisoning, that the IGZ can act on unsafe practice but not merely because a treatment is ineffective, that adverse events are minimally reported, and that two clinics and two disciplinary rulings concerning one case are known.
The mere fact that an alternative treatment is ineffective, such as chelation therapy for heart and vascular disease, is in itself indeed no reason for enforcement action by the IGZ.
Alleen het enkele feit dat een alternatieve behandeling onwerkzaam is, zoals chelatietherapie bij hartvaatziekte, is als zodanig inderdaad geen aanleiding voor handhavend optreden door IGZ.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over de sluiting van de afdeling cardiologie in Ruwaard van Putten ziekenhuis te Spijkenisse

An MP asked the health minister whether patients died from cardiologists' errors at Ruwaard van Putten hospital, whether patients were informed, and what lessons would be learned. The minister answered that the IGZ intervened with a closure order and enhanced supervision, that a Medirede report found substandard care, that IGZ and an internal review are ongoing, and promised to inform parliament later while citing privacy.
Taking into account the privacy of the patients involved and medical confidentiality, I will inform your House of the results of this investigation in due course.
Met inachtneming van de privacy van de betrokken patiënten en het medisch beroepsgeheim zal ik uw Kamer ter gelegener tijd informeren over de resultaten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over besparingen in de zorg

MP Bouwmeester asked the health minister about FD proposals for healthcare savings, including tightening the drug price law along Norwegian lines, lowering the GVS reimbursement limits, a preventable co-payment system for medical aids, and transparency of drug prices. The minister said the income-based premium is off the table, the WGP study will be answered later, the savings estimates are not supported, and she rejects the limit-based systems and the public price list proposal.
I will not send the House a proposal for such a system, because limit-based reimbursement has disadvantages
Ik zal de Tweede Kamer geen voorstel voor een dergelijk systeem sturen, omdat aan het hanteren van vergoedingslimieten nadelen zijn verbonden
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over het weigeren medicijnen te verstrekken aan patiënten die niet meedoen aan het EPD

An MP asks whether the Antonius Hospital pharmacy was right to refuse medicines to patients who do not opt in to the electronic patient record (EPD), and whether this amounts to coercion. The minister replies that the hospital has labelled the report incorrect and corrected it, that patients decide themselves whether to participate, and that she knows of no other providers imposing such conditions.
The starting point is and remains that the patient himself decides whether he wants to participate in the exchange of his medical data via the care infrastructure.
Uitgangspunt is en blijft dat de patiënt zelf bepaalt of hij wil deelnemen aan de uitwisseling van zijn medische gegevens via de zorginfrastructuur.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over achterstand bij jongeren met psychoses

An MP asks the health minister about the poor outcomes for young people with psychosis, including unemployment and few partnerships, and what is being done about late intervention, family support, and shortages of antipsychotic medication. The minister replies that early detection teams, the strengthened GP role, family trust persons and a new helpline are in place, declines to register national figures on help requests for privacy and administrative burden, and describes temporary supply measures for penfluridol.
Nationwide registration of the number of people reporting with a request for help for a psychiatric patient is not available.
Landelijke registratie van het aantal mensen dat zich meldt met een hulpvraag voor een psychiatrische patiënt, is niet voorhanden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over namaak goede doelen in de zorg

An MP asked whether fake charities in healthcare should be stopped by stricter rules, such as extra demands on the 'Ruimte voor geven' covenant and limits on ANBI tax status. The government answered that it opposes misleading charities, points to the transparency and supervision vision already sent to parliament, and says adding new covenant demands now would be premature, while agreeing that only compliant charities should get ANBI status.
The cabinet finds it undesirable that people are misled and that incorrect medical information is provided, whether via sites of fake charities or otherwise.
Het kabinet vindt het ongewenst dat mensen worden misleid en dat foutieve medische informatie wordt verstrekt, of dit nu via sites van namaak goede doelen gebeurt of anderszins.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over de gevolgen van het preferentiebeleid medicatie

An MP asks the health minister about the effects of the medicine preference policy, including savings, risks to health, patient information, and alternatives. The minister answers that the policy saved about €1.1 billion in 2008–2010, is no health risk since the same active substance is always given, and that complaints channels (NZa, SKGZ, Lareb) exist.
Exactly which savings the preference policy has produced is hard to state because gross drug prices are also affected by other policy measures.
Tot welke besparingen het preferentiebeleid precies heeft geleid is lastig aan te geven omdat de (bruto-)prijzen voor geneesmiddelen ook door andere beleidsmaatregelen worden beïnvloed.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het sluiten van de afdeling klinische verloskunde in Meppel

An MP from the PvdA asks the minister of Health whether the obstetrics department in Meppel will close on 1 January 2013, what conditions must be met for quality and accessibility, and what the College Perinatale Zorg has done in the region. The minister answers that the IGZ will monitor the conditions, refers largely to earlier answers to other MPs, and describes the CPZ's regional visits and the appointment of an external process facilitator.
It is important that the quality and accessibility conditions are still met after the decision. The IGZ monitors this.
Van belang is dat ook na het besluit wordt voldaan aan de randvoorwaarden voor kwaliteit en bereikbaarheid. De IGZ ziet hierop toe.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Hilkens over zwangere rokende vrouwen met een psychische stoornis

Two MPs asked the health minister about pregnant smoking women with psychiatric disorders, including whether mental health providers need specific guidance and a unified message. The minister answered that midwives and GPs are already trained in smoking cessation support, that treatment decisions are left to individual providers, and that no specific mental-health-sector guidance or role is considered necessary.
Specific information for mental health care providers therefore does not appear necessary in my view.
Specifieke voorlichting voor hulpverleners in de GGZ lijkt mijns inziens daarom niet nodig.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over stijgende kosten van medicijnverspilling

An MP asked the health minister about media reports of medicine waste, including whether returned medicines could be reused, and whether binding rules and agreements with stakeholders would be made. The minister agreed waste is undesirable, explained that the professional norm requires destruction of returned medicines for quality reasons, and said a survey of healthcare providers would be sent to parliament later.
I will inform the House of Representatives as soon as possible about the results of that survey and the follow-up actions.
Ik zal de Tweede Kamer zo snel mogelijk informeren over de resultaten van die enquête en de vervolgacties.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over de premie ziektekostenverzekering en de maatschappelijke verantwoordelijkheid van zorgverzekeraars

An MP asks the health minister whether insurer premium rises are justified given savings from expiring drug patents and added costs, and whether insurers' profits are socially acceptable. The minister answers that the expected 20 euro premium rise is based on real cost increases without using reserves, provides a solvency table, and leaves judgments on insurers' conduct and profits to the insurers and to consumer choice.
I leave that statement to Mr Oomen.
Ik laat die uitspraak voor rekening van de heer Oomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over mogelijke besparingen door doelmatig gebruik van geneesmiddelen

Rep. Bouwmeester asked the health minister whether she knew of the IMS report claiming USD 500 billion a year is wasted globally through misuse of medicines, how much the Netherlands could save by implementing its recommendations, and how the six recommendations are already reflected in Dutch policy. The minister said the figures are indicative and she sees no point in a national share, but believes savings are possible; she then outlined existing measures on pharmacists, quality assessment, antibiotic reporting, error reporting, and high-risk patient programmes, without new commitments.
Precieze cijfers zijn niet te geven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kuzu en Bouwmeester over tekort aan allochtone medisch specialisten

MPs Kuzu and Bouwmeester asked the health minister about the underrepresentation of doctors with non-Western backgrounds among medical specialists, and whether selection for specialist training is biased, including by age. Minister Schippers answered that ethnicity is not registered by law so the claims cannot be verified, that selection is the responsibility of the medical specialty societies, and that age limits are legally restricted unless objectively justified.
Because registering ethnicity is not legally permitted, it is unknown whether the cited percentages are correct.
Daar registratie van etniciteit wettelijk niet is toegestaan, is onbekend of genoemde percentages correct zijn.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over tekort aan medicijnen

An MP asked the health minister about shortages of cancer and psychosis medicines and what patients were offered as alternatives. The minister said alternative therapies exist, that shortage data from pharmacy reports may be incomplete, and that a project group will report on EU and domestic solutions by end 2012.
At the end of 2012 the House of Representatives will receive a report on the preliminary findings, conclusions and recommendations of the project group.
Eind 2012 ontvangt de Tweede Kamer een rapportage over de voorlopige bevindingen, conclusies en aanbevelingen van de projectgroep.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht dat 60% van de claims bij medisch verzekeraars niet wordt uitgekeerd

An MP asked the health minister about a broadcast reporting that around 60% of medical liability claims against medical insurers are not paid out, and about the independence of insurers, the complaints handling and the GOMA code. The minister said she has no view on the 60% figure, cites 52-55% from the insurers who attribute most cases to unavoidable complications, and declines to commission a study of claims handling for now, pointing to ongoing audits and a pending bill.
Question 7: Are you willing to have research carried out into the practice of complaint handling for medical errors by medical insurers?
Vraag 7 Bent u bereid onderzoek te laten doen naar de praktijk van klachtafhandeling bij medische missers door medische verzekeraars
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Leijten, Van der Staaij en Bruins Slot over het toegenomen aantal zelfdodingen

MPs asked the Minister of Health about the rising number of suicides, the effect of prevention policy, the new suicide treatment guideline, weekend psychiatric care and bank staff training. The minister acknowledged the increase, said the effect of policy is hard to measure, will seek advice from the VU on a target figure, and said weekend crisis care is sufficient while training bank staff is the financial sector's own responsibility.
Given that the absolute number of suicides rose again over the past year, I consulted relevant stakeholders on whether a target figure is possible and desirable.
Mede gezien de omstandigheid dat het absolute aantal suïcides over het afgelopen jaar wederom is gestegen, heb ik overleg gevoerd met betrokken veldpartijen
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over onduidelijke garantiebepalingen

An MP asked the minister of Economic Affairs about unclear statutory guarantee rules and whether consumers know their rights, given reports that they pay unnecessarily for repairs. The minister answered that consumer information via ConsuWijzer and enforcement by the Consumentenautoriteit exist, that Dutch law uses an open non-conformity period rather than a fixed guarantee term, and that he will seek more clarity together with the social partners.
I consider it important that clarity is created on this which is broadly supported.
Ik vind het van belang dat hier duidelijkheid over wordt geschapen die breed wordt gedragen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over een ontsnapte ter beschikking gestelde en de aan een burgemeester opgelegde zwijgplicht

An MP asked the state secretary about a tbs patient who escaped during escorted leave from FPC Oldenkotte, his prior offences, the role of the advisory board in granting leave, comparative escape figures, and whether a mayor was ordered by the prosecution to stay silent. The state secretary answered that the patient was arrested and suspected of attempted murder and rape, the advisory board advised leave and he followed that advice, escape figures show no clinic anomaly, and the prosecution asked the mayor not to publicise the case for investigative reasons, though he did not impose a formal gag.
The prosecution then urgently asked him, in view of the investigative interest, not to make any public statements about the case.
Daarop heeft het OM hem in verband met het opsporingsbelang dringend verzocht geen mededelingen over de zaak in de openbaarheid te brengen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht dat cannabis slecht is voor de ontwikkeling van de hersenen van jongeren

The MP asks whether a youth substance-use action plan will be made, whether parents will be informed, whether names of pupils using soft drugs should be disclosed, and about coffeeshop compliance and the wietpas effects. The minister says existing prevention programmes continue, no new action plan is launched due to the caretaker cabinet, incident registration is the tool for schools, and a coffeeshop report will follow in October 2012.
I do not have recent figures on coffeeshops' compliance with the two criteria you mention, but I expect to receive the results of a study commissioned from Intraval shortly.
Ik beschik niet over recente cijfers over de naleving door coffeeshops van de twee in uw vraag genoemde criteria, maar op korte termijn verwacht ik de uitkomsten te ontvangen van een onderzoek
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over kinderen die in Maastricht in drugs handelen

The MP asks whether children in Maastricht are involved in selling cannabis, what the government will do about it, and about school attendance, diplomas and seizing criminal assets. The minister answers that police and truancy officers address juvenile street dealing with criminal and school-return approaches, promises a report to parliament in October 2012, and points to existing education in youth detention and planned legislation.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht ‘Verzekeraar wil luxe afkickresorts niet vergoeden’

An MP asked ministers whether the Jellinek Curaçao addiction retreat, subsidised with €600,000 under the Dutch Antilles programme, is too expensive, serves only wealthy patients, transferred expertise to local staff, and whether the subsidy should be reclaimed. The minister replied that local Curaçaos can apply on the same terms, the subsidy's job-creation and expertise goals were largely met, and no conditions on treating local addicts were attached to the subsidy.
No conditions were attached to the PSNA subsidy regarding the treatment of local addicts.
Vanuit de PSNA-subsidie zijn geen voorwaarden gesteld met betrekking tot het behandelen van lokale verslaafden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over tekst op pakjes sigaretten

An MP asked the health minister whether she would change cigarette pack warnings, which research showed do not work, to point smokers toward quit-smoking help instead of health consequences. The minister confirmed the warnings will be replaced from March 2014 under an EU directive, including a referral to a quit-smoking website, and deferred other health recommendations to a future cabinet.
The texts on cigarette packs will be changed as of 28 March 2014.
De teksten op pakjes sigaretten worden aangepast per 28 maart 2014.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Marcouch over een verplichte alcohol- of drugstest

MPs Bouwmeester and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the commitment to systematically record alcohol and drug use in violent incidents, made in 2005, and the promised mandatory drug/alcohol test have taken so long to turn into action. The minister answered that pilots and an evaluation were carried out, registration was introduced, and a bill allowing mandatory drug and alcohol tests in violent offences went to consultation in August 2012, with entry into force planned for 2013.
It provides for the possibility of a mandatory drug and alcohol test in cases of violent offences.
Het voorziet in de mogelijkheid van een verplichte drugs- en alcoholtest bij geweldsdelicten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Recourt over het toezicht op vrijgekomen ernstige zware delinquenten

Two MPs asked whether police supervision of released violent and sex offenders is unclear and poorly coordinated with probation, and whether dangerous offenders are reliably checked. The state secretary answered that a 2011 national cooperation agreement and the new conditional sanctions law (in force 1 April 2012) clarify roles, with probation primarily responsible and police providing a signalling function, and that mayors are informed of certain returning offenders.
Probation is primarily responsible for supervision and always contacts the neighbourhood police officer when restrictive conditions have been imposed (and in other cases when necessary).

De reclassering is primair verantwoordelijk voor het toezicht en neemt indien vrijheidsbeperkende voorwaarden zijn opgelegd altijd (en in andere gevallen indien daar noodzaak toe is) contact op met de wijkagent.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Bouwmeester over de ontsnapping van twee jeugdige gedetineerden

MPs Marcouch and Bouwmeester asked about a police report on two girls who escaped from Het Poortje youth institution during a theme park outing, and whether the outing and supervision were appropriate. The state secretary answered that the girls were not detainees but were in closed youth care, that the outing followed a planned, individually assessed reintegration step with parental consent, and that the institution acknowledges the individual risk assessment should have outweighed the group interest.
The institution acknowledges that in this case the individual risk assessment of the girls should have weighed more heavily than the group interest.
De instelling erkent dat in dit geval de individuele risicotaxatie van de meisjes zwaarder had moeten wegen dan het groepsbelang.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over compensatie van passagiers met grote vertraging door vliegtuigmaatschappijen

An MP asks the government why airlines still inform passengers poorly about compensation for long delays, and whether they should be forced to act, adopt a uniform claims procedure, and revive the aviation complaints committee. The State Secretary replies that inspection finds compliance on information provision generally good, that the main problem is the Sturgeon ruling on delay compensation pending European Court clarification which blocks sanctions, and declines new national rules or a revived complaints committee while pointing to existing inspectorate complaint handling.
Pending the legal clarity that only the European Court can give, or an amendment of the Regulation, the inspectorate currently cannot impose sanctions for violating the Sturgeon ruling.

In afwachting van de juridische duidelijkheid die alleen gegeven kan worden door het Europese Hof, of door aanpassing van de Verordening, kan de inspectie momenteel geen sancties opleggen voor overtreding van het Sturgeon-arrest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over agressie op de ggz-werkvloer (geestelijke gezondheidszorg)

An MP asked the health minister about violence against mental health staff, whether the anti-aggression action plan should be binding, whether staffing is sufficient after budget cuts, and why the nursing association V&VN was not involved in the agreements. The minister answered that the Actieplan Veilig werken in de zorg contains binding measures, including an evaluation of the ELA prosecution agreements due in December, that V&VN will be involved in the GGZ agreement and the action plan, and that trainings are planned.
I consider it important that mental health workers feel heard. That is why I will involve the V&VN in elaborating the GGZ Administrative Agreement and in the Action Plan.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat medewerkers in de ggz zich gehoord voelen. Mede daarom zal ik de V&VN betrekken bij de uitwerking van het Bestuurlijk Akkoord GGZ en bij het Actieplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester inzake veiligheid van ggz-verpleegkundigen

MP Bouwmeester asked the health minister about aggression against mental health nurses, including the petition, whether the labour inspectorate investigates this, and whether nurses should be allowed to decide on patient transfers. The minister said the inspectorate found anti-aggression policies reasonably to well in order, will focus on psychosocial workload in 2012-2013, and will raise nurse transfer authority with social partners, while stating enough treatment places exist.
For 2012, 750 inspections are planned focusing on psychosocial workload.
Voor 2012 zijn er 750 inspecties gepland gericht op psychosociale arbeidsbelasting.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over gebrek aan ggz familiebeleid en tekortschietende hulp voor kinderen van verslaafde en/ of verwarde ouders

Two MPs asked the minister of Health about inadequate family policy in mental health care and insufficient support for children of addicted or mentally ill parents. The minister acknowledged the importance of family involvement, pointed to existing initiatives, a planned handbook for municipalities, and the forthcoming compulsory mental health bill, but did not commit to mandatory systematic attention to children.
It is the professional responsibility of the individual treating clinician to take this aspect into account in treatment.
Het is de professionele verantwoordelijkheid van de individuele behandelaar om in de behandeling dit aspect mee te nemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg Gesthuizen en Bouwmeester inzake de opsplitsting cq. verplaatsing van het Pieter Baan Centrum

MPs Van Toorenburg, Gesthuizen and Bouwmeester asked whether the government would fully inform parliament about plans to split up or relocate the Pieter Baan Centrum, a forensic psychiatric observation institute, after press reports and without debate on the matter. Minister Opstelten answered that the building is outdated and the funds for renovation are lacking, so a relocation to Almere is planned for 2013 with decentralised observation places, and that the move was not discussed in the June debate because there were no new developments beyond earlier letters to parliament.
As I also indicated in answering questions from MP Van der Steur (VVD), the Netherlands Institute for Forensic Psychiatry and Psychology (NIFP) is continuously working to improve quality.

Zoals ik ook heb aangegeven in de beantwoording van de vragen ( 2012Z14241 ) van het lid Van der Steur (VVD) werkt het Nederlands Instituut voor Forensische Psychiatrie en Psychologie (NIFP) voortdurend aan het verbeteren van de kwaliteit.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over niet functionerende psychiater/artsen die bij disfunctioneren jaren door kunnen werken

The MP Bouwmeester asked the health minister about a psychiatrist and other doctors who keep working for years despite poor performance, and what the rules and oversight do to prevent this. The minister answered that the inspectorate supervises the case, that a verbeterplan is in place, that a voorlopige voorziening for disciplinary cases is planned, and that the publication of disciplinary measures in the BIG-register has been expanded.
As indicated in the letter on disciplinary law, the Framework Act on disciplinary procedure will include the possibility of an interim measure (for example suspension).

Antwoord 10 Zoals in de brief over het tuchtrecht 4 aangegeven zal in de Kaderwet tuchtprocesrecht de mogelijkheid worden opgenomen tot het treffen van een voorlopige voorziening (bijvoorbeeld schorsing).
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het terugdringen van alcoholmisbruik door jongeren

An MP asks the health minister about municipalities' readiness for the revised Drank- en horecawet on curbing youth alcohol abuse, including local ordinances and preventive policy. The minister says municipalities have time before the 1 January 2013 entry into force, points to a handreiking, training and a support website, and refers to existing model ordinances and national prevention priorities.
There is therefore still enough time for municipalities to prepare for the new tasks and powers.
Er is dus nog tijd genoeg voor gemeenten om zich voor te bereiden op de nieuwe taken en bevoegdheden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht ‘Isoleercel te vaak en onterecht gebruikt’

MP Bouwmeester asks the health minister about reports that isolation cells in mental health care are used too often and wrongly, and about a Erasmus dissertation on this, asking whether she accepts that it is the institutions' responsibility and what she will do. The minister acknowledges the problem, says separation should be a last resort, describes a culture change, a 2012 sector agreement, planned Wet verplichte GGZ and tighter Inspectorate oversight, but states that reducing misuse is a shared responsibility with the field.
The IGZ will focus on 'do not separate unless', eradicating solitary confinement, and internal and external consultation.
De IGZ zal zich richten op het «niet separeren, tenzij», het uitbannen van eenzame opsluiting en de in- en externe consultatie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over lobbypraktijken van tabakfabrikant Philip Morris in Bergen op Zoom

An MP asked the health minister whether she knew of Philip Morris letters to Bergen op Zoom councillors and staff framed as job threats, and whether this lobbying was unethical and misleading, and whether the company had lobbied her ministry or the economics ministry on excise increases. The minister said lobbying a local government on local consequences of national policy is not inherently unethical, that she trusts local officials to weigh it, and that no influence on her ministry's excise plans occurred.

The fact that Philip Morris, on a policy field directly affecting its activities, seeks contact with local government and informs them of possible consequences of national policy is not necessarily unethical.

Het feit dat Philip Morris over een beleidsterrein dat hun activiteiten direct raakt, contact zoekt met het lokaal bestuur en hen informeert over mogelijke consequenties van landelijk beleid, is niet per definitie onethisch.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het nieuwe DSM handboek voor de psychiatrie

An MP asked the health minister about the new DSM psychiatric handbook, including professors leaving its working group over broadened diagnostic criteria and industry ties of contributing scientists. The minister declined to judge the DSM working method beyond earlier answers, defended collaboration with industry while pointing to self-regulatory transparency codes and a register due in early 2013.
I support the CGR's initiative to achieve transparency about (financial) ties and I endorse the Code to prevent improper influence.
Ik ondersteun het initiatief van de CGR om te komen tot transparantie over de (financiële) banden en ik onderschrijf de Code ter voorkoming van oneigenlijke beïnvloeding.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over ontevreden patiënten klachtafhandeling in de zorg

An MP asks the health minister about a Nivel/KNMG study finding patients do not know where to complain, feel unheard and distrust complaint handling in healthcare, and asks how patients' position will be strengthened. The minister acknowledges the findings and says the Wcz bill will introduce binding rulings from an independent dispute body, a patient ombudsman-style support role, and mandatory disclosure of incidents.
For this reason I have included in the Wcz proposal that people must be able to turn to an independent dispute body that makes binding rulings, can award compensation and publishes those rulings.

Om die reden heb ik in het voorstel voor de Wcz opgenomen dat mensen terecht moeten kunnen bij een onafhankelijke geschilleninstantie die bindende uitspraken doet, schadevergoedingen kan toekennen en die uitspraken openbaar maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars in medische gegevens van GGZ-patiënten neuzen

An MP asks the health minister about insurer CZ's audit of GGZ provider Europsyche, in which staff viewed patients' treatment plans and session notes and phoned patients. The minister replies that the audit followed the statutory graduated approach, that confidentiality was safeguarded under the medical adviser, and that the CBP is for it to decide whether to investigate.
From insurer CZ I understand that the way they carried out their audit is in line with the rules described above.
Van zorgverzekeraar CZ heb ik begrepen dat de wijze waarop zij hun controle hebben uitgevoerd in overeenstemming is met de hierboven beschreven regels.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over vergoeding van alternatieve therapieën uit het basispakket

An MP asks the minister about insurers reimbursing alternative therapies outside the basic package through Stichting Europsyche, which uses registered psychiatrists or psychologists as nominal main practitioners, and about the Kwaliteitswet, IGZ oversight and possible legal bans. The minister answers that IGZ and NZa are investigating, that main practitioners must ensure competence and that IGZ recommendations will be adopted, while noting gaps in regulation.
For this question I refer you to my letter of 25 June 2012 and the attached investigation results of the IGZ.
Ik wil u voor deze vraag verwijzen naar mijn brief van 25 juni 2012 en de daarbij gevoegde onderzoeksresultaten van de IGZ.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over de brandveiligheid in GGZ-instellingen

An MP asked the minister whether fire safety in mental health institutions is inadequate, whether staff are unprepared for fires, whether institutions have enough fire-response staff, and whether fire supervision should be concentrated in one inspectorate. The minister agreed fire safety is insufficient and says the primary responsibility lies with institution managers, with supervision by the competent authority, and that the inspectorates are still discussing consolidating supervision and will inform parliament.
When clarity on that exists, your House will be informed about it.
Wanneer daar duidelijkheid over is wordt uw Kamer daarover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over contact met de alcohol- en tabakslobby

An MP asks the health minister why her ministry does not keep minutes of meetings with the alcohol and tobacco lobby, why it refers to Freedom of Information requests for contact details, and why it did not disclose substantive contact information as promised. The minister replies that informal strategic sessions need no minutes, that only official meetings are minuted, that the Heineken visit has been confirmed, and that conclusions will be sent to the House later.
As soon as the conclusions from these strategic sessions are available, I will send them to the House.
Zodra de conclusies uit deze strategische sessies beschikbaar zijn zal ik deze aan de Kamer toezenden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kuiken over compensatie aan passagiers bij vertraging luchtvaart

MPs Bouwmeester and Kuiken asked whether airlines that refuse compensation for delays over three hours, cancellations or overbooking act unlawfully under EU Regulation 261/2004 and the Sturgeon ruling, and whether the state will enforce it. The state secretary answers that the Sturgeon ruling is binding, that the inspectorate enforces it but has paused new sanctions pending test cases and preliminary questions to the European Court, and that complaints are normally handled within six months.
For failing to comply with the Sturgeon ruling, the inspectorate has imposed a penalty order on each of four Dutch airlines.
Voor het niet naleven van het Sturgeon-arrest heeft de inspectie vier Nederlandse luchtvaartmaatschappijen elk een last onder dwangsom opgelegd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over zelfverrijking door fondsenwerving kankeronderzoek

An MP asked the government about the Dutch Wereld Kanker Onderzoek Fonds, including allegations of self-enrichment, outsourced fundraising owned by insiders, and paid board members. The state secretary answered that no facts showing self-enrichment were found, board members are unpaid, and the CBF chose not to renew the fund's quality mark because it no longer met standards.
I do not have information regarding the founders.
Ik beschik niet over informatie met betrekking tot de oprichters
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Dijsselbloem over de verplaatsing van de verkoop van drugs van het zuiden van het land naar Nijmegen

Two PvdA MPs asked the Justice minister whether he anticipated the shift of cannabis sales from southern Netherlands to Nijmegen after the 'wietpas' was introduced, whether he would act on resulting nuisance, and whether he still backs the policy given public skepticism. The minister answered that displacement was limited and as expected, straathandel is manageable and police act on it, and he sees no need for further steps at present.
In view of the above, I see no need to take further steps at this time.
Gezien het bovenstaande zie ik geen noodzaak om op dit moment nadere stappen te ondernemen.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester en Kuiken over belangen van huisartsen in de tabaksindustrie

MPs Bouwmeester and Kuiken asked the health minister about reports that the pension fund for GPs invests in the tobacco industry, whether the government knew of it, how much is invested, and whether this undermines doctors' credibility in fighting smoking. The minister replied that monitoring individual pension fund investments is not the government's task, that DNB supervises without disclosing fund-level data, and that investing in legal tobacco producers gives no reason for measures.
The law prohibits DNB from disclosing data on individual funds to me.
De wet verbiedt daarbij dat DNB gegevens over individuele fondsen aan mij kenbaar maakt.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over het forensisch psychiatrisch centrum De Oostvaarderskliniek

MP Bouwmeester asked about reports of a fear culture at De Oostvaarderskliniek, including the alarm system, whether staff can safely report incidents, and whether clients and staff have been surveyed. Secretary Teeven denied a faulty alarm system, described existing internal reporting channels and evaluation procedures, and saw no reason for further research into incident reporting.
I see no reason for further research into the reporting of incidents.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor nader onderzoek naar het melden van incidenten.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over de kosten van hotelkamers

An MP asks the minister of Economic Affairs whether online booking sites' strict rate parity conditions push up hotel room prices, and whether the Consumer Authority has the capacity to investigate. The minister replies that hotels remain free to set prices, that booking-site fees buy a service consumers may value, that competition and consumer-protection authorities already supervise the market, and that consumer information is available, without committing to new action.
It is up to the market itself to determine the price of hotel rooms.
Het is aan de markt zelf om de prijs van hotelkamers te bepalen.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over het verzuimen van de zorgplicht door luchtvaartmaatschappijen

The MP Bouwmeester asked the ministers whether low-cost airlines Ryanair and Vueling unlawfully refuse care to passengers delayed by strikes and whether a dedicated airline complaints committee should be reinstated. State Secretary Atsma answered that EU Regulation 261/2004 requires care, that the pending Court of Justice case (McDonagh/Ryanair) will decide the matter, that the inspectorate (ILT) enforces the rules and handles complaints, and that reinstating a complaints committee is primarily for private parties to decide.
The inspectorate does establish infringement of the Regulation, so passengers can, if they wish, start civil proceedings on the basis of that decision.
De inspectie stelt wel overtreding van de Verordening vast, zodat passagiers met dat besluit desgewenst een civiele procedure kunnen starten.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester en Kuiken over duidelijke, eenduidige en vindbare informatie over tekortschietende behandelaren

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister why psychotherapist Van Steijn, struck off as psychotherapist for malpractice, still appears as a health psychologist in the BIG register, and how IGZ and CIBG handled information and timing. The minister acknowledged the gap, said the law from 1 July 2012 will record such restrictions in the register, and said the IGZ dossier review will be awaited with results expected after the summer.

I share that view. The Act of 7 November 2011 amending the Individual Health Care Professions Act will require that restrictive orders issued by the IGZ are recorded in the BIG register from 1 July 2012.
Ik deel die mening. De Wet van 7 november 2011, houdende wijziging van de Wet op de beroepen in de individuele gezondheidszorg
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over de contacten met de alcohol- en tabakslobby

An MP asked the health minister to disclose all contacts with the alcohol and tobacco lobby, the minutes of meetings with alcohol industry directors, and the status of those meetings. The minister pointed to tobacco contacts already reported, refused to disclose full alcohol-industry contacts as unnecessary and burdensome, said no minutes were kept of the recent meeting, and called the consultation informal.
I have not made a commitment to provide insight into contacts with the alcohol industry, and I also consider it undesirable to do so.
Ik heb geen toezegging gedaan om inzicht te geven in de contacten met de alcoholindustrie, en ik vind het ook onwenselijk om dit te doen.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over tweedeling in de zorg als gevolg van de eigen bijdrage in de tweedelijns ggz (geestelijke gezondheidszorg)

An MP asked the minister about a Nivel study suggesting the new eigen bijdrage in tweedelijns ggz may cause low-income patients, especially in addiction and youth care, to reduce or stop treatment, creating a two-tier care system. The minister replied that the study measured intentions before introduction, that effects are being monitored with first results due in September, and that the measure was meant to rebalance costs and not to create tiers, with payment arrangements and municipal assistance available.
As I have already informed the House, I am monitoring the effects of the introduction and I will be able to send you the first results in September.
Zoals ik uw Kamer al heb laten weten ben ik de effecten van de invoering aan het monitoren en zal ik u in september de eerste resultaten kunnen toesturen.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester en Recourt over de rapportage van gerechterlijke psychologen en psychiaters

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a study of forensic psychologists and psychiatrists in criminal cases, including whether reports are based on seeing the suspect, whether recidivism tools are used, and whether the findings link to the Visser committee on tbs. The state secretary's answer, sent as a reply to the parliamentary agenda request, is a cross-reference to an earlier letter (Kamerstuk 29 279, nr. 143) dated 30 March, with no substantive answers included in this document.

I hereby inform you that the written questions from MPs Bouwmeester and Recourt (both PvdA) to the Minister of Security and Justice on the reporting of forensic psychologists and psychiatrists (submitted 23 March 2012) were answered on 30 March.

Hierbij bericht ik u dat de schriftelijke vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Recourt (beiden PvdA) van uw Kamer aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de rapportage van rechterlijke psychologen en psychiaters (ingezonden 23 maart 2012) zijn beantwoord op 30 maart
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over een ontsnapte ter beschikking gestelde

An MP asked the state secretary about a tbs detainee who escaped from FPC De Kijvelanden while on supervised leave, the role of the advisory board AVt, and whether this clinic is under closer supervision or has more absences than others. The state secretary answered that the escape followed procedure, the AVt advised negatively on unsupervised leave, inspections found no structural problems, and absences have fallen since 2005.
Since a negative advice from the AVt is binding for me, I did not grant the extension.
Aangezien een negatief advies van het AVt voor mij bindend is, heb ik de uitbreiding niet toegestaan.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester en Kuiken over lange reistijd bij low budget vliegmaatschappijen

Two MPs asked whether low-cost airlines misleadingly advertise airports as central to the capital while the transport from those airports is long and costly, and whether this breaches consumer protection and creates unfair competition. The minister says the Consumentenautoriteit and courts can judge misleading advertising under Dutch civil code rules and the travel industry code, and that the Consumentenautoriteit has sufficient powers and means to act.
I leave the judgement on whether these specific cases involve misleading or unfair commercial practices to the supervisory authority and the courts.
Ik laat het oordeel of er in deze concrete gevallen sprake is van misleiding of een oneerlijke handelspraktijk over aan de toezichthouder en de rechter.

Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over zelfmoord in detentie en reactie verzoek commissie voor Veiligheid en Justitie inzake meer informatie over de suïcide die in de nacht van 7 op 8 april plaatsvond in de Penitentiaire Inric
