An MP asks the Minister about a suicide in detention at PI Vught, the number of deaths in detention, and whether the frequent incidents at PI Vught will be analysed. The Minister answers that investigations (calamity commission, IGZ, OM) are ongoing, that all deaths are reported to the IGZ and examined, and that the Vught prison functions well overall with an incident analysis planned.
Only once the IGZ and calamity investigations are completed can statements be made about the cause.
Pas als de onderzoeken van de IGZ en het calamiteitenonderzoek zijn afgerond kunnen uitspraken over de toedracht worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over de verkoop van Holland Casino

An MP asked the state secretaries of Finance and Justice about the possible privatisation of Holland Casino, whether it could become an entertainment company, and reports of foreign interest. The government answered that no concrete privatisation proposal exists yet, that any sale will be considered within the broader reform of the gambling market, and that it cannot yet give meaningful answers on sale methods or buyers.
There is therefore currently no concrete proposal for privatisation.
Een concreet voorstel tot privatisering is er nu derhalve niet.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over geweldpleging Mohammed B. in de gevangenis

An MP asked the State Secretary about a reported fight in which Mohammed B. attacked a fellow inmate, whether it was true that a fellow inmate intervened instead of staff, and whether he had access to boxing training. The State Secretary answered that the OM dropped prosecution because the prisoner was already disciplined, that staff intervened adequately, that no boxing lessons were given though a punching bag is available, and that no martial arts instruction is provided.
It is correct that on 27 May 2011 a fight between two inmates took place in the exercise yard of the Extra Secure Facility (EBI), in which a fellow inmate intervened.

Het is juist dat op 27 mei 2011 een vechtpartij tussen twee gedetineerden heeft plaatsgevonden op de luchtplaats van de Extra Beveiligde Inrichting (EBI), waarbij een medegedetineerde tussenbeide is gekomen.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over zero tolerance bij de wietpas

An MP asks the Justice minister about a Maastricht mayor's hard line against coffeeshops, the expected effect of the cannabis pass on tourist visits, enforcement of illegal sales, and privacy advice on the pass. The minister replies that local authorities set coffeeshop policy within the national framework, that restricting non-resident access should reduce drug tourism, and that the privacy advice from the CBP is still awaited.
It is for the mayor to set coffeeshop policy within the national framework (the Opium Act and the tolerance criteria) and to lead on it.
Het is aan de burgemeester om het coffeeshopbeleid binnen het landelijke kader (de Opiumwet en de gedoogcriteria) vast te stellen en daarover de regie te voeren.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over het aantal sterfgevallen in detentie

MP Bouwmeester asked about deaths in detention, including discrepancies between DJI and IGZ figures and reported deaths of detainees in late 2011. The state secretary explained the differences in counting and reporting, acknowledged that some deaths outside prisons were not reported to the IGZ, and promised intensified cooperation and a policy response after the Nationale Ombudsman study.

I consider it important that such deaths are also reported, so that there is a complete overview of all deceased persons under the responsibility of DJI, and I have therefore asked the penitentiary institutions to comply.

Ik vind het belangrijk dat ook dergelijke sterfgevallen gemeld worden, zodat er een totaaloverzicht is van alle overledenen onder verantwoordelijkheid van DJI, en heb de pi's dan ook gevraagd hier gehoor aan te geven.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over de trage afhandeling van klachten over en door luchtvaartmaatschappijen

An MP asks the state secretary why the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport takes up to six months to handle passenger complaints about airlines, and what will be done to speed this up. The secretary defends the procedure as necessary for complex cases, reports added staff and an informing letter to complainants, and says the inspectorate will adopt the Ombudsman's recommendation to keep complainants informed.
The inspectorate has since informed the National Ombudsman in writing that it will adopt his recommendation to keep the complainant informed in the interim.
De inspectie heeft de Nationale ombudsman inmiddels schriftelijk laten weten zijn aanbeveling over te nemen om de indiener van een klacht tussentijds te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht meisje pleegt zelfmoord om beleid minister

An MP (PvdA) asked the health minister whether she knew of a press report that a girl died by suicide because of the minister's policy, whether an investigation would be conducted, and how acute care would be guaranteed despite a 200 euro own-contribution. The minister declined to answer, stating that the report had been found to be inaccurate according to the mental health provider's press release, and considered the questions moot.
I am of the view that answering the questions posed is therefore not relevant.
Ik ben van mening dat antwoord op de gestelde vragen daarmee niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over het boek Rien ne va plus van een ex medewerker van Holland Casino

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a book by a former Holland Casino employee alleging weak addiction prevention and money-laundering risks, and why a lifetime entry ban is refused. The government answers that Holland Casino's prevention and anti-money-laundering conduct meets the rules (per an Audit Office report), disputes several factual claims, and says a lifetime ban is unrealistic and Holland Casino may refuse it.
Holland Casino has told me it will investigate the factual basis of the incidents described in the book.
Holland Casino heeft mij aangegeven onderzoek te doen naar het feitelijke gehalte van de in het boek beschreven incidenten.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester en Arib over de lobby van de sigarettenindustrie

MPs Bouwmeester and Arib asked the health minister about reported tobacco industry lobbying, WHO guideline compliance, contacts with the industry, and whether smoking is addictive and the industry's economic role matters to policy. The minister said Dutch practice follows the FCTC 5.3 guideline with transparency, referred to earlier overviews of contacts, said there was no prior contact with the industry on recent measures, and stated tobacco policy is not affected by the industry's economic contribution.
The requested overview of contacts between my ministry and the tobacco industry was previously provided in parliamentary questions of 1 December 2011 and 31 January 2012.
Het gevraagde overzicht van contacten tussen mijn ministerie en de tabaksindustrie heb ik eerder verstrekt in Kamervragen van 1 december 2011 en 31 januari 2012.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de forse toename van jongeren in de daklozenopvang (ingezonden 12 december 2011).

MP Bouwmeester asks the health minister about the sharp rise in young people seeking homeless shelter, including minors, and about causes, problems, responsibility and prevention. The state secretary acknowledges the concern, explains that gemeenten (municipalities) hold the lead role and that the government will support them through handreikingen, a support tour and talks with the VNG, while noting the cause of the rise is not yet fully explained.
I want to ask the Federatie Opvang to break down the figures by centre-municipality level, to see whether local differences are visible.
Ik wil de Federatie Opvang vragen een uitsplitsing van de cijfers te maken naar centrumgemeenteniveau, om te zien of er lokale verschillen zichtbaar zijn.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over te hoge prijzen voor hotelkamers

An MP asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether online booking intermediaries charge excessive commissions to hotels, whether hotels are free to set prices, and whether consumers can see intermediary fees. The minister answered that commission levels vary and hotels are free to contract, that a legal disclosure duty is undesirable, and that the competition authority has received no formal complaints and sees no reason for further investigation.
I am not aware of the precise content of the contracts between booking sites and hotels.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van de precieze inhoud van de contracten tussen boekingssites en hotels.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over het “Cocaïnefeestje in de gevangenis”

An MP asked the state secretary about a report that a man smuggled cocaine into the Schutterswei prison by swallowing cocaine pellets, and why standard checks did not catch it. The secretary answered that the drugs were found after intelligence from another inmate, that standard checks found nothing, that no extra pellet check is planned for now, and that the drug-deterrence policy is being revised with a letter to parliament in spring.
Therefore the department-wide drug deterrence policy will be tightened on certain points, partly in light of the evaluation outcomes.
Daarom zal het GW-brede drugsontmoedigingsbeleid mede naar aanleiding van de uitkomsten van de evaluatie van dit beleid op bepaalde punten worden aangescherpt.
Vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over falend toezicht door de IGZ (ingezonden 16 december 2011).

MPs Bouwmeester and Kuiken asked the health minister whether, after a UMCG case where the IGZ failed to act, she would reconsider the PvdA's earlier call for independent investigation of the IGZ and have the Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid conduct it. The minister answered that she will commission an external audit of the IGZ's organisation to check whether it can carry out its new supervisory vision, reporting to parliament in summer, but declined to assign the review to the Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid.

To keep a close watch on whether the IGZ organisation is robust enough to carry out the supervisory vision and whether its processes and systems are sufficiently designed for this, I will have the IGZ organisation externally audited.

Om goed de vinger aan de pols te houden of de organisatie van de IGZ robuust genoeg is om de toezichtvisie uit te voeren en of de processen en systemen hierop voldoende zijn berekend, zal ik extern de organisatie van de IGZ laten doorlichten.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over geweld en agressie in de gevangenis (ingezonden 28 december 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether he is shocked that the Labour Inspectorate found safety not guaranteed in 79% of prisons, whether the machismo culture will be tackled, and whether he will focus on violence and recidivism rather than privatisation. The state secretary replies that a WODC survey shows measures have worked, that the inspectorate's findings call for more attention to embedding measures, and that a cabinet position on privatisation will follow.
The findings of the Labour Inspectorate mean that more efforts are needed in some areas, particularly in embedding the measures taken.
De bevindingen van de Inspectie SZW leiden ertoe dat er op onderdelen meer inspanningen nodig zijn, met name op het gebied van de borging van de getroffen maatregelen.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het overlijden van een gedetineerde in het penitentiair psychiatrisch centrum (PPC) (ingezonden 29 december 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a detainee's death in a penitentiary psychiatric centre, including IGZ findings on care quality, isolation use, staff training, workload links, and rising deaths in detention. The State Secretary answers that investigations are ongoing, outlines the reporting and inquiry steps, describes staff training and efforts to reduce coercion, and provides 2010 death statistics with commitments to a patient file and to await the Ombudsman and DJI studies.
Currently, fact-finding into this incident is being carried out through the appropriate channels.
Momenteel wordt via de geëigende kanalen toedrachtsonderzoek gedaan naar dit incident.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over psychedelische truffels (ingezonden 2 december 2011).

An MP asked the Health and Justice ministers why psychedelic truffles, which are not on the Opium Act lists, are replacing banned magic mushrooms, whether bans can be enforced, and why truffles are sold in souvenir shops. The minister said displacement was anticipated, the ban on mushrooms reduced incidents, education should accompany bans, and no regulated sales measures are planned.
Placing hallucinogenic substances on one of the Opium Act lists only makes sense if there is a certain degree of persistent use and demonstrable health and societal harm.

Het plaatsen van hallucinogene middelen op een van de lijsten van de Opiumwet heeft alleen zin als er sprake is van een zekere mate van bestendig gebruik en er sprake is van aantoonbare gezondheidsschade en schade voor de samenleving.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht van de IGZ dat eenzame opsluiting in een isoleercel wel mag als er een camera hangt (ingezonden 12 december 201

An MP asks the health minister about the IGZ's position that isolation with camera surveillance may still be allowed, questioning whether cameras can substitute for human contact and treatment. The minister responds that the IGZ's standard is separation-free care unless individually unavoidable, that a camera cannot replace personal contact and is only an aid, and that GGZ Nederland and the sector are to reduce separations.
A camera does not replace personal contact with the patient.
Een camera vervangt het persoonlijk contact met de patiënt niet.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over toenemend gebruik van de waterpijp met tabak (ingezonden 2 december 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about rising hookah smoking with tobacco among young people, the ease of underage access, the health risks and the lack of information. The minister answers that youth monitoring shows an increase only tentatively, that age checks online are being examined with the justice ministry, and that information and school programmes already address hookah use.
I will inform you shortly about the outcomes of this inventory.
Ik zal u binnenkort nader informeren over de uitkomsten van deze inventarisatie.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over intimidatie door de ex-directeur van PI te Tilburg (ingezonden 17 november 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that the former director of the Tilburg prison intimidated staff and secretly installed cameras, and whether the ministry buried complaints. The state secretary answered that an independent BI&V investigation found conflicting witness accounts, no sexual intimidation complaint was filed, and the director stopped camera monitoring after the works council refused consent.
No criminal complaint of sexual intimidation was filed.
Er is geen aangifte gedaan van seksuele intimidatie.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het vrijgeven van een medisch dossier in een strafrechtelijk onderzoek (ingezonden 25 novemb

An MP asks whether the Public Prosecution Service may obtain the medical file of a deceased psychiatric patient for a criminal investigation into his treaters, and how medical confidentiality applies after death. The ministers answer that a feitenonderzoek is underway, that medical confidentiality is not absolute and can be breached in exceptional circumstances under strict conditions, and that a study on medical confidentiality is planned for 2012.
Medical confidentiality is however not absolute. Very exceptional circumstances may arise in which the right of non-disclosure must yield to a higher interest, such as the discovery of truth.

Het medisch beroepsgeheim is echter niet absoluut. Er kunnen zich zeer uitzonderlijke omstandigheden voordoen waarbij het verschoningsrecht dient te wijken voor een hoger belang, zoals waarheidsvinding.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over stopzetten richtlijn drang en dwang Geestelijke Gezondheidszorg GGZ (ingezonden 29 november 2011).

An MP asks the health minister why the multidisciplinary guideline to reduce coercion and restraint in mental health care has stalled since 2008 despite commitments, and why the government leaves its development to the sector. The minister agrees coercion should be a last resort and that the guideline is important, says the sector bears responsibility since government funding ended in 2008, and promises to talk with parties at administrative level, while admitting she cannot yet enforce guideline development.
I cannot yet enforce the development of guidelines.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over alcoholmisbruik door jongeren (ingezonden 25 november 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about youth alcohol abuse, including the proposal to raise the drinking age to 18, cuts to prevention funding, and enforcement of alcohol sales rules now that municipalities say they lack funds. The minister answered that she sees youth drinking as a problem, will prioritise youth prevention within remaining funds, has stopped mass campaigns, and maintains that adequate structural funding was provided to municipalities for enforcement.
I also focus on legal measures: the Drink and Catering Act proposes several measures to curb alcohol use by young people.
Ik zet overigens ook in op wettelijke maatregelen: in de Drank- en Horecawet worden verschillende maatregelen voorgesteld om alcoholgebruik door jongeren tegen te gaan.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de gevolgen van de grote ontslaggolf in de Geestelijke gezondheidszorg GGZ (ingezonden 28 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about the consequences of mass layoffs in mental health care (GGZ), including effects on waiting lists, quality of care, regional supply and coercion. The minister says cuts need not reduce supply because insurers keep their duty of care and providers can become more efficient, while giving no data by region and committing to no concrete new action.
There is no breakdown of waiting list data by type of care or by region, only by type of client (elderly, youth and adults).
Er is geen uitsplitsing naar typen zorg of verschillende regio’s bij wachtlijstgegevens, wel naar type cliënten (ouderen, jeugd en volwassenen).

Vragen van de leden Arib en Bouwmeester (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat een veroordeelde pedofiel niet onder toezicht van de reclassering zou staan (ingezonden 2 september 20

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the probation service can no longer supervise a convicted paedophile, as reported in the press, and why this would be the case. The answers were given in a letter of 29 November 2011 to Parliament (Kamerstuk 29 270, nr. 62), which the item refers to without reproducing its content.
These questions have been answered in the letter of 29 November 2011 (Parliamentary paper 29 270, no. 62).
Deze vragen zijn beantwoord bij brief van 29 november 2011 (Kamerstuk 29 270, nr. 62 ).

Vragen van de leden Wolbert en Bouwmeester (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat er nauwelijks goede zorg is voor mensen met niet-aangeboren hersenletsel en prob

Two MPs asked the state secretary for health about reports that care for people with acquired brain injury and challenging behaviour is scarce, including claims of 150 people lacking housing and day care and questions about funding gaps. The secretary said the population cannot be counted from existing registrations, described the care landscape and the decentralisation to municipalities, and said the NZa is reviewing whether care-package classification needs changing.
It cannot be derived from existing registrations how many people exactly have NAH and how many of them lack a suitable residence or day care.
Het is niet uit bestaande registraties af te leiden hoeveel mensen er precies met NAH zijn en hoeveel daarvan geen passende verblijfplaats of dagbesteding hebben.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport, en de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de toezicht op het bestuur van Geestelijke Gezondheidszorg GG

An MP asks the government about alleged misconduct at GGZ WNB, including unjustified bonuses, a circus for the anniversary and bank loans, and the oversight role of the supervisory board, plus the appointment procedures for supervisory and management boards and whether this reflects quality-of-care differences. The state secretary answers that the supervisory board has taken action and the matter is its own responsibility, that the IGZ monitors quality, and that the institution itself bears financial consequences, declining to judge the board's diligence.
It is impossible for us to assess whether the former supervisory board of GGZ-WNB made the required utmost effort.
Het is voor ons onmogelijk te beoordelen of de toenmalige raad van toezicht van GGZ-WNB de gevraagde uiterste inspanning geleverd heeft.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de sluiting van logeerhuizen voor kinderen met psychische problemen (ingezonden 27 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary of Health, Welfare and Sport about the closure of respite homes for children with psychiatric problems, whether alternatives exist, the costs of day treatment versus respite stays, and differences in tariffs. The secretary says closures are decided by providers based on financial and capacity considerations, that alternatives exist, and that cost figures and tariff details are provided without any commitment to new action.
Decisions to close respite homes are decisions taken by care providers based on a complex set of considerations.
Beslissingen tot sluiten van logeerhuizen zijn beslissingen die genomen worden door zorgaanbieders op basis van een complex aan afwegingen
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het familiebeleid in de GGZ dat vaak niet op orde blijkt te zijn (ingezonden 27 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the health minister why family policy in mental health institutions is often inadequate, whether families can get effective responses when a patient deteriorates, and whether relatives should be able to view a deceased patient's file after suicide. The minister acknowledged the importance of family policy, pointed to existing channels and the IGZ complaints route, said 35 institutions (about 30 percent) have a family confidant, and announced a study of medical confidentiality with a planned legal regulation of relatives' file access.
I intend to explicitly regulate the latter in the Client Rights in Healthcare Act (article 23).
Ik ben voornemens dit laatste expliciet te regelen in de Wet cliëntenrechten zorg (artikel 23).

Vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over gevangene die in Breda wordt vergeten na een ziekenhuisbezoek (ingezonden 14 oktober 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary for Security and Justice why a prisoner was left behind at a hospital in Breda after an operation, whether the blame for escape was unjust, and how often escapes during hospital visits occur. The state secretary answered that the prisoner left the hospital on his own without waiting for escort, was placed in isolation for two weeks, that two escapes during hospital visits occurred in 2011 so far, and that such incidents are discussed nationally to learn lessons.
If incidents like this still occur, I consider it important that lessons are drawn across the sector.
Indien zich toch incidenten zoals deze voordoen vind ik het belangrijk dat hier sectorbreed lering uit wordt getrokken.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over levenslang entreeverbod Holland Casino (ingezonden 20 september 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about Holland Casino's refusal to impose a lifetime entry ban on a gambling-addicted visitor who requested one, and about the casino's lobbying versus prevention priorities. The state secretary replied that the casino must in principle admit visitors, that temporary bans of six months to one year are the rules, and that the current system needs no change, citing the Court of Audit's positive view of Holland Casino's prevention policy.
In my view, the current system of visitor restrictions and entry bans does not need to be amended.
Het huidige stelsel van bezoekbeperkingen en entreeverboden behoeft in mijn ogen geen aanpassing.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over eigen bijdrage e-mental health (ingezonden 10 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the health minister whether the 50 euro copayment for internet-based mental health treatment deters patients and slows e-mental health adoption, despite its promise for cost control. The minister defends the copayment as reasonable and as a useful threshold against dropout, promises to remove regulatory barriers and to inform parliament by letter on e-health.
On my plans to accelerate the implementation of e-health, I will separately inform the House of Representatives this year in a letter on e-health and ICT in care.
Over mijn voornemens om de implementatie van e-health te versnellen, zal ik de Tweede Kamer dit jaar nog apart informeren in een brief over e-health en ICT in de zorg.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over geweld binnen TBS-instellingen (ingezonden 30 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about violent incidents at TBS clinics (Vught and Rooyse Wissel), whether staff shortages are structural, recent violence statistics, and an Abvakabo survey on aggression against prison staff. The state secretary answers that internal research found no structural link or staff shortage, provides 2010 incident figures, states the Abvakabo survey has serious methodological flaws, and describes ongoing WODC research and DJI prevention measures.
Internal research has not shown that the incidents are connected to each other or stem from structural problems.
Uit intern onderzoek is niet gebleken dat de incidenten met elkaar in verband staan of voortkomen uit structurele problemen.

Vragen van de leden Dijksma en Bouwmeester (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het berekenen van buitensporig hoge annuleringskosten (ingezonden 10 oktober 2011).

MPs Dijksma and Bouwmeester asked the minister whether cancellation fees of €50 by Vliegwinkel.nl plus €50 by the airline on booked tickets are excessive, why they were not clearly disclosed, whether this is a misleading practice, and what remedies travellers have. The minister answered that the fees are permitted if disclosed, that the Consumentenautoriteit and courts decide on unfair practices, and that consumers can turn to the Geschillencommissie Reizen or the civil courts.

The Consumentenautoriteit does not comment on any ongoing investigations, and the judgment whether a specific case involves an unfair commercial practice is reserved for the Consumentenautoriteit and the courts.

De Consumentenautoriteit doet geen uitspraken over eventueel lopende onderzoeken en het oordeel of er in een specifiek geval sprake is van een oneerlijke handelspraktijk is voorbehouden aan de Consumentenautoriteit en de rechter.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over kinderen van ouders met psychische en verslavingsproblemen (ingezonden 1 september 2011).

An MP asks the minister whether preventive care for children of parents with mental health or addiction problems is available everywhere and whether it is being cut, and about support for children of detained parents. The minister answers that an inventory shows no structural change in reach, that funding uncertainty exists without known effect, that municipalities will be responsible after decentralisation, and that a child-check process via police and youth care bureaus operates in all municipalities.
Whether all children in every municipality receive KOPP/KVO help, I do not know.
Of alle kinderen in elke gemeente KOPP/KVO-hulp krijgen, weet ik niet.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het laten liggen van kostenbesparingen in de Geestelijke Gezondheidszorg (GGZ) door het kabinet (ingezonden 22 augustus 201

An MP asks the health minister whether she knows that 10-15% cost savings in mental health care are available but unused, and presses for a vision on mental health and savings based on quality, plus questions on co-payments, inefficiencies, protocols and consultations with sector bodies. The minister acknowledges the savings, defends the cuts as necessary and her co-payment policy, says she has asked the NZa for advice, and promises updates on agreements in early next year and inclusion of protocol questions in the agenda with the sector.
I will include this question in the policy agenda I am going to draw up with the field parties.
Ik zal deze vraag betrekken bij de bestuurlijke agenda die ik ga opstellen met de veldpartijen.

Vragen van de leden Eijsink en Bouwmeester (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Defensie en Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de gevolgen van de voorgenomen bezuinigingen in de GGZ in relatie tot veteranenzorg (ingezo

MPs Eijsink and Bouwmeester asked the ministers of Defence and Health whether planned mental health cuts would push veterans into avoiding care and whether veterans should be exempt from co-payments. The minister replied that there is no reason to expect veterans to fall through the cracks, that the LZV and Centraal aanmeldpunt ensure accessible care, and that no administrative distinction exists for co-payments, though military pension rules allow some compensation for service-related psychological injury.
There is no reason to assume that veterans with a service-related psychological condition will fall between the cracks or avoid care.
Er is geen aanleiding te veronderstellen dat veteranen met een dienstgerelateerde psychische aandoening tussen wal en schip zullen vallen of de zorg zullen mijden.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Bouwmeester (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het lage rendement van de opleiding tot profvoetballer (ingezonden 9 augustus 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the health and sport minister about the low success rate of youth football academies, the age at which children are recruited, effects on schooling, addiction among former players, and whether clubs and the KNVB bear responsibility for supporting dropouts. The minister answered that the KNVB's quality mark and protocols provide aftercare, that academies start at age 11, that no data exist on schooling or addiction outcomes, and that clubs and the KNVB already recognise their responsibility, so no specific agreements are needed.
Against this background I see no reason to make specific agreements with the KNVB in this area.
Ik zie tegen deze achtergrond dan ook geen aanleiding om op dit terrein specifieke afspraken te gaan maken met de KNVB.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Van Toorenburg (CDA) en Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het SBF-verlof voor gev

MPs Gesthuizen, Van Toorenburg and Bouwmeester asked why the SBF leave scheme for prison staff left DJI personnel inadequately and late informed about lower net income, why P-Direkt information was deficient, and whether the scheme should be changed or allow continued working. State Secretary Teeven answered that the lower net leave benefit was known from the start, that information was slow but not incorrect, that continued working is decided case by case on service interests, and that the scheme is a safety net not meant to encourage longer working.
Vragen van de leden Van Bommel (SP) en Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «Hoornaar vast in kliniek Israël» (ingezonden 5 augustus 2011).

MPs Van Bommel and Bouwmeester asked the foreign minister what the government had done for a Dutch national held in an Israeli psychiatric clinic, whether he could be repatriated, and how Dutch citizens abroad needing acute psychiatric care are handled. The minister answered that the embassy had visited, facilitated family contact and liaised with doctors, that the insurer's alarm centre had taken over the case, and that repatriation and aftercare decisions rest with the treating doctors and alarm centre.
However, it is for the treating doctors in the Netherlands and Israel, in consultation with the alarm centre, to assess whether and when the person can be repatriated.
Het is echter aan de behandelend artsen in Nederland en Israël, in overleg met de alarmcentrale, om te beoordelen of en wanneer betrokkene gerepatrieerd kan worden.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de uitspraak van de Raad van State over de Wietpas (ingezonden 30 juni 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice how a Council of State ruling on the residence criterion for coffeeshops affects the planned 'wietpas' (membership card), whether laws must change, and whether municipal drug policy and the Venlo model will be adopted. The minister answers that the ruling allows the residence criterion, that implementation will be phased with a transition period and agreements with coffeeshop municipalities, and that the Opiumwet need not be amended for the club card.
The ruling makes clear that European law and the Constitution leave room for introducing the residence criterion.
De uitspraak maakt duidelijk dat het Europese recht en de Grondwet ruimte laten voor invoering van het ingezetenencriterium.
Vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over opnameapparatuur in gespreksruimtes (ingezonden 24 juni 2011).

MPs Bouwmeester and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether microphones or cameras can be present in rooms where lawyers confidentially meet clients, in prisons and police stations, and whether clients and lawyers are told beforehand. The state secretary confirmed recording equipment can be present in prison consultation rooms for order and security reasons, said police-station consultations normally avoid recording rooms, and said the prison service will inform lawyers in advance and show that equipment is switched off, while the Dutch Bar pushed for rooms without recording.
It has therefore been proposed to the Bar that from now on it always be made clear to the lawyer whether recording equipment is present in a consultation room.
Daarom is aan de Orde voorgesteld om in het vervolg altijd duidelijk aan de advocaat te maken of er opnameapparatuur in een spreekkamer aanwezig is.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de sluiting van drie pokersites door de Amerikaanse justitie (ingezonden 20 april 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about the US closure of three online poker sites, whether Dutch online gambling will be legalised, the exposure of Dutch players, and how illegal operators will be tackled. The state secretary answers that a licensing regime for online gambling will be set up with transparent criteria, that Pokerstars was the largest illegal provider in NL, and that a new gambling authority and enforcement measures are planned.
That is why I intend to regulate online gambling through a licensing system.
Daarom ben ik voornemens de kansspelen via internet te reguleren door middel van een vergunningstelsel.
Vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Wolbert (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over zorg voor kinderen met een meervoudige zorgvraag (ingezonden 7 april 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary for Health about care for a child with autism and mild intellectual disability who can get a personal budget (PGB) for care and support but not for treatment, and whether a PGB for treatment or CCE mediation for PGB clients should be introduced. The state secretary reaffirmed client choice in principle but said a PGB may never be used for treatment, which should be judged by professionals, and rejected a CCE role for PGB care.
I do not consider it responsible from a quality standpoint that the PGB can be used for the treatment function.
Ik vind het uit kwalitatief oogpunt niet verantwoord dat het pgb kan worden ingezet voor de functie Behandeling.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de uitspraak van het EHRM over een paranoïde gedetineerde die geen behandeling kreeg (ingezonden 14 april 2011).

MP Bouwmeester asks the state secretary about an ECHR ruling finding a violation of article 5 due to a 13-month wait for psychiatric treatment (TBS) for a detainee with schizophrenia, and about whether rules must change and how long waits are. The state secretary acknowledges the violation, says the four-month transit limit is now generally respected with only incidental exceedances, and reports average waits of 135 days in 2010 with a longest wait of 26 months, without committing to new measures.
Yes, in this case the ECHR finds a violation of article 5(1) ECHR due to an overly long TBS transit period (in this case just over 13 months).
Ja, in de zaak constateert het EHRM een schending van artikel 5, eerste lid, EVRM als gevolg van een te lange TBS-passantentermijn (in casu ruim 13 maanden).
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de toename van gameverslaving onder jongeren (ingezonden mei 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about reports that 12,000 young people are addicted to online gaming and rising, and about prevention, treatment access and European experience. The minister answered that the figure does not show a rise, prevention is integrated and aimed at resilience, treatment methods appear effective, and little is known about European experience.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (van de PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over drugstoerisme in Breda (ingezonden 21 april 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about rising drug tourism to Breda after nearby coffee shops closed, whether this shifted sales, whether nuisance has increased, and whether the residency criterion ('wietpas') will help. The minister answers that visitors rose about 50% in Breda with local and foreign sources, that police data show no increase in incidents, that no complaints about petrol station drug sales were received, and that the residency criterion awaits a Council of State ruling.
In addition to an increase in drug tourists from Belgium, France and West-Brabant, there is also an increase from Breda itself.
Naast een toename van de «drugstoeristen» afkomstig uit België, Frankrijk en West-Brabant, is er ook een toename vanuit Breda zelf.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over tekortschietende hulp aan psychiatrische patiënten (ingezonden 21 april 2011).

An MP asked the minister about psychiatric patients not receiving help despite family requests, and about the role of police versus GGZ crisis services and a planned police-GGZ covenant. The minister answered that existing services (huisarts, FACT teams, bemoeizorg, crisis service) suffice, declined a single central reporting point, and promised a revised covenant by January 2012.
No figures are known to me on requests for help from family or close relations concerning psychiatric patients.
Er zijn mij geen cijfers bekend van hulpvragen van familie of naastbetrokkenen omtrent psychiatrische patiënten.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over topklinische geestelijke gezondheidszorg (ggz) die ggz hulp lokaal uitsluit (ingezonden 12 april 201

An MP asked the ministers of Health about a Brabant patient who receives outpatient top-clinical mental health care from a national institution but cannot get local ACT care, and whether the financing and coordination of such parallel care is secured. The minister answered that no formal barrier exists, that subcontracting and parallel DBCs are possible, that care coordination is the professionals' responsibility and a Trimbos study is pending.

To see whether there are problems in care coordination, I have asked the Trimbos Institute to research the financing and organisation of care coordination for people with multiple care needs in curative mental health care.

Om te zien of er geen problemen zijn in de zorgcoördinatie, heb ik het Trimbos Instituut gevraagd om onderzoek te doen naar de financiering en vormgeving van zorgcoördinatie voor mensen met een meervoudige zorgvraag in de curatieve ggz.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (van de PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het invoeren van de wietpas (ingezonden 8 april 2011).

MP Bouwmeester asks the minister about municipalities refusing to introduce the weed pass, citing fears of rising illegal sales, lack of enforcement capacity, and the residence criterion, and asks whether extra police capacity will be provided. The state secretary defers much to an upcoming drug policy letter and a pending Council of State ruling, says illegal sales will be tackled by local authorities, police and prosecutors, and says he will keep listening to municipalities.
For applying this, the outcome of the legal case before the Council of State between the municipality of Maastricht and a coffeeshop owner is important.
Voor het toepassen hiervan is de uitkomst van de rechtszaak bij de Raad van State tussen de gemeente Maastricht en een coffeeshophouder van belang.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over agressie bij weigering alcoholverkoop onder de 16 jaar (ingezonden 3 maart 2011).

An MP asks ministers how often cashiers face threats and aggression when refusing alcohol sales to minors under sixteen, how parents are informed, whether employers protect staff, and whether mandatory three-strikes rules for supermarkets would help. The ministers say supermarkets report threats to staff frequently, that police and employers handle such cases, and that a Drank- en Horecawet amendment with a three-strikes measure has been sent to parliament.
We recently sent a proposal to amend the Drank- en Horecawet to your House.
Wij hebben onlangs een voorstel tot wijziging van de Drank- en Horecawet naar uw Kamer gestuurd.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het vrijlaten van een niet uitbehandelde ter beschikking gestelde (ingezonden 23 februari 2011).

MP Bouwmeester asks the State Secretary about the release of an ex-tbs patient who reportedly needed treatment, the role of courts in contrary terminations of tbs, budget cuts and recidivism. The Minister answers that the tbs order ended by operation of law after the prosecutor withdrew its extension request, proposes a legislative change requiring a conditional phase before definitive termination, and states that court terminations contrary to advice are rare and that recidivism data for later cohorts cannot yet be confirmed.
I do not share this view. Recidivism figures from the WODC show that tbs treatment is generally very effective.
Ik deel deze mening niet. Uit recidivecijfers van het WODC blijkt dat de tbs-behandeling in het algemeen zeer effectief is.
Vragen van de leden Kooiman (SP) en Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het sluiten van de Doggershoek (ingezonden 3 maart 2011).

MPs Kooiman and Bouwmeester asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about closing the Doggershoek youth institution in Den Helder, alternatives, staff consultation, redeployment and remaining regional capacity. The State Secretary confirmed the closure as of 1 March 2011 for capacity reasons, said talks on reuse for LVB youths with Lijn 5 are ongoing with results promised by June 2011, and described staff mobility and redeployment measures.
As promised, I will inform you of the outcomes of that research in June 2011, or sooner if possible.
Zoals toegezegd zal ik u in juni 2011, of zoveel eerder als mogelijk, informeren over de uitkomsten van dat onderzoek.

Vragen van de leden Wolbert en Bouwmeester (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over vrijheidsbeperkende maatregelen in zorginstellingen (ingezonden 16 maart 2011).

MPs Wolbert and Bouwmeester asked the state secretary about restrictive measures in care institutions, including the late inspection attention after the Brandon case, the inspectorate's notification duties and frequency of contact, and the role of the CCE expertise centre. The state secretary said the inspectorate will focus on comparable cases, that notification is only mandatory for forced treatment, that a registration and reporting duty is foreseen under the Zorg en Dwang bill, and that data on institutions applying restraints more often is not available.
The Zorg en Dwang bill provides for a registration and reporting duty for all forms of restriction of liberty.
In het wetsvoorstel Zorg en Dwang is voorzien in een registratie en meldplicht van alle vormen van vrijheidsbeperking.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over levensgevaarlijke XTC (ingezonden 22 maart 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the government knew of dangerous XTC pills, whether a death linked to them could have been prevented by testing, and whether nationwide pill testing will be introduced. The minister answers that the DIMS monitoring system already warned the public, that testing is available on the user's initiative, and that nationwide testing is not planned.
No, as indicated in the answer to question 2, the DIMS already provides the possibility of having the composition and harmfulness of tablets and powders tested.
Nee, zoals in de beantwoording van vraag 2 is aangegeven voorziet het DIMS al in de mogelijkheid de samenstelling en schadelijkheid van tabletten en poeders te laten controleren.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het gebruik van drank, drugs en telefoons in Justitiële Jeugdinrichtingen (JJI’s) (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary how alcohol, drugs and phones can reach youths in juvenile detention centres (JJI's) despite announced tightening, and about drug-dog use, spot checks, education participation and staffing. The state secretary says full control cannot be guaranteed, points to drug dogs, a saliva/breath-test pilot, spot checks and inter-facility best-practice exchange, and reports a staff surplus rather than shortage.
Despite these efforts, I cannot guarantee that the institutions can be kept 100% free of these substances.
Ondanks deze inspanningen kan ik u niet garanderen dat de inrichtingen 100% vrij van deze middelen kunnen worden gehouden.

Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Bouwmeester (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Veiligheid en Justitie naar aanleiding van het lek van de website van de Postcodeloterij (inge

MPs Van Dam and Bouwmeester asked ministers about a leak on the Postcodeloterij website that exposed participants' personal data, and whether the organisation acted irresponsibly, breached the Wbp, could be sued, and whether the Wbp sanctions are adequate. Minister Opstelten answered that NPL did not wilfully expose data, has since fixed the leak, that liability and Wbp breach judgments belong to the Cbp and courts, and that the sanction regime is under review with a promised letter to parliament.
It is not for me to give a judgment on whether NPL violated the Personal Data Protection Act (Wbp) in this specific case.
Het ligt niet op mijn weg om een oordeel te geven over de vraag of NPL in dit concrete geval de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens (Wbp) heeft overtreden
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het sluiten van bestaande en het openen van nieuwe gevangenissen (ingezonden 3 maart 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether plans announced in Limburg for a new prison conflict with closures elsewhere, and questions the evidence for extra cell capacity from fast-track justice and other measures. The state secretary answers that capacity pressure is expected from other coalition measures, that a decision on a Limburg prison will come later in the year with a WODC study on private prisons, that the planned closures will be kept, and that Doggershoek will close with an alternative use under study.

I committed in the General Consultation of 9 December to inform you by June 2011 at the latest about the implementation of the Capacity Plan, including the possibilities for alternative use of JJI staff and locations.

Ik heb in het Algemeen Overleg van 9 december toegezegd u uiterlijk in juni 2011 te informeren over de uitvoering van het Capaciteitsplan, inclusief de mogelijkheden voor alternatieve inzet van JJI-personeel en -locaties.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over een reclamecampagne van de VriendenLoterij (ingezonden 23 februari 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether a VriendenLoterij SMS campaign telling recipients they had won a prize misled consumers, and whether this breached the gambling advertising code. The state secretary confirmed the SMS was sent, said the website has been adjusted, and said the Reclame Code Commissie is primarily responsible for judging the advertising, while declining to use his power to issue a directive for now.
It is therefore primarily up to the RCC to assess whether this campaign falls under article II.3 of the gambling advertising code.
Het is dan ook primair aan de RCC om te beoordelen of deze campagne onder artikel II.3 van de reclamecode kansspelen valt.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de mogelijkheid om de wietpas te weigeren (ingezonden 25 februari 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether municipalities can refuse the cannabis pass (wietpas), whether trade may go underground, and whether the economic stakes of the trade justify the policy. The minister answered that the measure will apply to all municipalities, that illegal sales will be tackled by local authorities, prosecutors and police, that drug policy does not aim to protect economic interests, and that the wietknip is contrary to policy.
Once the measures from the Coalition Agreement have been shaped, they will apply to all municipalities.
Zodra de maatregelen uit het Regeerakkoord zijn vormgegeven, zullen deze gaan gelden voor alle gemeenten.
Vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het schrappen van elektronisch huisarrest (ingezonden 21 februari 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary of Security and Justice whether he would scrap electronic house arrest (thuisdetentie) for convicted offenders, and about its preventive value, recidivism, costs and the cell shortage. The state secretary confirmed the plan, arguing that converting a prison sentence into home detention undermines the judicial sentence and retribution, that the government will instead pursue conditional sentences, and that the cell shortage no longer applies while electronic detention cost EUR 43 per day versus EUR 231 for a prison place.
This cabinet considers it fundamentally wrong that the administration decides that a prison sentence is carried out in a different way than in a prison.
Dit kabinet acht het principieel onjuist dat de administratie beslist dat een gevangenisstraf op andere wijze ten uitvoer wordt gelegd dan in een gevangenis.

Vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over problematiek van autistische kinderen en kinderen met een laag IQ (ingezon

MPs Bouwmeester and Kuiken asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Health about autistic youths and youths with low IQ in contact with police and detention, including whether better recognition, diagnosis and tailored police approaches are needed and how to prevent recidivism and fragmented care. The minister answered that recognition training helps but cannot be shown to prevent such incidents, that police do not develop policy for specific disorders, and that municipalities will be responsible for integrated, preventive care under decentralisation.
No policy is being made for specific disorders or limitations.
Er wordt geen beleid gemaakt voor specifieke stoornissen of beperkingen.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat de staatssecretaris kleinere cellen beter vindt (ingezonden 14 januari 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that he favours smaller cells and privatising prisons, questioning recidivism, cost savings, safety and staff pay. The State Secretary answers that a WODC study on privatisation will be commissioned, that cell sizes and staffing are described, and that reintegration support will be curtailed for unmotivated or repeat offenders.
The WODC will carry out a study into the advantages and disadvantages of privatisation.
Het WODC zal een onderzoek uitvoeren naar de voor- en nadelen van privatisering.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat geprivatiseerde gevangenissen niet goedkoper zijn (ingezonden 31 januari 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether privatised prisons are really cheaper, citing evidence that contract monitoring costs and wage pressures undermine savings, and asked about wages and capacity. The state secretary answered that the WODC will study the pros and cons of privatisation, including contract and monitoring issues and cost evidence abroad, while stating that current wages follow CAO-Rijk and no overcapacity exists.
The WODC has been asked to conduct a study into the pros and cons of privatising tasks relevant to the prison system.
Aan het WODC is gevraagd een onderzoek uit te voeren naar de voor- en nadelen van privatisering van voor het gevangeniswezen relevante taken.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over ADHD in Nederland (ingezonden 17 februari 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about rising ADHD diagnosis and medication use, criticism of DSM criteria, pharmaceutical industry ties to guideline-setters, drug safety monitoring, non-drug alternatives, and the NCRM report. The minister answers that prescribing is a matter for professional bodies, that existing pharmacovigilance and Inspectorate oversight are adequate, and that a prescribing-behaviour study and talks with specialists will follow.
In the meantime I have agreed with the Health Care Inspectorate to conduct further research into the prescribing behaviour for ADHD medication.
Inmiddels heb ik met de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg afgesproken nader onderzoek te doen naar het voorschrijfgedrag van ADHD medicatie.

Vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Wolbert (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat psychiatrische patiënten in Nederland veel vaker alleen gelaten worden (ingezonden 4 feb

MPs Bouwmeester and Wolbert asked the health minister about reports that Dutch psychiatric patients are left alone and separated more often than in other countries, and whether this reflects a policy preference for seclusion over coercive medication. The minister acknowledged high Dutch separation rates, described ongoing policies and projects to reduce coercion, and committed to developing a multidisciplinary guideline and monitoring progress.
Policy aims to limit separation and other coercive measures to a minimum and reduce them as much as possible.
Het beleid is erop gericht om separeren en andere dwangtoepassingen tot het minimum te beperken en zoveel mogelijk terug te dringen.

Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Bouwmeester (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het opstappen van een groot aantal brandweervrijwilligers in Almere (ingezonden 25 januari 2011).

MPs Marcouch and Bouwmeester asked the Minister of Security and Justice about volunteer firefighters leaving Almere over plans to sleep on the station and work with reduced crew levels, and whether staffing and safety are secured. The minister answered that about nine firefighters have left since 2009, that the variable crew experiment protects safety, that staffing is adequate now with about 25 more needed later, and that the sector bodies will be involved in a national project.
It is difficult to determine how many of those people left because of the changes within the corps.
Het is moeilijk na te gaan voor hoeveel van die mensen de veranderingen binnen het korps aanleiding zijn geweest om op te zeggen.
Vagen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het toegenomen gebruik van de populaire drug GHB (ingezonden 28 januari 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about rising GHB use, monitoring, prevention, treatment capacity, GBL access and drug-driving detection. The minister answered that monitoring and prevention are adequate, that GBL cannot be banned for industrial reasons, and that a treatment protocol project and a Wegenverkeerswet amendment on drug driving are being prepared.
No information is available on the number of traffic deaths and injuries directly resulting from GHB use.
Over het aantal verkeersdoden en -gewonden die het direct gevolg is van het gebruik van GHB, is geen informatie voorhanden.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over drugs, drank en telefoons in tbs-klinieken (ingezonden 9 februari 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about drugs, alcohol and phones in youth detention and TBS clinics after a PowNews item, and whether staff smuggled contraband in. The minister answers that the item concerns a youth institution (JJI), describes tightened controls, reports 13 incidents of contraband in 2010, and rejects the claim that youths lack treatment.
Within the institution concerned, it is currently being investigated how the prohibited items got in.
Binnen de bewuste inrichting wordt momenteel onderzocht hoe de verboden zaken zijn binnengekomen.
Vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Çelik (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over drugsbeleid in Rotterdam (ingezonden 16 december 2010).

MPs Bouwmeester and Çelik asked the Minister of Security and Justice about Rotterdam's drug policy, including school-based prevention at ROCs, closing coffeeshops, and drug runners. The minister answered that the Rotterdam approach is a good example but nationwide rollout is not appropriate, that closing coffeeshops near schools is effective in the longer term, and that drug runners are tackled jointly by the Public Prosecution Service, police and municipalities.

Nationwide introduction of the Rotterdam approach is not, however, an obvious choice, because I do not want to encroach on the scope of both municipalities and schools to tailor their drug and alcohol policy to local circumstances.

Landelijke invoering van de Rotterdamse aanpak ligt echter niet voor de hand, omdat ik niet wil treden in de ruimte van zowel gemeenten als scholen om hun drugs- en alcoholbeleid af te stemmen op de lokale situatie.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie, van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over verslavingsgevaar op scholen (ingezonden 10 december 2

The MP asks ministers whether their proposal to name drug-using pupils to parents, teachers and classmates amounts to naming-and-shaming, whether it was submitted to the privacy college, and about alcohol use, school dropout and parental support. The ministers say schools should decide themselves whether to name pupils, reject any formal duty to refer, decline to consult the privacy college, and point to existing prevention programmes and a forthcoming health policy note.
I see no reason to submit anything on this to the College bescherming persoonsgegevens for advice.
Ik zie geen reden om hierover iets ter advisering voor te leggen aan het College bescherming persoonsgegevens.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over een reclamecampagne van Holland Casino (ingezonden 24 december 2010).

An MP asks the state secretary whether Holland Casino's 'try out' advertising campaign shows it acting as a commercial entertainment provider rather than guardian of public interests such as preventing gambling addiction, and what oversight applies to balancing these goals. The state secretary answers that advertising to channel players away from illegal gambling is defensible, that licence holders must advertise carefully under a duty of care and a joint gambling code, that the Reclame Code Commissie and the gambling supervisory college oversee compliance, and that the March policy letter will address advertising.

In my view both aspects are appropriately reflected in the advertising, and Holland Casino remains with this campaign within the bounds of what can be considered a careful and balanced advertising offer.

Naar mijn mening komen beide aspecten op toelaatbare wijze tot uiting in de reclame-uitingen en blijft Holland Casino met deze reclameactie binnen de grenzen van wat als zorgvuldig en evenwichtig reclameaanbod kan worden beschouwd.
Vragen van de leden Van der Veen en Bouwmeester (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over 1 miljard kosten voor lobbyen in de zorg (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

MPs Van der Veen and Bouwmeester asked the health minister about a study claiming over one billion euros of public money is spent on lobbying in healthcare, and whether toezichthouders are outmatched in information by intermediary organisations. The minister replied that the study mapped information flows rather than lobbying spend, that about 60% of the money goes to supervisory and government agencies, and that she sees no reason to assume patient interests are harmed.
The study aimed to establish which information flows exist between the various organisations active in healthcare that do not themselves deliver direct patient care.
Het onderzoek had ten doel vast te stellen welke informatiestromen er bestaan tussen de diverse organisaties die wel in de zorg actief zijn, maar zich niet bezig houden met directe patiëntenzorg.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over ritalin als partydrug (ingezonden 7 december 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about reports that Ritalin is increasingly used as a party drug and obtained illegally online, citing an IVO study. The minister answers that the study sample was non-random and not representative, that prevalence is unclear, that the minister sees no reason for further research, and that Ritalin is mainly obtained through friends, so only monitoring and existing information instruments will be used.
Although it concerns me that Ritalin is used improperly, the outcomes of the above-mentioned studies are for me no reason for further research.
Hoewel het mij zorgen baart dat Ritalin oneigenlijk wordt gebruikt vormen de uitkomsten van bovenvermelde onderzoeken voor mij geen aanleiding tot nader onderzoek.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over dreigende sluiting van de kinderalcoholpoli in Eindhoven (ingezonden 16 december 2010).

MP Bouwmeester asks the health minister about the threatened closure of the Eindhoven child alcohol clinic, whether structural funding will be provided, and the government's youth alcohol policy. The minister says regional coverage is not set by the ministry, that short-term subsidy was granted with structural financing to be explored within premium-funded care, and that alcohol prevention will be addressed in forthcoming legislation and policy notes.
Structural financing from the VWS budget is not on the table, because budget money is never used to finance care costs.
Structurele financiering uit het VWS-budget is niet aan de orde, omdat uit begrotingsgeld nimmer zorgkosten worden gefinancierd.
Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Bouwmeester (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over geweld tegen winkelpersoneel (ingezonden 26 november 2010).

MPs Marcouch and Bouwmeester asked the Justice Minister about violence against shop staff, including the claim that a third of supermarket staff are threatened, police inaction, legal protection, employer reporting duties and security certification. The state secretary answered that the figures are unclear, that violence has complex causes, that police registration is comparatively good, that existing sentencing guidelines already cover shop staff, and that the government is preparing to simplify reporting and give feedback to complainants.
I am currently preparing, in line with the coalition agreement, measures to simplify and speed up the reporting process and to provide timely information on what has happened with the report.

Ik tref thans, conform het voornemen in het Regeerakkoord, voorbereidingen om het aangifteproces te vereenvoudigen en versnellen en daarbij ook tijdig informatie te doen verstrekken over wat er met de aangifte gebeurd is.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over Holland Casino als staatsdeelneming (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

Bouwmeester (PvdA) asked whether Holland Casino, as a state-owned monopolist, can be justified given public goals and EU competition rules, and whether the state can stress those goals when appointing supervisory board members. Teeven answered that the monopoly is legally justified, that Holland Casino faces only limited competition, and that appointment profiles require the company to operate within public gambling policy goals.
I will shortly send the House a letter on my policy intentions regarding gambling policy.
Ik zal de Kamer overigens binnenkort een brief sturen over mijn beleidsvoornemens met betrekking tot het kansspelbeleid.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een grote groep jongens die jarenlang niets doet, stopt met studeren, en de hele dag doorbrengt met drinken, blowen en game

An MP asks the health minister about a large group of young men who drop out of study and spend their days drinking, using cannabis and gaming, including questions on parental guidance and youth substance prevention. The minister says such behaviour is not acceptable, points to school dropout and student support measures and existing prevention programmes, and promises a national health policy note in 2011 without committing to new specific measures.
It is not normal for young people to stop studying or working and spend the whole day drinking, smoking weed and gaming.
Het is niet normaal als jongeren stoppen met studeren of werken en de hele dag doorbrengen met drinken, blowen en gamen.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de ministers voor Jeugd en Gezin en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport, mede namens de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

MP Bouwmeester asked the ministers about a US study suggesting up to one million children may be wrongly diagnosed with ADHD, whether Dutch diagnosis and medication are adequate, and whether the government should stimulate an ADHD knowledge centre and research. The state secretary answered that standardised protocols and guidelines exist, that the Landelijk Kenniscentrum Kinder- en Jeugdpsychiatrie covers ADHD, and that no new ADHD centre or practice research is warranted, though some protocol development and studies are underway.
In view of all these developments, I do not consider it opportune to further stimulate research into the practice of diagnosis and treatment.
Gelet op al deze ontwikkelingen vind ik het niet opportuun om onderzoek naar de praktijk van diagnostiek en behandeling verder te stimuleren.
Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over softdrugsbeleid (ingezonden 26 november 2010).

An MP from the PvdA asks the Justice and Health ministers about a proposed coffeeshop pass system, its effects on illegal sales and youth, and alternative drug policy approaches. The minister replies that a national pass system aims to reduce coffeeshop scale and prevent regional drug tourism, that illegal sales will be tackled by local authorities, police and prosecutors, and defers some questions to a forthcoming letter.
We will include this point in the letter we will shortly send to your House in preparation for the announced debate on drug policy.
Dit punt zullen wij meenemen in de brief die wij binnenkort aan uw Kamer zullen sturen, ter voorbereiding van het aangekondigde debat over het drugsbeleid.
Vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over geweldsincidenten in Eindhoven (ingezonden 2 december 2010).

Two Labour MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about drug-related violence in Eindhoven, whether it is a wider problem, whether police capacity and the new budget system will help, whether coffeeshops should grow their own cannabis, and whether fragmented governance caused the situation. The minister answered that he shares the concern, set up a multi-agency Taskforce, stressed an integrated approach with RIEC's, said the new budget allocation is not yet quantified, and rejected supply controls and coffeeshop home-growing as solutions.
Specifically for the Brabant situation, a Taskforce has been set up that will ensure the administrative and judicial approach to organised crime there is intensified immediately.
Specifiek voor de Brabantse situatie is een Taskforce ingesteld die ervoor zal zorgen dat de bestuurlijke en justitiële aanpak van de georganiseerde misdaad aldaar per direct wordt geïntensiveerd.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over alcoholreclame rondom jeugdsport (ingezonden 1 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the health minister whether alcohol advertising near youth sports fields, which the 25% minors criterion does not adequately prevent, is acceptable, and whether a ban should be added to the advertising code. The minister replied that the industry should follow its self-regulatory code, saw no evidence of violations, reported that the Reclame Code Commissie had recently ruled against billboards at one club and that they were removed, and rejected statutory measures.
My preference is for self-regulation. Statutory measures are not on the table.
Mijn voorkeur gaat uit naar zelfregulering. Wettelijke maatregelen zijn niet aan de orde.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Bouwmeester (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het stopzetten van een informatiseringproject van de Dienst Justitiële Inrichti

MPs Heijnen and Bouwmeester asked ministers about the halting of the DJI information system Cajis, its costs, project governance, and the information given to parliament. The government answered that the project was stopped after a June 2010 review found its design outdated and costs would exceed 20 million euro, that parliament was not informed because the project did not meet the large-ICT threshold, and that existing systems continue to be used.
The Tweede Kamer was not informed about the planning and progress of the Cajis project, because this is not usual for projects that do not meet the criterion for designation as a 'large ICT project'.

De Tweede Kamer is niet geïnformeerd over de planning en voortgang van de ontwikkeling van het Cajis-project, omdat dit niet gebruikelijk is voor projecten die niet voldoen aan het criterium voor aanwijzing tot «groot ICT project».
Vragen van de leden Recourt en Bouwmeester (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over handhaving van het casinobeleid op Curaçao (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

PvdA MPs asked the minister of Interior whether Curaçao's government may fail to enforce a recently amended casino ordinance, whether it may reverse it, and whether this breaches the financial supervision law. The minister answered that enforcement and budgeting are autonomous matters of Curaçao, that the Rijkswet Financieel Toezicht covers budgets rather than policy choices such as casino taxes, and that he lacks the requested information.
Yes, drawing up a budget and enforcing the Island Ordinance on Casinos are autonomous matters of the country of Curaçao.
Ja, het opstellen van een begroting en de handhaving van de Eilandsverordening Casinowezen zijn autonome aangelegenheden van het land Curaçao.

Vragen van de leden Recourt, Bouwmeester en Dijsselbloem (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over financiering terreurgroep met qatsmokkel (ingezonden 5 juli 2010).

MPs Recourt, Bouwmeester and Dijsselbloem asked the Justice and Health ministers about qat smuggling from the Netherlands possibly financing a Somali terrorist group, the scale and routes of qat trade, possible health risks and local nuisance in Tilburg. The minister answered that qat is legal in the Netherlands, data on trade and use are lacking, no formal Swedish-Dutch coordination exists, the CAM risk assessment found low risk, and Tilburg's municipal bylaw has reduced nuisance.
Qat is not prohibited in the Netherlands. The available information is therefore limited.
Qat is in Nederland niet verboden. De beschikbare informatie is daardoor beperkt.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het niet meer melden van suïcidepatiënten bij de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) (ingezonden 23 juni 2010).

An MP asked the health minister why GGZ mental health institutions would no longer have to report every suicide to the Inspectorate for Health Care, questioning the pilot's value, the lack of consultation with patient groups, and the quality of care. The minister answered that three institutions will pilot a revised procedure where all reports are evaluated with the Inspectorate, that the change follows a Huisman doctoral study, that patient groups were not consulted beforehand but later met, and that the Inspectorate will keep oversight through systemic supervision and annual aggregated review.
In the second half of this year a pilot with a revised suicide reporting procedure will take place in three GGZ institutions.
In de tweede helft van dit jaar vindt in drie GGZ instellingen een pilot plaats met een aangepaste meldprocedure bij suïcide.
Vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Leerdam (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de financiering van Jellinek Retreat op Curaçao (ingezonden 9 april 2010).

Two MPs from the Labour Party asked the health minister how the Jellinek Retreat clinic on Curaçao is financed, whether public funds or premium money are used, and whether local Antillean addicts can access it. The minister answered that the clinic is financed partly by a subsidy from the Programme for Cooperation with the Netherlands Antilles and partly by private investment, that it is a private foreign clinic open to all at the same rate, and that an evaluation of the programme is under way with a report expected in June 2010.
A subsidy provided from the Programme for Cooperation with the Netherlands Antilles
Een subsidie verstrekt vanuit het Programma Samenwerking Nederlandse Antillen

Minister Schippers answers that regional bodies (ROAZ) and insurers should address capacity, that no incidents are known to the inspectorate, and that the NZa will assess continuity of care without committing to a specific government intervention.
Without a thorough analysis of these figures, I cannot give a judgement on that.
Zonder een gedegen analyse van deze cijfers kan ik daar geen oordeel over geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Jan Vos en Wolbert over de bezinningsperiode in de Drentse Veenkoloniën

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether he would insert a reflection period in the Drenthe wind park decision, pending the Council of State appeal, and pause irreversible steps while exploring alternatives with local stakeholders. The minister refused to withdraw or suspend the permit, citing the provincial renewable energy target, but committed not to start placing turbines before the Council of State ruling and to explore solar alternatives with local authorities.
Pending the Council of State ruling, no start will be made on placing the wind turbines.
In afwachting van de uitspraak van de Raad van State zal geen begin met de plaatsing van de windmolens worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Wolbert over de Wet Normering topinkomens voor de zorgsector

MPs Kerstens and Wolbert asked whether the WNT pay cap applies to self-employed healthcare professionals such as GPs, dentists and pharmacists, and about the CIBG questionnaire. The minister answered that the WNT applies by law based on organisational form, that CIBG designates no institutions, that the questionnaire was halted to allow consultation, and that medical specialists will be excluded from the WNT via a bill in preparation.
The CIBG does not designate any institutions.
Het CIBG wijst geen instellingen aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht ‘Huidige donorsysteem werkt niet’
