An MP asked the Minister of Health about a report that organ donation procedures are delayed or abandoned because no independent retrieval team (ZUT) is available, keeping patients on life support longer. The minister answered that only one such case is known, that between 2014 and mid-2016 110 of 737 procedures did not proceed for medical or procedural reasons (not lack of ZUT), and described ZUT-sharing and a planned move to three regions with one ZUT each.
In this case, in consultation with the next of kin, the donor hospital and the ZUT, it is examined whether procedures can be scheduled one after another.
In dit geval wordt er in samenspraak met de nabestaanden, het donorziekenhuis en met het ZUT gekeken of procedures na elkaar gepland kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Wolbert over marketing rondom de nipt test

MPs Bouwmeester and Wolbert asked the Minister of Health about Gendia marketing screening tests alongside the NIPT test, including the consent wording and whether the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens should review it. The minister answered that privacy rules require specific informed consent, that Gendia is itself responsible for compliance, and that the supervisory authorities will act, while leaving the decision to end cooperation with hospitals to the hospitals themselves.
Companies and organisations are themselves responsible for complying with privacy legislation.
Bedrijven en organisaties zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de naleving van privacywetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Wolbert over het bericht “Patiënt de dupe van beperkende voorwaarden zorgverzekeraars”

MPs Bouwmeester and Wolbert asked the health minister about reports that restrictive contract conditions imposed by health insurers prevent providers, such as physiotherapists, from giving patients needed treatment, and about hidden restrictions and information for insured persons. The minister answered that patients should not be harmed by contract disputes, that the NZa oversees insurers' information duties and can enforce, that medical necessity should guide treatment, and that talks on the treatment index are ongoing.
The NZa supervises whether insurers comply with this obligation.
De NZa houdt toezicht of verzekeraars zich hieraan houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bevolkingsonderzoek baarmoederhalskanker voor vrouwen van boven de 60 jaar

An MP asked the Minister of Health why women over 60 no longer receive invitations for the cervical cancer screening programme, and about the evidence behind the age limit, international comparisons, mortality figures, and information given to women. The minister answered that the 30-60 age range rests on Health Council advice and RIVM assessment of risk versus screening harms, that women over 60 receive a final invitation and symptom information, and that the programme was not extended.
Women older than 60 face a relatively low risk of developing cervical cancer.
Vrouwen die ouder dan 60 jaar zijn lopen relatief weinig risico op het krijgen van baarmoederhalskanker.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Wolbert over het bericht dat de Poolse regering abortus wettelijk wil verbieden en strafbaar stellen

Two PvdA MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Poland would criminalise abortion, including for women and doctors, and about risks to women's health and rights under European law. The minister said the concerning bill, a citizens' initiative, was rejected by the Polish lower house, that Dutch policy promotes access to safe abortion as part of sexual and reproductive rights, and that it will keep raising these issues in the EU.
The cabinet finds this report worrying.
Het kabinet vindt dit bericht zorgelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Leenders over verwijsproblemen van Brabantse huisartsen

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister about reports that Brabant GPs struggle to refer MRSA patients, including hospitals refusing pig farmers and patients going to Belgium, and about isolation beds for stroke patients. The minister answered that the reports rest on suspicions without concrete cases, that one incident was resolved by referral to another hospital, that no formal reports were filed with the IGZ, and that no norms exist for isolation beds, which the IGZ oversees.
I have made inquiries in the region as to whether there is a question of major problems.
Ik heb in de regio navraag gedaan of er sprake is van grote problemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Wolbert over een gemeente die geen nieuwe zorginstelling binnen zijn grenzen wil

MPs Van Dijk and Wolbert asked whether the municipality of Aa en Hunze's refusal to host a 24-place assisted-living facility over budget concerns, and the risk of shifting clients between municipalities, is acceptable. The State Secretary says regional need is already met, explains that cost exposure depends on the care actually provided and contracts, and points to a regional plan and a 2020 objective funding model rather than new cross-municipal payment arrangements.
For the distribution of funds for sheltered housing there is currently a historical distribution.
Voor de verdeling van de middelen behorend bij beschermd wonen is momenteel sprake van een historische verdeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over de bezettingsnorm voor zorg aan ernstig zieke baby's op de afdeling neonatologie

MP Wolbert asked the Minister of Health about staffing norms for specialised nurses caring for critically ill babies in neonatology, including night-time ratios and whether tasks can be shifted to other staff. The Minister answered that the field norms come from a 2000 Health Council report, that the hospital and inspectorate are responsible for staffing, and that the inspectorate will intervene if quality falls short.
It is not for the Ministry of VWS but for the hospital or department itself, within the framework of applicable laws and regulations, to organise a care offer with sufficient qualified staff.

Het is niet aan het Ministerie van VWS maar aan het betreffende ziekenhuis of afdeling zelf om binnen het kader van geldende wet- en regelgeving een zorgaanbod te organiseren met voldoende gekwalificeerd personeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht  “Oudere met kanker loopt juiste zorg mis”

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a newspaper report that elderly cancer patients receive inconsistent treatment depending on hospital, and questioned causes, socio-economic effects, and insurer purchasing policy. The Minister acknowledged hospital variation, attributed it mainly to lack of evidence for older patients, and promised research agenda work and regional oncology networks but said she had no data on several points.
I agree with the doctors in the article that the patient's place of residence should not determine the treatment.
Ik ben het met de artsen uit het artikel eens dat de woonplaats van de patiënt niet bepalend mag zijn voor de behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over een doppler echo om vast te stellen of foetale bloedvaten voor de geboorte-uitgang liggen

An MP asked the health minister about a baby who died from undetected vasa praevia, and whether routine Doppler ultrasound at 20 weeks should be introduced to prevent such harm. The minister reported that vasa praevia is rare, that referral happens only for specific placenta findings per current guidelines, and that the guideline revision is for the professional bodies, so no change in practice is planned.
I therefore see no reason to ask them to change current practice.
Ik zie derhalve geen aanleiding hen te vragen de huidige praktijk aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Wolbert over het gebruik van hormoonverstorende stoffen in ziekenhuizen

MPs Çegerek and Wolbert asked the Minister of Health about specialists' warnings on endocrine-disrupting substances leaking from medical devices in hospitals, WHO and Gezondheidsraad signals, and whether hospitals should phase out plastics. The Minister says the government is acting on BPA and DEHP, convening hospital associations and professional groups on a stepwise plan, and pursuing EU criteria and new medical device rules, but does not commit to a specific ban.

In the short term I have therefore invited the hospital associations and the professional groups relevant to the most vulnerable patients to jointly consider how reducing exposure can best be done, for example through a targeted step-by-step plan.

Op korte termijn heb ik daarom de koepels van ziekenhuizen en de voor de meest kwetsbare patiënten relevante beroepsgroepen uitgenodigd om gezamenlijk na te denken over de manier waarop terugdringing van de blootstelling het beste gedaan kan worden, bijvoorbeeld via een gericht stappenplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over de mogelijke wijziging van het Planningsbesluit IVF (in vitrofertilisatie)

An MP asked the Minister of Health why she called refusal of an IVF licence application legally vulnerable under a planning decision updated in 2000, 2004 and 2014, and why the licence numbers were not expanded earlier. The minister replied that the 1998 needs estimate and quality guideline are outdated, so the Planningsbesluit must first be updated to let the IGZ assess the pending application, and she allowed only limited growth in clinics.
That is why it is necessary to first update the Planningsbesluit now.
Daarom is het nodig nu eerst het Planningsbesluit te actualiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het onderzoek dat er op wijst dat thuisbevallingen voor vrouwen met een lagere sociaal-economische status onveiliger zijn

MP Wolbert asks the minister about a study finding home births less safe for women of lower socio-economic status and whether the co-payment for hospital births without medical indication should be scrapped or widened to a social indication. Minister Schippers answers that the research is for professional groups to study, that ZonMw may fund follow-up research, that vulnerable pregnant women are a known concern, and that the co-payment question awaits the health insurance institute's advice expected by August 2016.
I have asked the Health Insurance Institute to advise me on this.
Ik heb het Zorginstituut gevraagd mij hierover te adviseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert, Fokke en Oosenbrug over de situatie dat niet elke gemeente een overlijdensakte van een doodgeboren baby aan de ouders verstrekt

MPs Wolbert, Fokke and Oosenbrug asked whether it is acceptable that some municipalities, unlike Amsterdam, do not issue a death certificate for stillborn babies, and how the law's wording (a stillborn child is deemed never to have existed) can be reconciled with parents' recognition needs. The minister said Amsterdam's practice fits existing rules and a 2006 official communication, promised to examine additional forms of registration and wording changes, and to inform parliament before summer.
The Minister of the Interior is willing to examine the possibilities of registration both within and outside the BRP.
De Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties is bereid de mogelijkheden te onderzoeken van registratie zowel binnen als buiten de BRP
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert, Albert de Vries en Vermeij over de overname van het Admiraal De Ruyter Ziekenhuis (ADRZ) door het Erasmus MC

Three PvdA MPs asked the health minister about Erasmus MC's planned takeover of ADRZ hospital in Zeeland, including effects on care access, cooperation with Zorgsaam, patient information and continuity in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen. The minister answered that the takeover is not yet decided, pointed to review by the NZa and ACM and to the joint Zeeland care vision, and said the outcome of the planned hospital cooperation would be clear before summer.
There is currently a planned takeover; the decision that ADRZ continues as an independent holding within Erasmus MC is not yet final.
Er is op dit moment sprake van een voornemen tot overname, de beslissing dat ADRZ als zelfstandige holding binnen het Erasmus MC door gaat is nog niet definitief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over mogelijke wijziging van het Planningsbesluit IVF.

An MP asks the Minister of Health whether she will amend the 1998 IVF planning decision to allow more clinics, and whether it will be finalised before parliament can respond. The Minister confirms she intends to update the decision, allowing controlled growth from 13 to 16 clinics, mainly for legal reasons, and declines to delay it.
I intend to update the Planning Decision on in vitro fertilisation (hereinafter: the planning decision).
Ik ben voornemens het Planningsbesluit in-vitrofertilisatie (verder: het planningsbesluit) te actualiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Wolbert over voeding in de zorg

MPs Dik-Faber and Wolbert asked the Minister of Health about nutrition in care: medical training, malnutrition screening, transmural guidelines, cancer screening advice, prevention funding and food concepts in hospitals. The Minister answered that professional bodies and guideline makers should lead on curriculum and guidelines, pointed to existing initiatives, and promised letters on prevention and a Kwaliteitsinstituut request.
I will ask the Kwaliteitsinstituut to promote attention to nutrition in the relevant guidelines.
Daarnaast zal ik het Kwaliteitsinstituut vragen om te bevorderen dat in de relevante richtlijnen aandacht is voor voeding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Wolbert over sluipsuikers in drinkpakjes voor kinderen

MPs Dik-Faber and Wolbert asked the Health Minister about sugar levels in children's drink cartons, the Akkoord Verbetering Productsamenstelling, daily sugar limits and EU action. The minister described existing prevention programmes, the staged sugar-reduction agreements (with results not yet available), and plans to raise product reformulation at the EU level during the Dutch presidency.
How much of these drinks from drink cartons is consumed is not known.
Hoeveel van deze dranken uit drinkpakjes worden genuttigd is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Wolbert inzake de gevolgen van de afschaffing van leerlinggebonden financiering en de positie van logopedisten in de eerste lijn

MPs Ypma and Wolbert asked whether speech therapy in primary care is only reimbursed for activities performed in the patient's presence, whether unpaid coordination work is a problem, and what insurers' role is. The Secretary of State answered that telespeech therapy can be billed under the NZa tariff, that contact with other professionals is covered by existing tariffs, that inequality cannot be concluded, and that insurers have a duty to purchase quality care without signals of non-compliance.
No, a care provider can also bill for a speech therapy treatment that takes place without the patient being directly present.
Nee, een zorgaanbieder kan een logopedische behandeling ook in rekening brengen wanneer deze plaatsvindt zonder directe aanwezigheid van de patiënt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Kuiken over een dreigend tekort van menskracht bij de GGD door de toestroom van vluchtelingen

MPs Wolbert and Kuiken asked whether the influx of refugees will cause a staff shortage at the GGD public health services and what the government will do to prevent it. The Secretary of State said the staffing impact is hard to predict, that municipalities are responsible for adequate GGD capacity, and that a working group with the VNG was set up to address the issues.
As a result, it cannot be stated in advance whether a staff shortage will arise at the GGDs.
Daardoor is het op voorhand niet aan te geven of er zich een tekort aan menskracht bij GGD'en gaat voordoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Bouwmeester over indicatieproblemen bij terminale thuiszorg

MPs Wolbert and Bouwmeester asked why terminally ill patients in care institutions sometimes cannot die at home because of indication problems with the Wlz and ZZP profiles, and who is responsible for timely solutions. The State Secretary called this undesirable, said the CIZ can now issue palliative terminal care indications for home deaths, and clarified that care offices and providers share responsibility for timely follow-up care.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over een stagetekort voor nieuwe verpleegkundigen

MP Wolbert asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Education whether a shortage of internship places is blocking growth in nursing training, and what hogescholen and the government will do about it. The government answered that internship places have grown faster than student numbers, that regional initiatives under the Zorgpact are underway, and that it will keep stimulating them without announcing a new concrete measure.
That is why it is good that initiatives are being developed at regional level.
Daarom is het goed dat op regionaal niveau initiatieven tot stand komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Wolbert over herindicatie van cliënten met een persoonsgebonden budget (pgb) voor wijkverpleging

MPs Van Dijk and Wolbert asked why insurers use differing forms when re-assessing personal-budget (pgb) clients receiving community nursing and what can reduce the administrative burden. The Secretary of State answered that insurers are adopting a uniform application form from 1 January 2016, developed with nursing bodies, and that ministry, insurers and providers will screen forms for necessity while monitoring progress.
I will keep a close eye on this.
Ik zal dit in de gaten blijven houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Wolbert over het bericht ‘NZa bemiddelt bij ruzies inkoop wijkverpleging’

MPs Bouwmeester and Wolbert asked whether the NZa was asked to mediate in disputes over home-care contracting and whether patients should be involved in the process. The State Secretary answered that he did not request mediation, that the NZa described the meeting as general rather than mediation with no patients present, and that he is preparing two bills to strengthen patient and client influence.
Although the involvement of insured persons and patients takes various forms in different places, we are still far from there.
Hoewel het betrekken van verzekerden en patiënten op verschillende plekken op diverse wijzen vorm krijgt, zijn we er nog lang niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Oosenbrug over de registratie van levenloos geboren kinderen

MPs Wolbert and Oosenbrug asked whether stillborn children, who by law are deemed never to have existed, could be entered in the Basisregistratie Personen, and how other EU countries register them. The minister answered that stillborn children are not entered in the BRP because it only holds data needed by government bodies, that a special civil-status deed is issued instead, and that practice differs across EU states.

Recording in the BRP of data on a stillborn child that is not necessary for the performance of government bodies' or designated third parties' tasks is not consistent with the purpose and principles of the basic personal records registration.

Opname in de BRP van gegevens over een levenloos geboren kind, die niet noodzakelijk zijn voor de vervulling van de taken van overheidsorganen of aangewezen derden, is niet in overeenstemming met het doel en de uitgangspunten van de basisregistratie personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over geweigerde terminale thuiszorg aan mensen die thuis wilden sterven

An MP asked the state secretary whether insurer CZ's refusal to timely buy terminal home care, forcing over 20 patients into hospital, is acceptable and what will be done to guarantee home care. The government says insurers have a duty of care, only one case is known to it, the hospital does not recognise the 23 figure, and it will emphasise regional agreements and a proactive attitude.
Health insurers have a duty of care and must ensure sufficient and timely available terminal home care.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben een zorgplicht en moeten voor voldoende en tijdig beschikbare terminale thuiszorg zorgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het intrekken van bestaande vergunningen voor apotheekhoudende huisartsen

MP Wolbert asked the minister whether pharmacy-dispensing GPs should keep their licences in ageing shrinking regions and why CIBG refused renewal for the Annen practice. The minister defended the distance-based licensing rules, said CIBG does not periodically revisit licences, and refused to scrap the main/associate licence distinction or to override the distance test for Annen.
At a distance between 3.5 and 4.5 kilometres I do not have full legal discretion.
Bij een afstand tussen de 3,5 en 4,5 kilometer beschik ik niet over alle wettelijke vrijheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Wolbert over de voorgenomen sluiting van de kraamafdeling van het Vlietland Ziekenhuis in Schiedam

MPs Bouwmeester and Wolbert asked the minister about concerns over the proposed closure of the Vlietland hospital maternity ward in Schiedam, including travel times, staffing, and whether local stakeholders were consulted. The minister answered that ambulance-model travel times remain within the norm, that a stakeholder steering group is in place, and that the decision lies with hospital and insurer rather than the ministry.
The process is still ongoing and no decision has yet been taken.
Het proces is nog gaande en er is nog geen besluit genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Wolbert over het monopolie van softwareleveranciers van gemeenten

MPs Oosenbrug and Wolbert asked the Minister of Interior about a near-duopoly in municipal central software, price increases, vendor lock-in and possible cheaper alternatives. The Minister acknowledged a dominant two-supplier market but said KING and VNG convenants address interoperability, declined to investigate prices, and will only assist if municipalities take the initiative.
It is in any case a task of the municipalities themselves, with the help of VNG/KING, to prevent through standardisation and good client management that suppliers are able to do so.
Het is overigens een taak van de gemeenten zelf om, met behulp van VNG/KING, door standaardisatie en goed opdrachtgeverschap te voorkomen dat leveranciers hiertoe in staat zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi, Cegerek en Wolbert over het gebruik van de kankerverwekkende stof perfluoroctaanzuur (ook wel PFOA of C8) bij DuPont in Dordrecht

MPs Jacobi, Cegerek and Wolbert asked the government about PFOA (C8) use at DuPont in Dordrecht, including health risks, the company's blood-monitoring data not being shared with the inspectorate, and whether specific environmental health research was ever done. The government answered that the inspectorate lacks the data, that the environmental permits followed national guidelines, and that it will ask RIVM to prepare a study on possible health effects.
The company concerned has not shared the research data with the Inspectorate SZW.
Het betreffende bedrijf heeft de onderzoeksgegevens niet met Inspectie SZW gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over nieuw rekenmodel om de verspreiding van Q-koorts te voorspellen

MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked whether a new weather-based model predicting Q-fever spread is ready for use in an outbreak, how much further development is needed, including for other zoonoses, and whether the government will support it. The minister replied that the model can map exposure but cannot yet compute infection risk without emission data, that it can be extended to other airborne pathogens over one to two years per pathogen, and that RIVM will continue the work.
The RIVM has in recent years built up expertise in modelling the spread of airborne pathogens.
Het RIVM heeft de afgelopen jaren expertise opgebouwd in het modelleren van de verspreiding van luchtoverdraagbare ziekteverwekkers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over frisdrankautomaten en frituurpannen op middelbare scholen

An MP asked the health minister whether he agrees with a municipal alderman that soft drinks and deep fryers do not belong in secondary schools, and whether the voluntary approach to healthy school canteens is sufficient given only 105 of 2000 targeted canteens qualify. The state secretary agrees the environment matters and that the goal is supported, but defers the detailed answers on timing and steps to a letter sent later than promised.
As stated in my letter responding to the Wolbert motion CZ-141843 dated 7 October 2015, I fully support the goal of making school canteens healthy.
Zoals aangegeven in mijn brief in reactie op de motie Wolbert CZ-141843 d.d. 7 oktober 2015, ondersteun ik het doel om schoolkantines gezond te krijgen volledig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het toenemend aantal patiëntenstops in de wijkverpleging

An MP asks the State Secretary about rising patient-intake stops in home nursing care, including Vierstroom's stop, whether insurer CZ meets its duty of care, and whether the budget suffices. The State Secretary says the Vierstroom stop has been lifted, insurers must ensure care under their duty of care, and the 2016 budget rises by 180 million euro, while declining to identify other providers at risk.
These signals do not go so far that I have insight into which providers these are.
Deze signalen gaan niet zover dat ik inzicht heb in welke aanbieders dit zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Wolbert over het sluiten van de rechtbank in Assen

MPs Recourt and Wolbert asked whether the Assen district court would be closed, citing a press report, and about job losses and conflict with a motion on local access to justice. The Minister replied that there is no plan to close the Assen location, that shifting some workplaces to Leeuwarden and Groningen would not cost jobs in the court district, and that the court board is responsible for any zoning decision under Council for the Judiciary oversight.
There is no intention to close the Assen location of the Noord-Nederland district court.
Er is geen sprake van een voornemen om de locatie Assen van de rechtbank Noord-Nederland te sluiten.

Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de Minister en Staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over oudere en hoogopgeleide vrouwen die behoorlijk meer zijn gaan drinken tijdens de zwangerschap (ingezonden 2

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that older and highly educated pregnant women are drinking more alcohol, and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary said the cited figures are outdated, awaits new TNO data, outlined existing advice and communication measures on alcohol in pregnancy, and noted progress on pregnancy logos on alcohol labels.
If the new figures give cause for more attention, I will adjust my policy accordingly and/or hold other parties to their responsibilities.
Indien de nieuwe cijfers aanleiding geven tot meer aandacht, zal ik mijn beleid daar op aanpassen en/of andere partijen aanspreken op hun verantwoordelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over de snelste Hiv-aanpak ooit

An MP asked the state secretary about a new rapid HIV-detection approach, its extension beyond Amsterdam, access for people outside Amsterdam, and costs. The secretary replied that it is a pilot (H-team in Amsterdam, possibly Rotterdam), that current guidelines remain in force, and that results must be awaited before any expansion or cost decisions.
For now, this is a pilot project.
Vooralsnog gaat het hier om een pilot project.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Wolbert over het project ‘Samen Oud’ in Groningen en Drenthe

MPs Van Dijk and Wolbert asked the State Secretary about the 'Samen Oud' project in Groningen and Drenthe, which faces discontinuation by insurer Achmea, and about whether insurers use the experiment article and Van Dijk's amendment to require municipal-insurer cooperation. The State Secretary said the project is not being stopped, that the communication problem with Achmea is resolved, and that insurers may take different approaches, with ongoing trajectories on innovation; the final question was not answered.
As stated in my answer to question 4, there is no question of stopping the 'Samen Oud' project.
Zoals gezegd in mijn antwoord op vraag 4, is er geen sprake van het stopzetten van het project «Samen Oud».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over volgens de WHO (Wereld gezondheidsorganisatie) teveel ingeleide bevallingen in Nederland

An MP asked the minister about a reported WHO concern over rising induced births in the Netherlands, and whether research and hospital-level figures would follow. The minister said the WHO report does not exist, no professional signals were received, no specific research is currently planned, and national figures show a stable rate around 24% since 2010 with anonymised hospital differences in the Zorgbalans.
I have national figures on the number of inductions, and these figures have been made public via the Zorgbalans 2014 of the RIVM.
Ik beschik over landelijke cijfers met betrekking tot het aantal inleidingen en die cijfers zijn via de Zorgbalans 2014 van het RIVM 3 bekend gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Wolbert over privacy regels die de veiligheid en de gezondheid belemmeren

MPs asked whether addresses of ambulance call-outs remain findable online, whether privacy rules block locating callers in emergencies, and why the address-anonymity issue has not been resolved after two years. The Minister says alternative alerting methods are being explored in half the regions, encryption is an option in the new C2000 tender, and precise location of 112 callers is limited only by technical factors, so no wise-persons commission is needed.
The possibility of a more precise location determination is limited only by technical factors and the time required, not by (privacy) legislation.
De mogelijkheid voor het doen van een meer nauwkeurige plaatsbepaling wordt alleen beperkt door technische factoren en de tijd die ervoor nodig is, niet door (privacy)wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over cupping-praktijken

MP Wolbert asked the Minister of Health about cupping practices, including health risks, untrained practitioners cutting skin, cancer claims, and whether cupping should be regulated under the Warenwet like tattooing. The minister replied that cupping is a reserved medical act under the Wet BIG, supervised by the IGZ with fines, disciplinary and criminal routes available, that no incidents have been reported, that the cancer claim is misleading, and that she rejects bringing cupping under the Warenwet.
Cupping, as a reserved surgical treatment, falls under the Individual Health Care Professions Act (Wet BIG).
Cupping valt, als voorbehouden heelkundige behandeling, onder de Wet op de beroepen in de individuele gezondheidszorg (Wet BIG).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over lange wachtlijsten voor hiv-test

An MP asked the state secretary about long waiting lists for HIV testing at GGD Amsterdam and whether the supplementary sexual health scheme is adequate and efficiently allocated. The secretary answered that high-risk clients still receive timely consultations, that GGDs are in transition to better triage, and that the scheme's evaluation is planned for 2018.
It is still too early to say whether the waiting times are temporary in nature or not.
Het is nog te vroeg om aan te geven of de wachttijden tijdelijk van aard zijn of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Wolbert over universele beschikbaarheid van breedbandinternet

MPs Oosenbrug and Wolbert asked whether broadband should be a universal service and how to reach the roughly 330,000 addresses in rural areas lacking 30 Mbps access. Minister Kamp answered that a universal service obligation adds little for the Netherlands, pointed to facilitating measures and regional tailoring, and saw no legal obstacles or need for uniform rules.
For the Netherlands, I consider the added value of a universal service obligation for broadband internet to be small.
Voor Nederland acht ik de toegevoegde waarde van een universele dienstverplichting voor breedbandinternet gering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Wolbert en Leenders over de gezondheidsrisico’s van de intensieve veehouderij

MPs asked the ministers why GPs in Reusel-De Mierden warn of rising resistant-bacteria infections in livestock farmers when RIVM data do not show it, whether data submission should be made mandatory, and whether the GGD study will be shared. The minister replied that RIVM data reflect local trends adequately, that laboratory participation is good and all relevant institutions will be connected by end 2015, that a letter on antibiotic resistance will follow before summer, and that the GGD will not publish a report.
The GGD Brabant-Zuidoost has indicated that it will not publish a report.
De GGD Brabant-Zuidoost heeft aangegeven dat zij geen rapport zullen uitbrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over de gezondheidsklachten bij mensen die in de buurt van stallen en boerderijen wonen

MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked whether the 2015 NIVEL/IRAS findings on health complaints near livestock farms, and the lack of firm conclusions in the 2012 Health Council report, meant the government would set distance criteria or other health norms. The state secretary answered that evidence is still insufficient, pointed to the ongoing RIVM VGO study due in 2016 and the Wgv odour framework, and said action would be considered after that study.
After this study is completed in 2016, it will be examined whether additional measures regarding public health aspects are needed.
Na afronding van dit onderzoek in 2016, zal worden bezien of aanvullende maatregelen in relatie tot volksgezondheidsaspecten aan de orde zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Wolbert en Leenders over het bericht dat de ingrijpende gevolgen van Q-koorts onderschat worden

Three PvdA MPs asked whether the health consequences of Q-fever, including chronic patients who may be overlooked, are being underestimated, and whether doctors' training, compensation and a general fund for future zoonosis outbreaks will be pursued. The Minister of Health answered that Q-fever remains serious, that Q-support and professional training will address recognition, rejected direct state compensation while promising to review arguments from patient groups, and saw no need for a general zoonosis fund.
I will of course carefully examine whether there are indeed more or different insights that could change the position.
Ik zal uiteraard zorgvuldig bezien of er inderdaad meer of andere inzichten zijn die het standpunt kunnen wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over niet-westerse vrouwen die zich te laat melden bij de verloskundige

An MP asks the health minister why non-Western pregnant women register late with midwives, what is being done to reverse this and whether best practices will be made the norm. The minister acknowledges the problem, points to existing programmes and says she has no plans for specific measures in big cities and that setting a field norm is up to the sector.
I currently have no plans to introduce specific measures in the big cities.
Ik heb op dit moment geen plannen om specifieke maatregelen in grote steden in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over de uitbraak van vogelgriep in Barneveld

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the government about a bird flu outbreak in Barneveld, including preventive culling, animal welfare in culling, the broeder transport ban, and the Wet dieraantallen en volksgezondheid and Brabantwet. The state secretary answered that no preventive culling occurred, that vaccination is not yet a feasible alternative, that the sector must prepare for transport bans, and that the outbreak does not warrant the Brabant law's use in Gelderland.
No animals have been preventively culled on farms surrounding the infected company.
Er zijn geen dieren preventief geruimd op bedrijven rondom het besmette bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Wolbert en Leenders over de gezondheidsrisico’s van de intensieve veehouderij

MPs from the PvdA asked the ministers whether they share concern from Reusel-De Mierden GPs about rising multiresistant infections and requested an overview of infection trends in Noord-Brabant. The minister replied that Brabant infection rates are not higher than elsewhere in the Netherlands, no regional data for Reusel-De Mierden is available, and an integrated antibiotic resistance approach letter will follow before summer.
Separate data for Reusel-De Mierden are currently not available to us.
Aparte gegevens voor Reusel-De Mierden zijn bij ons op dit moment niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht ‘Iedereen kiest opeens voor dure beugel; orthodontist krikt omzet op ondanks lagere tarieven’

An MP asked the Minister of Health why orthodontists' revenue rose despite two 16% tariff cuts, whether patients are choosing pricier braces, and whether the NZa and Consumentenbond complaint action will reveal practice variation and over-billing. The minister attributes the revenue rise to material cost growth, a 2.6% rise in patient numbers and more partial treatments, says the decoupling of material costs lets patients choose pricier braces, and notes the complaint portal closes in April with the NZa to assess whether further measures are needed.
This complaint action does not provide insight into practice variation.
Met deze meldactie wordt geen inzicht gegeven in de praktijkvariatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over de langetermijneffecten van Q-koorts

MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked about long-term effects of Q fever, including whether the government will settle claims with patients outside court and reach an amicable settlement. The minister acknowledged the health burden, pointed to support via Stichting Q-support and research funding, but stated the state accepts no liability and sees no reason for an amicable settlement.
According to the State, however, there is no question of unlawful conduct as a result of which Q-fever patients have suffered damage.
Volgens de Staat is evenwel geen sprake van onrechtmatig handelen als gevolg waarvan Q-koortspatiënten schade hebben geleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over snoepautomaten in ziekenhuizen

MP Wolbert asked the Minister of Health about a survey showing most hospitals offer candy and snack vending machines, with few healthy options, and whether hospitals should adopt specific healthy-food policies and broad agreements. The Minister acknowledged the survey, said healthy choice is a goal but hospital management is responsible for its own layout, and pointed to existing guidelines and the Alles is Gezondheid programme without committing to new binding action.
Responsibility for the layout of a hospital lies with the relevant hospital board.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de inrichting van een ziekenhuis ligt bij het betreffende bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Wolbert over de Stichting Maatschappij der Weldadigheid te Frederiksoord

MPs Monasch and Wolbert asked the minister about the Stichting Maatschappij der Weldadigheid in Frederiksoord, whose high WOZ-based landlord levy and monumental housing may hinder renovation and preservation. The minister answered that the levy burden follows from low rents relative to property values, that monumental homes do not face special obstacles, and that the position of such landlords will be reviewed in the 2016 evaluation of the levy.
However, the evaluation of the landlord levy, which I will send to your House in 2016, will also pay attention to the position of this type of landlord.
Wel zal in de evaluatie van de verhuurderheffing, die ik in 2016 aan uw Kamer zal doen toekomen, ook aandacht geschonken worden aan de positie van dit type verhuurders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over de inkoop van wijkverpleegkundigen voor het sociale wijkteam

MP Wolbert asked whether CZ's refusal to fund a community nurse for social neighbourhood teams in six Parkstad municipalities endangers care access, and about adequacy of the 40 million euro budget and future funding to 200 million. The State Secretary answered that individual community nursing care is contracted in those municipalities, that not every social team needs a nurse, and that the government will talk with stakeholders to ensure integrated care is delivered.
In the coming period I will again talk with the parties involved to ensure that the intended integrated care continues to be delivered.
De komende tijd ga ik wederom met betrokken partijen in gesprek om er voor te zorgen dat er de beoogde integrale zorg geleverd blijft worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over de hulpverlening aan Q-koortspatiënten

MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked the minister about support for Q-fever patients, including Q-support's reach, overheads, consultation with patient organisation Q-uestion, future outbreak support, and goat vaccination across the Belgian and German borders. The minister answered that Q-support is reaching more patients, overheads were about 11% in its start-up year, Q-uestion is consulted through structural channels, and that member states set their own Q-fever policy with no EU-wide rules, while the ministry lacks data on foreign farms.
My colleague at Economic Affairs does not have data on companies in Belgium or Germany, only on goat farms in the Netherlands.
Mijn collega van Economische Zaken beschikt niet over gegevens van bedrijven in België of Duitsland, uitsluitend over gegevens van geitenbedrijven in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Kerstens over het ontslag van bijna 2000 medewerkers van Thebe

MPs Wolbert and Kerstens asked about the bankruptcy of home-care provider Thebe, which left nearly 2,000 workers jobless, and what municipalities and the Wmo framework do to keep clients and workers in place. The state secretary answered that the curator, municipalities and other providers (TSN, Tzorg) are securing continuity for most clients and offering jobs, that some municipalities have revised their policies, and that the government is following developments closely without committing to new measures.
We closely follow the efforts and progress of the municipalities concerned.
Wij volgen de inspanningen en vorderingen van de betrokken gemeenten nauwgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Kerstens over het sluiten van de Philipsvestiging te Emmen

Two MPs asked the ministers about Philips' decision to close its Emmen site and move work to Poland and Spain, including tax benefits, regional jobs support, and reshoring. The government regrets the closure but says companies must decide location on business grounds, cannot comment on individual tax matters, and will work through employer federations and reshoring initiatives.
Because of the tax confidentiality obligation, the cabinet cannot make statements about the tax affairs of individual taxpayers such as Philips.
Op grond van de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht kan het kabinet echter geen uitspraken doen over belastingaangelegenheden van individuele belastingplichtigen zoals Philips.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over de uitbraak van de hoog pathogene variant van vogelgriep in Hekendorp

Two PvdA MPs asked about measures to prevent human infection and spread of highly pathogenic bird flu from the Hekendorp outbreak, signs of human infection, causes, a possible link to Germany, and measures against future zoonotic outbreaks. The government answered by referring to earlier letters on measures and the investigation, stating there are no signs of human infection, and referring to earlier answers on pandemic risk.
For the answer to this question I refer to the answers to questions about the report 'Pandemic from Brabant is possible'.
Voor het antwoord op deze vraag verwijs ik naar de antwoorden op vragen over het bericht «Pandemie uit Brabant is mogelijk».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over communicatie aan burgers bij een mogelijke ebola-uitbraak

An MP asked the Health Minister how citizens are informed about a possible Ebola outbreak, including which bodies communicate, whether there are agreements, and who decides the message. The Minister answered that RIVM provides factual information, a helpline was opened, no outbreak is occurring, and communication roles and agreements are set out in the Public Health Act framework.
RIVM communicates on behalf of the government about developments, precautionary measures and courses of action.
Het RIVM communiceert namens de overheid over de ontwikkelingen, voorzorgsmaatregelen en handelingsperspectieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Wolbert over de uitspraak van het gerechtshof Arnhem-Leeuwarden over een in de thuiszorg werkzame verpleegkundige

MPs Mei Li Vos and Wolbert asked the State Secretary of Finance about a court ruling treating a home-care nurse as a self-employed entrepreneur for income tax, asking about enforcement consequences for VAR-wuo declarations in care, the impact on about 1,200 freelancers who received a VAR-loon, and the relation to the eight criteria for entrepreneurship. The State Secretary answered that the ruling is not a generic rule for care in kind, that VAR declarations depend on the facts presented, that the affected group was offered a pilot-based new VAR-wuo, and that the Tax Administration applies the same criteria set out in case law.
The Tax Administration does not give such a generic interpretation to this court ruling.
Een dergelijke generieke uitleg geeft de Belastingdienst niet aan deze uitspraak van het hof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert het bericht dat ActiZ en V&VN opnieuw de noodklok luiden over de knip in wijkverpleging

An MP asked the state secretary for Health whether the warnings by ActiZ and V&VN about a cut in district nursing (wijkverpleging) are justified, and how integrated procurement, the link between indication and care, and nurses' referral practices will work. The state secretary denies any cut at provider or individual level, says the rules allow contracting only where providers also deliver individual care, and promises to monitor the procurement talks, though he gives no concrete new step beyond passing the concerns on.
I therefore interpret the letter from Actiz and V&VN as a call from both parties to keep closely monitoring whether parties adhere to what we agreed on in substance.
Ik duid de brief van Actiz en V&VN dan ook als een oproep van beide partijen om scherp te blijven monitoren of partijen zich houden aan hetgeen we in de inhoudelijke lijn zijn overeen gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over terminale patiënten die onnodig in het ziekenhuis liggen

An MP from the PvdA asks the Minister of Health whether she is aware of a report that terminal patients are often unnecessarily kept in hospital, and what would help GPs refer fewer such patients and discuss dying with them. The Minister agrees home care is preferable, points to existing initiatives, the 2015 home-care entitlement and the National Palliative Care Programme, and names coordination between GPs and hospitals as a theme to improve, without committing to a new concrete step.
I find it very desirable, especially if this matches the wishes of the patient and their environment.
Ik vind het zeer wenselijk, zeker als dit aansluit bij de wens van de patiënt en zijn omgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Wolbert over het bericht dat zeker 10% van de grotere zwangerschapscomplicaties kan worden voorkomen als zwangere vrouwen niet meer roken

MPs Rebel and Wolbert asked the minister whether smoking during pregnancy could be cut to prevent complications, and about costs, measures, lifestyle warnings and the role of midwives. The minister agreed that smoking reduction matters, pointed to existing programmes and inspectorate action, and declined to add warnings to medicine leaflets citing EU rules and industry views.
The instrument also takes lifestyle aspects into account.
Het instrument houdt ook rekening met leefstijlaspecten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en de Albert de Vries over berichten met betrekking tot  de kerncentrale in Doel

MPs Wolbert and Albert de Vries asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports on incidents at the Doel nuclear plant in Belgium and their implications for Dutch safety, cross-border cooperation, and information for border residents. The minister answered that the plant is safely shut down, Dutch and Belgian authorities cooperate and exchange information, and no additional measures or resident information beyond the FANC website are currently considered necessary.
Further information beyond what is available on the FANC website is therefore currently not necessary.
Nadere informatieverstrekking dan die te verkrijgen is op de website van het FANC is op dit moment dan ook niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over het bericht dat minimaal 33% en mogelijk zelfs 60% van de inwoners van Herpen besmet is met Q-koorts

MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked whether the Q-fever investigation in Herpen is too slow, whether screening should be expanded, and about a dissertation on antibody testing. The Minister replies that the research runs within subsidy deadlines, first results show no large group of missed patients, and a single antibody check one year after acute infection is recommended for patients without risk factors.
At the next revision of the LCI Q-fever guideline, this recommendation will be included.
Bij de volgende revisie van de LCI-richtlijn Q-koorts zal deze aanbeveling opgenomen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Wolbert over schendingen van de privacy bij het bellen van het alarmnummer

MPs Bouwmeester and Wolbert asked whether the privacy of people is breached when online pages show that ambulance, police or fire services were at a given address, why the issue has not yet been resolved nationally, why some regions shield addresses and others do not, and when it will be fixed. The minister agrees it is undesirable, says a Northern Netherlands approach withholding location in most calls is being evaluated for national use, that encryption of paging messages is being examined, and that the Kamer will be informed later this year.
I find it undesirable from a privacy standpoint that information from paging messages of the emergency services remains visible on internet sites for a long time.
Ik vind het vanuit privacy-oogpunt onwenselijk dat informatie uit pagingberichten van de hulpdiensten langdurig zichtbaar is op internetsites.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Agnes Mulder en Wolbert over de dreigende sluiting van attractiepark De Sprookjeshof in Zuidlaren

MPs Ziengs, Agnes Mulder and Wolbert asked about the threatened closure of the De Sprookjeshof amusement park, the inconsistent certification of identical attractions by inspection bodies, and whether the government is responsible for consistent rules. The minister answered that certification rules were applied correctly, that individual inspection was required for unique slides, that operators bear primary responsibility for compliance, and that the answers could not be sent by the requested date.
On 12 September the NVWA held consultations with the CdK Drenthe, where it was agreed that the inspection body and the owner of De Sprookjeshof will again consult on measures that ensure safety.

Op 12 september heeft de NVWA met de CdK Drenthe overleg gevoerd waarbij is afgesproken dat de keuringsinstelling en de eigenaar van De Sprookjeshof opnieuw in overleg gaan over de maatregelen die de veiligheid waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Wolbert over verrassingsrekeningen na bezoek aan spoedeisende hulp in het ziekenhuis

MPs Bouwmeester and Wolbert asked the minister how patients can be better informed about where to go for urgent care and its costs, to avoid surprise bills after emergency department visits. The minister acknowledged the need for better cost information, pointed to ongoing initiatives with insurers and providers, and gave partial answers on which hospitals lack GP cooperation and on monitoring ED use.
The information on which hospitals have not made agreements with GPs on reducing unnecessary use of the emergency department is not known to me.
De informatie in welke ziekenhuizen geen afspraken zijn gemaakt met huisartsen over het terugdringen van het onnodig gebruik van de SEH is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht dat patiënten niet kunnen wisselen van huisarts

An MP asked the minister about a NPCF study finding that a third of patients wanting to switch GP cannot do so, and whether GP market-sharing arrangements exist. The minister acknowledged the problem, committed to talks with the LHV and NPCF, said no own research data exist, and noted that market-sharing agreements are generally prohibited and enforced by the ACM.
I have committed to your House to enter into talks with the Landelijke Huisartsen Vereniging and the NPCF to jointly find a solution to this problem.
Ik heb uw Kamer toegezegd om in gesprek te gaan met de Landelijke Huisartsen Vereniging en de NPCF om gezamenlijk tot een oplossing voor dit probleem te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Wolbert over stagetekort voor studenten Medische hulpverlening

MPs Mohandis and Wolbert asked about a shortage of internship places for Medical Assistance (Medisch hulpverlener) students and whether the profession would be BIG-registered. The minister acknowledged the shortage, said it is primarily the responsibility of hospitals, and said registration decision is being prepared with an expected answer after the summer.
The civil-servant preparation for the decision-making by the Minister of VWS has meanwhile been set in motion.
De ambtelijke voorbereiding voor de besluitvorming door de Minister van VWS is inmiddels in gang gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Wolbert over de ontruiming van een gedeelte van het centrum van Amsterdam naar aanleiding van de bommelding op 25 juni 2014

MPs Van Dijk and Wolbert asked about the evacuation of central Amsterdam after a bomb threat, including whether Hotel Krasnapolsky should have been evacuated and whether disabled people face delays in evacuations. The minister said the hotel was not ordered evacuated, that police only advised, and that no evidence shows disabled evacuations are delayed, while declining to collect data on building accessibility and pointing to planned rule changes.
I do not have that data and I do not consider it necessary to collect that data after all.
Ik beschik niet over die gegevens en vind het ook niet nodig om die gegevens alsnog te verzamelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert De Vries en Wolbert over het bericht dat het RIVM heeft geconcludeerd dat bewoners van Krimpregio’s zich gemiddeld minder gezond voelen

MPs Albert de Vries and Wolbert asked about the RIVM finding that residents of shrinking regions feel less healthy on average, and whether equal health rights, care provision and local action are being ensured. The minister acknowledges the socioeconomic link, points to primary responsibility at local level and existing programmes, and promises follow-up letters on curative care and the RIVM study after the summer.
Proximity of care, also for the patient/citizen in the shrinking regions, is one of the policy priorities.
Nabijheid van zorg, ook voor de patiënt/burger in de krimpregio’s, is één van de speerpunten van het beleid.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het onderzoek van de huisartsen waaruit blijkt dat bijna alle huisartsen meemaken dat patiënten vanwege financiële redenen zich niet laten doorsturen naar het ziekenhuis of naa

An MP asks the health minister about an LHV survey in which nearly all GPs report patients skipping referrals, lab tests or medication for financial reasons, and how this fits government efforts to reduce socioeconomic health gaps. The minister says the survey is hard to interpret and not conclusive, points to four earlier studies finding no clear rise in care avoidance, and promises a further Vektis study on second-line care use before summer 2015.
I think it is good that the LHV conducted such a survey among its members.
Ik vind het goed dat de LHV een dergelijk onderzoek onder haar leden heeft gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Bouwmeester over het bericht “Patiënt te snel naar ziekenhuis”

MPs Bouwmeester and Wolbert asked the Minister of Health about a report that patients are sent to hospital too quickly, including the lack of understandable cost and quality information, potential premium savings, incentives for GP care, and the transparency of hospital bills and prices. The Minister replied that a cost-awareness trajectory with stakeholders is underway, that exact savings cannot be given, that GP substitution is being promoted through hoofdlijnenakkoorden, and that new price and billing information is being published, but gave no figures or binding commitments on quality transparency.
Exact amounts cannot be given for this.
Exacte bedragen zijn hiervoor niet te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Recourt over lijkschouwers die nog steeds misdrijven missen door gebrekkige opleiding

MPs Wolbert and Recourt asked whether forensic doctors with a short 30-day course get the same powers as those with a four-year profile training, and whether national figures on missed unnatural deaths exist. The minister answered that no such figures are kept, that the professional body's register is considered sufficient guarantee of quality, and that the supply of forensic doctors is not seen as requiring short-term measures.
I do not have figures on the number of times it later became apparent that a natural cause of death had been wrongly assumed.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers van het aantal keren dat in een later stadium is gebleken dat aanvankelijk onterecht is uitgegaan van een natuurlijke doodsoorzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Bouwmeester over ziekenhuizen die doorverwijzingen van het bevolkingsonderzoek darmkanker niet aan kunnen

Two PvdA MPs asked why referrals from the colorectal cancer screening programme were nearly triple expectations, whether hospitals could cope, and what would be done about waiting times. Minister Schippers attributed the surplus to higher uptake, starting with older cohorts and a more sensitive test, said waiting times had been cut by inviting fewer people, and announced a higher cut-off value to reduce referrals and an effectiveness evaluation.
As soon as the national appointments point signalled that waiting times were rising, the number of invitations was reduced.
Zodra in het landelijke afsprakenpunt werd gesignaleerd dat de wachttijden opliepen, is het aantal uitnodigingen teruggebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over extramurale zorginstellingen die buiten het stagefonds van VWS vallen

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the internship fund, which covers only intramural care, should also cover extramural care providers that offer internship supervision without a funding basis under the Zvw, AWBZ, Wmo or Youth Act. The State Secretary replied that extramural providers are already eligible on equal terms, that the case in the blog concerns an institution outside these regimes, and that the scope will be reconsidered from subsidy year 2015–2016.
For the period after that (from subsidy year 2015–2016) a new assessment will be made.
Voor de periode daarna (vanaf subsidiejaar 2015–2016) wordt een nieuwe afweging gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over het bericht dat minimaal 33% en mogelijk zelfs 60% van de inwoners van Herpen besmet is met Q-koorts

MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked the ministers about reports that 33% to 60% of Herpen residents had Q-fever, the validity of a new test, chronic Q-fever diagnoses, expanding screening, underreporting and livestock farming limits. The minister answered that the GGD study results are due spring 2015 and that screening expansion will await them, while Q-support has started and an evaluation is planned for around September 2014.
I am awaiting the final result of this study and the related conclusions and recommendations before I seek advice on the necessity and usefulness of a more extensive study.
Ik wacht het uiteindelijke resultaat van dit onderzoek en de daarbij behorende conclusies en aanbevelingen af, voordat ik mij laat adviseren over nut en noodzaak van een uitgebreider onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht dat Alzheimer met preventieve maatregelen terug te dringen is

An MP asked the minister whether Alzheimer's can be delayed or prevented through preventive measures, whether the public is aware of this, whether prevention organisations cooperate on it, what obstacles exist, and when research results are expected. The minister answered that research on prevention is ongoing under the Deltaplan Dementie, promoted healthy lifestyles via the Nationaal Preventie Programma, and expects first research results in 2016.
The first results are expected in 2016.
De eerste resultaten worden in 2016 verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht ‘Hoge bloeddruk? Eet minder zout’ en Wereld Hypertensie Dag

An MP asked the minister about a Voedingscentrum message on salt and blood pressure, the progress on salt maximums in foods, and the role and binding force of the scientific advisory committee and steering group under the food industry agreement. The minister said the committee reviews industry proposals at the front end, advises a steering group chaired by VWS, the committee's advice weighs heavily, and the initiative stays with industry, with progress reviewed yearly and a report promised by end 2014.
The advice of the scientific advisory committee carries significant weight in this.
Het advies van de wetenschappelijke adviescommissie weegt hierbij zwaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Oosenbrug over de mobiele bereikbaarheid van 112 in het grensgebied

Two PvdA MPs asked whether mobile 112 emergency calls work reliably in border regions and whether full mobile coverage is required. The Minister acknowledges coverage complaints, says the extent is unknown and under study, explains that 112 calls are routed across networks, and rejects coverage requirements in licences while advising residents to use landlines and promising ongoing communication.
The Ministry of Economic Affairs is researching the scope of mobile coverage.
Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken doet onderzoek naar de reikwijdte van de mobiele dekking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Wolbert over HIV zelftests

MPs Bouwmeester and Wolbert asked the minister about the growing availability of HIV and STI self-tests, their reliability, and whether quality standards and oversight should be tightened. The minister answered that online self-tests often lack CE marking and may give false results, pointed to EU regulatory negotiations and the inspectorate's enforcement limits, and said a separate quality mark is not useful while tests fail existing rules.
In these negotiations and more broadly in European Commission working groups, I will specifically raise the issue of (online) self-tests.
Ik zal in deze onderhandelingen en breder in werkgroepen van de Europese Commissie specifiek aandacht vragen voor de problematiek rond de (online) zelftests.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over kinderen van allochtone afkomst die nog steeds evenveel overgewicht hebben

An MP asked the state secretary for health about news that overweight among children of non-Western origin is not declining while it falls slightly among native Dutch children, and what effective interventions exist. The state secretary answered that JOGG and other local, culturally tailored interventions are used, that a national programme for health inequalities (GIDS) starts in 2014, and that data for 2013 are still awaited.
I have asked the Netherlands Nutrition Centre to examine whether and how certain basic information can be offered in various languages from 2015.
Ik heb het Voedingscentrum gevraagd te onderzoeken of en hoe bepaalde basisinformatie vanaf 2015 in verschillende talen aangeboden kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het waarschuwen van zwangere vrouwen voor alcoholgebruik

An MP asked the government about Heineken's campaign against drinking during pregnancy, public-private cooperation in health promotion, and whether warnings should appear on contraceptives and pregnancy tests. The state secretary supports cooperation with clear shared goals, reports that pharmaceutical bodies declined voluntary warnings citing EU rules, and says no additional measures are planned beyond existing information and a pregnancy logo on alcoholic drinks.
I see the introduction of a pregnancy logo on alcoholic drinks as a logical next step in informing people about the risks of alcohol use during pregnancy.
Ik zie de invoering van het zwangerschapslogo op alcoholhoudende dranken als een logische volgende stap in de voorlichting over de risico's van het gebruik van alcohol bij zwangerschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over ruzie binnen de perinatale zorg

An MP asks the minister about disputes between obstetric and midwife professional bodies (NVOG and KNOV) that hinder integrated perinatal care, including whether the College Perinatale Zorg should have a stronger role. The minister says regional care standards are being developed, that the CPZ should lead rather than merely advise, and that she is willing to discuss the CPZ's status if it requests change.
The CPZ must take the lead in order to get things done.
Het CPZ moet leiding nemen om zaken voor elkaar te kunnen krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over het bericht ‘Pandemie uit Brabant is mogelijk’

MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked the government about reports that a pandemic originating in Brabant is possible, including calls to reduce animal numbers, close farms, and separate pig and poultry farms by a kilometre. The minister answered that current hygiene and early-warning measures are sufficient, that reducing animals or fully closed farms is not the solution, and that the RIVM distance advice did not lead to a policy change.
We are of the view that the current measures are sufficient to keep the chance of an outbreak as small as possible.
Wij zijn van mening dat de huidige maatregelen voldoende zijn om de kans op een uitbraak zo klein mogelijk te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Kuzu over de falende controle op medicijngebruik van ouderen

MPs Wolbert and Kuzu asked the Minister of Health about insufficient checks on medication use by elderly people, including the low uptake of annual medication reviews and whether the Dutch Health Care Insurance (eigen risico) should exclude them. The minister acknowledged medication safety gaps, said implementation of the polypharmacy guideline is shared among GPs, pharmacists and patients, and said the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate will tighten supervision from 2015, while declining to exclude reviews from the deductible for now.
The IGZ will in any case tighten supervision from 1 January 2015.
De IGZ zal in ieder geval vanaf 1 januari 2015 het toezicht verscherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het banenverlies in de zorg in Groningen, Friesland en Drenthe

An MP asked the state secretary about projected job losses of about 4% in healthcare in Groningen, Friesland and Drenthe, and whether a sector plan with a support team and retraining funds is underway. The secretary confirmed the forecast and the ongoing regional sector plan work, said a support need would be checked, and pointed to a regional labour market programme with EUR 7.5 million per year to 2015.
For that reason I will check whether the Northern Netherlands region still needs specific support.
Om die reden zal ik nagaan of de regio Noord-Nederland nog specifieke ondersteuning nodig heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over de enquête onder brandweerpersoneel

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about an EenVandaag survey in which 80% of fire service staff said reorganisation reduced public safety, and about organisational problems such as bureaucracy and poor communication. The minister disputed the survey's picture, pointed to the Hoekstra commission's finding that safety improved, and said Brandweer Nederland will run a follow-up staff survey and keep consulting unions and works councils.
I take the signals from the survey seriously and am in contact with the employers, the safety regions, about them.
Ik neem de signalen uit de enquête serieus en ben daarover in contact met de werkgevers, de veiligheidsregio's.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Wolbert en Dikkers over het niet voldoen van testen die controleren op de aanwezigheid van hormoonverstorende stoffen in consumentenproducten

MPs Wolbert and Dikkers asked the health minister whether standard tests can detect low but harmful concentrations of hormone-disrupting substances in consumer products, which substances may slip through, and whether national measures and better consumer information are needed. The minister answered that current OECD tests are broadly adequate for some effects, that low-dose risks remain scientifically uncertain, and that no additional national product restrictions are planned for now, while the leaflet and website for pregnant women will be reviewed.

However, it is important that the government contributes to making information available about these uncertain risks, so that citizens have a course of action and can make conscious choices themselves.
Wel is het belangrijk dat de overheid bijdraagt aan het beschikbaar maken van informatie over deze onzekere risico’s, zodat de burger een handelingsperspectief heeft en zelf bewuste keuzes kan maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht dat huisartsen als strenge poortwachters bijdragen aan de hoge kankersterfte in Nederland

MP Wolbert asked the Minister of Health whether GPs acting as strict gatekeepers delay cancer referrals and contribute to high cancer mortality, and related questions about diagnostic competence, patient involvement and training. The Minister rejected the claim that gatekeeping causes high mortality, citing the Lancet study's limits and Dutch evidence, and promised a forthcoming NHG position and cancer care standard.

I see no reason to assume that cancer patients are regularly treated too late by a specialist due to a strict referral policy of the GP and that this leads to high cancer mortality in the Netherlands.

Ik zie geen reden om aan te nemen dat kankerpatiënten door een streng doorverwijsbeleid van de huisarts regelmatig te laat worden behandeld door een specialist en dat dit leidt tot hoge kankersterfte in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Wolbert over het bericht dat fabrikanten van levensmiddelen verdoezelen hoeveel suiker in producten zitten

MPs asked whether food manufacturers use many names for sugar and claims like 'no added sugars' to mislead consumers, and what labelling should require. The minister said the current EU and Dutch rules already require specific ingredient names, that 'no added sugars' claims are restricted, and that mandatory nutrition declarations with sugar content come from December 2016, and she agreed sugar content should be clearly stated on children's products.
In my view there is still generally too much sugar in our food supply.
Naar mijn mening zit er ten algemene nog teveel suiker in ons levensmiddelenaanbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het toestaan van kindermarketing in supermarkten

An MP asked the state secretary whether child-targeted marketing of unhealthy products in supermarkets, which drives children's pester-purchases, should be restricted, and why it is banned online and on TV but not in stores. The secretary replied that responsibility lies with industry self-regulation and parents, opposed legal measures, said supermarkets set shelf placement in consultation with manufacturers, and pointed to voluntary initiatives.
I am therefore not in favour of legal measures.
Ik ben daarom geen voorstander van wettelijke maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over ontoelaatbare kindermarketing via het Nationaal Schoolontbijt

An MP asked whether the Nationaal Schoolontbijt, sponsored by food companies, is allowed to distribute products that are too sweet, salty or fatty and whether industry self-regulation on child-directed advertising under age 12 is working. The state secretary defended the initiative as private responsibility, noted the Voedingscentrum advises on products, and said industry has agreed to stop advertising to children under 12 except for products meeting nutritional criteria from 2014.
I support it when private parties take their social responsibility to promote a healthy lifestyle for young people.
Ik ondersteun het wanneer private partijen hun maatschappelijke verantwoordelijkheid nemen om in te zetten op een gezonde leefstijl voor de jeugd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Rebel over zwangeren die alcohol blijven drinken

MPs Wolbert and Rebel asked about reports that many pregnant women keep drinking alcohol and how prevention policy reaches lower-educated women, and whether professionals discuss alcohol before conception. The Staatssecretaris answered that no safe amount of alcohol in pregnancy is advised, described existing public information, professional guidelines and training, and said the government will not further evaluate this but points to existing channels.
During pregnancy there is no safe amount of alcohol.
Bij zwangerschap bestaat geen veilige hoeveelheid alcohol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Dikkers en Wolbert over de uitbreiding van een melkveebedrijf in Coevorden naar 1.900 koeien

MPs Van Dekken, Dikkers and Wolbert asked the state secretary about a dairy farm expansion in Coevorden to 1,900 cows, its health and environmental impact, consistency with the cabinet's livestock scale position, whether the province can block it, and whether abolishing milk quotas will drive similar expansions. The state secretary answered that environmental permitting is a matter for province and municipality, that a new Wet Dieren provision will let them set health-based limits on livestock size, and that no data exist on the number of farms with expansion plans.
Provinces and municipalities can, under the Spatial Planning Act, for example set a maximum on stable size and impose restrictions on the establishment or expansion of livestock farms.

Provincies en gemeenten kunnen op basis van de Wet ruimtelijke ordening bijvoorbeeld een maximum stellen aan de stalgrootte en beperkingen opleggen aan de vestiging of uitbreiding van veehouderijbedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over verpleegkundigen en verzorgenden die zichzelf onvoldoende toegerust vinden voor preventie en bevorderen van zelfmanagement

An MP asked the state secretary about a Nivel study showing many nurses and care workers feel insufficiently equipped for prevention and self-management support, and about training and practical education. The minister answered that the study gives only a signal without deeper analysis, that new professional profiles address these competences, that training institutions do not recognise the picture, and that the wijkverpleegkundige is central.
A further analysis of exactly where the shortcoming lies and what its cause is is lacking.
Een nadere analyse van waar het precies aan schort en wat de oorzaak daarvan is ontbreekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over tekort aan huisartsen in Drenthe

An MP asked the health minister about a looming shortage of GPs in rural Drenthe, including whether national steering, tariff differentiation, practice centres and flanking incentives could help. The minister answered that insurers carry the duty of care, that Achmea is working with local GPs on a plan with extra funding, and that the matter is being examined in a quick scan, while declining to use the availability contribution instrument.
It is the responsibility of insurers to purchase sufficient care in order to meet their duty of care towards their insured.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van verzekeraars om voldoende zorg in te kopen om jegens hun verzekerden aan de zorgplicht te kunnen voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over de Q-koorts

Two MPs asked the health minister about low recorded Q-fever infections among children and young people, whether doctors are more alert, and the status of the 10 million euro Q-support foundation. The minister answered that under-diagnosis is normal for mild cases, that the epidemic is over, that the foundation was set up and is starting activities, and that an evaluation will be reported around September 2014.
I have committed to evaluating, one year after the foundation starts, whether there are still people the foundation has not helped in the way we intended.
Ik heb u toegezegd dat een jaar nadat de stichting van start is gegaan geëvalueerd zal worden of er nog mensen zijn die door de stichting niet geholpen zijn op de manier waarop wij ze wilden helpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht dat vrouwen niet meer in het ziekenhuis in Spijkenisse kunnen bevallen

The MP Wolbert asks whether the Spijkenisse hospital's end of births in October is justified by RIVM travel-time data, the status of the regional acute-care plan, and whether 24/7 gynaecologist and operating-team cover exists at the remaining hospitals. The Minister says the RIVM models are not the basis for closing the maternity unit, that an extra ambulance was added temporarily with an analysis to follow, that plans are developed by the hospital with insurers in a regional consultation, and that the IGZ supervises safe care, while 24/7 gynaecologist presence is not a required norm.
I will send the conclusions of the research by the RAV and the insurer to your House in due course.
Ik zal de conclusies van het onderzoek van de RAV en de verzekeraar t.z.t. aan uw Kamer toezenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Kuzu over een dronken huisarts

MPs Wolbert and Kuzu asked whether the Inspectorate should immediately investigate and suspend a doctor who came to work drunk, and about related reporting and disciplinary steps. Minister Schippers said the IGZ investigated in 2012 and found no patient-safety risk while the doctor was sober, has now reopened an inquiry after new complaints, plans a legal power for immediate interim suspension, and will work with the sector on alcohol norms and refer to the College van Medisch Toezicht where unfitness is proven.
Within disciplinary law I want to create the possibility to immediately suspend a practitioner by way of interim measure
