In het kader van het tuchtrecht wil ik de mogelijkheid creëren om een beroepsbeoefenaar bij wijze van voorlopige voorziening direct te schorsen
Antwoord vragen van de leden Arib en Wolbert over de ‘beste manier’ om genetische afwijkingen te achterhalen

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister about the best way to detect genetic abnormalities, including whether the NIPT blood test should be introduced quickly and why Gezondheidsraad advice was delayed. The minister answered that NIPT is promising but must first be shown effective and safe under the Bevolkingsonderzoek law, that advice has been requested, and that a decision will follow promptly after the advice arrives.
Women go abroad on their own initiative to Belgium or Germany. Figures on this are not known to me.
Vrouwen gaan op eigen gelegenheid naar België of Duitsland. Cijfers hierover zijn mij niet bekend.
Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het uitvallen van het C2000 netwerk en het haperen van 112 in Brabant (ingezonden 26 juli 2013).

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about the C2000 network outage in Brabant on 26 June 2013, its cause, preparedness of safety regions, and why 112 calls failed in Noord-Brabant despite earlier improvements. The minister confirms the outage, attributes it to maintenance work under investigation, says regions relied on fall-back plans and mobile phones, and attributes the 112 call problems to a KPN fixed-line disruption rather than the 1-1-2 network.
The investigation into the exact cause of the outage is now underway.
Het onderzoek naar de exacte oorzaak van de storing is nu gaande.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arib en Wolbert over de beste manier om genetische afwijkingen te voorkomen

MPs Arib and Wolbert asked the health minister about the best way to detect genetic disorders, including whether Dutch hospitals send blood abroad for the non-invasive prenatal test (NIPT) and whether such testing should be allowed meanwhile. The minister said the precise role of hospitals is unknown, that she supports a swift but careful Health Council assessment, and that under the Dutch Population Screening Act testing abroad without a licence is not permitted.
The precise role of the Dutch hospitals is not known to me.
De precieze rol van de Nederlandse ziekenhuizen is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht dat huisartsen melden dat patiënten aangeven geen geld te hebben voor medicijnen of vervolgbehandelingen

An MP asked the minister whether patients are avoiding medicines, follow-up treatment or operations because of the forced deductible (eigen risico), including misconceptions that GP visits fall under it. The minister answered that the ongoing research will examine these issues, that the deductible is compensated via the healthcare allowance for low incomes, and that misunderstandings should be corrected.
The research I am having conducted will provide more insight into whether insured persons may refrain from or postpone operations or follow-up treatment, and what the reasons for this are.
Het onderzoek dat ik laat doen, zal meer inzicht geven in de vraag of verzekerden mogelijk afzien van operaties of vervolgbehandelingen of deze uitstellen, en wat daarvan de reden is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht dat verpleegkundigen vrezen voor hun baan

An MP asked the health ministers whether nurses are worried about their jobs, why unemployment among nurses rose, what the vacancy situation is, and whether matching problems exist. The government acknowledged the reports, described a small rise in job seekers as a normal fluctuation, cited falling vacancy rates, and said it had seen no signals of matching problems, promising to review a sector survey after the summer.
We have no data available on the number of open vacancies for nurses.
We hebben geen data voorhanden over het aantal openstaande vacatures voor verpleegkundigen.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Wolbert over het bericht “inactiviteit bij kinderen”

PvdA MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked the health minister about a TV report on child inactivity, its long-term effects, the performance of sports coaches, and investment in physical education from the PvdA Topsport action plan. The minister acknowledged the concern, said evaluation of sports coaches is still ongoing with results expected end 2013, and pointed to existing programmes and the coalition agreement's ambition for more gym lessons, with OCW to report later.

Given the recent change and the ongoing research, I consider it too early to speak about adjusting the current scheme or to judge the performance of combination officers and neighbourhood sports coaches.

Gezien de recente wijziging en het lopende onderzoek acht ik het daarom te vroeg om te spreken over een aanpassing van de huidige regeling en om te oordelen over de prestaties van combinatiefunctionarissen en buurtsportcoaches.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dikkers, Jacobi en Wolbert over het bericht dat bij 44% van de Europeanen glyfosaat in de urine zit

MPs Dikkers, Jacobi and Wolbert asked the health and economic affairs ministers about a German study finding glyphosate in the urine of 44% of Europeans, including whether the NVWA tests crops and what risk applies. The minister answered that the RIVM sees no health risk at these microgram levels, that the NVWA tests grains with no MRL exceedances, and that glyphosate is under EU re-evaluation which will be followed closely.
Because the RIVM currently has no indication that the glyphosate levels found in urine give cause for concern, there is no reason to inquire with neighbouring countries about such research.

Omdat het RIVM op dit moment geen aanwijzingen heeft dat de gevonden glyfosaatwaarden in de urine reden tot zorg geven, is er geen aanleiding om bij de omringende landen te informeren naar dergelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen Otwin Van Dijk en Wolbert over het bericht “Megaclaims ziekenhuizen bij overheid”

Two Labour MPs asked the health minister about hospital claims for transition payments worth around 300 million euros against roughly 90 million in reported debts, and about the effect on 2014 premiums, possible fraud and the follow-up to a report on transition-model abuse. The minister said no formal applications had yet been submitted so no overview exists, that insurers' central team is assessing applications and will replace estimates with verifiable figures, and that a first insight is expected by year-end.
I therefore have no overview available and cannot anticipate the outcomes of this process.
Ik heb dus geen overzicht beschikbaar en ik kan niet vooruit lopen op de uitkomsten van dit proces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht dat borstkankerkliniek Monro niet voor risicopatiënten is

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that the Alexander Monro breast cancer clinic is not suited to high-risk patients, including whether it meets guidelines, its use of a Zelfstandig Behandel Centrum model without intensive care, its self-description as a centre of excellence, and patient information. The minister answered that the IGZ supervises the clinic, planned inspections, listed the specialists and regional arrangements, and declined to commission further research, while the clinic's self-chosen labels are not regulated.
It is primarily the responsibility of a healthcare institution itself to comply with the guidelines for responsible care.
Het is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van een zorginstelling zelf om aan de richtlijnen voor verantwoorde zorg te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het gegeven dat vrouwen in achterstandswijken nog steeds geen gelijkwaardige perinatale zorg krijgen

MP Wolbert asked the minister whether she knows the latest EURO-PERISTAT findings and what concrete steps will narrow perinatal mortality gaps for women in disadvantaged neighbourhoods. Minister Schippers acknowledges the concern, cites the ErasmusMC 'Healthy Pregnancy 4 All' project and CPZ activities, and points to results only expected in 2014 and later.
That does not detract from the fact that I agree with you that perinatal mortality in disadvantaged situations is a point of concern.
Dat laat overigens onverlet dat ik het met u eens ben dat de perinatale sterfte in achterstandssituaties een punt van zorg is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het nieuws dat het gehoor van de Nederlandse jeugd nog verder is verslechterd

MPs Wolbert and Van Laar asked the state secretary about reported further hearing deterioration among Dutch youth and what measures would be taken. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, promised a RIVM study, a prevention programme item and a convenant with the music sector, but deferred a statutory noise limit and declined to answer some questions in time.
I have asked the RIVM to conduct research into this, so that we can have recent figures.
Ik heb het RIVM gevraagd om hier onderzoek naar te doen, zodat we over recente cijfers kunnen beschikken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over het terugdringen van de administratieve druk voor verpleegkundigen in ziekenhuizen

An MP asked the health minister about nurses in Dutch hospitals being burdened by computer-based administrative tasks and whether this should be reduced. The minister acknowledged the burden, said reducing government-imposed administrative load is a top priority, but argued that much of the data collection is necessary for quality of care and can only be simplified rather than dropped.
As far as government-imposed administrative burdens are concerned, it is clear: it is a top priority for me to minimise these.
Voor zover het de door de overheid opgelegde administratieve lasten betreft is het helder: het is voor mij een topprioriteit om deze tot een minimum te beperken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wolbert en Bouwmeester over onnodige sterfte door Hepatitis B en C

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister about rising mortality from hepatitis B and C, the trend after 2010, risk groups among first-generation migrants, and the China-in-the-Low-Countries pilot and Bibhep project. The minister answered that cases are similar to 2009-2010, that a screening/vaccination policy for migrant risk groups is being explored with the RIVM and may go to the Gezondheidsraad, and that the pilots are being evaluated and partly supported.
If necessary, the Health Council will be asked for advice.
Zonodig zal de Gezondheidsraad om een advies gevraagd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over de reductie van zoutgebruik

An MP asked the health minister whether food industry warnings that salt reduction harms taste are misleading, whether the Netherlands lags other EU countries, and when a further 25% cut in bread salt should be reached. The minister said taste change is manageable and not misleading, disagreed that the Netherlands lags (it performs well in the EU), and set no target, relying on voluntary sector-wide agreements.
I do not regard the food industry's mention of the possible effect of salt reduction on taste as a warning, nor as misleading information.
Ik zie het benoemen van het mogelijke effect van zoutreductie op smaak door de levensmiddelenindustrie niet als een waarschuwing en ook niet als misleidende informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over de situatie dat Nederlandse zwangeren naar België moeten voor een veilige test

An MP asks the health minister why Dutch pregnant women must travel to Belgium for the non-invasive prenatal test (NIPT) that avoids miscarriage risk, and why the Netherlands has not adopted it, given foreign recognition and an academic proposal. The minister answers that the test requires a licence under the Wet op het bevolkingsonderzoek, that the Health Council is advising on the licence application with a four-month deadline, and that a decision will follow, aiming for speed.
After that, a decision can be taken on introducing the test into screening.
Daarna kan een beslissing worden genomen over invoering van de test in de screening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert, Jan Vos en Van Dekken over het aardbevingsbestendig maken van de olie- en gasopslag in Groningen

MPs asked whether oil storage in Eemshaven, licensed on older earthquake assumptions, must be made earthquake-proof, whether systematic risk studies cover licensed firms, and whether NAM should pay for upgrades. The government replied that Vopak is still assessing its terminal, that 11 studies including effects of quakes above 3.9 Richter are underway, that NAM will be approached if preventive upgrades are needed, and that COVA can rely on Vopak's licence compliance.
As part of the 11 studies mentioned, the possible surface effects of an earthquake larger than 3.9 Richter are also being examined.
Als onderdeel van de genoemde 11 onderzoeken wordt ook onderzocht wat de mogelijke effecten aan het oppervlak zijn van een aardbeving groter dan 3.9 Richter
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Van Dekken en Wolbert over het bericht ‘Kernafval net over de grens’ in het Dagblad van het Noorden van 11 april 2011

Three PvdA MPs asked the economics minister whether plans exist to store nuclear waste in salt domes across the border from Vlagtwedde, and about health, drinking water and consultation with Groningen and Germany. The minister replied that Germany has no concrete site plans yet, only a renewed site search with a committee report due in 2015, and that Dutch policy favours geological disposal while contact with Germany would follow if a border site emerged.
There are no plans in Germany to store radioactive waste just across the border near Vlagtwedde.
Er zijn in Duitsland geen plannen om radioactief afval vlak over de grens bij Vlagtwedde op te slaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch, Wolbert en Van Dekken over het bericht dat per 1 maart 2013 al banen verdwijnen bij gevangenissen in Ter Apel, Hoogeveen en Veenhuizen

MPs Marcouch, Wolbert and Van Dekken asked the state secretary whether job losses at prisons in Ter Apel, Hoogeveen and Veenhuizen from 1 March 2013 were true and linked to the unpublished Masterplan. The state secretary denied that dozens of jobs were disappearing, said empty capacity is being concentrated for efficiency as a separate operational measure, and gave partial answers on consultation, cells and transfers.
Pending the discussion of the Masterplan in your House, no irreversible steps will be taken.
Vooruitlopend op de bespreking van het Masterplan in uw Kamer zullen er geen onomkeerbare stappen worden gezet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jacobi en Wolbert over de mogelijke frustratie van recreatie en natuurontwikkeling in het gebied Dwingelderveld als gevolg van stagnatie bij de herinrichting

MPs Jacobi and Wolbert asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that renewed delays in the Dwingelderveld restoration would stall nature development and keep parts of the area closed to walkers, cyclists and disabled visitors, including whether the rezoning and subsidy deadlines are at risk. The State Secretary answered that she is aware of the reports but that, under the Bestuursakkoord Natuur, responsibility for the restoration and for walking paths lies with the province of Drenthe and regional bodies, and she declined to take that responsibility on.
By signing the Bestuursakkoord Natuur, the restoration of the Dwingelderveld falls under the responsibility of the province of Drenthe.
Met het ondertekenen van het Bestuursakkoord Natuur valt de herinrichting van het Dwingelderveld onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincie Drenthe.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over het onderzoek van Foodwatch

MP Wolbert asked the state secretary about a Foodwatch study finding over 80% of food marketed to children is unhealthy, the reliability of industry self-regulation, public disclosure of violations, and whether a traffic-light labelling system should replace the Vinkje. The secretary acknowledged the findings, said industry self-regulation has improved and is under review, pointed to the Advertising Code Commission as a transparent accountability route, and defended the Vinkje over traffic lights.
I am currently in consultation with the FNLI on this and I expect them to take their responsibility.
Momenteel ben ik hierover in overleg met de FNLI en ik verwacht dat zij haar verantwoordelijkheid pakt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over een mogelijk tekort aan HCG ten behoeve van vruchtbaarheidsbehandelingen

MP Wolbert asked the health minister about a shortage of HCG-based fertility drug Pregnyl, whether urine collected via Moeders voor Moeders is used for other purposes, off-label use for slimming and horse breeding, Inspectorate enforcement results, and measures to restrict use to fertility treatment. The minister confirmed a shortage of Pregnyl 1500, said the manufacturer uses urine only for human fertility drugs, reported Inspectorate fines and a conviction, and announced plans to move Pregnyl to hospital-only supply to curb off-label use.
I do not have data on the extent of HCG use as a slimming agent or for bodybuilding.
Ik beschik niet over gegevens wat betreft de mate van gebruik van HCG als afslankmiddel of het gebruik bij bodybuilding.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars verpleegkundig specialisten niet als hoofdbehandelaar erkennen

MP Wolbert asked the minister whether insurers refuse to recognise nurse specialists as main treating professionals, why the issue persists, and how the government will improve use of their skills. The minister confirmed insurers restrict main-treater status, including for nurse specialists, and pointed to a pending IGZ advice and a field norm on main-treater status as the route to clarity.
I therefore expect that the IGZ advice will give more insight into the considerations of health insurers regarding main-treater status.
Ik verwacht daarom dat het advies van de IGZ meer inzicht zal geven in de overwegingen van de zorgverzekeraars op het gebied van het hoofdbehandelaarschap.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over het onderzoeksresultaat dat de babysterfte 's nachts niet hoger is dan overdag?

An MP asked the health minister whether a study showing that infant mortality fell in all hospital types, including night shifts, undermines the rationale for closing obstetric care in Meppel and whether this should change how large organisational changes are weighed. The minister acknowledged the positive trend but noted the study covers only uncomplicated births, declined to issue new recommendations, and said decisions on concentrating obstetric care lie with hospital boards and other parties.
It is up to the hospital boards, insurers, professionals and all other stakeholders to make decisions about concentrating obstetric care.
Het is aan de Raden van Bestuur, de verzekeraars, de professionals en alle andere betrokkenen om besluiten te nemen over concentratie van verloskundige zorg.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Wolbert en Ziengs over het verklaren van Ruinerwold tot een beschermd dorpsgezicht door de Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed

Three MPs asked why the Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed designates Ruinerwold as a protected village view despite opposition from the municipal council and the province, and what this means for economic development and solar panels. The minister explains the designation procedure, that municipal and provincial advice plays an important role but cultural-historical values are leading, and that the municipality decides on permits without blocking development or renewable energy.
The cultural-historical values are leading in the designation procedure, but the advice of the municipal council and Provincial Executive plays an important role in the weighing towards the decision.
De cultuurhistorische waarden zijn bij de aanwijzingsprocedure leidend, maar de adviezen van de gemeenteraad en van Gedeputeerde Staten spelen een belangrijke rol bij de afweging tot het besluit.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over de onzekerheid ten aanzien van wijkverpleegkundigen in de Zichtbare Schakel

An MP asked the health minister whether municipalities were spending only half of the Zichtbare Schakel budget on district nurse projects and how spending would be monitored. The minister said the projects are not being stopped, municipalities may not redirect the funds, and ZonMw will set up a monitor, though details remain undecided.
On your questions about municipalities not spending the funds on Zichtbare schakel projects, we cannot give an answer given the answers to the previous questions.
Op uw vragen over het niet besteden van de middelen door gemeenten aan Zichtbare schakel projecten kunnen wij – gegeven de antwoorden op voorgaande vragen – geen antwoord geven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over het gebruik van alcohol tijden de zwangerschap

An MP asked the health minister about inconsistent no-alcohol advice in pregnancy among gynaecologists, midwives and GPs, and what government should do to publicise it and target low-SES women. The minister acknowledged the findings, said professional bodies and the Partnership Vroegsignalering Alcohol will raise awareness, pointed to existing preconception campaigns and municipal duties, and gave no new binding commitment.
The PVA will bring the gynaecologists' shortcoming to the attention of the KNMG, with which it cooperates on early signalling.

Het PVA zal het knelpunt voor wat betreft gynaecologen onder de aandacht brengen via de Koninklijke Nederlandsche Maatschappij tot bevordering der Geneeskunst (KNMG), waarmee samenwerking op het gebied van vroegsignalering plaatsvindt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over de te hoge werkdruk bij verpleegkundigen

MP Wolbert asked the minister about nursing staff reporting workloads too high to keep working until retirement, and asked how the government would retain care staff and reduce workload. The minister answered that the employer and employees bear primary responsibility, cited existing arbo tools and inspectorate checks, and listed government programmes on sustainable employability and professional pride.
It is primarily their responsibility, together with employees, to manage the workload and improve job satisfaction.
Het is primair hun verantwoordelijkheid om, in samenwerking met werknemers, de werkdruk te beheersen en de werktevredenheid te verbeteren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht dat de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) zeer zwakke onderzoeksmethodes gebruikt

An MP asks whether the Dutch health care authority NZa's research on orthodontic tariffs is reliable, after a Leiden professor criticised its quantitative study, and whether NZa research can still be used. The minister says the professor's criticism concerns only one quantitative study, that the NZa's wider body of research is sound, and that no new agreements with the NZa are needed.
In view of the full set of studies, I see no reason in Prof. Gill's criticism to stop using the NZa's data in future.
Ik zie, mede in het licht van het geheel aan onderzoeken, in de kritiek van prof. Gill dan ook geen aanleiding om de gegevens van de NZa voortaan niet meer te gebruiken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch, Hamer, Van Dekken, Albert de Vries en Wolbert over het bericht dat er gevangenissen in Groningen, Drenthe Zeeland worden gesloten

PvdA MPs asked whether plans to close prisons in Groningen, Drenthe and Zeeland exist, and about the employment, visitor travel and cultural-heritage effects of such closures. The State Secretary replied that no decision has been taken, closures cannot be avoided given budget cuts, a Masterplan on detention capacity will be presented in April 2013, and regional employment and visits will be weighed.

With a view to a careful decision-making process, I have asked the Director-General of DJI to draw up a Masterplan on DJI detention capacity, which will show the consequences of the cuts for cell capacity and staff.

Met het oog op een zorgvuldig besluitvormingsproces heb ik de hoofddirecteur van DJI verzocht om een Masterplan detentiecapaciteit DJI op te stellen, waarin de gevolgen van de ombuigingen voor de celcapaciteit van DJI en het personeel in beeld worden gebracht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht dat de voedingsindustrie via internet de regels over reclame voor kinderen omzeilt

An MP asked the minister whether food industry advertising circumvents the rules on advertising to children online and what could be done about it. The state secretary replied that under the Dutch advertising code food ads aimed at under-7s are prohibited, that an industry monitoring report found compliance good on TV and cinema but with concerns on websites, and that the industry federation is expected to address its members.
I expect the FNLI to hold its members to account for their responsibility and that the next report shows parties, including on digital media, complying with the agreed RvV rules.

Ik verwacht van de FNLI dat zij haar leden aanspreekt op hun verantwoordelijkheid en dat in de volgende rapportage (over het jaar 2013) blijkt dat partijen, ook op digitale media, de afgesproken regels van de RvV naleven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Wolbert over de NODO-procedure in de praktijk

MPs Recourt and Wolbert asked why the Child Death Review was dropped, why only two instead of five NODO centres were set up, and whether forensic doctor knowledge gaps affect NODO referrals. The state secretary answered that the CDR could not be funded given budget limits, that two centres were chosen for expertise and cost reasons with a startfase evaluation until October 2013, and that enough qualified forensic doctors are now available.
The available budget has been used to introduce the NODO procedure.
Het beschikbare budget is ingezet om de NODO-procedure in te voeren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt, Groot en Wolbert over de verhoogde vrijstelling van de erfbelasting voor mantelzorgers

MPs Recourt, Groot and Wolbert asked whether the government would improve information to carers about the inheritance tax exemption linked to the mantelzorgcompliment, and whether the exemption should rest on receiving that compliment. The state secretary replied that information has already been improved, including SVB letters, and that the compliment is not meant for the exemption, so the statutory condition cannot be waived through the hardship clause.
Since this is an explicit choice by the legislature, I have no room to deviate from it by applying the hardship clause.
Nu sprake is van een uitdrukkelijke keuze van de wetgever, heb ik geen ruimte om daarvan met toepassing van hardheidsclausule af te wijken.
Antwoord vagen van het lid Wolbert over verontrustende cijfers over gehoorschade

An MP asks the health minister about alarming figures on hearing damage among young people from loud music, including what the government has done, which interventions work, and whether it accepts the public's expectation of government oversight. The state secretary answers that the music sector and the Nationale Hoorstichting bear primary responsibility, cites information campaigns, and says the Oorveilig keurmerk and sector convenant will be evaluated in December 2012 before deciding on further action.
Based on this evaluation, I want to work with the sector to see whether further action is necessary and desirable.
Op basis van deze evaluatie wil ik samen met de sector kijken of nadere actie nodig en gewenst is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wolbert en Ypma over het falen van het huidige beleid ten aanzien van marketing van ongezonde voedingsmiddelen gericht op kinderen

MPs Wolbert and Ypma asked the health minister about an IASO report showing rising exposure of Dutch children to unhealthy food advertising, and how this fits with industry self-regulation. The minister replied that self-regulation covers under-7s and calls for restraint for 7-12s, that the report only covers EU Pledge signatories, that free riders can be addressed via the Advertising Code Commission, and that industry should continue monitoring and accountability.
I expect the industry to keep taking steps on this and to keep taking responsibility.
Ik verwacht dat de industrie hierop stappen en haar verantwoording blijft nemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wolbert en Kuiken over de onveilige situaties als gevolg van de inzet van niet gekwalificeerde Poolse en Hongaarse chauffeurs bij transport van gevaarlijke stoffen

MPs Wolbert and Kuiken asked the minister about unqualified Polish and Hungarian drivers transporting dangerous goods, following a ZEMBLA broadcast alleging certificates were bought without training. The minister replied that certificate oversight lies with the country of origin, that the ILT checks certificates and fines violations, and that the issue will be raised with member states and the Commission.
I am also willing to raise this issue with the member states concerned and the European Commission.
Ik ben ook bereid deze kwestie bij de betrokken lidstaten en de Europese Commissie aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wolbert en Klijnsma over het kopen van cliënten door thuiszorgorganisaties

MPs Wolbert and Klijnsma asked the minister about home-care organisations paying hospitals for referrals, whether the NZa's investigation was broad enough, and the conflicts of interest of hospital-linked or payroll-linked transfer nurses. The minister answered that the NZa has issued directions to four hospitals, that the market works as intended, that the NZa is investigating further, and that the payroll arrangement is undesirable but no specific study is planned.
They invoiced home-care institutions for referring clients to them, although this was not permitted.
Zij hebben gedeclareerd aan thuiszorginstellingen voor het naar hen doorverwijzen van cliënten terwijl dit niet is toegestaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wolbert en Groot over gebruik van financiële derivaten door zorginstellingen

Two MPs asked the health minister about rising use of financial derivatives by healthcare institutions, the risks, oversight by the NZa and the Waarborgfonds voor de Zorgsector, and whether legal limits apply. The minister answered that usage rose per KPMG data, that institutions' boards bear primary responsibility, that the WFZ requires prior approval for derivatives and bars margin calls, that no statutory limits exist, and that a WFZ survey will inform possible future regulation.
It is primarily the responsibility of an institution's Executive Board and then its Supervisory Board to oversee the prudent use of derivatives.
Het is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de Raad van Bestuur en vervolgens van de Raad van Toezicht van een instelling om toezicht te houden op het verstandig gebruik van derivaten.
Antwoord vragen Klijnsma en Wolbert over overbelasting van mantelzorgers

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary for health about reports (Mezzo survey) that many family carers in nursing homes feel obliged to perform care tasks and are overburdened, and asked for action on communication between carers and professionals. The state secretary called family involvement voluntary and valuable, placed the survey's small sample in perspective, promised talks with stakeholders and reporting on the 2012 carers letter in spring 2013.
I intend to sit down together with Mezzo, the Expertise Centre Informal Care and the training institutions to consider how informal care can better come onto the professional's radar.
Ik ben van plan om samen met Mezzo, het Expertisecentrum Mantelzorg en «de opleidingen» om de tafel te gaan zitten om te bezien hoe mantelzorg beter op het netvlies van de professional kan komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het sluiten van dagbestedinglocaties in Drenthe als gevolg van de bezuinigingen op de vervoerkosten voor gehandicapten

An MP asked the state secretary whether closing day-care locations in Drenthe due to transport cost cuts for disabled people was consistent with earlier assurances that institutions would handle the cuts themselves, and what recourse clients have. The state secretary answered that the institution had long planned reorganisation, that institutions act autonomously on their own management, that clients retain medezeggenschap via the client council, and that no other closures are known.
I am explicitly not responsible for the management or competent in the area of the individual institution.
Ik ben nadrukkelijk niet verantwoordelijk voor de bedrijfsvoering c.q. bevoegd op het terrein van de individuele instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over mantelzorgers die geen compliment krijgen

An MP asked why carers of people on waiting lists for institutional care are excluded from the mantelzorgcompliment and how the government will ensure they receive it. The state secretary confirmed the exclusion, explained the eligibility criteria and budget overrun, and said the scheme will be fundamentally reconsidered, though the answers arrived late.
In my policy letter of 29 March 2012 I indicated that these signals call for a fundamental reconsideration of the mantelzorgcompliment scheme.
In mijn beleidsbrief van 29 maart 2012 geef ik aan deze signalen nopen tot een fundamentele heroverweging van de regeling mantelzorgcompliment.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Koopmans, Wolbert en Snijder-Hazelhoff inzake sierkolen

MPs Koopmans, Wolbert and Snijder-Hazelhoff asked why pesticides approved for food cabbage cannot be used on ornamental cabbage, whether the small-use definition excludes such crops, and how other EU states treat them. The state secretary explained the separate authorisation procedure, said the small-use area limits will be widened to 5,000 ha open and 1,000 ha covered, and that the Ctgb will be asked to apply this.
I will ask the Ctgb to act in accordance with the above.
Ik zal het Ctgb verzoeken conform het bovenstaande te handelen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Eijsink en Wolbert over het bericht “Defensie in zee met USG voor reorganisatie”

MPs Eijsink and Wolbert asked the Defence minister about the outsourcing of job placement for surplus Defence staff to USG People, including why SMEs and reintegration firms were not involved. The minister answered that the tender followed EU rules with quality and price criteria, that Defence is responsible for work-to-work support and works with various firms including SMEs, and that results will become visible in 2013.
The public tender for the placement organisation contract was carried out in accordance with European directives.
De openbare aanbesteding van het contract voor de bemiddelingsorganisatie is volgens de Europese richtlijnen uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Groot en Wolbert over de verhoogde vrijstelling van de erfbelasting voor mantelzorgers

MPs Recourt, Groot and Wolbert asked whether carers can qualify for the raised inheritance tax exemption of 600,000 euro, what conditions apply, and whether citizens have been adequately informed. The state secretary confirmed the partner exemption conditions (including the carer allowance, cohabitation contract or five-year registration, and no other partner), said no specific agreements on information were made with parliament, and committed to working with Mezzo on improving information to carers.
The state secretary of Health, Welfare and Sport will consult with Mezzo to examine whether information to carers on inheritance tax and the exemption could be further improved.
De staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport zal in overleg met Mezzo bezien of zij de voorlichting aan mantelzorgers over erfbelasting en vrijstelling verder zouden kunnen verbeteren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Klijnsma en Wolbert over de extreem hoge inkomens van bestuurders in de zorg

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister whether it is acceptable that 41 elderly-care executives earn well above the Balkenende norm, and whether the government will enforce the Wolbert motion capping sector pay. The state secretary pointed to the forthcoming Wet normering topinkomens (WNT) and said the BBZ pay code has been actively promoted, with a stricter norm to apply when the WNT takes effect.
This proposal is now under consideration in the Senate.
Dit voorstel ligt inmiddels ter behandeling in de Eerste Kamer.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht dat gehandicapten niet meer naar hun dagbesteding kunnen als gevolg van het Kunduz-akkoord

MP Wolbert asked whether the Kunduz coalition's budget cuts would stop wheelchair users getting taxi transport to day care, whether institutions may refuse or limit transport, and whether institutions were over-compensated for transport costs. The state secretary confirmed the report, said the transport entitlement continues with a new standard tariff from 2013 and that institutions must organise it efficiently in consultation with clients, and cited an NZa/PwC study on widely varying transport costs.
This transport is an entitlement to which a client has a right and for which an institution is funded.
Dit vervoer is een aanspraak waarop een cliënt recht heeft en waarvoor een instelling wordt bekostigd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over de onzekerheid bij patiënten door een te groot gebruik van flexwerkers in de verpleeg- en thuiszorg

MP Wolbert asked the state secretary about patient uncertainty caused by heavy use of temporary (flex) staff in nursing and home care, including whether flex staff undermine continuity of care and what policy would reduce them. The state secretary answered that employers are primarily responsible for staffing, that continuity matters but some flex staff may be needed, that no data on flex staff numbers are known to her, and pointed to existing programmes and labour-market policy.
I am not aware of any data on the number of flex workers in care.
Er zijn mij geen gegevens bekend over het aantal flexwerkers in de zorg.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over het succes van de wijkverpleegkundige en het voortzetten van de Zichtbare Schakel

An MP asked the state secretary about the success of district nurses in the Zichtbare Schakel programme, which is ending without a clear follow-up, causing nurses to leave, and whether indication-free working will be abolished. The state secretary confirmed the programme ends at ZonMw, said the projects will be continued in 2013 and 2014 via a decentralisation grant, and that NZa advice on long-term funding is expected this summer, while indication-free working is still under consideration.
I have received calls from various projects to continue the projects.
Ik heb van diverse projecten een oproep ontvangen om de projecten voort te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over kwaliteitsproblemen in verpleeghuizen

An MP asks the state secretary about reports of unqualified staff distributing medication in nursing homes, falling numbers of HBO-level nurses, activities for residents, incontinence care and the Beginselenwet Zorg, and under-reporting of medication errors. The state secretary cites IGZ reports showing improvement, notes rising HBO-nurse numbers, says the new client-rights law strengthens clients and staff, and states that medication incidents must be reported through internal MIC committees that the IGZ checks.
The IGZ checks during a visit whether the care institution has such a committee.
De IGZ toetst bij een bezoek of de zorginstelling een dergelijke commissie heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over woon-zorgcombinaties

An MP asked whether residents of care-housing complexes can be forced to take care from the 'linked' provider, whether landlords may charge extra for switching provider, and whether this deters choice. The state secretary answered that free choice is ideal but landlords may bind tenancy to using partner providers for efficiency or safety reasons, that the AWBZ does not regulate this, and that the Mededingingswet (competition law) may apply to tie-in sales by a dominant landlord.
Tenant and landlord are free to agree in the rental contract that care is purchased from care providers with which the landlord has a partnership.
Het staat huurder en verhuurder vrij om in het huurcontract afspraken te maken over de afname van zorg bij zorgaanbieders waarmee de verhuurder een samenwerkingsverband heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Van der Veen over onrust rondom de contractering tussen verzekeraars en ziekenhuizen

MPs Wolbert and Van der Veen asked the health minister about contracting disputes between insurers and hospitals that could leave insured patients paying for care, including passant prices and whether acute and ongoing treatment is covered. The minister said she has no view on passant prices, that insurers and hospitals must inform patients, that ongoing and acute care is fully reimbursed, and declined to give details of individual contracts as commercially confidential.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het gerucht dat u plannen heeft om de 10-uursnorm voor het persoonsgebonden budget (pgb) te verlagen

An MP asks whether the government plans to lower the 10-hour threshold for the persoonsgebonden budget (pgb) after a magazine quoted the state secretary, and when the Chamber will get the first evaluation of the pgb measure. The state secretary replies that the 10-hour rule applies to the Vergoedingsregeling persoonlijke zorg rather than the pgb, that she has no plans to lower it, and that the first quarterly evaluation covering January to March is expected in April.
The first evaluation covering January through March can be expected in April.
De eerste evaluatie over de maanden januari tot en met maart kunt u naar verwachting april a.s. tegemoet zien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over de verstrekking van iPad’s door een zorgorganisatie

An MP asked the state secretary whether it is right that care provider Sensire gives free iPads to AWBZ-indicated clients and offers lessons on them, and whether this should be paid from AWBZ care funds rather than alternatives such as loans. The state secretary answered that remote care via ICT is desirable and permitted under a new NZa policy rule, that iPads are lent and returned, and that the device does not create an unlawful pull toward the provider.
The use of remote care is permitted.
De inzet van zorg op afstand is geoorloofd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht dat er nog steeds te weinig hulp is voor zwaarst gehandicapten

An MP asks the state secretary of Health, Welfare and Sport about reports that severely disabled people, especially children with behavioural problems, still lack adequate care, and whether parents are forced to care for them at home. The state secretary acknowledges the problem, says she has consulted parents, cannot quantify how many need one-on-one care, and says she has asked an expert panel for interim advice and wants to act quickly rather than wait two years.
I believe action must be taken as quickly as possible.
Ik vind dat er zo snel als mogelijk gehandeld moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over de hoogte van het zak- en kleedgeld van bewoners van zorginstellingen

An MP asked the state secretary whether the earlier study on pocket and clothing money for care home residents, and the Nibud study on laundry costs, remain valid given rising care costs. The secretary confirmed knowledge of the study, said many providers charge less than the Nibud guideline for laundry, and saw no reason to revise the conclusions.
At this moment I see no reason to revise the conclusions on the amount of pocket and clothing money – which is in any case updated every year.
Op dit moment zie ik geen aanleiding om de conclusies over de hoogte van het zak- en kleedgeld – dat overigens ieder jaar wordt geactualiseerd – te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Smilde over het vertrek van de belastingdienst uit Emmen

MPs Wolbert and Smilde asked whether the Tax Authority's departure from Emmen, costing about 300 jobs, had been weighed against regional employment and service to citizens. The minister replied that no decisions on relocation have been taken, that the regional impact will be assessed in the Drenthe office masterplan with the province, and that savings phase in through 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Kuiken over onderzoek dat uitwijst dat wijkverpleegkundigen goedkoper en beter zijn dan verpleeghuiszorg

Two PvdA MPs asked whether research showing district nurses are cheaper and better than nursing-home care (44.7% lower costs in a comparison) holds, and whether more district nurses should be deployed. The state secretary answered that the 44.7% figure rests on a single-client financial comparison that cannot support general conclusions, that the NPCF/V&VN, ZonMw and BMC findings are broadly consistent, and that the NZa will issue a feasibility review before deciding on financing.
It should be clear that no general conclusions can be drawn from this.
Het moge duidelijk zijn dat hieruit geen algemene conclusies getrokken kunnen worden.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Wolbert (beiden PvdA) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het ontbreken van goede mondzorg voor veel verpleeghuisbewoners (ingezonden 5 december

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers about poor oral care in nursing homes, citing research that residents' teeth are rarely brushed and asking about inspection, training, and AWBZ spending. The state secretary acknowledged the risks, pointed to a guideline and training modules, said the Inspectorate may give attention to oral care in a short series of visits, and said spending data and effects of free-market dental tariffs are not yet known.
The inspectorate intends to give oral care extra attention as a specific theme in a short series of visits.
De inspectie is voornemens om mondzorg als specifiek thema in een korte serie bezoeken extra aandacht te geven.

Vragen de leden Wolbert en Heijnen (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat toezichthouders in de zorg de bezoldigingsnorm overschrijden (ingezonden 9 december 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister whether supervisory board members in care institutions exceeding the NVTZ pay norm, and how this relates to the WNT pay-cap amendment. The minister answered that only about 2.5% exceed the norm, that consequences of the amendments are being inventoried, and that under the WNT the accountant reports overruns and she could enforce corrections via a dwangsom or dwangbevel.
I cannot verify whether the remuneration of supervisory board members in an unknown but selected sample has doubled over two years.
Ik kan niet verifiëren of de beloning van toezichthouders in een mij onbekende, maar selecte steekproef in twee jaar is verdubbeld.
Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over misbruik van PGB’s via internetaanvragen (ingezonden 12 december 2011).

MP Wolbert asks the State Secretary for Health about the basis for claiming people obtained PGB care budgets by fabricating disabilities online, and whether this undermines the independent CIZ assessment. The State Secretary points to the attracting effect of the PGB scheme, stresses that an objective CIZ or BJZ indication is always required, and rejects the accusation.
To apply for a pgb, an objective indication from the CIZ or BJZ is always required in all cases.
Om een pgb aan te kunnen vragen, is in alle gevallen een objectieve indicatie van het CIZ of BJZ vereist.

Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het in rekening brengen van extreem hoge waskosten door zorginstellingen (ingezonden 30 november 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary for health about care institutions charging extremely high laundry costs, why the complaints reached client councils but not the NZa, what will be done about board attitudes, when a guide price will come, and whether residents can reclaim payments. The secretary says laundry is not an AWBZ entitlement, pricing is for client councils and providers under the Wet medezeggenschap, the NZa oversees only AWBZ charges, and a Nibud guide price is expected early 2012.
Washing clothes is not an AWBZ entitlement.
Het wassen van kleding is geen AWBZ aanspraak.

Vragen van de leden Jacobi, Van Dekken en Wolbert (allen PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over meerdere gevallen van vergiftiging roofdieren door malafide jagers (ingezonden 15 n

Three PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about poisonings of predators by unlawful hunters, the penalties involved, the lack of national registration, the role of Staatsbosbeheer and whether a temporary hunting ban in Drenthe would be imposed. The state secretary said the Flora- and faunawet provides enforcement powers and hunting licences can be withdrawn, but could not give a complete figure of cases because there is no national registration, and he rejected a hunting ban.
Because there is no national registration, I am currently examining the possibilities of having all suspected dead animals sent to the Central Veterinary Institute (CVI).
Vanwege het ontbreken van een landelijke registratie bezie ik momenteel de mogelijkheden om alle verdachte dode dieren te laten opsturen naar het Central Veterinary Institute (CVI).

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat bewoners van krimpregio’s minder gezond zijn dan bewoners elders in Nederland (in

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about RIVM findings that residents of shrinking regions rate their health lower and have lower life expectancy and higher cardiovascular mortality. The minister answered that the study is a first exploration, that socioeconomic differences explain part of the gap, that a follow-up study was requested, and pointed to existing krimp experiments and convenants with provinces.
The study is a first exploration of the health situation in shrinking regions in the Netherlands.
Het onderzoek is een eerste verkenning van de gezondheidssituatie in krimpregio's in Nederland.

Vragen van de leden Wolbert en Bouwmeester (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat er nauwelijks goede zorg is voor mensen met niet-aangeboren hersenletsel en prob

Two MPs asked the state secretary for health about reports that care for people with acquired brain injury and challenging behaviour is scarce, including claims of 150 people lacking housing and day care and questions about funding gaps. The secretary said the population cannot be counted from existing registrations, described the care landscape and the decentralisation to municipalities, and said the NZa is reviewing whether care-package classification needs changing.
It cannot be derived from existing registrations how many people exactly have NAH and how many of them lack a suitable residence or day care.
Het is niet uit bestaande registraties af te leiden hoeveel mensen er precies met NAH zijn en hoeveel daarvan geen passende verblijfplaats of dagbesteding hebben.

Vragen van de leden Wolbert (PvdA) en Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het beëindigen van de zorginkoop bij een zorgaanbieder in Twente (ingezonden 17 oktober 2011)

Two MPs asked why health insurer Menzis stopped contracting care from Bureau SPV in Twente, whether the underlying research can be shared, who supervises insurers' decisions, and whether there is any non-judicial route to challenge them. The state secretary said the Dutch health care authority (NZa) supervises legality and efficiency, the insurer is responsible for contracting decisions and the research is not held by the ministry, and that the only formal remedy is a court appeal.
No, there are no other formal ways than challenging the decision in court.
Nee er zijn geen andere – formele – manieren dan het besluit aan te vechten bij de rechter.

Vragen van de leden Wolbert en Dijsselbloem (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat drie studiebegeleidingsinstituten officieel erkend zijn als zorginstelling (ing

MPs Wolbert and Dijsselbloem asked whether three Maltha study-guidance institutes approved as care institutions could be funded via the Zvw and AWBZ, and how many pupils would qualify. The state secretary replied that the WTZi approval covers only AWBZ 'begeleiding' for those with serious limitations on self-reliance, not study guidance as such, that CIZ decides case by case, and that municipalities will take over this function under the Wmo.
It is up to the CIZ to decide, on the basis of an individual application, whether a pupil qualifies for AWBZ guidance.
Het is aan het CIZ om op basis van een individuele aanvraag te besluiten of een leerling in aanmerking komt voor AWBZ-begeleiding.

Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de staatsecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat zorgkantoren amper nieuwkomers en kleine zorgaanbieders contracteren (ingezonden 26 september 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether health insurers are contracting few new and small care providers for 2012, and what this means for clients and innovation. The state secretary answers that the first contracting round is ongoing, that insurers apply their own criteria without a contracting obligation, that clients keep choice of providers, and that the new providers have no lost production as they had no contracts yet.
Care offices make agreements with existing and new providers in order to be able to meet the duty of care.
Zorgkantoren maken afspraken met bestaande en nieuwe aanbieders om aan de zorgplicht te kunnen voldoen.
Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het gebrek aan toezicht op pgb-gebruik persoonsgebonden budget (ingezonden 14 september 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about weak oversight of personal budget (pgb) spending, including reports of fraud by care providers and whether regional care offices have adequate incentives to act. The secretary says investigations are ongoing, denies that care offices lack incentives, reports about 6.3 million euro in fraud recovered over 2008-2010, and points to planned fraud-prevention measures.
My department is aware of this report and is in contact with the care office concerned to see what progress they are making in the investigation launched into this case.
Mijn departement is bekend met deze melding en onderhoudt contact met het betreffende zorgkantoor om te bezien welke vorderingen zij maken in het ingestelde onderzoek naar deze zaak.

Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de staatsecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het feit dat Brandon vanaf zijn vertrek uit ’s Heerenloo niet meer vast hoeft te zitten (ingezonden 29 september 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary why Brandon, a resident of a care institution, no longer needs to be physically restrained after moving, and whether good non-restrictive practices should be copied elsewhere. The secretary confirms he is doing well and is not secluded, but says some restriction of movement still counts as involuntary care; she points to a new Zorg en dwang bill, a Denktank Complexe Zorg, and an interim report expected next spring.
Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het nieuws dat het pgb nóg goedkoper is dan het Kabinet dacht (ingezonden 29 september 2011).

MP Wolbert asks the state secretary for Health about reports that the personal budget (pgb) is even cheaper than the cabinet assumed, including whether unspent budgets (around 10%) were accounted for and whether they could be carried over. The state secretary answers that underspending is known and factored in, carry-over is not permitted under budget discipline rules, and the claim that the pgb costs 63% of in-kind care is incorrect, since tariffs are about 75% of maximum rates and actual costs cannot be compared on CVZ data.
No, this is not correct. Any difference in costs between the pgb and in-kind care cannot be determined on the basis of CVZ data.
Nee, dit klopt niet. Een eventueel verschil in kosten tussen pgb en zorg in natura is op basis van CVZ-gegevens niet te maken.
Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat gemeente Amsterdam komt met een eigen pgb-regeling (ingezonden 28 september 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether Amsterdam's planned own personal budget (pgb) scheme for care support is comparable to existing arrangements, whether current pgb holders can keep their budgets, whether the state secretary is responsible for municipal pgb schemes, and how Amsterdam will finance it. The state secretary answers that the scheme is preparation for the 2013 transfer of support care to municipalities, that municipalities cannot guarantee existing pgb holders their budget, that municipal choices are a matter for local councils, and that financing comes from the transferred budget.
It is for the municipal council to form a judgement on local policy and its implementation.
Het is aan de gemeenteraad een oordeel over het lokale beleid en de uitvoering daarvan te vormen.

Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat normaal gedrag in het nieuwe psychologenhandboek als ziek wordt benoemd (ingezonden 10 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary whether the revised DSM manual, which lowers diagnostic thresholds and adds conditions, will increase medicalisation of normal behaviour in the Netherlands and inflate reimbursed treatments, and whether DSM influence and diagnosing-and-treating conflicts of interest can be curbed. The minister replies that the DSM is a professional classification the government does not steer, that the basic health insurance package is being reviewed with the CVZ, that ICF experiments are under way at the CIZ, and that a quality institute will be set up to tighten indication and oversight.
I will remain very critical of possible consequences for the insured package and its 'appropriate use'.
Maar ik zal zeer kritisch blijven kijken naar mogelijke gevolgen voor het verzekerd pakket en het «gepast gebruik» daarvan.

Vragen van de leden Wolbert en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, welzijn en Sport over de manier waarop 12 000 extra handen aan het bed komen (ingezonden 8 september 2011).

Two MPs asked the state secretary how the 12,000 extra care workers would be realised, monitored and financed, and whether the funds would reach frontline care rather than risk reserves or management, plus questions on training, care culture and staff qualifications. The state secretary answered that a convenant with insurers and employers sets the target, progress will be tracked via the labour-market research programme with annual reporting, funds flow through regular contracting under which care offices can intervene, and training and culture change are left largely to institutions.
On progress I will inform your House annually in the labour market letter.
Over de voortgang zal ik uw Kamer jaarlijks in de arbeidsmarktbrief informeren.

Vragen van de leden Wolbert en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de Bredase aanbesteding van hulp in de huishouding in het kader van de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteu

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary of Health, Welfare and Sport about Breda's price-focused tender for home help under the Wmo, including job losses, continuity of care, lower pay for new staff, and alfacheques. The state secretary said the municipality may set quality requirements and let the market price services, pointed to the staff-transfer clause and the VVT collective agreement, and found no reason for concern about alfacheques.
I am closely following the developments in Breda.
Ik volg de ontwikkelingen in Breda nauwgezet.

Vragen van de leden Jacobi, Monasch en Wolbert (allen PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de getroffen maatregelen van een verpleeghuis te Sneek (ingezonden 7 juli 2011).

Three PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about a Friesland nursing home leaving beds empty because of a tight AWBZ budget, whether freed funds for staff would be made more flexible, and how to prevent empty beds alongside growing waiting lists. The state secretary confirmed awareness, said the 12,000 staff convenant is not flexible, and said the NZa advises €25 million in redistribution funds to two care-purchasing concessionaires, which the minister intends to follow, plus a request for further NZa investigation.
I intend to follow this NZa advice.
Ik ben voornemens dit Nza-advies te volgen.
Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de Rotterdamse pgb-fraudezaak (ingezonden 20 juli 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary for Health how the care offices failed to detect non-existent care providers in the Rotterdam personal-budget (pgb) fraud case, whether continued misuse is being prevented, whether medical confidentiality hampers prosecution, and whether a mandatory care plan would have prevented the fraud. The secretary says care offices check only selectively, promises to explore identity checks via the GBA and new measures, refers prosecution-related questions to the Minister of Justice, and says a care plan would likely not have prevented the fraud.

Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat slechts 6,5% van de gemeenten de ondersteuning voor mantelzorg op orde heeft (ingezonden 10 mei 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary of Health, Welfare and Sport whether only 6.5% of municipalities have adequate mantelzorg (informal care) support in place, why municipalities report high satisfaction despite this, and whether the ministry monitors Wmo implementation. The state secretary says the figures differ significantly from an earlier baseline study, will consult municipalities, the VNG and Mezzo, and promises two policy letters in autumn with fuller answers.
I want to enter into discussion with parties including the VNG and Mezzo about this.
Ik wil met partijen waaronder de VNG en Mezzo, hierover in gesprek gaan.

Vragen van de leden Jacobi en Wolbert (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de vernielde dassenburchten en vergiftigde wilde dieren in Drenthe (ingezonden 8 april 2011).

MPs Jacobi and Wolbert asked the state secretary about destroyed badger setts and poisoned wildlife in Drenthe, and about penalties and enforcement against illegal pesticide use and animal cruelty. The state secretary answered that such acts are already prohibited and punishable, that fines and economic-offence penalties are sufficient, and pointed to existing animal police and boa training arrangements without committing to new investment.
I consider the fine mentioned in answer 4 sufficiently deterrent for most cases.
Ik acht de bij vraag 4 genoemde boete voldoende afschrikkend voor de meeste gevallen.
Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Wolbert (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat dementiezorg betere opleiding vergt (ingezonden 18 april 2011).

Two MPs asked the minister whether dementia care institutions prioritise small-scale housing over staff training, and whether budget cuts are lowering staff education levels, and how this fits the government's plans to invest in elderly care. The state secretary denied a known causal link, pointed to ongoing Nivel research due end 2011 and to government investment in long-term care staffing and training.
A study is currently under way, partly at the request of the House of Representatives, into the education level of care staff and the quality of care in nursing and residential homes.
Momenteel is, mede vanuit een vraag van de Tweede Kamer, een onderzoek gaande naar het opleidingsniveau van zorgpersoneel en de kwaliteit van zorgverlening in verzorgings- en verpleeghuizen.

Vragen van de leden Wolbert en Bouwmeester (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over vrijheidsbeperkende maatregelen in zorginstellingen (ingezonden 16 maart 2011).

MPs Wolbert and Bouwmeester asked the state secretary about restrictive measures in care institutions, including the late inspection attention after the Brandon case, the inspectorate's notification duties and frequency of contact, and the role of the CCE expertise centre. The state secretary said the inspectorate will focus on comparable cases, that notification is only mandatory for forced treatment, that a registration and reporting duty is foreseen under the Zorg en Dwang bill, and that data on institutions applying restraints more often is not available.
The Zorg en Dwang bill provides for a registration and reporting duty for all forms of restriction of liberty.
In het wetsvoorstel Zorg en Dwang is voorzien in een registratie en meldplicht van alle vormen van vrijheidsbeperking.

Vragen van de leden Wolbert (PvdA), Voortman (GroenLinks) en Smilde (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het recht van grensarbeiders op een Persoons Gebonden Budget (PGB) in Duitsland (ingezo

MPs asked whether Dutch premium-paying workers living in Germany can obtain a PGB or German Pflegegeld, why the CVZ website suggests otherwise, and what steps the minister will take to change EU rules or allow PGB access. The state secretary answered that PGB is a subsidy not a legal right, EU case law (Molenaar) classes Pflegegeld as a benefit not a service, and the government will examine the issue when legislating the PGB.
Legislating the PGB was agreed in the Coalition and Toleration Agreement.
Het wettelijk regelen van het PGB is afgesproken in het Regeer- en Gedoogakkoord
Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de minister van Defensie over het bericht dat Assen de Johan Willem Friso kazerne gaat verliezen (ingezonden 18 maart 2011).

Labour MP Wolbert asked the Defence Minister about reports that the Assen barracks would lose its air-mobile brigade, mortar brigade and training unit, asking whether this means job losses in the north and how it fits a motion on spreading cuts evenly. The minister declined to comment on the speculation, said cuts are not yet finalised, refused to promise sparing the north, and promised a policy letter in early April.
The decision-making on the budget cut measures has not yet been fully completed.
De besluitvorming over de bezuinigingsmaatregelen is nog niet geheel voltooid.

Vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Wolbert (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat psychiatrische patiënten in Nederland veel vaker alleen gelaten worden (ingezonden 4 feb

MPs Bouwmeester and Wolbert asked the health minister about reports that Dutch psychiatric patients are left alone and separated more often than in other countries, and whether this reflects a policy preference for seclusion over coercive medication. The minister acknowledged high Dutch separation rates, described ongoing policies and projects to reduce coercion, and committed to developing a multidisciplinary guideline and monitoring progress.
Policy aims to limit separation and other coercive measures to a minimum and reduce them as much as possible.
Het beleid is erop gericht om separeren en andere dwangtoepassingen tot het minimum te beperken en zoveel mogelijk terug te dringen.

Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de eigen bijdrage voor begeleiding pas na maanden werd vastgesteld en mensen nu geconfronteerd worden m

MP Wolbert asks the state secretary about delayed and large own-contribution invoices for care support, with no payment arrangement offered, and whether people are dropping support as a result. The state secretary admits delays caused by providers not supplying data, points to payment arrangements on the bill and CAK website, says financial hardship is unknown, and refuses to reconsider the measure.
No data are available on people who have recently stopped ambulatory support.
Over de mensen die recent gestopt zijn met ambulante begeleiding zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar.
Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de IQ-grens voor begeleiding (ingezonden 4 februari 2011).

An MP asks the minister about removing AWBZ care for people with IQ above 70, its effects on young people and on municipalities, and the cumulative impact with other cuts. The state secretary says a study on the affected group is underway with results expected April 2011, commits to an integrated approach with municipalities, and gives no firm numbers yet.
At present I am having research carried out into the size of the group of clients with an IQ between 70 and 85 who use AWBZ care.
Op dit moment laat ik onderzoek doen naar de omvang van de groep cliënten met een IQ tussen de 70 en 85 die gebruikmaken van AWBZ-zorg.

Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over trucs van gemeenten bij de inkoop van hulp in de huishouding ten koste van alfahulpen (ingezonden 23 november 2010).

MP Wolbert asks the state secretary about municipal tricks that channel home-help clients to alfahulpen, including use of a BV as employer, and whether this undermines the 2009 Wmo amendment and worker protections. The secretary rejects the word 'tricks', says the Wmo's informed consent rules apply, and sees no signals of insufficient care from municipalities.
I currently have no signals that the municipalities wishing to introduce the alfacheque are insufficiently accounting for this.
Ik heb thans geen signalen dat de gemeenten die de alfacheque willen invoeren, zich hier onvoldoende rekenschap van geven.

Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een moeder die met het persoonsgebonden budget (PGB) geen kant op kan zonder begeleiding voor haar zoon (ingezonden 31 januari

MP Wolbert asks the health minister whether a mother whose autistic son is cared for through a PGB (personal budget) was discharged from an observation clinic without arranged care, whether budget cuts played a role, how often such discharges occur, who is responsible for helping find care, and what steps will be taken. The state secretary says the clinic and client cannot be identified, that the frequency is unknown but a study on youth with psychiatric problems is underway, that PGB holders are themselves responsible for purchasing care while care-in-kind providers have a duty of care, and that a letter with study results will follow in spring.

Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat een substantieel deel van de ziekenhuisbestuurders in 2009 meer verdiende dan de Balkenendenorm en het door de

An MP asks the health minister about reports that many hospital executives earned more in 2009 than the Balkenende norm and the sector's own maximum income. The minister says the sector code only applies to new contracts, that the Balkenende norm is unsuitable for the sector, and that the pay-cap legislation is with parliament and the motion will be handled during its debate.
The motion can be taken up during the debate on the bill.
De motie zal bij de behandeling van het wetsvoorstel aan de orde kunnen komen.
Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over het terugvorderen van miljoenen in verband met misbruik van pgb’s (ingezonden 26 november 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about Menzis health insurer reclaiming millions from personal budget (pgb) holders in Twente for fraud and poor accountability, whether similar amounts would arise elsewhere, and the status of motions on separating intermediary bureau roles, a quality mark for pgb providers, and advice to file criminal complaints. The state secretary answers that reclaiming unspent funds is routine (about 10% of pgb, over 200 million nationally), describes the ongoing quality mark and comparative information subsidy, says complaints apply where providers act unlawfully, and states that zorgkantoren already use a common control protocol and share fraud signals.
Health insurance offices check on the basis of this control protocol.
Zorgkantoren controleren op basis van dit controleprotocol.
Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over «Dagboek van een bejaardenbroeder» (ingezonden 19 november 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about a newspaper report on a closed dementia ward at Zorggroep Rijnmond where five staff care for 31 residents, questioning whether this is responsible and whether the inspectorate will act. The state secretary replies that staffing is the care provider's responsibility overseen by the Inspectorate, that the inspectorate was informed by the provider itself, and that the forthcoming care principles law will not cover staffing criteria, with a study due in autumn 2011.
How the care institution organises its care is the responsibility of the care institution.
De wijze waarop de zorginstelling de zorg inricht is de verantwoordelijkheid van de zorginstelling.

Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het ontslag van het voltallige huishoudelijk personeel van thuiszorgaanbieder Amstelring (ingezonden 27 september 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about Amstelring dismissing its entire domestic staff after Haarlemmermeer municipality contracted other providers, and whether the municipality meets its Wmo obligations to staff. The state secretary replies that the transfer-of-staff duty rests with new providers, that the municipality enforces it through contract terms, that most staff will move to new providers, and that reintegration responsibility lies with UWV or the municipality.
The municipality oversees that this consultation takes place.
De gemeente ziet er op toe dat dit overleg plaatsvindt.

Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over gemeente Breda die overstapt op alfahulpen in de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning (Wmo) (ingezonden 1 november 2010).

An MP asks the state secretary whether Breda's plan to shift home-care clients toward alfahulp cheques (a PGB) conflicts with the Wmo and the aim of getting more alfahulpen into employment. The state secretary replies that the scheme is lawful, that clients keep the choice and are informed about their employer role, and that the 2010 Wmo amendment remains a good measure.
If the municipality of Breda, like so many municipalities, decides to carry out the assessments itself, this is therefore not in conflict with the law.
Indien de gemeente Breda, zoals zoveel gemeenten, zelf gaat indiceren, is dit dus niet in strijd met de wet.
Vragen van de leden Leijten (SP) en Wolbert (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het mogelijk afschaffen van de Wtcg (ingezonden 26 november 2010).

Two MPs asked the health minister whether she is considering abolishing the Wtcg allowance for chronically ill and disabled people, and what replacement would follow. The minister said the scheme needs improvement and will be evaluated after the 2011 payment round, that abolition would only happen with a replacement, and that a new tax deduction for chronic illness costs is not appropriate since the existing fiscal scheme already covers such costs.
I intend to evaluate the scheme after the 2011 payment round.
Ik ben voornemens om de regeling na de uitkeringsronde van 2011 te evalueren.
Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de minister van Defensie over de gevolgen van de bezuinigingen voor de Johan Willen Friso-Kazerne in Assen (ingezonden 25 november 2010).

MP Wolbert (PvdA) asked the Defence Minister whether the Johan Willem Friso barracks in Assen may close due to defence spending cuts, why light infantry was named, when clarity will come for its 1,500 staff, and how the parliamentary motion on protecting jobs in shrinking regions will be honoured. Minister Hillen answered that defence faces major cuts, that bases in shrinking regions cannot be ruled out, and that the decision on future land use will follow once effects are studied, in a policy letter in spring 2011.
Only after the effects of the cuts on operational capabilities have been established can Defence's future land use be determined.
Pas nadat is vastgesteld wat de gevolgen van de bezuinigingen zijn voor de operationele capaciteiten, kan het toekomstige ruimtebeslag van Defensie worden bepaald.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Wolbert (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over geweld tegen verpleegkundigen (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

MPs Kuiken and Wolbert asked ministers about a survey showing high levels of aggression against nurses, what hospitals do to train staff and share best practice, why nurses may leave, and why threatened nurses often do not file police reports. The government acknowledges the problem, points to employer responsibility under the Arbo law, the Veilige Zorg project, a planned Expertisecentrum VPT, and an information brochure to encourage reporting.

Vragen van de leden Vermeij en Wolbert (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Economische Zaken over het faillissement van Kip caravans (ingezonden 27 september 2010).

MPs Vermeij and Wolbert asked ministers about the bankruptcy of Kip caravans, the chances of a restart, and how UWV, the mobility centre and local/provincial authorities are supporting workers into new jobs. The minister answered that the bankruptcy was declared, 18 parties have expressed interest in a restart, UWV and partners are placing workers, and that businesses and government each bear their own responsibility.
There is thus a realistic chance of a restart, but whether and to what extent results will be achieved with the 18 parties is not yet known at this time.
Er is dus een reële kans op een doorstart, maar of en in hoeverre resultaten bereikt worden met de 18 partijen, is op dit moment nog niet bekend.
Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht onderbezetting in zorginstellingen (ingezonden 17 september 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about reports of summer understaffing in care institutions and whether this is a structural problem, and what measures institutions and the government could take. The minister said the problem is not known to be structural or national, that institutions are primarily responsible for solutions, and that the government subsidises regional cooperation and is discussing an agenda with social partners.
