As far as I am aware, this does not constitute a structural and national problem in care.
Voor zover mij bekend vormt dit geen structureel en landelijk probleem in de zorg.

Vragen van de leden Wolbert en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een stijgend aantal medewerkers uit de zorg dat is ingeschreven bij het UWV (ingezonden 2 september 2010).

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister about a rising number of care workers registered with the UWV, and whether reorganisations, company size or fragmented jobs might cause burnout. The minister answered that personnel policy is primarily the employers' responsibility, that labour conditions inspection falls under the social affairs ministry, and that concerns would be raised with social partners and included in a research programme, without committing to a new investigation.
I will ask social partners about this in my contacts with them.
Daarom ga ik sociale partners daar naar vragen in mijn contacten met hen.

Vragen van de leden Wolbert en Van der Veen (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het feit dat patiënten de dupe worden van voortdurende onduidelijkheid over ziekenhuisverplaatste zorg

MPs Wolbert and Van der Veen asked the health minister about insurer Menzis ending reimbursement for home-administered immunoglobulins, forcing patients toward hospital day treatment and raising unclear NZa rules. The minister answered that Menzis contracted hospitals for this care, that patient-side options exist, and that the bekostiging of home nursing will be evaluated, while not committing to a change in the rules.
Moreover, the House of Representatives has been promised that this new form of funding for nursing will be evaluated.
Overigens is aan de Tweede Kamer toegezegd dat deze nieuwe bekostigingsvorm van de verpleging zal worden geëvalueerd.
Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat steeds meer mantelzorgers stoppen met werken (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

MP Wolbert asked the health minister about reports that more informal carers are quitting or reducing paid work, linked to AWBY package measures, and about support, leave awareness and a carer-friendly employment policy. The minister acknowledged the trend, pointed to existing programmes and municipal support, disputed the 20% leave-awareness figure, and said further measures are for the next cabinet to decide.
It is for the new cabinet to decide whether other measures should be taken, and how developments in this area will be monitored and reported on.
Het is aan het nieuwe kabinet om te bepalen of nog andere maatregelen moeten worden ingezet, en hoe de ontwikkelingen op dit terrein zullen worden gevolgd en hoe daarover zal worden gerapporteerd.
Vragen van de leden Wolbert en Hamer (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over bezuinigingen op de thuiszorg (ingezonden 3 juni 2010).

MPs Wolbert and Hamer asked the health minister about reported cuts of 200 million euros to municipal Wmo home-care budgets, alleged use of that money for medical specialist overruns, and a delayed or reduced reimbursement of Wmo implementation costs. The minister confirmed a structural downward adjustment of 200 million linked to expected efficiency gains and lower personal budgets, said specialist overruns play no role, and stated that no agreement with the VNG has yet been reached and talks continue in September.
After final conclusion of the administrative consultation, I will inform your House and the municipalities of the outcomes.
Na definitieve afronding van het bestuurlijk overleg zal ik uw Kamer en de gemeenten informeren over de uitkomsten.
Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het Utrechts college dat AWBZ-geld achterhoudt (ingezonden 10 juni 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether the Utrecht municipal executive is withholding part of the AWBZ package-measure funds, how many clients lost day care, and whether this conflicts with a motion requiring the funds to be used only for that purpose. The minister confirmed the report, said the number of affected clients is unknown, and said municipalities are free to decide how to support citizens under the Wmo compensation principle.
The municipality of Utrecht is therefore free in how it supports, in 2010 and 2011, citizens affected by the package measure.
De gemeente Utrecht is dus vrij in de wijze waarop zij in 2010 en 2011 burgers die te maken hebben gehad met de gevolgen van de pakketmaatregel ondersteunt
Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de voortgang van onderzoeksprojecten naar palliatieve zorg (ingezonden 2 juni 2010).

Labour MP Wolbert asked the Minister of Health about a reported halt to subsidies for palliative care research projects due to a departmental commitment pause. Minister Klink answered that the pause stems from a possible budget overrun, that subsidy applications will resume once it is lifted, and that institutions are asked to limit adverse effects until 1 August 2010.
As soon as the temporary commitment pause can be lifted, the processing of the subsidy applications for the projects will resume.
Zodra de tijdelijke verplichtingenpauze kan worden opgeheven, wordt de behandeling van de subsidieaanvragen voor de projecten hervat.

m: Motie Mastwijk over overleg met de Kamer voor het aanwijzingsbesluit Natura 2000 Westerschelde en Saeftinghe
Asks the government not to adopt a definitive Natura 2000 designation decision for the Westerschelde and Saeftinghe before separate consultation with the House.
requests the government not to adopt a definitive designation decision before separate consultation with the House has taken place
verzoekt de regering niet over te gaan tot het nemen van een definitief aanwijzingsbesluit voordat hierover separaat overleg met de Kamer heeft plaatsgevonden
Motie Van der Staaij c.s. over regelgeving die een optimale versterking van dijken en waterkeringen beperkt
Asks the government to inventory whether EU rules such as Natura 2000 hinder optimal dike reinforcement and report to the House.
requests the government, in consultation with the water boards, to inventory the extent to which (European) regulations such as Natura 2000 may hinder
verzoekt de regering – mede in overleg met de waterschappen – te inventariseren in hoeverre (Europese) regelgeving, zoals Natura 2000, belemmerend kan werken
Motie Cramer/Mastwijk over bezuinigen op advertentiebudgetten
Asks the government to investigate with infrastructure managers and carriers how advertising budgets can be cut and to inform the House in spring 2010.
and to inform the House about this in spring 2010
en de Kamer hierover voorjaar 2010 te informeren
Motie Mastwijk c.s. over versneld vervangen van relatief vuile motoren van bussen
Motion asks the government to explore accelerated replacement of old diesel bus engines, consult stakeholders on financing, and inform the House by mid-2010.
requests the government to further explore the possibilities of such accelerated replacement of relatively dirty engines in buses
verzoekt de regering de mogelijkheden van zo’n versnelde vervanging van relatief vuile motoren in bussen van het stads- en streekvervoer in Nederland verder te onderzoeken
Motie Snijder-Hazelhoff en Mastwijk over kredieten uit het fonds "Garantie Ondernemingsfinancieringen" voor de agrarische sector
Asks the government to ensure the agricultural sector, especially greenhouse horticulture, can draw credit from the GO guarantee fund by 1 September 2009 or set up a comparable facility.
requests the government to ensure the agricultural sector, especially greenhouse horticulture, as soon as possible
verzoekt de regering er zorg voor te dragen dat de agrarische sector, in het bijzonder de glastuinbouw, zo spoedig mogelijk
Motie Mastwijk c.s. over een garantstelling bij liquiditeitsproblemen in de glastuinbouwde

Asks the government to create, by 1 September 2009 and in consultation with the sector and banks, a guarantee scheme for greenhouse horticulture firms facing liquidity problems, plus related support measures.
requests the government, at very short notice (by 1 September 2009) and in consultation with the sector and banks, to create a provision for a guarantee in case of liquidity problems
verzoekt de regering op zeer korte termijn (uiterlijk 1 september 2009) in overleg met de sector en de banken een voorziening te creëren ten behoeve van een garantstelling bij liquiditeitsproblemen
Motie Waalkens c.s. over het aanmelden van Veenhuizen als sociaal cultureel-historisch erfgoed
Motion asking the government to investigate whether Veenhuizen can be nominated as socio-cultural heritage for the UNESCO World Heritage List.
asks the government to investigate whether Veenhuizen can be nominated as socio-cultural heritage
vraagt de regering te onderzoeken of Veenhuizen als sociaal cultuur-historisch erfgoed aangemeld kan worden
qa: Vragen van het lid Mastwijk (CDA) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de boktor (ingezonden 27 mei 2010).

An MP from the CDA asks the minister whether growers who imported no risk plants from China should bear the costs of the Anoplophora (boktor) controls and destructive sampling as ordinary entrepreneurial risk, and why compensation under Article 4 of the Plant Health Act should not cover them. The minister answers that growers bear this risk as entrepreneurs, that Article 4 only compensates disproportionate damage from Article 3 measures and not imagoschade or trade effects, and that individual requests will be assessed case by case.
I will assess any requests for compensation for disadvantage individually against this background.
Ik zal eventuele verzoeken tot nadeelcompensatie tegen deze achtergrond individueel beoordelen.

m: Amendement van het lid Verkuijlen c.s. over het expliciet strafbaar stellen van huwelijkse uitbuiting
Amends the criminal law on human trafficking to explicitly list forced marriage as a form of exploitation within marital relationships.
With Directive 2024/1712, the Netherlands is obliged to make explicit that exploitation also includes a forced marriage.
Met de richtlijn 2024/1712 wordt Nederland verplicht expliciet te maken dat onder uitbuiting ook een gedwongen huwelijk.
Gewijzigd subamendement van de leden Bikker en Becker ter vervanging van nr. 28 over bij amvb een lager drempelbedrag kunnen vaststellen voor hoogrisicolanden
Subamendment letting an AMvB set a lower donation threshold than 15,000 euro, including zero, for high-risk countries listed in the Wwft.
To this end, the submitters ask the government to align the AMvB with the high-risk list from the Wwft.
Hiertoe verzoeken indieners de regering in de AMvB aan te sluiten bij de hoogrisicolijst uit de Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme (Wwft)
Motie van het lid Becker over de Wtmo per 1 januari 2026 invoeren
Asks the government to do everything possible to bring the Wtmo into force on 1 January 2026 instead of 1 July 2026.
requests the government to do everything possible to be able to introduce the Wtmo on 1 January 2026
verzoekt de regering alles in het werk te zetten om de Wtmo per 1 januari 2026 in te kunnen voeren
Subamendement van de leden Bikker en Becker over bij amvb een lager drempelbedrag kunnen vaststellen voor hoogrisicolanden
Subamendment allowing a general administrative order to set a lower donation threshold, including zero, for donations from high-risk countries under the proposed donation rules.
a lower amount may be set by general administrative order for donations from countries to be designated in that measure
kan bij algemene maatregel van bestuur een lager bedrag worden vastgesteld voor donaties afkomstig uit in die maatregel vast te stellen landen
Motie van het lid Becker over het voorbereiden van een een nieuw meerjarenplan zelfbeschikking en een versterkte aanpak schadelijke praktijken
Asks the government to prepare a new multi-year plan on self-determination and a stronger approach to harmful practices such as female genital mutilation and honour-related violence.
requests the government to prepare a new multi-year plan on self-determination and a strengthened approach to harmful practices
verzoekt de regering een nieuw meerjarenplan zelfbeschikking en een versterkte aanpak schadelijke praktijken voor te bereiden
Motie van het lid Becker over gegevens bijhouden over culturele en religieuze normen en waarden van Nederlanders met een migratieachtergrond

De ministeries hebben geen juridische grondslag voor het verwerken van persoonsgegevens in het kader van de aanpak van problematisch gedrag en ongewenste buitenlandse financiering.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heite en Becker over de ANBI-status van Civitas Christiana in verband met de rechterlijke uitspraak over onrechtmatige uitlatingen die Rutgers in verband brengen met pedofilie

MPs Heite and Becker asked whether the ANBI tax-exempt status of Civitas Christiana should be reviewed after a court ruled it had unlawfully linked Rutgers to paedophilia, and whether the ANBI framework is adequate. The Secretary of State answered that tax confidentiality prevents comment on individual institutions, that the public-benefit test is deliberately neutral, that status is revoked only on limited legal grounds such as a final criminal conviction, and that the cabinet will respond to the ANBI evaluation and explore adding criminal offences before summer.
Because the Tax and Customs Administration is bound by the confidentiality duty of article 67 of the General Tax Act, no further information can be provided about individual institutions.
Omdat de Belastingdienst gehouden is aan de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan geen nadere informatie worden verstrekt over individuele instellingen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Dobbe over de eerdere beantwoording van schriftelijke vragen over het risico op vrouwelijke genitale verminking en het aanzetten daartoe in religieuze context

MPs Becker and Dobbe asked about the effectiveness of border indicators, awareness campaigns, training and follow-up on female genital mutilation risks at Schiphol, and the status of related programmes and research. The government answered that indicators and training are in place, the Marechaussee sees no need for evaluation or stronger controls, campaigns ran with reach figures but no formal evaluation, and a comparative study on preventive protection orders is expected before summer 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Becker over het bericht ‘Hoe Nederlands geld naar radicale kolonisten gaat. De Palestijnen hebben geen macht’

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch donations via the foundation Christenen voor Israël reach radical settlers in the West Bank, and what the government will do about it, including whether the foundation's ANBI tax status and the settlement discouragement policy apply. The minister answered that the government does not supervise financing flows abroad and cannot confirm the claims, that investigation of possible criminal offences is for the Public Prosecution Service, and that the Tax Administration is bound by confidentiality on individual ANBI cases, while restating the policy that contributions to settlements are undesirable.
The cabinet does not have the necessary information to confirm this claim.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over de benodigde informatie om deze bewering te bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Kisteman en Heite over het bericht 'Civitas Christiana voert al jaren een leugen– en lastercampagne tegen Rutgers

MPs Becker, Kisteman and Heite asked the State Secretary of Education about Civitas Christiana's campaign against Rutgers, including its impact on schools, desinformation, foreign influence and the motion on foreign funding. The State Secretary answered that schools must be free from external pressure, pointed to a court ruling against Civitas and to existing support tools, and said the motion on foreign funding is being followed up through consultations and pending legislation.
In addition, the bill on free and safe education will make a confidential counsellor mandatory at every school.
Daarnaast wordt met het wetsvoorstel vrij en veilig onderwijs een vertrouwenspersoon op elke school verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Ellian over Holocausteducatie

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why Holocaust education has not yet become a fixed part of civic integration (inburgering), including whether newcomers should visit sites like the National Holocaust Museum, and when a proposal would follow. The State Secretary answered that Holocaust knowledge is now an explicit part of the integration exam from 1 July 2025, that a feasibility study on museum visits and a teacher survey are underway, and that the Chamber will be informed in the third quarter of 2025.
I expect to inform the Chamber further in the third quarter of 2025 on strengthening Holocaust education in civic integration and the next steps.
Ik verwacht de Kamer in het derde kwartaal van 2025 verder te informeren over het versterken van Holocausteducatie in de inburgering en de vervolgstappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van Campen over het bericht ‘Terwijl Hongaarse parlement Pride verbiedt, radicaliseert Orbán: zijn critici betitelt hij als ‘bedwantsen’’

Two VVD MPs asked the government about Hungary's 2025 anti-LGBTIQ+ legislation banning Pride and restricting assembly, its compatibility with EU fundamental rights, the suspension of EU cohesion funds, and possible Article 7 steps. The minister replied that the Commission must first assess legal compatibility, that the Netherlands has voiced concern bilaterally and in Council of Europe and EU fora, and that the Article 7 majorities are not currently in sight.
The Netherlands calls on the Commission to do this expeditiously and to take action if it finds that EU law has been infringed.
Nederland roept de Commissie op om dit voortvarend te doen en actie te ondernemen indien zij constateert dat het Unierecht is geschonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Van der Werf en Mutluer over de stand van zaken van de aanpak van femicide

MPs Becker, Van der Werf and Mutluer asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the progress of the femicide action plan, including implementation steps, criminalising psychological violence, a 24/7 reporting point, funding, police training, the EU rape-centre directive, stalking, police case coordination, and children's contact with perpetrators after partner killings. The government answered that much detail will follow in a June 2025 progress letter, gave timelines for the bill on psychological violence and the EU directive (delayed to early 2026), described how the 10 million euro is being spent, and defended the existing legal framework on contact after partner killings.
I cannot currently indicate point by point in detail how the implementation of the femicide action plan stands.
Ik kan op dit moment niet per punt in detail aangeven hoe het staat met de implementatie van het plan van aanpak «Stop femicide!».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Tielen over het bericht 'Geen 'kerst', maar wel ramadan mét scheiding mannen en vrouwen bij overheidsorgaan'

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister about reports that the CAK replaced Christmas with a winter party, planned an iftar, and used gender-separated prayer rooms, and asked about its funding and governance. The minister answered that the CAK does not offer separated prayer rooms and still held a Christmas breakfast or lunch, that staff can use internal channels, and that a ministry-wide survey found no separated prayer rooms.
Following the article in HP/De Tijd, I spoke with the CAK's director.
Naar aanleiding van het artikel in HP/DeTijd heb ik gesproken met de bestuurder van het CAK.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Michon-Derkzen over het opzetten van een kaasfabriek in Marokko met Nederlandse subsidies voor deradicalisering

MPs Becker and Michon-Derkzen asked about alleged misuse of Dutch deradicalisation and integration subsidies by Rotterdam foundations, including funding a cheese factory in Morocco, and about the status of prosecution, recovery claims, and radicalisation oversight. The minister answered that the OM prosecuted fraud by the foundations via penal orders, that information sharing with Rotterdam was limited to what the OM judged appropriate, that recovery is limited by a five-year term, and described current prevention policy and evaluation tools.
The OM is currently in discussion with the municipality to determine which information can be shared.
Momenteel is het OM met de gemeente in gesprek om te bezien welke informatie wel kan worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Michon- Derkzen, Becker en Rajkowski over de komst van omstreden predikers naar de Ramadan Expo in de Jaarbeurs

MPs from the VVD asked the Justice and Asylum ministers how to keep three controversial preachers with past antisemitic, homophobic and extremist statements from speaking at the Ramadan Expo in Utrecht, and what could be done about the organisers and the venue. The Minister said the three were barred via SIS signalling, that a court suspended this until a decision on objection, that the municipality holds the power over public order and any prohibition, and that prosecution remains possible if speech is criminal.

On 20 February 2025 the interim relief judge suspended these decisions until six weeks after the decision on the objection, with the result that the alerts in the Schengen Information System were removed and the persons can travel to the Netherlands.

Op 20 februari 2025 heeft de voorzieningenrechter deze besluiten geschorst tot zes weken na bekendmaking van de beslissing op bezwaar, met als gevolg dat de signaleringen in het Schengeninformatiesysteem verwijderd zijn en personen Nederland in kunnen reizen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski, Aartsen en Becker over het bericht 'Duizenden asielzoekers krijgen werkvergunning nu regels soepeler zijn'

VVD MPs asked the ministers about a report that thousands of asylum seekers receive work permits since the 24-week rule was lifted, including refusal rates, processing times, and whether asylum seekers from safe countries or with low chances of asylum can work. The minister answered that the rule change largely explains the rise, about 11% of 2024 applications were refused and 25-30% withdrawn or refused, processing has been partly delayed, only under 1% of permits went to safe-country nationals, and restricting such groups awaits implementation of the EU reception directive by June 2026.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Becker over het bericht ‘Groot gebrek aan noodbedden voor vrouwen die vluchten voor gewelddadige partner: noodgedwongen opgevangen in hotels en vakantieparken’

Two MPs from the VVD asked the state secretaries about a reported shortage of emergency beds for women fleeing violent partners and how many beds are needed under the Istanbul Convention. The minister acknowledged the shortage but said no complete picture exists, pointed to a monitor due in spring 2025, and placed primary responsibility with municipalities, declining to re-index the grant specifically for the 35 centre municipalities.
There is currently no complete picture of the distribution of available emergency beds or of the shortage.
Er is op dit moment geen compleet beeld van verdeling van het aantal beschikbare noodbedden en over het tekort hieraan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Michon-Derkzen over de uitspraak van de Raad van State in de zaak Stichting Femmes For Freedom tegen de burgemeester van Den Haag

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice Minister how the Council of State ruling in the Femmes For Freedom case against The Hague mayor affects mayors' powers to act against preachers inciting violence against women and non-believers, and about possible legislation and EU/foreign comparisons. The minister agreed such incitement is unacceptable, said the Municipal Act gives no basis for preventive action against preachers, pointed to criminal prosecution by the OM, and promised consultation with VNG and to bills on criminalising glorification of terrorism, expected for internet consultation in spring 2025.
Neither the Municipal Act nor the Public Demonstrations Act provides a basis for preventively restricting the constitutional freedom of expression (due to the ban on censorship).
De Gemeentewet noch de Wet openbare manifestaties bieden de grondslag om preventief de grondwettelijke vrijheid van meningsuiting te beperken (vanwege het verbod op censuur).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over de beantwoording van eerdere schriftelijke vragen over het risico op vrouwelijke genitale verminking en het aanzetten daartoe in een religieuze context

An MP asked the Justice and Security and Social Affairs ministers about the handling of earlier written questions on the risk of female genital mutilation and incitement to it in a religious context, including OM prosecution, KMAR indicators, online monitoring, reporting channels and prevention campaigns. The government answered that the OM did not appeal, that prosecutions have not increased, that online monitoring is not actively done by the ministry, that reporting goes to police or Veilig Thuis, and that a campaign was evaluated as successful and extended, with a further advice-duty study completed and information promised for 2025.
The Ministry of Justice and Security does not actively monitor online activities relating to genital mutilation.
Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid monitort online activiteiten met betrekking tot genitale verminking echter niet actief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over de beantwoording van eerdere schriftelijke vragen over het risico op vrouwelijke genitale verminking en het aanzetten daartoe in een religieuze context

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about enforcement and prevention of female genital mutilation (FGM), including whether the OM appealed a case, whether online calls for FGM are monitored, and whether reporting points and campaigns exist. The government answered that no appeal was lodged, enforcement is police and platform responsibility, reporting channels such as Veilig Thuis exist, and prevention campaigns and a parental declaration are in place, though no evaluation of some measures has been done.
The Ministry of Justice and Security does not actively monitor online activities related to genital mutilation.
Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid monitort online activiteiten met betrekking tot genitale verminking echter niet actief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Ellian over het verruimen van de mogelijkheden voor het vervolgen van medeplichtigen bij eergerelateerd geweld

MPs Becker and Ellian asked whether criminal law should be broadened to prosecute accomplices in honour-related violence, citing high figures and the collective nature of such crimes. The minister replied that existing offences and participation forms (co-perpetration, incitement, complicity) and the aggravating factor of premeditation already suffice, that the registration is inherently imperfect, and that no new classification, guideline or statutory article is currently deemed necessary.
Criminal law offers us, through various forms of participation, sufficient instruments to dissect group dynamics and do justice to the complexity of such cases in criminal-law terms.
Het strafrecht biedt ons met verschillende deelnemingsvormen voldoende instrumenten om de groepsdynamiek te ontleden en in strafrechtelijke zin recht te doen aan de complexiteit van dit soort zaken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America, Becker, Michon-Derkzen en Ellian over het bericht 'Omstreden Samidoun-kopstuk Mohammed Khatib komt naar Radboud Universiteit Nijmegen: ’Extremistische haatprediker’'

MPs from the VVD asked ministers whether they would refuse or flag a visa for Mohammed Khatib of Samidoun, whether universities should host such speakers, and what the government will do about foreign influence and the organisation's banning. The ministers answered that Khatib has been flagged in the national alert system and refused entry, that the Radboud University cancelled the lecture, that the government is supporting an EU listing of Samidoun and talking with Germany and the public prosecutor, and that a national antisemitism strategy will follow in autumn.
These conclusions led the Minister for Asylum and Migration, in consultation with the Minister of Justice and Security, to flag the person in E&S.
Deze conclusies hebben ertoe geleid dat de Minister van Asiel en Migratie, in samenspraak met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, betrokkene heeft gesignaleerd in E&S.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk en Van der Werf over het bericht ‘Britse overheid wil vrouwenhaat aanpakken als ‘ideologisch extremisme’’

MP Becker asked the government about the UK's plan to treat misogyny as ideological extremism, and whether the Netherlands should follow with a stronger approach to misogyny, incels and manosphere influencers. The government answers that misogyny is a serious problem covered by existing plans and laws, that it is not classed as an extremist ideology but appears in extremist narratives, and that it will consult the UK and include misogyny in the forthcoming Emancipation Note.
The cabinet therefore does not regard misogyny as an extremist ideology, but it does appear as part of the narrative within various extremist and terrorist ideologies.

Vrouwenhaat wordt door het kabinet daarom niet gezien als een extremistische ideologie, maar komt wel terug als onderdeel in het narratief bij verschillende extremistische en terroristische ideologieën.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Kort en Becker over de nieuwe vo-school van Soner Atasoy

MPs De Kort and Becker asked about the new secondary school founded by Soner Atasoy despite his dismissal as board member of Cornelis Haga Lyceum and AIVD warnings, and about the criteria for school board eligibility, the Tilburg Islamic school, and the 15 km catchment area. The Staatssecretaris answered that Atasoy met all legal requirements, announced a bill to set stricter board requirements for all boards, and deferred structural changes (such as municipal consent rights) until the evaluation of the new founding law at the end of 2025.
My ministry is currently working on a bill that sets further requirements for school boards.
Momenteel werkt mijn ministerie aan een wetsvoorstel waarin nadere eisen worden gesteld aan schoolbesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht dat minder dan de helft van de lhbti+ personen vindt dat het goed gaat met acceptatie

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about a survey showing only 47% of LGBTI+ people think acceptance is going well, and about measures against conservative and foreign influence, and the follow-up on the LGBTI safety action plan. The State Secretary agreed action is needed, announced a study into causes of declining acceptance due in summer 2025, and promised further letters on safety measures, while noting existing disinformation strategy.
I will commission this research this autumn and expect the results of the study before summer 2025.
Ik zet dit najaar de onderzoeksopdracht uit, en verwacht de resultaten van het onderzoek voor de zomer van 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van Campen over het bericht ‘Bulgaria's new anti-LGBTQ law is official. Opponents beg EU to take action.’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether a Bulgarian law banning 'propaganda' of non-traditional sexual orientation and gender identities in and around schools breaches EU non-discrimination principles, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The government answered that the European Commission is primarily responsible for assessing compliance with EU law, that the Netherlands will raise concerns bilaterally and at EU level, has already voiced concerns publicly, and funds LGBTQ+ organisations including in Bulgaria.
The Netherlands will, together with like-minded member states, raise concerns about the amendment bilaterally and at EU level.
Nederland zal, in samenwerking met gelijkgezinde lidstaten, zorgen over de wetswijziging bilateraal en in EU-verband aankaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Bamenga, Becker en Brekelmans over het bericht 'Rwandese ambassade in Den Haag intimideert en bedreigt critici van regime-Kagame in Nederland'

MPs from D66 and VVD asked the ministers about reports that the Rwandan embassy in The Hague intimidated and threatened critics of the Kagame regime, including allegations of plotted assassinations, surveillance of demonstrators, and the role of the 1F procedure and Dutch rule-of-law aid. The minister answered that the ambassador enjoys immunity, that the government condemns foreign interference and has summoned the ambassador, that OM and police handle prosecution, that Dutch rule-of-law aid totalled EUR 144 million and was positively assessed, and that a more intensive anti-interference approach is underway with further letters promised.
It should be noted that the ambassador in the Netherlands enjoys inviolability and immunity, which stands in the way of (supporting) an investigation.
Daarbij moet worden opgemerkt dat de ambassadeur in Nederland onschendbaarheid en immuniteit geniet hetgeen (het ondersteunen van) een onderzoek in de weg staat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Becker, Erkens, Paternotte en Bamenga over ‘het bericht dat de nieuwe partij NL Plan steunt op organisaties verbonden aan de Chinese Communistische Partij’

MPs from VVD and D66 asked ministers about reports that the new party NL Plan received support from organisations linked to the Chinese Communist Party, and about foreign interference and the effectiveness of the ban on foreign donations under the Dutch party financing law. The minister answered that NL Plan reported no donations above the threshold, that enforcement and oversight of the ban are still being assessed, and that a study on Chinese interference and a new political parties law are in preparation.

I would like to refer to the extensive media coverage of the recently arrested employee of German AfD lead candidate Maximilian Krah, who allegedly spied for China, and to the Belgian politician Filip de Winter, who allegedly worked for years on behalf of the Chinese Communist Party.

Ik verwijs hier graag naar de uitgebreide berichtgeving in de media over de recent gearresteerde medewerker van de Duitse AfD-lijsttrekker Maximilian Krah die gespioneerd zou hebben voor China en over de Belgische politicus Filip de Winter die jarenlang in opdracht van de Chinese Communistische Partij gewerkt zou hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht 'Minder dan helft Amsterdamse jongeren zegt homoseksualiteit te accepteren'

An MP asked the government about a report that fewer than half of Amsterdam youths accept homosexuality, and about causes, school obligations and planned action. The State Secretary answered that acceptance has fallen sharply in the Gezondheidsmonitor Jeugd, that no causal research exists, that data cover only the regions surveyed, and that the government will consult COC and others and encourage Amsterdam to act.
I will share these reports with your House.
Ik zal deze rapporten met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Kisteman over het bericht «Steeds meer Twentse scholen vinden Paarse Vrijdag maar gedoe»

MPs Becker and Kisteman asked the State Secretary of Education about a report that more Twente schools find Paarse Vrijdag (Purple Friday, an LGBTIQ+ awareness initiative) burdensome, and about acceptance, safety, and support for LGBTIQ+ pupils. The answers affirm the importance of sexual diversity education, report COC-coordinated participation by nearly 3,000 school locations, describe ministry subsidies and support for GSAs, and promise talks with Twente schools and further follow-up on the evaluation of the safety action plan.
I am happy to discuss this with the Twente secondary schools and the Healthy School Programme
Ik ga hier graag over in gesprek met de Twentse middelbare scholen en het Programma Gezonde School
Antwoord op van de leden Becker en Michon-Derkzen over “recente berichtgeving rond haatimams in Nederland”

MPs Becker and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and Justice about reports of hate-preaching imams in the Netherlands, including whether prosecution is underway, whether residence permits can be revoked, funding transparency of Ar-Rahmah, and whether municipalities can prevent such speakers. The government answered that individual cases cannot be discussed, that prosecution is for the OM to decide, that revocation is possible only under strict proportionality rules, and that legislation on transparency and informal education oversight is in preparation.
For this reason, it is not appropriate for us as Ministers of Social Affairs and Employment and of Justice and Security to address investigations into individual cases.
Daarom past het ons als Ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Justitie en Veiligheid niet om in te gaan op onderzoeken naar individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Becker over het bericht ‘In Gambia dreigt genitale verminking weer legaal te worden’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether the government would act against a Gambian bill that would legalise female genital mutilation, including aid, diplomatic contacts and prevention in the Netherlands. The government answered that it opposes FGM, has raised the issue with the Gambian government and works through EU projects and campaigns, but has no direct Dutch programmes on FGM in Gambia.
Our ambassador in Dakar has repeatedly discussed the Dutch position on the bill to legalise female genital mutilation with representatives of the Gambian government.

Onze ambassadeur in Dakar heeft de Nederlandse positie met betrekking tot het wetsvoorstel betreffende legalisering van vrouwelijke genitale verminking meermaals met vertegenwoordigers van de Gambiaanse regering besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Bamenga, Becker en Brekelmans over de beantwoording van eerdere schriftelijke vragen over door de Chinese overheid gefinancierde weekendscholen

MPs Paternotte, Bamenga, Becker and Brekelmans asked whether the government has oversight of Chinese state-funded weekend schools and their teaching materials, and about the delayed bill on supervising informal education. The minister says the government has no full overview of informal education, will seek talks with China and consider signal-based supervision, but gives no firm timeline beyond consultation before Prinsjesdag.
I will make efforts to enter into consultation with the Chinese government and will ask whether they can provide the transparency you desire.
Ik zal mij inspannen om in overleg te treden met de Chinese overheid (zie mijn antwoord op vraag 9) en zal daar vragen of zij de door u gewenste transparantie kunnen bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Michon-Derkzen over een conferentie door Hizb ut Tharir in Nederland

MPs Becker and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked about a March 2024 Hizb ut-Tahrir conference in Amsterdam, its extremist character, visa refusals, the possibility of banning the organisation, and the status of the government's problematic-conduct taskforce. The minister answered that speech crimes can be reported and prosecuted by the police and Openbaar Ministerie, that the AIVD rates the threat as low, that banning is for the prosecutor to decide, and that the taskforce has no legal basis for sharing case information.
The Openbaar Ministerie can ask the court to prohibit and dissolve an organisation under article 2:20 of the Civil Code.
Het Openbaar Ministerie kan de rechter verzoeken een organisatie te verbieden en ontbinden op grond van artikel 2:20 Burgerlijk Wetboek
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Becker over het bericht ‘Oeganda handhaaft een van de strengste antihomowetten ter wereld

MPs Kamminga and Becker asked whether the government will reduce development aid to Uganda after its Constitutional Court let the Anti-Homosexuality Act stand, and about related steps and international coordination. The minister answers that the government has already stopped direct budget support to the central Ugandan state (JLOS programme, Orange Knowledge scholarships), rejects further aid cuts to civil society and multilateral programmes, and describes diplomatic and multilateral efforts without committing to new concrete action.
Yes, the cabinet is of the view that this is a very worrying development.
Ja, het kabinet is van mening dat dit een zeer zorgelijke ontwikkeling is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Brekelmans en Michon-Derkzen over de rellen in Den Haag tussen groepen Eritreers

MPs Becker, Brekelmans and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked the Justice Minister about violent clashes in The Hague between Eritrean groups, the handling of perpetrators, residence-permit consequences, and foreign interference by the Eritrean regime. The minister answered that the matter is under criminal investigation, outlined existing legal grounds for revoking permits, and said the government has taken diplomatic steps and is developing a complaints point for victims of foreign interference.
Since this is still an ongoing investigation, no further substantive information can be provided.
Nu het nog een lopend onderzoek betreft kunnen geen nadere inhoudelijke mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en De Kort over het bericht ‘hoe wenselijk zijn islamitische scholen?’

MPs Becker and De Kort asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education whether Islamic schools' rules (gender-segregated classes, pop-music ban, resilience training against LGBTIQ+ ideology) fit the civic-education duty, and how the inspectorate checks this. The minister says segregation and such teaching are not desirable but are allowed under conditions, that the inspectorate supervises the civic-education duty, and that no talks with schools are currently needed.
The inspectorate will investigate the named schools further if it sees reason to do so.
De inspectie zal nader onderzoek doen naar de genoemde scholen, als zij daar aanleiding toe ziet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en De Kort over het bericht 'Turkse sekte met tweeëntwintig moskee-internaten stapt nu in scholen'

MPs Becker and De Kort asked about reports that a Turkish religious movement with boarding schools was entering mainstream schools in Amsterdam and Rotterdam, raising concerns about civic integration, founder backgrounds, oversight of the approval process and boarding houses. The government answered that the schools meet all legal founding requirements and may open in August 2024, that inspectorates monitor civic education, that it can refuse applications where concrete signals exist, but that no such signals were received, and that the boarding-house oversight and the planned informal-education bill are being maintained.
The powers to investigate persons and/or civil society organisations are not vested in the Ministries of Education, Culture and Science, Social Affairs and Employment, and Health, Welfare and Sport.

De bevoegdheden om onderzoek te doen naar personen en/of maatschappelijke organisaties zijn niet belegd bij de Ministeries van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (OCW), Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (SZW) en Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (VWS).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en De Kort over het artikel “Dit is de extreem-conservatieve club die zich ook dit jaar verzet tegen lessen over seks”

Two VVD MPs asked the Education Minister whether pressure by Civitas Christiana on schools to avoid sex-education material (Rutgers) is unacceptable, whether schools are obliged to teach respect for sexual diversity, and whether the government will monitor and act. The minister called the pressure undesirable and misleading, said schools are free to choose materials and reported no known cases of schools dropping them, but stated that the ministries have no legal basis to investigate or ban such organisations and offered support and a newsletter instead.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Becker over het bericht ‘Parlement Ghana akkoord met wet die lhbti’s celstraf oplevert’

MPs Kamminga and Becker asked the government how it responds to Ghana's parliament passing a law criminalising LGBTI identification and funding, and what action it will take on human rights and aid. The ministers say they are concerned, have raised the issue bilaterally and in EU and Equal Rights Coalition settings, but avoid public statements and will review aid only after the president signs the law.
The cabinet finds it worrying that the so-called Human Sexual Rights and Family Values law has been adopted by Ghana's parliament.
Het kabinet vindt het zorgelijk dat de zogenaamde Human Sexual Rights and Family Values wet is aangenomen door het parlement van Ghana.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Ellian over het bericht 'Aanpak stalking schiet vijf jaar na moord op Hümeyra nog altijd te kort'

MPs Becker and Ellian (VVD) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about stalking enforcement after the murder of Hümeyra, a femicide plan, a definition of femicide, a victim device for stalkers, the SASH risk tool, and whether serious domestic abuse could be handled via fast-track justice. The Minister answered that a femicide plan is due in April 2024, outlined a definition, reported on the victim device pilot, and rejected fast-track prosecution as unsuitable for domestic abuse cases.
I have asked the Research and Documentation Centre (WODC) to explore how we can routinely carry out such a structured analysis of cases in the Netherlands.
Ik heb het Wetenschappelijk Onderzoek- en Datacentrum (WODC) gevraagd om te verkennen hoe we een dergelijke gestructureerde analyse van casussen standaard kunnen uitvoeren in Nederland
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Roep in Amsterdam om weren Samidoun kopstuk'

MPs Becker and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked whether Amsterdam or the national government can ban Samidoun-linked speaker Mohamed al Khatib from events in the Netherlands, given his alleged membership of a banned terrorist organisation. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that the IND found insufficient grounds for exclusion, that local authorities cannot impose a ban on the closed event, and that the government will keep monitoring the risks.

On the basis of the available information, there is insufficient ground in this case to conclude that the person's individual conduct constitutes a genuine, present and sufficiently serious threat to a fundamental interest of society.

Op basis van de beschikbare informatie is er in deze zaak onvoldoende grond om te concluderen dat het persoonlijk gedrag van betrokkene een werkelijke, actuele en voldoende ernstige bedreiging voor een fundamenteel belang van de samenleving vormt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Bamenga, Becker en Brekelman over het nieuwsbericht 'Chinese overheid sponsort weekendles Chinees-Nederlandse kinderen'

MPs from D66 and VVD asked the government about RTL reporting on Chinese state-funded weekend schools for Chinese-Dutch children, including oversight, visas for Chinese teachers, foreign interference and possible visitation of schools. The government answered that it has no data on these informal schools, that it is working on a bill for signal-based oversight, and that it sees no reason yet to raise the matter with the Chinese government.
The cabinet does not have figures on informal education institutions, where they are located, how many pupils attend them, or what their funding structure is.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over cijfers van instellingen voor informeel onderwijs, waar zij zich bevinden, hoeveel leerlingen deze instellingen bezoeken of hoe de financieringsstructuur eruit ziet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Brekelmans over het bericht 'Erdogan: Hamas is geen terroristische organisatie'

Two VVD MPs asked ministers about President Erdogan calling Hamas a liberation group, whether Turkish-funded mosques and schools spread such views, and how the government counters foreign influence and antisemitism. The ministers condemned Hamas as terrorist, said they raised the issue with Turkey and monitor foreign interference, but declined to investigate specific mosques or schools, citing lack of competence and absence of signals.
The Ministries of Social Affairs and Employment and of Foreign Affairs are not authorised to investigate persons or organisations.
De Ministeries van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en Buitenlandse Zaken zijn niet bevoegd onderzoek naar personen of organisaties te verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van der Woude over het artikel ‘Exorcisten ’De Laatste Reformatie’ onder vuur: duiveluitdrijvingen bij kinderen en wegbidden autisme’

MPs Becker and Van der Woude asked about reports of exorcisms of children and prayer to cure autism by the group De Laatste Reformatie, covering child protection, reporting routes, foreign contacts, visas and a promised law on informal education. The government condemned such practices, pointed to Veilig Thuis, the police and existing child protection tools, declined a new investigation or legal measures against the group citing religious freedom, and said it had no knowledge of a promised study on the scale of exorcisms.
I do not intend to investigate this further.
Ik ben niet voornemens dit nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over de uitvoering van het amendement Becker c.s. over voor- en vroegschoolse educatie voor kinderen van inburgeraars (35483-51)

Becker (VVD) asks how the adopted amendment requiring municipalities to address pre- and early-school education (VVE) for children of integration-obliged migrants is implemented, including agreements in the integration plan, participation figures and monitoring. The minister answers that no national data exist on agreements or participation, that municipalities only stimulate rather than must offer VVE, and that a qualitative study will report in 2024.
I do not have national figures on the agreements in the PIP.
Ik beschik niet over landelijke cijfers over de afspraken in het PIP.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Brekelmans over het bericht ‘Turkse Nederlanders mogen opnieuw in Amsterdam stemmen, extra aandacht voor veiligheid’

Two VVD MPs asked about reports that Turkish voters in Amsterdam could vote again amid safety concerns, including who organised the polling locations, the role of Turkish and Dutch authorities, campaign rules and possible foreign interference. The government answered that foreign states organise their own elections with local authorities advising on safety, that Turkish consulates submitted security plans, that campaigning by foreign officials is restricted, and that it would not commit to changing how voting is organised.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs was informed in a timely and complete manner, both in writing and orally, by the Turkish embassy about how the voting process for the 2023 Turkish presidential and parliamentary elections would be organised in the Netherlands.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken is tijdig en volledig, zowel schriftelijk als mondeling, door de Turkse ambassade op de hoogte gebracht van de wijze waarop het stemproces voor de Turkse presidentiële en parlementaire verkiezingen van 2023 in Nederland wordt georganiseerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Zelfbenoemde salafistenpolitie zaait angst in moskeeën: moslims met verkeerd geloof aan schandpaal genageld; AIVD en NCTV waarschuwen: salafistis

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about the salafist 'self-appointed police' in mosques and whether intelligence and counterterrorism gaps, imam recruitment from abroad, and information-sharing need tightening. The government answered at length: it says the NCTV lacks a legal basis to process personal data from social media, the bill on casus consultations is needed, soft signals cannot be shared with foreign countries under current law, and it is working on an imam training route and transparency rules, while declining a single legal definition of problematic behaviour.
The NCTV currently has no legal basis for processing personal data and therefore cannot consult social media sources, resulting in a more limited view.
De NCTV heeft op dit moment geen grondslag voor het verwerken van persoonsgegevens, en kan derhalve geen sociale media-bronnen raadplegen en heeft dus ook beperkter zicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht van Omrop Fryslân op 30 november 2022 'Grote stroom aan nieuwe leerlingen op internationale scholen levert problemen op'

MP Becker asked the minister about reports of long waiting lists for ISK international bridge classes for newly arrived young migrants, the two-year funding start date, data gaps, inspection and PABO attention to newcomer education. The minister acknowledges severe capacity shortages, promises an emergency bill for temporary arrangements by early June, will review funding timing, admits lack of registration and monitoring data, and commits to a later exploration of regular newcomer education.
At present there is no statutory obligation to register newcomer education as such.
Op dit moment is er geen wettelijke verplichting om het nieuwkomersonderwijs als dusdanig te registreren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het risico op genitale verminking en het aanzetten daartoe in een religieuze context

An MP asked the government about calls to female genital mutilation in a religious setting, whether such statements incite violence, which legal or administrative tools exist, and how girls at risk abroad are protected. The government answered that incitement to violence is criminal regardless of context, that statements not amounting to crime cannot be countered administratively, and it outlined prevention measures, airport alertness indicators, and a planned bill on informal education.

Statements about female genital mutilation that do not constitute a criminal offence are protected by freedom of expression under Article 7 of the Constitution and Article 10 of the European Convention on Human Rights.

Uitlatingen over vrouwelijke genitale verminking die geen strafbaar feit opleveren, worden beschermd door de vrijheid van meningsuiting, hetgeen is vervat in artikel 7 van de Grondwet en artikel 10 van het Verdrag tot bescherming van de rechten van de mens en de fundamentele vrijheden (EVRM).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het in Nederland oprichten van zogenaamde Fatwa-units

An MP asked whether the Turkish government, via Diyanet and ISN, set up 'fatwa units' in the Netherlands, how they are financed, and what the government will do about foreign influence and vulnerable youth. The minister answered that ISN said it was unaware of such units, that the Dutch legal framework limits religious advice, and pointed to the pending transparency bill and the existing foreign-interference approach.
I am not aware whether this happens in an organised manner within the Islamic tradition in the Netherlands.
Het is mij niet bekend of dit binnen de islamitische traditie in Nederland in georganiseerd verband gebeurt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Becker over het bericht 'Zelfbenoemde salafistenpolitie zaait angst in moskeeën: moslims met ‘verkeerd geloof’ aan schandpaal genageld; AIVD en NCTV waarschuwen: salafist

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about a Telegraaf report on self-appointed 'salafist police' intimidating mosques and imams, and about how the state can detect and act against salafist preachers. The government answered that intimidation is unacceptable and that the NCTV, police, municipalities and a taskforce have limited legal grounds, so some tools (data processing, Europol exchange, online removal) remain constrained, while promising legislation and a strategy on online radicalisation.

For the Taskforce on Problematic Behaviour and Undesirable Foreign Financing, and at the request of local authorities, the NCTV provided assessments of individual persons, including salafist preachers.

Ten behoeve van de Taskforce Problematisch gedrag en ongewenste buitenlandse financiering, alsmede op verzoek van lokale overheden, verstrekte de NCTV duidingen over individuele personen, ook over salafistische aanjagers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het actiever werk maken van werkervaring voor statushouders tijdens de inburgering, ook in tekortsectoren

The VVD MP Becker asks whether municipalities offer too few work-experience placements to asylum-status holders during integration, especially in shortage sectors, and what obstacles exist. Minister Van Gennip responds that she will discuss the issue with the Taskforce Werk en Integratie and branch organisations, that dual trajectories are being monitored, that she has received no signals of municipal reluctance, and that municipal autonomy under the Wi2021 is deliberate.
I will soon enter into discussion with the Taskforce Werk en Integratie.
Ik ga binnenkort in gesprek met de Taskforce Werk en Integratie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Yassini en Becker over het artikel ‘Arbeidsmigranten profiteren van leefgeld voor Oekraïense vluchtelingen: ‘Mogelijk misbruik’

MPs El Yassini and Becker asked whether Ukrainian labour migrants already resident in the Netherlands are wrongly receiving living allowance (leefgeld) under the refugee reception scheme, and whether municipalities can verify eligibility. The government says the scheme is deliberately broad, municipalities cannot refuse eligible applicants, data-sharing with UWV is being examined, and it will look into pressure on workers, with no firm numbers on the misuse.
No figures are available on the number of labour migrants who were already residing in the Netherlands and fall under the Temporary Protection Directive.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar van het aantal arbeidsmigranten die al in Nederland verbleven en onder de Richtlijn Tijdelijke Bescherming (RTB) vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Becker over het bericht dat statushouders en nieuwkomers van buiten de EU het personeelstekort in de hartzorg verkleinen

MPs Van den Hil and Becker asked about reports that refugees and non-EU newcomers are easing health-care staffing shortages, and how to speed up BIG registration and link newcomers with care jobs. The minister answered that the government supports win-win approaches, cites a pilot mentoring project and the TAZ programme, and says no overview of municipal arrangements exists nationally.
An overview of all ongoing agreements between municipalities and care institutions on job placement and work experience places does not exist at national level.
Een overzicht van alle lopende afspraken van gemeenten met zorginstellingen bij de bemiddeling naar werk en/of werkervaringsplekken is er niet op landelijk niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker en De Kort over het bericht ‘Rotterdam geeft statushouders baan: ‘Rijk moet ook bijspringen.’

MPs Becker and De Kort asked the Minister of Social Affairs about Rotterdam's plan to give asylum-status holders (statushouders) jobs through learn-work tracks and whether the national government should contribute. The minister explains that Rotterdam's tracks give regular employment rather than subsidised jobs, that the 23 participants at the municipality all moved into jobs, and that funding and sector-matching options are being explored, while the ministry will share lessons and join local follow-up talks.
I agree that the learn-work tracks for asylum-status holders ideally lead to them standing on their own feet.
Ik ben het met u eens dat de leerwerktrajecten voor statushouders er idealiter toe leiden dat de statushouders op eigen benen komen te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Verkuijlen over het bericht dat mogelijk ook een Nederlandse moskee een rol speelt in constructies voor mensenhandel en prostitutie

MPs Becker and Verkuijlen asked the government about reports that Dutch mosques may be involved in sham 'pleasure marriages' linked to sex work and trafficking, and about possible investigation, prosecution and sanctions. The minister answered that no signals of such marriages in the Netherlands have been received, that no investigation is planned, that the OM sees no current signs of crimes, and that the Taskforce cannot investigate individuals, while pointing to the pending Wtmo amendment and other planned instruments.
The OM has indicated that there are currently no signals of criminal offences.
Het OM heeft laten weten dat er op dit moment geen signalen zijn van strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Becker over het nieuwe inspectierapport over het Cornelius Haga Lyceum

MPs Paul and Becker (VVD) asked the minister why the Cornelius Haga Lyceum's education quality deteriorated, why the school remains open despite serious concerns, and what sanctions and faster intervention are possible. Minister Wiersma answered that the inspectorate rated all departments very weak, outlined sanctions already applied and options still available, and said she will inform parliament before summer on faster intervention for underperforming schools.
If education does not improve within a year, the limit has been reached and I will intervene.
Indien het onderwijs niet binnen een jaar verbetert, is de maat vol en zal ik ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Becker over het bericht ‘Menstruatie meteen melden bij de juf – straks ook in het Westland’

MPs Paul and Becker asked the Education and Social Affairs ministers about an Islamic school board's rule requiring girls to report menstruation to teachers before joining prayer, and about citizenship education and oversight of Islamic schools. The minister answered that the rule was unacceptable, that the Inspectorate contacted the board which agreed to remove it, and that the government will use the Inspectorate, the safety duty and a planned expansion of administrative powers, while stating the matter would be raised with the municipality.
In this case, the inspectorate discussed the entire identity policy, as it appeared on the website, with the board.
In dit geval heeft de inspectie het hele identiteitsbeleid zoals dat op de website stond besproken met het bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Rajkowski over het bericht 'Erdogans Trolle Schwören sich auf Wahlkampf ein'

MPs Becker and Rajkowski asked the government about reports that Turkish influencers and trolls target Turkish-Dutch and German voters ahead of Turkey's 2023 elections, and whether this interference happens in the Netherlands, along with related questions on counter-strategies, UETD training of candidates, campaign rules and social media regulation. The government condemned unwanted foreign interference, said it has no signals that Turkey is interfering in the 2023 elections, pointed to its existing counter-interference approach, support for municipalities and the Digital Services Act, and did not provide figures on UETD-trained candidates.
These figures are not known to the central government.
Deze cijfers zijn niet bekend bij de rijksoverheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Rajkowski over de uitvoering van de gewijzigde motie Becker c.s. over het structureel tegengaan van extremistische uitingen online

MPs Becker and Rajkowski asked how the government will implement the amended Becker motion on structurally countering extremist online expression, including the role of the new terrorist content authority, cooperation with platforms, financing, and Taskforce casework. Minister Van Gennip answered that extremist but non-terrorist online content falls outside the new authority's mandate on proportionality grounds, that the DSA will be used to tighten notice-and-action procedures, and that the Justice Minister will map preventive and repressive instruments, while many questions were answered only by reference to earlier answers or not answered in time.

To consider what options exist to act against this kind of harmful content, the Minister of Justice and Security will map which preventive and repressive instruments other countries have and what these offer the Netherlands.

Om te bezien wat de mogelijkheden zijn om juist tegen dit soort schadelijke content op te treden zal de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid in kaart brengen over wat voor preventief en repressief instrumentarium landen om ons heen beschikken en welke mogelijkheden dit biedt voor Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Brekelmans over de participatie van Oekraïense vluchtelingen in onze samenleving

MPs Becker and Brekelmans asked the government about the reception, municipal costs, income support, integration and work of Ukrainian refugees, including whether mayors could be made legally responsible for reception. The minister answered that the mayors were given a statutory reception duty from 1 April 2022, that municipal costs will be fully reimbursed by central government, that Ukrainians are not subject to the civic integration obligation, and that further proposals on language and work are still being developed.
Your House has been informed about this by letter of 30 March.
Uw Kamer is hierover per brief van 30 maart jl. geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het gebrek aan een planning rond afspraken over eergerelateerd geweld en zelfbeschikking uit het coalitieakkoord

The MP Becker asked the ministers whether the coalition agreement's commitments on honour-related violence, self-determination and female genital mutilation are adequately planned, and when proposals on penalties, reporting duties and protection orders will come. The government answers that a multi-year prevention programme on self-determination and a broader plan on harmful practices will be sent to the House before the summer recess, that existing law already allows prosecution of accomplices, and that no separate proposal will be sent on that point.
As indicated in the answer to question 5, the House will be further informed about the approach to harmful practices, including a multi-year programme to promote self-determination.

Zoals in het antwoord op vraag 5 aangegeven, wordt uw Kamer nader geïnformeerd over de inzet op schadelijke praktijken waaronder ook over een meerjarig programma gericht op de bevordering van zelfbeschikking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over zorgwekkende cijfers uit achterstandswijken en armoede onder Syriërs

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Social Affairs about alarming poverty figures among Syrian migrants, whether this calls for restricting immigration, and about inburgering exemptions, the link between poverty and integration, the VIA programme, and raising naturalisation language requirements. The minister said integration takes time, cited research showing that completing inburgering raises employment, outlined measures such as the new Inburgeringswet and the Werkagenda VIA, and promised further information on naturalisation language requirements after the summer.
Your House will be informed about this after the summer.
Uw Kamer wordt hier na de zomer over geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude, Kamminga en Becker over het bericht 'French government protests EU Commissioner meeting with 'Islamist' NGO'

MPs Van der Woude, Kamminga and Becker asked ministers about an EU Commissioner's meeting with the FEMYSO network, reported as Islamist, and about whether Dutch student associations linked to FEMYSO received university funding. The government declined to endorse the French criticism, said it supports broad civil-society consultation, reported limited funding details from universities, and said the Taskforce on problematic behaviour and undesirable foreign financing would act only if concrete problematic conduct arose.
The cabinet has confidence that our higher education institutions are well able to critically assess applications for financial support for student organisations
Het kabinet heeft er vertrouwen in dat onze instellingen voor hoger onderwijs uitstekend in staat zijn om aanvragen voor financiële ondersteuning voor studentenorganisaties kritisch te beoordelen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van den Hil over het bericht ‘Meldingen eergerelateerd geweld stijgen, opvang vol’

Two VVD MPs asked the government about reports that honour-related violence notifications are rising while shelter places are full, including shelter capacity, perpetrator removal, early recognition and a multi-year action programme. The government answered that notifications rose only slightly in 2020, that shelter demand peaked and was temporarily solved, that criminal law tools exist, and that work on prevention and a follow-up exploration is ongoing.
Talks are now taking place between the VNG, municipalities and care providers on the availability, occupancy and financing of this specialised shelter, with the aim of reaching a structural solution.

Er vinden nu gesprekken plaats tussen VNG, gemeenten en betrokken zorgaanbieders over de beschikbaarheid, bezetting en financiering van deze specialistische vorm van opvang, met als doel om tot een structurele oplossing te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over ondersteuning van LHBTI ‘ers in gesloten gemeenschappen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about support for LHBTI people in closed migrant and religious communities, including survey figures on acceptance and the status of a 3 million euro budget amendment. The minister cited SCP survey data showing lower acceptance in some communities, listed existing projects, and said an exploratory study would be carried out in autumn before implementing the amendment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over integratiesubsidies in Nederland

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Social Affairs about integration subsidies in the Netherlands, including misuse risks, an overview of subsidies, the Consortium Zelfbeschikking, and informal religious schooling projects. The minister answered that subsidy safeguards exist, listed current subsidies, explained the alliance funding, said municipalities decide on their own subsidies, and described pilots to improve informal schooling, but did not answer all questions individually.
No, unfortunately that did not succeed.
Nee, dat is helaas niet gelukt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over de uitvoering van toezeggingen en moties van het notaoverleg 'In Nederland beslis je over je eigen leven'

An MP from the VVD asked the ministers about implementation of motions and commitments on honour-related violence, forced marriage protection, female genital mutilation registration and the possible criminalisation of hymen restoration. The State Secretary replied that the government is following up on these motions through action programmes, investigations and working groups, with most results promised in later progress letters.
I informed your House on 18 March 2021 about the progress of the action agenda on harmful practices.
Ik heb uw Kamer op 18 maart 2021 geïnformeerd over de voortgang van de actieagenda schadelijke praktijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht 'Omstreden imam Fawaz Jneid blijft ‘ongewenst’, maar gemeente kan hem geen strobreed in de weg leggen'

MP Becker (VVD) asks why the minister extended a area ban on Fawaz Jneid, whether he will appeal a court ruling lifting the ban for two Den Haag neighbourhoods, and how he weighs local concerns about radicalisation. The minister says no appeal was filed because new facts are needed and the court found insufficient link to those neighbourhoods, and that a new ban would require fresh facts, while local monitoring and prevention continue.
Given the information in the administrative report underlying the area ban in relation to the court's ruling, I consider an appeal to have no prospect of success.

Gelet op de informatie in de bestuurlijke rapportage die ten grondslag ligt aan het betreffende gebiedsverbod in relatie tot de uitspraak van de rechtbank acht ik een hoger beroep geen kans van slagen te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'Geheime ‘Turkije analyse’ NCTV lekt uit: grote rol Erdogan bij opkomst salafisme in Nederland'

MPs Becker and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked the government about a leaked confidential NCTV analysis linking Erdogan to the rise of salafism in the Netherlands, and about follow-up on related motions. The Minister declined to discuss the draft analysis's contents, referred to existing policy and a forthcoming final analysis, and answered the remaining questions largely by pointing to ongoing work and existing frameworks.
At this moment I cannot address the questions posed by your House about the content of the draft analysis.
Ik kan op dit moment niet ingaan op door uw Kamer gestelde vragen over de inhoud van de conceptanalyse.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Wörsdörfer over signalen over problematiek samenhangend met de overgang van statushouders van een AZC naar de gemeente

VVD MPs asked how status holders are transferred from asylum reception centres to municipalities, what factors guide placement, what funding and information municipalities receive, and whether their care needs and municipal difficulties are being addressed. The State Secretary explained the COA-to-municipality matching and information-sharing process, noted some information gaps and a review underway, and stated that funding and care needs are handled under the same criteria as other residents, with an Ombudsman investigation into unaccompanied minors pending.
Your House will be informed about this shortly.
Uw Kamer wordt hierover op korte termijn geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Veldman over het voorkomen en bestrijden van genitale verminking

MPs Becker and Veldman (VVD) asked the ministers about preventing and combating female genital mutilation (FGM), including prevalence data, the role of GPs and the care chain, Veilig Thuis reporting, reconstructive surgery coverage, integration course content, Schiphol controls and a reporting obligation. The state secretary answered that preventive and chain policy exists and is being evaluated, that data are limited or not monitored, that some measures (Schiphol controls) have no fixed timeline, and that a mandatory reporting duty is under study with Raad van State reservations.
The number of women who report to their GP because they are victims of FGM is not monitored.
Het aantal vrouwen dat zich meldt bij de huisarts omdat zij slachtoffer zijn van VGV wordt niet gemonitord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Wiersma over het bericht 'Gemeenten: uitstel nieuwe inburgeringswet teleurstellend'

MPs Becker and Wiersma asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the postponement of the new civic integration law after municipalities criticised the delay, including the timeline, DUO's implementation assessments, and financial and practical consequences. The minister answered that the postponement was necessary for responsible implementation, that DUO's assessments flagged feasibility risks, that consultation with municipalities and partners is ongoing, and that several questions (financial impact, costs) are still being mapped.
My ministry is currently mapping the total financial consequences of the postponement and I am in discussion about this with the VNG and other chain partners.
Mijn ministerie brengt op dit moment de totale financiële gevolgen van het uitstel in kaart en ik ben hierover in gesprek met VNG en andere ketenpartners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'veroordeelde oorlogsmisdadigers kunnen mogelijk asiel krijgen'

MPs Becker and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked whether a Raad van State ruling of December 2020 lets people excluded under Article 1F (war crimes) obtain asylum in the Netherlands, and whether they could gain residence via family ties to an EU citizen in another member state. The Secretary of State answered that the ruling concerns entry bans and public-order risk rather than asylum, that 1F exclusion from asylum remains unchanged, and that no legislative change is needed.
The Council of State ruling brings no change to the existing laws and regulations or their interpretation, nor to the 1F policy.
De uitspraak van de Raad van State brengt geen verandering in (de uitleg van) bestaande wet- en regelgeving, ook niet in het 1F-beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van Wijngaarden over de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad inzake het inreisverbod

MPs Becker and Van Wijngaarden asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the Supreme Court ruling on entry bans, the use of criminal prosecution under article 197 Sr for illegal residents, detention and reception of those with bans, and the relation to unwanted-person declarations. The State Secretary answered that prosecutions have sharply declined pending a Court of Justice ruling, gave approximate figures (about 10 people detained), explained the return procedure and reception policy, and referred to earlier letters for further detail.
It is not possible to give a precise picture of how many foreigners reside unlawfully in the Netherlands and therefore also not how many of them have an entry ban.
Het is niet mogelijk een precies beeld te geven van hoeveel vreemdelingen onrechtmatig in Nederland verblijven en dus ook niet hoeveel van hen een inreisverbod hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Becker over subsidie aan de organisatie Islamic Relief

MPs Weverling and Becker asked the ministers why Islamic Relief was selected for Power of Voices subsidy despite alleged links to the Muslim Brotherhood and German funding being stopped, and what the government would do about subsidies to organisations opposing integration. The minister answered that no subsidy will be granted to Islamic Relief Worldwide, that the Dutch intelligence services assess the Muslim Brotherhood's presence in the Netherlands as limited, and that municipalities decide their own subsidies, with the Rijk informing them of problematic conduct.
Based on the information available to me, however, I have decided not to grant Islamic Relief Worldwide a subsidy.
Op basis van de mij beschikbare informatie heb ik evenwel besloten om Islamic Relief Worldwide geen subsidie te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Koerhuis over het bericht 'Steen door de ruit en dreigbrief Molukse wijk in Elst'

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers about reports of a stone through a window and a threatening letter in a Moluccan neighbourhood in Elst, and about the allocation policy giving Moluccans priority for housing in such neighbourhoods.
