The government explained the historical basis of the arrangements, said they exist in about 45 municipalities, denied that tensions are a recurring pattern, and said it sees no reason to revisit the agreement.
Apart from the incidents reported by the Gelderlander and the NOS, I am not aware of any signals so far that give cause to revisit this agreement.
Buiten de incidenten waarvan de Gelderlander en de NOS melding hebben gemaakt, zijn mij vooralsnog geen signalen bekend die aanleiding geven tot een herijking van deze afspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Ziengs over het bericht “Treinterreur door asielzoekers op de Vechtdallijn”

MPs Becker and Ziengs asked the state secretaries about reports of asylum seekers committing violence against rail staff on the Vechtdal line and whether they were from safe countries, which azc they came from, what steps were taken, and whether a travel ban would be imposed. The government condemned the behaviour, said it does not register residence status of offenders, described existing measures such as Top-X lists, travel bans and a pilot regional travel ban in Eastern Netherlands, and gave few individual details.
As you know, I do not comment on individual cases.
Zoals u weet ga ik niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Veldman over het bericht 'Twee asielzoekers in azc Ter Apel besmet met Corona'

MPs Becker and Veldman asked about reports of COVID-19 infections at the Ter Apel reception centre, including the applicable protocol, quarantine of contacts and arrivals from high-risk areas, and protection of staff and vulnerable asylum seekers. The State Secretary answered that no Ter Apel-specific protocol exists, describes the general COA/GGD/GZA protocol, and sets out quarantine, testing and staff protection measures, while several answers note capacity constraints.
There is no protocol specifically for the Ter Apel reception centre. Therefore I cannot provide it to you.
Er is geen protocol voor specifiek het aanmeldcentrum ter Apel. Derhalve kan ik u dat niet verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht 'COA zoekt honderden extra plekken voor asielzoekers in Oost-Nederland'

MP Becker (VVD) asked the State Secretary about reports that COA is seeking hundreds of extra asylum reception places in Eastern Netherlands, asking about the causes, capacity forecasts, municipal cooperation and whether municipalities can attach conditions to locations. The State Secretary answered that capacity is near its maximum, that no three-year forecast can be given, that the response to municipalities runs through COA and regional tables, and that a small-scale pilot of about ten locations is being prepared.
I therefore cannot give a forecast for the coming three years, nor a breakdown by type of asylum seeker.
Ik kan dus geen prognose geven voor de komende drie jaar, net zomin als een uitsplitsing naar type asielzoekers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht 'IND ontdekt fraude met asielzoekers'

An MP asked the State Secretary whether asylum seekers who obtained residence permits by lying about their sexual orientation can have those permits revoked, and about the burden of proof and sanctions. The State Secretary answered that revocation is possible where feasible but that the IND bears the burden of proof, that an investigation into Ugandan cases found 36 possible grounds for revocation (one revocation so far), and that the government will further examine the issue.
To revoke, the IND must demonstrate that a ground for revocation exists.
Om tot een intrekking over te kunnen gaan dient de IND aan te tonen dat er sprake is van een intrekkingsgrond.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over de persverklaring van Hizb ut Tharir dat vervolging voor de aanbeveling tot vrouwenbesnijdenis een poging zou zijn om moslims te criminaliseren

MPs Becker and Yesilgoz-Zegerius asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about a Hizb ut Tahrir press statement calling prosecution for recommending female genital mutilation an attempt to criminalise Muslims, and asked whether the government would act against the group, ban it, or have the task force examine it. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the statement is unacceptable, that FGM is criminal and prosecuted, that Hizb ut Tahrir is a radical movement not calling for violence but he sees no reason for further measures now, that a dissolution bill is before parliament, and that the task force will monitor developments.
I currently see no reason to take further measures against the organisation.
Ik zie momenteel geen aanleiding nadere maatregelen te treffen tegen de organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘‘Ga naar Holland’ is trending als homofobe sneer in Turkije’

Two MPs (Becker and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, VVD) asked the ministers about a Turkish religious official's remarks linking homosexuality to population decline, the hashtag campaign that followed, threats, and Diyanet's influence in Dutch mosques. The minister condemned the remarks, said no criminal complaint was filed, referred to existing integration, monitoring and diaspora-policy measures, and declined to change those measures on the basis of this single statement.
A single statement by Mr Erbas in Turkey, however reprehensible, is not for the cabinet a reason to revise this approach at this moment.
Een enkele uitspraak van de heer Erbas in Turkije, hoe verwerpelijk dan ook, vormt voor het kabinet geen aanleiding om deze aanpak op dit moment te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht 'COA plaatst Nigeriaans slachtoffer homohaat over naar ander azc'

MP Becker asked the State Secretary and Integration Minister, after reports that a Nigerian victim of anti-gay violence at an asylum centre was moved rather than the perpetrators, how incidents are prevented, recorded and punished, and whether asylum seekers can be required to sign equality principles or be placed in a handhavings location. The government answered that perpetrators are addressed through COA measures and police referral, victims may be moved at their own choice, no incident statistics are kept and mandatory pre-integration was rejected, while promising a policy response to a COA audit.
As you know, I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Zoals u bekend, kan ik geen uitspraken doen over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Koopmans en Middendorp over het bericht dat honderden Chinezen hun valse identiteit ‘herstelden’ bij gemeenten

MPs from the VVD asked the government about reports that hundreds of Chinese nationals 'restored' false identities through municipalities, covering detection, document verification, nationality consequences, limitation periods and sanctions. The State Secretary answered at length, describing existing procedures and safeguards, rejecting several proposed legal changes, and committing only to approach Chinese authorities if useful.
It is not possible to answer this question using data from the BRP.
Het is niet mogelijk om met behulp van gegevens uit de BRP deze vraag te beantwoorden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Jasper van Dijk over verontrustende berichtgeving met betrekking tot de As Soennah Moskee en de reactie van de burgemeester van Den Haag op het handhavingsverzoek van Femmes for

MPs Becker and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the Justice Minister could take enforcement action against the As Soennah mosque after Femmes for Freedom's enforcement request, which the Hague mayor rejected and an appeal is pending. The minister answered that enforcement is for the mayor and the courts, that the anti-terrorism measures law does not apply, and that he will not intervene or revisit joint enforcement.
It is up to the mayor to assess such an enforcement request and decide on it after weighing all relevant facts and circumstances.
Het is aan de burgemeester om een dergelijk handhavingsverzoek te beoordelen en daarop, na afweging van alle relevante feiten en omstandigheden, een beslissing te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Becker over het bericht ‘Moord op Rik van de Rakt: foutengala rond Soedanese verdachte; ’Cruciale informatie vanwege privacy niet gedeeld’’

MPs Van Toorenburg and Becker asked the State Secretary about a report on the murder of Rik van de Rakt by a Sudanese status holder, and whether mental health information was withheld from the receiving municipality because of privacy rules. The State Secretary said privacy law governs sharing medical information, that COA shares what it lawfully may, that the report is the municipality's responsibility, and that partners will review the allocation and information-sharing process.
Strict privacy laws and regulations apply to sharing medical information, and for status holders these are no different than for other citizens in the Netherlands.
Voor het delen van medische informatie geldt strikte wet- en regelgeving op het gebied van privacy, die voor statushouders niet anders is dan voor andere burgers in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Remco Dijksta over het bericht dat mensensmokkel via visserij een ‘blinde vlek’

MPs Becker and Dijkstra asked the government about an Inspectorate report finding that maritime smuggling via fishing and leisure boats is a blind spot, including gaps in risk information, staffing, systems and cooperation. The State Secretary answered that current risk assessments show limited risks, that controls continue, and that improvements such as joint risk analyses, system modernisation and training are being explored or pursued.
Following the findings of the inspection report, the KMar and ZHP are currently exploring options to strengthen their intensive cooperation.
Naar aanleiding van de bevindingen van het inspectierapport verkennen de KMar en ZHP momenteel de mogelijkheden om de intensieve samenwerking te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht dat Helmonder Farad K. tonnen verdiende met 90 verzonnen verhalen voor asielzoekers en waar tegen vier jaar cel is geëist

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a case in which a lawyer earned large sums from about 90 fabricated conversion stories for asylum seekers, and about how the IND verifies conversions and detects such fraud. The State Secretary answered that the IND assesses conversion claims on three pillars, does not actively check statusholders after status is granted, relies on signals to detect organised fraud, does not register religious belief, and intends to reassess the affected cases and revoke statuses where no ground for protection remains.
The IND intends to reassess these cases and is currently examining which follow-up steps will be taken for this reassessment.
De IND is voornemens om deze zaken te herbeoordelen en momenteel wordt door de IND nagegaan welke vervolgstappen genomen zullen worden ten behoeve van deze herbeoordeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Macron gaat buitenlandse imams weren’

MPs Becker, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Heerema asked the government about France's plan to restrict foreign imams, about radical religious influence in Dutch neighbourhoods, closing institutions, foreign-trained imams, an imam certification system, an imam training programme, informal education oversight and French-language rules in schools. The minister answered that the government will act against antidemocratic conduct without targeting any religion, points to a taskforce and a bill on dissolving legal persons, and promises an exploratory report on informal education before summer.
Due to signals of possible antidemocratic or intolerant elements within a number of organisations offering informal education, I have announced a broad exploration.
Vanwege signalen van mogelijke antidemocratische of onverdraagzame elementen binnen een aantal organisaties die informele scholing aanbieden, heb ik een brede verkenning aangekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over COA-personeel dat zich onveilig voelt door ‘Minderjarige’ criminele Noord-Afrikanen

An MP asks the State Secretary about COA staff feeling unsafe due to criminal asylum seekers, return of such people, the Top-X approach, a handhaving location, sharing Top-X data with mayors, and a complaints point for staff. The State Secretary answers that overlast is unacceptable, describes existing measures (HTL Hoogeveen, Top-X, ketenmariniers), says data sharing requires legal basis under the AVG and is being examined, and sees no need for a staff complaints point.

I am examining whether, under existing legal frameworks (such as police and public order legislation), it is possible to share certain information from the migration chain about persons on the Top X list with the local authorities' triangle for public order and safety.

Ik onderzoek of het onder bestaande wettelijke kaders (zoals de politie – en openbare orde wetgeving) eventueel mogelijk is om in het kader van de openbare orde en veiligheid bepaalde informatie van de migratieketen over personen op de Top X lijst te delen met de lokale gezagsdriehoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Becker over terugkeerprogramma’s voor uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers

MPs Van Toorenburg (CDA) and Becker (VVD) asked about subsidised return programmes for rejected asylum seekers, including amounts spent, selection and quality control, effectiveness and whether subsidy depends on actual return. The State Secretary answered that 17 completed projects cost about 3.17 million euro and achieved roughly 45% verified departures, promised an evaluation of the subsidy scheme in autumn, and said it would be reviewed whether subsidy conditions should change.
Because I consider it important to provide insight into how the subsidy funds under the Ondersteuning Zelfstandig Vertrek scheme are spent, I have instructed that this scheme be evaluated.
Omdat ik het belangrijk vind inzage te geven in de besteding van de subsidiegelden die onder de Regeling Ondersteuning Zelfstandig Vertrek vallen, heb ik opdracht gegeven deze regeling te evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Becker en Koopmans over de Europese Afrikastrategie

MPs from the VVD asked the government about the new EU-Africa strategy, its migration section, conditionality linking migration cooperation to returns, the EIB president's remarks on open procurement, Chinese contractors in African infrastructure, and untied aid. The minister's answers largely defend the Commission's approach as balanced and consistent with Dutch policy, while declining to press for the specific linkages the MPs proposed and rejecting a shift away from untied aid.
The cabinet assesses the migration section of the Commission communication on the EU-Africa Strategy as balanced
Het kabinet beoordeelt de paragraaf over migratie in de Commissiemededeling over de EU-Afrika Strategie als gebalanceerd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Peters, Paternotte en Segers over het zo snel mogelijk invoeren van de inburgeringsplicht van Turkse asielstatushouders

Four MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether Turkish asylum status holders can be made subject to civic integration duties from 1 May 2020 before the new law takes effect, and how COVID-19 measures apply to civic integration. The minister confirmed the duty will apply from 1 May 2020, the opt-in scheme will lapse for new holders, and the civic integration deadline is extended by two months for everyone due to the crisis.
Yes, I will act on this from 1 May 2020.
Ja, ik zal hier per 1 mei 2020 gevolg aan geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over oorlogsmisdadigers in de gemeentelijke bed-, bad-, brood voorziening

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about war criminals (1F-status) receiving municipal bed-bath-bread shelter, asking for figures, assurances on deportation, agreements on closing such shelters, and an instruction to Leiden. The State Secretary confirmed pursuit of forced departure but noted Article 3 ECHR limits, said BBB shelters are municipal responsibility without national legal power to instruct them, and committed to closing some BBB shelters and exploring alternative return countries.
There is no immigration-law power to give an instruction of the above kind.
Er bestaat geen vreemdelingenrechtelijke bevoegdheid tot het geven van een aanwijzing van bovengenoemde strekking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over de conclusie van de minister dat de inburgeringsplicht vanaf 2011 gecontinueerd had moeten worden voor Turkse asielstatushouders

An MP asked why Turkish asylum status holders were exempted from the civic integration obligation after a 2011 Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling, how many obtained permanent residence or citizenship without integrating, and whether municipalities could be asked to require them to integrate. The minister explained the exemption followed from that ruling on equal treatment and standstill rules, gave permanent residence figures without citizenship, said bijstand data is not available, and pointed to municipal responsibility and existing options under the new integration system.
This decision was based on the ruling of the Central Appeals Tribunal (CRvB).
Aan deze beslissing lag de uitspraak van de Centrale Raad van Beroep (CRvB) ten grondslag
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘KLM weigerde Lili en Howick te vervoeren‘

MPs Becker and Remco Dijkstra asked whether KLM, partly state-owned, cancelled the flight of two deported children (Lili and Howick) at the last moment, what agreements exist with KLM on removals, whether airlines can be sanctioned for frustrating deportation policy, and whether the state should talk to KLM. The State Secretary confirmed KLM's decision, said the captain bears final responsibility for safe flight operation, declined to examine KLM's risk assessment, and stated that no sanctions exist and that KLM's independent decision is separate from the government's decision on the children.

I respect the decision KLM made to not transport these passengers on grounds of safe flight operation, and given KLM's professionalism and long-standing good cooperation, I see no reason to inquire into the risk assessment in this specific case.

Ik respecteer de beslissing die de KLM heeft genomen om uit hoofde van een veilige vluchtuitvoering deze passagiers niet te vervoeren en gelet op de professionaliteit van de KLM en de jarenlange goede samenwerking, zie ik geen aanleiding om navraag te doen naar de risico inschatting in deze specifieke casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Becker over het bericht ‘Ladingen afgekeurd wegens inklimmers‘

MPs Dijkstra and Becker asked the ministers about reports that cargo was rejected because stowaways were found, including the size of the damage, the numbers and nationalities of stowaways and what happens to them, and what measures are taken against smuggling networks. The government answered that it has no overview of the damage or of rejected cargo, outlined expulsion and prosecution practice, listed border measures and cooperation with the UK and Belgium, and said smuggling is investigated where signals exist.
The government has no insight into the extent of the damage suffered in the transport sector from rejected cargo due to stowaways.
De overheid heeft geen inzicht in de omvang van de schade die wordt geleden in de transportsector door het afkeuren van ladingen vanwege inklimmers.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Jasper van Dijk over verontrustende berichtgeving met betrekking tot de As Soennah Moskee en de reactie van de burgemeester van Den Haag op het handhavingsverzoek van Femmes for

MPs Becker and Van Dijk asked about reports on the As Soennah mosque advocating female genital mutilation and violence against women, and about the Hague mayor's response to an enforcement request from Femmes for Freedom. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the prosecutor is pursuing incitement charges, that enforcement lies with the mayor in an ongoing procedure, that the TWBMT cannot be applied without terrorism-related conduct, and that the municipality is already in contact with the mosque.
It is therefore not for me to make statements about this now, nor about the existence of limits for the college of mayor and aldermen when it comes to enforcement.
Het is dan ook niet aan mij om hierover nu uitspraken te doen, noch over het bestaan van beperkingen voor het college van burgemeesters en wethouders als het gaat om handhavend optreden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Becker over het bericht ‘Cartoonist Ruben L. Oppenheimer: “Ik radicaal? Ik hecht aan mijn vrijheid” en het bericht ‘Cartoonisten: “We zijn kanonnenvoer op de eerste ri

Two VVD MPs asked the government about threats against cartoonist Ruben Oppenheimer, apparent foreign pressure from Turkey and China, and whether the state will investigate undue foreign influence. The Minister of Justice and Security replied that the reports were noted, that the police are investigating his complaints, that press freedom is protected under the Constitution and existing protocols, and that the government opposes foreign interference but sees no direct link between a Turkish block and threats in the Netherlands.
Mr. Oppenheimer's complaints are known and under investigation by the police.
De aangiften van de heer Oppenheimer zijn bekend en bij de politie in onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Becker over het gesprek van de Commissie Justitie en Veiligheid met de nieuwe Eurocommissaris Johansson

MPs Van Toorenburg and Becker asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether she agrees with EU Commissioner Johansson that the Netherlands does not fully use EU rules allowing detention of migrants, and whether she will have this analysed. The State Secretary answered that the government will pursue wider administrative migrant detention within EU law, has asked the Commission for an analysis, and commissioned WODC research with results expected in 2021.
I indicated to the Commissioner that I would like an explanation and/or analysis from the Commission of the possibilities that the current regulations offer regarding detention.
Ik heb de Eurocommissaris aangegeven dat ik graag een toelichting en/of analyse zou krijgen van de Commissie op de mogelijkheden die de huidige regelgeving biedt op het onderdeel van bewaring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman en Becker over de collectieve zorgverzekering van Zilveren Kruis met Milli Görüs

MPs Veldman and Becker (VVD) asked whether the Zilveren Kruis collective health insurance with Milli Görüs, which they link to Erdogan's AK party and Turkish diaspora politics, is appropriate and what care-related benefit it offers. The minister answers that the government has no evidence of unwanted foreign interference, that insurers may make collective agreements, and that the collective is under review for genuine care-related added value.
The cabinet has no information showing that the choice of this collective insurance discount involves any form of unwanted foreign interference.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie die aantoont dat er via de keuze voor deze collectiviteitskorting van de zorgverzekering sprake is van een vorm van ongewenste buitenlandse inmenging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het risico op een toenemende migratiestroom via de Balkan

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about rising migration pressure on the Western Balkans route, EU border control failures, visa checks at border posts, MFF funding and cooperation with EU partners. The State Secretary answered that the Commission reports increased pressure but not comparable to 2015–2016, that member states are primarily responsible for border control with EU evaluation and Frontex vulnerability assessments as checks, and that the Netherlands supports more migration priority in the next MFF and continued EU support to the region.
Individual EU member states are primarily responsible for border supervision at the external borders and must carry out border control in accordance with the Schengen acquis.
De individuele EU-lidstaten zijn primair verantwoordelijk voor het grenstoezicht aan de buitengrenzen en zij dienen conform het Schengenacquis grenstoezicht uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Becker over het bericht 'Seawatch3 alweer bijna bij Libië'

Two VVD MPs asked why the Sea-Watch 3 sailed again despite safety rules not being met, whether it could be blocked, and whether migrants would be accepted. The minister replied that the ship must meet the rules before rescuing, Sea-Watch is responsible for incidents, the ship was not informed in advance, Tunisia was the nearest safe port, and the Netherlands no longer takes over migrants from such ships.
I made a moral appeal to Sea-Watch to only sail again once the ship and crew meet the safety and crew requirements set out in the regulation.
Ik heb een moreel beroep gedaan op Sea-Watch om pas weer uit te varen als het schip en de bemanning voldoen aan de veiligheids- en bemanningseisen die zijn gesteld in de regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het afbreken van het overleg over een nieuwe inburgeringswet in de week dat het aantal statushouders in bijstand onverminderd groot blijkt

An MP asks why consultations on the new integration act (Wet inburgering) were broken off with the VNG, what it means for the timeline, and what is being done about the large number of status holders on welfare. The minister says concerns about municipal financing led to a CPB independent review with results expected mid-October, that the start date is not yet affected, and that new municipal arrangements on sanctions and welfare follow-up are still under discussion.
At the administrative consultation on 27 June I agreed with the VNG to jointly ask the CPB for an independent review of the financial consequences for municipalities.
Tijdens het bestuurlijk overleg op 27 juni jl. heb ik met de VNG afgesproken om samen het CPB te vragen om een onafhankelijke toets te doen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over de ongerustheid in Amsterdam rond de pilot landelijke vreemdelingen voorziening (LVV)

An MP from the VVD asks the State Secretary of Justice and Security about local unrest in Amsterdam over the national reception pilot for irregular migrants (LVV), including the alderman's stance on enforcement, police discretion, site selection and resident consultation. The State Secretary confirms the pilot's departure-oriented approach, states that police migration enforcement is under her authority, says site selection and resident consultation are municipal responsibilities, and promises a letter after the summer and a WODC evaluation.
I will inform your House after the summer about the state of affairs regarding the development of the pilot LVVs.
Ik zal uw Kamer na de zomer informeren over de stand van de zaken wat betreft de ontwikkeling van de pilot-LVV's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht '1600 kinderen verdwenen uit de asielopvang'

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that 1,600 unaccompanied minors disappeared from asylum reception, including origin countries, possible trafficking networks, investigation, and detention options. The state secretary confirmed the figure but said it is unverified, pointed to two pending investigations (an analysis of migration-chain data and an EMM study due in autumn), explained existing measures, and announced a planned policy change adding a fourth detention ground.

Depending on the findings, it will be examined which additional measures, including at international level, need to be taken to prevent as far as possible the departure of unaccompanied minors to unknown destinations.

Afhankelijk van de bevindingen daarvan zal gekeken worden welke aanvullende maatregelen, ook in internationaal verband, genomen moeten worden om het vertrek met onbekende bestemming van amv's zoveel mogelijk te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht ‘Te weinig tijd, te veel moeite, te veel geld: IND stuurde criminelen niet weg’

Becker (VVD) asked whether IND staff, under workload and management pressure, deliberately chose non-revocation of residence permits for criminal asylum seekers instead of pursuing revocation, and whether the government would tighten discretion and reassess such cases. The state secretary answered that the internal reports show no such deliberate steering, that prioritisation under workload is normal, that revocation follows when legally warranted, and that no reassessment is needed; she is still examining how much extra capacity the revocation team needs.

From the two reports it has not appeared to me that, due to workload and management pressure, there was a deliberate increase in non-revocations of residence permits and closing of files of criminal asylum seekers.

Uit de twee verslagen is mij niet gebleken dat vanwege werkdruk en druk vanuit het management bewust is overgegaan tot het opvoeren van niet-intrekkingen van de verblijfsvergunning en het afsluiten van dossiers van criminele asielzoekers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht ‘Meer  migranten claimen slachtoffer van mensenhandel te zijn’

MPs Becker and Van Wijngaarden asked whether rising numbers of African migrants claiming to be trafficking victims undermine the trafficking regime and asylum procedures, and whether the law could be changed. The State Secretary confirmed a sharp rise in trafficking reports, especially from Nigerian Dublin claimants, said this overloads police and prosecution and that the Dublin claim lapses when a residence permit is granted, and said a package of measures would follow.
By letter of 28 June 2019 I informed your House about an integrated package of measures addressing the above problems.
Bij brief van 28 juni 2019 heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd over een integraal pakket aan maatregelen die bovengenoemde problematiek adresseert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Becker over het bericht ‘Staatsvijand nummer één deradicaliseert maar niet’

VVD MPs asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about press reports that a convicted jihadist (Samir A.) was not deradicalised despite a government-supported trajectory, and about how agencies coordinate, who leads, whether financing of terrorism is prosecuted, and what happens to those who are not receptive. The minister acknowledged the trajectory failed, defended the TER team's effectiveness, described the coordination mechanisms and roles, and stated that prosecution is an opportunity decision for the OM, but gave no concrete new commitment.
When in 2015 it appeared that the intended goal, demonstrable deradicalisation of A., was not achieved, the deployment of this expert was ended.
Toen in 2015 bleek dat het beoogde doel, aantoonbare deradicalisering van A., niet werd behaald, is de inzet van deze expert beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Becker over het bericht ‘Blauwe Moskee biedt podium aan radicale prediker’

Two VVD MPs asked the government whether it could bar a Dutch-national hate preacher from speaking at the Blue Mosque in Amsterdam, whether his hateful statements could be prosecuted or sanctioned, and how the Blue Mosque could be sanctioned for hosting him. The Minister of Justice replied that Dutch nationals cannot be excluded from the Netherlands, that the government relies on a three-track approach with municipalities, that the Public Prosecution Service decides on prosecution, and that a bill to expand the ban on radical organisations is being prepared.
In general, it is not possible to exclude Dutch citizens from the Netherlands.
In het algemeen geldt dat het niet mogelijk is Nederlandse staatsburgers te weren uit Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht dat te weinig leraren getraind zijn in de aanpak van radicalisering

MPs Becker and Rudmer Heerema (VVD) asked whether the government agrees that too few teachers have been trained to recognise and address radicalisation, given few school reports and concerns from NCTV and AIVD. Minister Slob replied that about 5,000 education professionals have been trained via SSV and 2,000 via ESS, that the government will focus training on priority municipalities and promote it, but will not make teacher training mandatory.
I do not intend to oblige teachers to follow a training.
Ik ben niet voornemens docenten te verplichten een training te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Becker over het bericht 'Ter Apel wil van opvangcentrum af wil, tenzij er meer politie komt'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Security ministers about reports that Westerwolde wanted to end its reception centre contract unless more police were deployed, and about the police capacity agreed for Ter Apel. The minister answered that police allocation is handled regionally and nationally, outlined the 2010 agreement and the current capacity arrangements, and committed to a meeting with the regional mayor and the Westerwolde mayor and a further letter before the summer recess.

As I also reported to your House in the Police committee meeting on 4 June, I have nonetheless arranged a separate meeting in the short term with the regional mayor of Noord-Nederland and the mayor of Westerwolde to discuss this problem.

Zoals ik uw Kamer ook in het AO Politie op 4 juni jl. heb gemeld, heb ik desalniettemin op korte termijn een aparte afspraak met de regioburgemeester Noord-Nederland en de burgemeester van Westerwolde om over deze problematiek te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Becker over het bericht ‘Amby wil ‘jihadbruid’ Aïcha niet in de buurt’ en het Limburg programma Avondgasten ‘Jihadbruid’ Aïcha uit Maastricht

MPs Laan-Geselschap and Becker (VVD) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that a returned foreign-fighter woman would live in a Maastricht neighbourhood, including whether mandatory deradicalisation, notification of residents and municipal supervision apply. Minister Grapperhaus answered that no mandatory deradicalisation is imposed in such cases, that location restrictions are possible via conditions or a temporary anti-terror order, that the BIJ notification scheme does not yet cover terrorism convicts, and that a multidisciplinary case consultation monitors individuals.
A improvement plan for the BIJ scheme is currently being drawn up.
Op dit moment wordt er een verbeterplan voor de BIJ-regeling gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘AIVD: zorgen over radicalisme bij naschoolse Arabische lessen’

MPs Becker and Laan-Geselschap asked about AIVD concerns over radicalism at informal Arabic-language after-school lessons and whether supervision of such informal education should be broadened. The minister answered that the government lacks full insight into informal schooling, will commission an independent exploration in three stages including possible supervision and intervention options, and pointed to the evaluation of the Wet op de Jeugdverblijven due in summer 2019.
Therefore the cabinet will commission an exploration of forms of informal schooling in the Netherlands to gain more insight into their nature and scope.
Daarom gaat het kabinet een verkenning laten uitvoeren naar vormen van informele scholing in Nederland om meer inzicht in aard en omvang ervan te verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Veldman over het bericht dat er op basisschool de Stelaertshoeve in Tilburg door de GGD voorlichting wordt gegeven over de ramadan

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Health about GGD health education on Ramadan given at a Tilburg primary school, including its purpose, whether it is GGD policy, how widespread it is, and whether other religious practices get similar attention. The State Secretary answered that the GGD advises schools on request within the Healthy School approach, that the Ramadan advice was tailored to exam or CITO test periods and given to a school and some parents, and that no other religious-holiday requests have been received.
For the whole of the Netherlands this question cannot be answered. No registration takes place.
Voor geheel Nederland kan deze vraag niet beantwoord worden. Er vindt geen registratie plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Rudmer Heerema en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht dat meisjes met een migratie-achtergrond al in de basisschoolleeftijd worden ontvoerd en uitgehuwelijkt

MPs Becker, Rudmer Heerema and Van Wijngaarden asked whether girls with a migration background are abducted and married off from primary school age, how many cases exist, how schools report them, and what legal and consular tools exist. The minister answered that no 2018 reports involved primary-school-age victims, gave case counts, pointed to existing reporting and court-intervention routes, and promised further steps in a June progress report.
Exact figures on the abandonment of minors abroad are currently not available, as figures on this specific subject cannot be derived from the current registration system.

Exacte cijfers over achterlating van minderjarigen in het buitenland, zijn momenteel niet beschikbaar aangezien cijfers over dit specifieke onderwerp niet te herleiden zijn uit het huidige registratiesysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Becker over het bericht ‘Islamitische Haga Lyceum van plan meer omstreden predikers uit te nodigen’

MPs Heerema and Becker asked the government about a school inviting controversial preachers, asking whether it can refuse entry, act through EU-level lists, and use the proposed changes to article 2:20 BW against such schools. The minister called the invitations undesirable, said entry bans on EU citizens are unrealistic and EU blacklists undesirable due to the ban on censorship, and said dissolution of organisations under 2:20 BW is case-dependent for the courts.
Under article 2:20 of the Civil Code, the court may, at the request of the Public Prosecution Service, declare a legal entity whose activities conflict with public order prohibited and dissolve it.
Op basis van artikel 2:20 BW kan de Rechtbank op verzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie een rechtspersoon waarvan de werkzaamheid in strijd is met de openbare orde, verboden verklaren en ontbinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht 'Haatpreek wint terrein'

Two VVD MPs asked ministers about salafist hate preachers in mosques and online, and about counter-strategies, sanctions and closing mosques. The government answered that it applies criminal prosecution, travel bans, the Twbmt, a planned civil-law route to ban radical organisations, and an integrated approach, while declining to comment on specific individuals or to commission a further investigation into online platforms.
I cannot make statements about possible ongoing actions against the spiritual leaders mentioned in the article.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over mogelijk lopende acties tegen de in het artikel genoemde voormannen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Becker over het bericht ‘Koppositie Schiphol als poort naar VS onder druk’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that US pressure threatens Schiphol's position and about the state of the pre-clearance negotiations, including costs, benefits and the government's role. The minister replied that there is no pressure, that the negotiations are ongoing, that any treaty must comply with Dutch, EU and international law and that parliament will approve the treaty after negotiations conclude.
Afterwards the treaty will be submitted to parliament for approval.
Daarna zal het verdrag ter goedkeuring aan het parlement worden voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Tielen over het bericht ‘Ook asielzoeker krijgt hulp bij eerwraak’

MPs Becker and Tielen asked the government about reports of honour-based violence and threats against asylum seekers in reception centres, including how many cases were recorded, whether perpetrators were removed, and whether residence permits were revoked. The State Secretary answered that COA-registration is limited for safety reasons, that perpetrators can be moved to an EBTL and victims to women's shelters, and that the government will audit social safety in late 2019 and agree with municipalities to fund shelter access for victims awaiting residence decisions.
Quantitative information on the number of reports made to Veilig Thuis is currently not available.
Kwantitatieve informatie omtrent het aantal meldingen gedaan bij Veilig Thuis is op dit moment echter niet voor handen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Becker over de dreigementen van de Turkse Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken richting Europese toeristen die Turkije zouden verraden

MPs Koopmans and Becker asked the Foreign and Social Affairs ministers whether Turkey's interior minister threatened to detain European tourists who attend certain meetings, and what this means for Dutch citizens criticising Turkey; they also asked about Turkish weekend schools and contacts with the Turkish embassy. The government answered that it does not change its position on free expression within the rule of law, that it knows of no policy change by Turkey, and that it will inform the House on the motion-Becker implementation before summer.
The cabinet will inform the House more fully before this coming summer about the implementation of the Becker et al. motion.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer voor aanstaande zomer nader informeren over de uitvoering van de motie Becker c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Becker en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'Universiteit Utrecht is te wit'

MPs from the VVD asked whether Utrecht University's diversity policy is compatible with rule-of-law values after reports that men and women were seated separately at a student society lecture, and whether the university has rules to exclude events conflicting with those values. The minister answered that the society said seating was free, that gender equality is a core value, that the university's Code of Conduct prohibits discrimination and forced segregation, and that she sees no reason for further action.
Utrecht University has a Code of Conduct that describes the values guiding work and study at the university.
De Universiteit Utrecht heeft een Code of Conduct die de waarden beschrijft die richting geven aan het werken en studeren aan de universiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Arno Rutte over het adverteren voor en meewerken aan maagdenvliesherstel in Nederland

The MPs Becker and Arno Rutte (VVD) asked whether the government would raise with Dutch gynaecologists the option of no longer issuing certificates of virginity, following a Belgian medical council ruling. Minister De Jonge answered that he is willing to raise it in his meeting with gynaecologists and will report on it in the next progress letter on the Geweld hoort nergens thuis programme.
Yes, I am willing to raise this during my conversation with gynaecologists in the Netherlands.
Ja, ik ben bereid om tijdens mijn gesprek met de gynaecologen in Nederland dit aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Tielen over het diversiteitsbeleid bij de Universiteit Utrecht

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a reported Utrecht University diversity plan, including prayer rooms with separate entrances and Islamic holiday calendars, and whether such measures serve education quality. The minister answered that diversity and inclusion are the institution's own responsibility, that the university has no plans for separate entrances or a changed calendar, and that equal admission chances matter.
However, it is up to the institutions themselves to determine how they pay attention to this and which measures they take in this area.
Het is echter aan de instellingen zelf om te bepalen hoe zij hier aandacht aan besteden en welke maatregelen zij op dit gebied nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Arno Rutte over het adverteren voor en het meewerken aan maagdenvliesherstel in Nederland

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about hymen reconstruction clinics, medical practice and whether doctors should still cooperate, given WHO opposition and risks of coercion linked to honour-related pressure. The minister condemns the practice when driven by fear, says the NVOG 2004 guidance still advises against the operation unless counselling leaves no alternative, and commits to talks with doctors and the NVOG, reporting back later.
I will therefore enter into discussion with the doctors concerned and the Dutch Society for Obstetrics & Gynaecology (NVOG) about preventing hymen reconstruction in women.
Ik ga daarom met de betreffende artsen en de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Obstetrie & Gynaecologie (NVOG) in gesprek over het voorkomen van maagdenvliesherstel bij vrouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Tielen over anti-integratieve uitspraken rector islamitische universiteit Rotterdam

MPs Becker and Tielen asked the government how it would respond to statements by the rector of the Islamic University of Rotterdam that followers of Gülen may receive the death penalty, and whether it would use powers under the Wet bescherming namen en graden. The minister condemned the statements, said an independent advisory commission had been asked for advice under the step-by-step procedure, and said she is willing to use the law's options but will await the commission's advice before deciding.
With the commission's advice I will assess whether there is reason to intervene at the IUASR.
Met het advies van de commissie zal ik beoordelen of er aanleiding is om bij de IUASR in te grijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht «Turkije gaat weekendscholen financieren in Nederland»

Two VVD MPs asked the government about reports that Turkey would finance weekend schools in the Netherlands, asking about contacts with Turkey, the number of applications, oversight, and risks to integration. The minister answered that Turkey promised transparency and shared information, about 15 subsidy applications exist, weekend schools fall outside Inspectorate supervision and no specific rules apply, and the government has no full picture but cannot ban informal education, while raising concerns with Turkey.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Jasper van Dijk over antwoorden op eerdere vragen inzake het bericht "Jongerenreis naar radicale prediker"

MPs Becker and Van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the government knew of Milli Görüş youth trips to Turkey involving a radical preacher, and whether it would monitor, investigate or act on such trips and on the organisation's independence and funding. The minister answered that the government does not monitor organisations' trips or religious education, that intelligence matters cannot be disclosed, that Milli Görüş distanced itself from the preacher's statements, that a 2017 study found no proven Turkish control, and that municipalities did not know of the trips.
Social and religious organisations are free to organise foreign trips. The government does not supervise this.
Het staat maatschappelijke en religieuze organisaties vrij om buitenlandse reizen te organiseren. Hierop wordt door de overheid geen toezicht gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over "Examens in inburgering uitgelekt"

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether exam questions for Dutch language and civic integration tests leaked via social media, how long this lasted, and whether candidates who benefited should lose their integration status and loan forgiveness. The minister acknowledges leaked recollections of exam items, says the leaks are not criminal fraud, has removed affected items and postponed the state exams to January 2019, and states he has no powers to sanction the people who shared them.
Sharing recollections of previously taken exam questions is not punishable, and I have no powers to sanction the persons who shared the descriptions.
Het delen van herinneringen aan eerder gemaakte examenopgaven is niet strafbaar en ik heb geen bevoegdheden de personen die de beschrijvingen hebben gedeeld, te sanctioneren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over fraude met inburgeringsexamens

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about leaked and fraudulently shared inburgering exam questions on Facebook, YouTube and other channels, the handling of fraud at language schools, and whether exams were adequately protected. The minister said the Facebook group is no longer active, some YouTube questions were removed, the investigation into an Amsterdam language school is ongoing, and detailed information on question sets is withheld to protect exam integrity.

Information on how many questions or versions of the various exam components exist and how often they are renewed cannot be shared, because doing so would increase the risk of undermining the integrity of the exams.

Informatie over hoeveel vragen dan wel versies er van de verschillende examenonderdelen zijn en hoe vaak deze worden vernieuwd kan niet gedeeld worden omdat daarmee het risico op aantasting van de integriteit van de examens vergroot wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Koopmans over de intenties van de Turkse ambassade om bij te dragen aan de integratie van de "Turkse gemeenschap" in Nederland

MPs Becker and Koopmans asked the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Social Affairs whether the Turkish ambassador's stated aim of bringing the Turkish community together for integration is acceptable, and whether Turkish diaspora politics should be raised with Turkey. The government answered that integration policy is its own responsibility, that Turkey may maintain voluntary ties with its diaspora within the limits of the rule of law, and that it will raise concerns with Turkey if those limits are exceeded.
The Cabinet sees no role in this for diplomatic representatives of other countries.
Het Kabinet ziet hierin geen rol voor diplomatieke vertegenwoordigers van andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Syriërs sturen kinderen naar weekendscholen'

VVD MPs Becker and Rudmer Heerema asked about reports that Syrian refugees send children to weekend schools teaching their own language and culture, asking for data, content oversight, and whether such schools undermine integration and Dutch values. The government answered that it has no information on the content or numbers of these weekend schools because they are not schools under education law and fall outside Inspectorate oversight, while stating that informal education is free but should not obstruct integration or promote anti-democratic views.

At present the cabinet has no information on the nature and scope of the education at weekend schools focused on language, culture and religion, because weekend schools are not schools within the meaning of education legislation.

Op dit moment heeft het kabinet geen informatie over de aard en omvang van het onderwijs op onder andere weekendscholen die zich richten op taal, cultuur en religie, omdat weekendscholen geen scholen zijn in de zin van de onderwijswetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Becker over het bericht ‘Amsterdamse school ruilt Paasontbijt voor Suikerfeest’

Two VVD MPs asked the education minister about an Amsterdam primary school replacing its Easter breakfast with a Suikerfeest celebration, including whether parents and the medezeggenschapsraad were consulted and whether Dutch traditions are protected. The minister answered that schools set their own celebrations, the school's participation body had discussed broader attention to faith traditions, and the civic-education duties and a forthcoming bill clarifying the citizenship mandate were pointed to.
Primary schools themselves determine which festivals, celebrations or commemorations take place at school.
Basisscholen bepalen zelf welke feesten, vieringen of herdenkingen op school plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en Becker over het bericht ‘IS-gangers welkom in El Tawheed-moskee’

MPs Rutte and Becker asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about reports that jihadist-linked persons were welcome at the El Tawheed mosque in Amsterdam, and whether police access and enforcement could be ensured. Minister Grapperhaus answered that no criminal offences have been established, that police may enter a place of worship only in limited circumstances under the Constitution and the Algemene wet op het binnentreden, that seven travellers' Dutch nationality was revoked, and that Amsterdam will inform the council of any decisions.
During a religious service, the police may only enter a mosque upon discovery in the act (on the spot).
De politie mag tijdens een religieuze dienst alleen een moskee binnentreden bij ontdekking op heterdaad
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Arno Rutte over het bericht 'Jongerenreis naar radicale prediker'

MPs Becker and Rutte asked whether Milli Görüs organised trips of young people to a radical preacher in Turkey, who funds them, whether security services are aware, and whether mosque financing and imam training should be supervised. The government says such trips are lawful and not monitored, that it is unacceptable to radicalise youth but no concrete action on the trips is announced, and that the imam training falls outside higher education supervision.
If persons or organisations, through their aims or activities, give rise to a serious suspicion that they pose a threat to national security, the AIVD can conduct an investigation.

Indien personen of organisaties door de doelen die zij nastreven, dan wel door hun activiteiten aanleiding geven tot het ernstige vermoeden dat dat zij een gevaar vormen voor de nationale veiligheid, dan kan de AIVD onderzoek doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en Becker over het bericht ‘'Duitse inlichtingendienst getipt dat Jawed S. radicaliseerde'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Security and Social Affairs ministers whether German intelligence had warned about the radicalisation of an asylum seeker, whether information sharing with foreign services is adequate, how Dutch and German authorities cooperate on asylum radicalisation, and whether such information reaches municipalities. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the person did not appear in German threat systems, described existing international intelligence-sharing channels and migration-chain reporting structures, and said information can be shared with municipalities as permitted by the WIV 2017.
In the context of counterterrorism, information is shared internationally fully and quickly.
In het kader van contraterrorisme wordt informatie internationaal volledig en snel gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Becker over het bericht 'Onvrede over moskee-schoolreis'

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether schools organising class visits to mosques, possibly to salafist mosques with past hate preachers, conflict with parental rights and the civic-education duty, and whether the inspectorate should act. The minister said schools decide their own programmes within legal limits, parents can request exemption, the inspectorate sees no signals of conflict with democratic basic values, and he will clarify the civic-education duty and ask the inspectorate to reinforce oversight.
I intend to make active promotion of the basic values of our democratic constitutional state an explicit part of the civic-education duty, as part of clarifying that statutory duty.

Ik ben van plan om, als onderdeel van de verduidelijking van de wettelijke burgerschapsopdracht, actieve bevordering van de basiswaarden van onze democratische rechtsstaat daarvan expliciet onderdeel te laten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over de afspraken tussen de EU en de VS over de toekomstige handelsrelatie

Member Becker (VVD) asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the Juncker-Trump agreement on EU-US trade relations, including tariff reduction, WTO reform, China, steel and aluminium tariffs, and EU tariff levels. The minister answered that the agreement (industrial tariff and non-tariff barrier reduction, energy cooperation, standards dialogue, WTO reform) is a constructive step, that a high-level working group will elaborate it, and that EU and US tariff levels are comparable.
A high-level working group will be set up to further elaborate and concretise this common agenda in the coming months.
Een high-level werkgroep zal worden opgericht om deze gemeenschappelijke agenda in de komende maanden nader uit te werken en te concretiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Tielen over het bericht 'Nieuwe imamopleiding, nu van Milli Görüs'

Two VVD MPs asked whether the planned private imam training by Milli Görüs in Amsterdam will start in September 2018, how it relates to the VU programme, whether Dutch-rooted imams are preferred, and whether civic values and inspection oversight apply to it. The minister replies that the private training falls outside recognised higher education, so the government has no view on its start or content and the Inspectorate has no oversight, while the VU exploration proceeds and the government supports Dutch-rooted imams.
I cannot impose obligations on institutions outside the recognised higher education system.
Ik kan geen verplichtingen opleggen aan instellingen buiten het bestel van erkend hoger onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Ten Broeke en Koopmans over de brief van de Turkse president Erdogan inzake de Turkse verkiezingen

MPs Becker, Ten Broeke and Koopmans asked the government about a letter from Turkish President Erdogan to Turkish voters in the Netherlands before the 2018 Turkish elections, including who supplied the address data, whether the Dutch data protection authority investigated, and whether Turkish election signs on Dutch motorways were justified. The government answered that the letter was not a literal voting instruction but was inappropriate, that address lists can be obtained in Turkey under Turkish law, that the data protection authority acted independently and the GDPR does not apply, and that local authorities handled the signs and no disclaimer will be added.
The Dutch Data Protection Authority is an independent supervisory body that itself determines which investigations it carries out.
De Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder die zelf bepaalt welk onderzoek zij uitvoert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Baudet, Van Helvert, Van der Staaij, Karabulut, Becker, Sjoerdsma en Van Ojik over de sluiting van kerken door de Algerijnse overheid

Eight MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Algeria is closing Protestant churches under its law on non-Islamic religions and whether this breaches religious freedom. The minister confirmed that some churches cannot hold services without the required permits, said freedom of religion is not generally violated, and said he raised the issue with the Algerian foreign minister, who replied that churches have nothing to fear.
Needless to say, I will continue to closely monitor developments in this regard and, if necessary, voice my concerns bilaterally and within the EU.
Het spreekt voor zich dat ik de ontwikkelingen hieromtrent nauwgezet blijf volgen en indien nodig hierover, bilateraal en in EU-verband, mijn zorgen zal uiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Koopmans over het bericht dat de Turkse president Erdogan campagne wil voeren in het buitenland voor de Turkse presidents- en parlementsverkiezingen in juni

VVD MPs Becker and Koopmans asked whether Erdogan would campaign abroad before the June 2018 Turkish elections, how the Netherlands would prevent such campaign visits, and whether a German-style ban on foreign politicians campaigning could be introduced. The government said Erdogan attended a rally in Sarajevo, that visits by Turkish government members are unwanted, that municipalities decide on other campaign activities, and that it will explore a general line on foreign politicians' campaigning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Ten Broeke, van Helvert, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over aanvallen op de Kerem Shalom-grensovergang in Israël

MPs asked whether Gazan demonstrators tried to damage the Kerem Shalom crossing, whether the Dutch-funded scanners and cargo flows were affected, how much freight crossed this year, and whether the government accepts Israel's view that the border protests amount to a state of war. The minister answered that damage occurred on the Palestinian side with minimal effect on trade, gave UN cargo figures for January to April, and rejected the war qualification, stating that Gaza is occupied territory under the law of occupation.
On Friday 4 May Gazan demonstrators caused damage on the Palestinian side of the Kerem Shalom / Karm Abusalem crossing.
Op vrijdag 4 mei hebben Gazaanse demonstranten aan Palestijnse zijde van de Kerem Shalom / Karm Abusalem grensovergang beschadigingen aangebracht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ploumen, Voordewind, Becker, Diks, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij, Agnes Mulder en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Prominente Saudische vrouwenrechtenactivisten opgepakt’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the arrests of Saudi women's rights activists were only for campaigning for women's right to drive, and whether the government would raise the matter bilaterally and in the EU and call for their release. The minister said the detainees are suspected of conspiracy with foreign powers and financing hostile actors, that Nederland raised concerns with the Saudi foreign minister and is consulting partners including in the EU, and that it remains concerned about repression of dissent.
The Netherlands will continue to ask for attention to the detention of the activists and press for proper treatment.
Nederland zal aandacht blijven vragen voor de aanhoudingen van de activisten en aandringen op goede behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Voordewind, Kuik en Bouali over het bericht dat OS-ontvanger Rwanda de nieuwe shirtsponsor van voetbalclub Arsenal wordt

MPs from VVD, ChristenUnie, CDA and D66 asked the minister whether Rwanda, a development aid recipient, becoming Arsenal's shirt sponsor is consistent with aid dependency concerns and whether the government would raise this with Rwanda. The minister answered that the choice of partner is Rwanda's, that the Netherlands continues a transition relationship with bilateral aid being phased out, and that it will keep discussing the effectiveness of such tourism investments with Rwanda's development board.
The Rwanda Development Board has made no statements about the costs associated with this partnership.
De Rwanda Development Board heeft geen uitspraken gedaan over de kosten die gepaard gaan met dit partnerschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over misbruik van belastinggeld door een Malinese NGO

MP Becker asked the minister about misuse of Dutch aid funds by a Malian NGO, including which NGO it was, how monitoring failed, and whether other projects will be reviewed. The minister confirmed about EUR 962,000 was misappropriated or mishandled, withheld the NGO's name because of ongoing litigation, and said existing risk management is adequate with no new review planned.
No, because the lawsuit is still ongoing. Once the judge has ruled, the name of the NGO will be made public.
Nee, omdat de rechtszaak nog loopt. Zodra de rechter een uitspraak heeft gedaan wordt de naam van de NGO openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over berichten inzake een gifaanval in Douma

MP Becker asked the Foreign Minister about the alleged chemical attack in Douma, the OPCW investigation, UN Security Council steps, Russian vetoes, Syrian chemical weapons stocks, and whether the P5 should give up the veto in mass-atrocity cases. The minister answered that the government considers Syrian responsibility likely, details the OPCW fact-finding and Russian obstruction, and says it supports a voluntary veto restraint code, which it promoted at a Council debate.
The government supports the French-Mexican and other initiatives aimed at voluntary abstention from the veto by permanent members of the UN Security Council in cases of mass atrocities.

Het kabinet steunt het Frans-Mexicaanse en andere initiatieven gericht op het vrijwillig afzien van het gebruik van het veto door de permanente leden van de VN Veiligheidsraad wanneer sprake is van massale wreedheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht dat Oxfam weer in opspraak is geraakt en bonussen zou hebben uitgekeerd aan personeel verantwoordelijk voor de hulpoperatie in Haïti

MP Becker (VVD) asked whether Oxfam paid bonuses to Haiti relief staff and whether the high personnel share in a 2011 audit is normal. Minister Kaag answered that the spending split reflects project expertise, that the flagged payment was a pension gratuity for one person rather than a bonus, and that personnel policy is the organisations' own responsibility with the ministry checking against cost guidelines.
Inquiries show that no bonuses were paid by Oxfam Novib or Oxfam GB in Haiti.
Navraag leert dat er geen bonussen zijn betaald door Oxfam Novib of Oxfam GB in Haïti.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht 'Ministerie hield informatie over moskeeën achter voor gemeenten'

An MP asks why the Ministry of Social Affairs withheld information on foreign funding of mosques from municipalities, and whether all such information will be shared going forward and when restrictions on funding from unfree countries will follow. The minister admits information was shared late and incompletely due to diplomatic confidentiality and procedural delays, promises to inform municipalities of new funding reports, and says a report on restricting such funding will come in autumn 2018.
In doing so, this information was mistakenly not promptly shared with the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment.
Daarbij is deze informatie per abuis niet gelijk gedeeld met het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Ten Broeke, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht dat Iran stiekem delen van het atoomprogramma zou hebben voortgezet

MPs Becker, Ten Broeke, Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked whether Israeli claims that Iran secretly continued parts of its nuclear weapons programme after the JCPOA were new, whether the IAEA and the Dutch government had received the material, and how the Dutch government would keep the JCPOA in place after the US withdrew support. The minister answered that the information offers no new insight, that the IAEA reports Iran is complying, that Nederland urges Israel to share the material with the IAEA, and that Nederland is working with EU partners to preserve the agreement and consider measures on ballistic missiles.
The information presented by Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu does not lead to new insights into the Iranian nuclear programme.
De informatie die de Israëlische minister-president Netanyahu presenteerde leidt niet tot nieuwe inzichten over het Iraanse nucleaire programma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het conflict met de Congolese regering over een mede door Nederland georganiseerde donorconferentie

Mr Becker (VVD) asked the minister about the Congolese government's objection to a donor conference co-organised by the Netherlands and what the Netherlands did to address it. The minister answered that the conference went ahead because of very large humanitarian needs, that the Congolese concerns were taken seriously through dialogue with the UN, and that Dutch aid to DRC in 2018 totals roughly EUR 10 million in direct emergency aid plus further amounts through multilateral channels.
The cabinet, the UN and the EU were of the view that the conference had to go ahead, because it concerned very large humanitarian needs of the Congolese population.
Het kabinet, de VN en de EU waren van mening dat de conferentie door moest gaan, omdat het hier ging om zeer grote humanitaire noden van de Congolese bevolking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over exportcontrole op cybersurveillancegoederen

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade about EU export controls on cyber-surveillance goods, the position of the Dutch government on brokering services, and the timeline of the negotiations on the dual-use regulation. The minister answered that Netherlands supports extending export controls to prevent human rights abuses, that its position on brokering is unchanged, and that negotiations are ongoing without a set end date.
The Netherlands cannot currently indicate how frequently this happens, because some cyber-surveillance goods are not yet subject to control.
Nederland kan op dit moment niet aangeven hoe frequent dit gebeurt, omdat een deel van cybersurveillancegoederen op dit moment nog niet gecontroleerd is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht dat Turkije een jihadpreek dicteert in Nederland

MP Becker asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether Turkey dictated a jihadist sermon to Dutch mosques, whether Dutch imams delivered it, how imams are checked for criminal statements, and how foreign political influence and mosque financing are addressed. The minister replied that one Hoorn mosque used part of a Turkish sermon once without any suspicion of criminal offences, that government does not judge sermon content beyond criminal limits, that a governance model with ISN is being discussed, and that transparency and foreign-funding reviews are underway.
From the information I have received about the Hoorn case, it appears there is no suspicion of criminal offences.
Uit de informatie die ik heb ontvangen over de zaak in Hoorn blijkt dat er géén sprake is van een verdenking van strafbare feiten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over de beïnvloeding van Nederlanders in Nederland door Turkse lobbyorganisatie gelieerd aan AK-partij

An MP asks the minister about the Turkish-linked organisation UETD Netherlands, its links to the AK party, its funding, its role in conflicts among Turkish Dutch after the 2016 coup attempt, and its training of youths for politics. The minister answers that UETD denies formal ties to the AK party, says it is funded by member contributions, and refers to a separate letter on foreign interference for the broader policy response.
Do you see a risk in the fact that UETD appeals to Dutch citizens of Turkish background on their Turkish loyalty and asks them to deploy this in Dutch politics too?
Ziet u een risico in het feit dat de UETD Nederlanders met Turkse achtergrond op hun Turkse loyaliteit aanspreekt en hen vraagt deze ook in de Nederlandse politiek in te zetten?

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Ten Broeke over het bericht dat Diyanet, het Turkse ministerie voor geloofszaken met 140 moskeeën in Nederland, de uitspraak heeft gedaan dat kinderen in de puberteit, voor meisj

MPs Becker and Ten Broeke asked whether Diyanet, the Turkish religious affairs ministry operating 140 mosques in the Netherlands, issued a fatwa allowing child marriage and whether this fits a pattern of rights violations, and what it means for mosque leaders and children. The government answered that Diyanet distanced itself from the report and opposes child marriage, that child marriage under 18 is banned and punishable in the Netherlands, and that it is exploring ways to make foreign funding of religious organisations more transparent.
Diyanet issued a press statement explicitly distancing itself from this interpretation as described in the original article in the Turkish newspaper Sözcü.
Diyanet heeft een persverklaring afgegeven, waarin zij nadrukkelijk afstand doen van deze interpretatie zoals beschreven in het oorspronkelijke artikel in de Turkse krant Sözcü.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Voordewind over een door Oxfam Novib en een Hamas-activist georganiseerde workshop

Two MPs asked whether a workshop organised with Oxfam Novib involving Abou Amin Rashed, linked by the government to Hamas-related fundraising, involved government participation or funding. The ministers answered that the event was organised by United Civilians for Peace without government involvement, that Dutch officials attended only as ordinary participants, and that government funding does not support BDS-promoting activities.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs was not involved in organising the meeting or in the invitation policy.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken is niet betrokken geweest bij de organisatie van de bijeenkomst of het uitnodigingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Becker en Van Helvert over verhoging van het budget voor betalingen aan veroordeelde Palestijnen

MPs Van der Staaij, Becker and Van Helvert asked the government about reports that the Palestinian Authority's 2018 budget raises payments to prisoners and their families by $56 million, and what the Netherlands is doing to change the system. The ministers answered that the increase is about $900,000 compared with 2017, that the Netherlands opposes linking payments to length of detention, and that it keeps raising this bilaterally, multilaterally and within the EU.
The cabinet continues to press on this, including in multilateral settings.
Het kabinet blijft hierop aandringen, ook in multilateraal verband.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Veldman over het voorbereiden van de Rotterdamse haven op de Brexit

MPs Becker and Veldman asked how the government is preparing the Rotterdam port and business for a hard Brexit, and what the government is doing about it. The government answers that it shares concerns, is informing business and mapping consequences and measures with stakeholders, but leaves primary preparation responsibility with business.
The cabinet has begun informing governments, citizens and businesses about these changes.
Het kabinet is begonnen met het voorlichten van overheden, burgers en bedrijven over deze veranderingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over de rapporten van het Amerikaanse Department of Commerce inzake de import van staal en aluminium

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade about US Commerce Department reports on steel and aluminium imports justified on national security grounds, including the effect on the Dutch sector, WTO compatibility, EU responses and consultation with industry. The minister answered that the US tariffs will hurt Dutch exporters, that the national security justification is insufficiently substantiated and a systemic risk to the WTO, and that the government is coordinating an EU three-track response and consulting industry.
The cabinet is of the view that, on the basis of the information currently available, the US invocation of national security in the report is insufficiently substantiated.
Het kabinet is van mening dat – op basis van de nu voorliggende informatie – een beroep van de VS op de nationale veiligheid in het rapport onvoldoende is onderbouwd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over "Grote commotie over in Rijswijk verspreid Turks pamflet tegen de PKK"

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Turkish anti-PKK pamphlet distributed door to door in Rijswijk, Delft, Rotterdam and Antwerp, including who financed it, whether it contains criminal content, and whether it risks Turkish-Kurdish tensions in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the author appears to be a Turkish publicist acting alone with no sign of state interference, that the Public Prosecution Service saw no criminal passages on first reading so no investigation is planned, and that the government will monitor the situation without new measures.
There are currently however no signals that a state actor is interfering here; this concerns a solo action by a Turkish publicist.
Er zijn momenteel echter geen signalen dat hier sprake is van inmenging van een statelijke actor, het gaat hier om een soloactie van een Turkse publicist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Lodders over de Colombiaanse antidumpingprocedure tegen de Nederlandse aardappelsector

Two MPs asked whether Colombia's anti-dumping investigation into frozen potato products from Dutch, German and Belgian producers was procedurally and substantively sound, and whether the Netherlands would push the European Commission to take it to the WTO. The minister answered that the Netherlands shares concerns about the procedure and has lobbied Colombia and the Commission, but that a WTO case can only be brought by the Commission once definitive measures exist, with a decision expected in March 2018.
On the basis of the facts now available, the Netherlands already urged the European Commission at the trade policy committee of 16 February 2018 to seriously consider this step.
Nederland heeft er op basis van de nu voorliggende feiten in het handelspolitiek comité van 16 februari 2018 reeds bij de Europese Commissie op aangedrongen deze stap serieus te overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over ‘weeshuistoerisme’ in Kenia

An MP asked the minister about orphanage tourism in Kenya, including whether the government supports NGOs linked to orphanage funding, and whether it will warn volunteers or act against such programmes. The minister answered that the government does not track volunteer numbers, does not fund orphanages as a policy goal, and relies mainly on awareness-raising and existing networks, promising only to update embassy website information.
The government has a limited role in this and does not keep figures on volunteer deployment in this area.
De overheid heeft daar een beperkte rol in en houdt geen cijfers bij over vrijwilligersinzet op dit vlak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht ‘Gemeenten negeren wettelijke taaleis bijstand’

Two VVD MPs asked the minister and state secretary about a report that municipalities ignore the statutory language requirement for welfare recipients, and how this fits with plans to give municipalities a bigger role in integration. The government acknowledged the CBS findings, said municipalities must enforce the law, committed to talks with the VNG, and noted that ultimate sanctions against municipalities are possible.
It is unacceptable if it were to turn out that people who do not speak the language receive a welfare benefit for years and are left alone.
Het is onacceptabel als zou blijken dat mensen die de taal niet spreken jarenlang een bijstandsuitkering ontvangen en met rust gelaten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over de onduidelijkheden die de EU-exportsancties met zich meebrengen

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation about uncertainties in EU export sanctions against Russia, including whether the handbook and company checks are adequate, RVO's question desk, and bank due-diligence demands on SMEs.
