The minister replied that businesses have adequate tools, that the handbook is not outdated and will be updated as needed, that most export license applications are handled on time, and that the ministries will consult business associations and banks.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs will however contact the relevant trade associations and inquire about their experiences, with a view to possible further improvements where relevant.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken zal evenwel contact opnemen met de relevante brancheverenigingen en navraag doen naar hun ervaringen, met het oog op mogelijke verdere verbeteringen waar relevant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht ‘Oxfam Novib: seksrapport ook in Nederland bekend’

An MP asked the minister about reports that Oxfam Novib knew of sexual misconduct by Oxfam GB staff in Haiti and whether Dutch public funds were involved and whether donors were aware. The minister confirmed Dutch money went to Oxfam GB activities, that audits found no programme fraud, and that she is reviewing the ministry's integrity requirements for NGOs while an inquiry into what the ministry knew is ongoing.
The aim is to establish what information the ministry received from Oxfam Novib at the time and what the ministry did with the information it received.
Doel is om na te gaan welke informatie het ministerie destijds heeft ontvangen van Oxfam Novib en wat het ministerie heeft gedaan met de ontvangen informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht dat Artsen zonder Grenzen medewerkers heeft ontslagen vanwege seksueel wangedrag

An MP asked the minister about MSF dismissing staff for sexual misconduct, including how many cases occurred, whether the ministry was informed, and whether aid funds would be cut or recovered. The minister said MSF has no reporting obligation to the ministry since 2016, promised to examine tightening subsidy frameworks with a zero-tolerance policy, and committed to a meeting on 6 March and to informing parliament.
MSF has had no funding relationship with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs since 2016 and therefore has no reporting obligations to the ministry.
Artsen zonder Grenzen heeft sinds 2016 geen financieringsrelatie met het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken en heeft derhalve geen rapportageverplichtingen richting het ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht 'Gros van de vluchtelingen in de bijstand'

An MP asked the Social Affairs minister about reports that most refugees are on social assistance, and about causes, data, integration and sanctions for non-integration. The minister said no national data split by benefit type exists, cited a CBS cohort study showing 90% of 2014 permit holders on assistance after 1.5 years, and promised to inventory with municipalities an activating support system, reporting back to parliament.
There are no national figures on the current share of permit holders receiving benefits, broken down by benefit type, origin and length of residence in the Netherlands.
Er zijn geen landelijke cijfers van het huidige aandeel statushouders in een uitkering, met een uitsplitsing naar type uitkering, afkomst en verblijfsduur in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Ten Broeke en Bosman over het bericht “Deal in Nederland onder de radar”

MPs Becker, Ten Broeke and Bosman asked about reports that a Dutch administration office became shareholder in a large Venezuelan oilfield, whether this breaches Venezuelan law and EU sanctions, and what risks and oversight apply. The government declined to discuss the specific case citing tax secrecy, stated the EU sanctions do not restrict oil-sector transactions, noted firms must self-check compliance, and said the OECD guidelines research by the National Contact Point will be sent to parliament before summer 2018.
Under the confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act, individual taxpayers cannot, as is well known, be discussed.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan zoals bekend niet worden ingegaan op individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Becker en Kuik over het naar voren halen van de Nederlandse bijdrage aan UNRWA

MPs Voordewind, Becker and Kuik asked why the Netherlands should fill budget gaps at UNRWA caused by the US funding freeze, and about effects on Israel, the PA, other donors and future funding. Minister Kaag answered that the Dutch annual contribution of EUR 13 million was brought forward to address an acute liquidity problem, not to replace US money, and that the government will reassess later in the year without a commitment to top up.
The cabinet decided to make the planned annual contribution to UNRWA available early to mitigate an acute financing problem and give UNRWA the chance and time to find other donors.

Het kabinet heeft besloten de geplande jaarbijdrage voor UNRWA versneld beschikbaar te stellen om een acuut financieringsprobleem te mitigeren en UNRWA de kans en tijd te geven om andere donoren te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht ‘EU-exportsancties Rusland te onduidelijk’

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that EU export sanctions on Russia are unclear for businesses, including rising exports, information access for SMEs, end-user checks, payment channels, outdated guidance and licence processing times. The minister replied that information is adequately provided via RVO's sanctions desk, handbooks and apps, that the handbook is still correct, and that over 90% of licence applications in 2016 and 2017 were handled on time, while committing to continue improving guidance.
The cabinet aims to process licence applications within the statutory time limit.
Het kabinet streeft er naar de vergunningaanvragen binnen de doorlooptijd af te handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Becker over het bericht ‘Oekraïne wil tafeleieren naar Europa brengen’

MPs Lodders and Becker asked whether Ukrainian table eggs will soon be exported to the EU and whether they meet EU animal welfare and food safety standards. The minister answered that an EU-approved exporter exists, that Ukraine is phasing in EU standards by 2021 under the association agreement, and that EU egg import quotas leave the Dutch and EU producers largely unaffected.
The cabinet will continue to keep itself informed of progress.
Het kabinet zal zich blijvend op de hoogte laten stellen van de voortgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het niet verspreiden van meldingen ten aanzien van ontucht met een minderjarige scholier

An MP asked the minister how the reporting procedure under Article 3 of the Secondary Education Act works after reports of suspected sexual misconduct by a teacher at a Capelle aan den IJssel school, and whether prior reports to the inspectorate should be shared with the school board. The minister declined to discuss the individual case because it is before the courts, explained the duties of the board and the inspectorate's advisory role, and saw no need to change policy.
I cannot go into this case, because it is currently before the court.
Op deze casus kan ik niet ingaan, omdat deze op dit moment onder de rechter is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Ten Broeke en Van den Bosch over landen die in Nederland onderdelen voor massavernietigingswapens proberen te kopen

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers whether countries such as Iran, Syria and Pakistan are procuring weapons-of-mass-destruction components in the Netherlands, what has been done about successful purchases, what extra measures are needed, how businesses and SMEs are made aware of the risk, and whether a blacklist of intermediaries exists. The government confirmed the risk, described export-control and awareness measures, and declined to publish a blacklist or specific case details for national security reasons.
The cabinet does not make public statements about case matters that touch on the current knowledge level and modus operandi of the Dutch intelligence and security services.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over casuïstiek die het actuele kennisniveau en de modus operandi van de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten raken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het onderzoek van RTL nieuws dat ouders hun keuze voor een school zouden laten afhangen van de hoogte van de vrijwillige ouderbijdrage

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about an RTL Nieuws investigation suggesting parents base school choice on the voluntary parental contribution, and whether schools communicate its voluntary nature and whether the Inspectorate intervenes. The State Secretary said the findings match existing monitoring, schools inform parents, the Inspectorate received 126 signals in five years without sanctions, and handling of voluntariness will be a thematic focus in 2018.
I do not have exact data on how many schools communicate insufficiently clearly or even incorrectly about the voluntary parental contribution.
Ik beschik niet over exacte gegevens hoeveel scholen onvoldoende helder of zelfs onjuist communiceren over de vrijwillige ouderbijdrage.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over de protectionistische houding van de Verenigde Staten binnen de World Trade Organisation

The MP Becker asks the minister whether the United States is blocking appointments to the WTO Appellate Body to influence its course, and what the consequences are for the WTO, the EU and the Netherlands. The minister confirms the US has twice blocked reappointments and raises procedural objections, calls this worrying and undesirable, and says the Netherlands and EU will keep raising the issue bilaterally and within WTO and EU settings.
This mechanism is a crucial part of the rules-based multilateral trading system.
Dit mechanisme is cruciaal onderdeel van het op regels gebaseerde multilaterale handelssysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het niet tijdig beschikbaar zijn van digitale leermiddelen

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Education why schools cannot access digital learning materials at the start of the school year, what causes this, how it relates to privacy law, the market position of distributor Van Dijk, and the cost and market development of digital materials. The State Secretary answered that causes are varied and shared among distributors, publishers and schools, that problems have fallen from about 80 schools to about 10, that a pseudonym law and an independent study are expected to help, and that market competition remains limited.
I have no insight into how the costs of digital learning materials have developed compared with conventional learning materials.
Ik heb geen inzicht in hoe de kosten voor digitale leermiddelen zich hebben ontwikkeld ten opzichte van conventionele leermiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Wörsdörfer over het op straat belanden van gevoelige gegevens van 1800 kwetsbare leerlingen

MPs Becker and Wörsdörfer asked the State Secretary for Education and the Interior Minister about leaked personal data of 1,800 vulnerable pupils via unanonymised municipal school-transport tenders, and about municipal privacy compliance, other risky tenders, pseudonymisation law and digital security standards. The government answered that municipalities are responsible for compliance and accountable to their councils, pointed to PIANOo and school-sector awareness measures, and said pseudonymisation targets digital learning tools rather than municipal tenders.
The municipalities are accountable to the municipal council for this.
De gemeenten zijn daarover verantwoording verschuldigd aan de gemeenteraad.

Vragen van het lid Becker (VVD) aan de Staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «Privacy van leerlingen groeit scholen boven het hoofd» en het rapport «Doordacht Digitaal» van de Onderwijsra

An MP asks the state secretary for Education about reports that schools are inadequately protecting student data privacy and about the Onderwijsraad report, and whether schools should adopt digital security standards and inform parents. The secretary responds that sector agreements, a model processor agreement, a pseudonym number facility via a forthcoming bill, and a follow-up survey are underway, and commits to sending the bill and survey results to parliament.
Your House will receive the bill enabling introduction of the pseudonym very shortly.
Uw Kamer ontvangt op zeer korte termijn het wetsvoorstel dat invoering van het pseudoniem mogelijk maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Azmani over het bericht “Christelijke scholen zwakken paasviering af”

Two VVD MPs asked the education state secretary whether Christian schools that reportedly scaled back their Easter celebrations were self-censoring, and what the ministry will do to support teachers and promote civic education. The state secretary answered that the schools deny the media account, that he has no signs of self-censorship, that teachers should feel supported by their own boards, and that a legislative tightening of the civic education duty is being prepared.
I am now preparing this legislative amendment. I will submit it to your House as soon as possible.
Ik bereid deze wetswijziging nu voor. Ik leg deze zo spoedig mogelijk aan uw Kamer voor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht dat het Nederlandse onderwijs nog teveel talenten van leerlingen en studenten onbenut laat

An MP asked the state secretary about the Inspectorate's finding that some schools get more from their pupils than others and whether schools rated 'voldoende' should be pushed to 'goed'. The secretary agreed that schools differ, said the inspectorate will be able to distinguish 'voldoende' from 'goed' under renewed supervision from August 2017, and said the inspectorate has a stimulating role but gave no new concrete commitment.
The renewed supervision enters into force on 1 August 2017.
Het vernieuwde toezicht treedt 1 augustus 2017 in werking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over een Amerikaans onderzoek naar staalimporten/staaldumping

An MP asked the trade minister about a US national-security investigation into steel and aluminium imports under section 232, its differences from EU anti-dumping measures, and risks to Dutch steel producers such as Tata Steel IJmuiden. The minister answered that the probe is ongoing, that it is not targeted at one country, that she raised concerns with US Commerce Secretary Ross, and that she would keep the Chamber informed.
Yes. The Netherlands has always pressed for anti-dumping measures to be no more distorting or protectionist than necessary.
Ja. Nederland heeft zich er altijd voor hard gemaakt dat antidumpingmaatregelen niet meer verstorend of protectionistischer zijn dan nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over de werkdruk onder basisschoolleraren door "administratieve rompslomp"

MP Becker asked the state secretary about teacher workload caused by administrative burden in primary schools, citing an NOS survey, and asked about measures to reduce paperwork and clarify what is legally required. The state secretary confirmed the workload picture, described the Regeldrukagenda and Operatie Regels Ruimen, explained that much paperwork is self-imposed by schools rather than required by the inspectorate, and promised a overview of common misunderstandings by June.
Yes. To help schools take more control, an overview of the biggest misunderstandings about registrations in education will be available in June, with an explanation from the inspectorate.

Ja. Om scholen te helpen meer de regie te nemen, komt er in juni een overzicht voor scholen van de grootste misverstanden over registraties in het onderwijs, met hierbij een toelichting van de inspectie.

m: Amendement van het lid Bühler over het handhaven van de uitzonderingen in het Burgerlijk Wetboek, de Wet flexibel werken en de Wet op de Loonbelasting 1964
Deletes the exemptions for PGB care workers working under four days a week from the Civil Code, Flexible Work Act and Wage Tax Act, keeping the exemptions for sick pay, training and dismissal law.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Grinwis c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 3 over het toevoegen van € 60 miljoen via verdeelartikel 5.4 aan het OS-budget voor 2023
Adds 60 million euro to the 2023 development aid budget through a cash shift, funded by moving spending within the aid budget.
In article 5 Multilateral cooperation and other engagement, the commitment and expenditure amounts are increased by 60,000 (x 1,000) euros.
In artikel 5 Multilaterale samenwerking en overige inzet wordt het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 60.000 (x € 1.000).
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Grinwis c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 13 over het toevoegen van € 70 miljoen via verdeelartikel 5.4 aan het OS-budget voor 2023
Amendment adds 70 million euro to the development aid budget for 2023 via a cash shift, funded from the 2028 buffer.
the commitment and expenditure amount is increased by 70,000 (x 1,000) euro
wordt het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 70.000 (x € 1.000)
Motie van de leden Thijssen en Van den Brink over het langjarig maximeren van de toerekening van eerstejaarsopvangkosten aan ODA-middelen
Asks the government to cap for the long term the share of first-year reception costs for refugees that is counted as ODA aid spending.
requests the government to cap long-term the attribution of first-year reception costs to ODA funds
verzoekt de regering de toerekening van eerstejaarsopvangkosten aan ODA-middelen langjarig te maximeren
Amendement van het lid Grinwis c.s. over het toevoegen van € 50 miljoen via verdeelartikel 5.4 aan het OS-budget voor 2023
Adds 50 million euro to the 2023 development aid (OS) budget through a cash-flow shift, reversing part of the earlier cut.
this amendment provides that 50 million euro is added to the 2023 development aid budget via allocation article 5.4
regelt dit amendement dat € 50 miljoen via verdeelartikel 5.4 aan het OS-budget voor 2023 wordt toegevoegd
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van den Brink c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 17 over het verlengen van de fase van vrijwilligheid

Amends the asylum reception distribution bill to make the provincial allocation final by 1 February, extend the voluntary phase to 1 November, and postpone ministerial distribution decisions to 31 December.
By extending the phase in which reception facilities can be offered voluntarily, the chance that interadministrative supervision is needed is reduced.

Door de fase waarin op vrijwillige basis opvangfaciliteiten kunnen worden aangeboden te verlengen, wordt de kans op de inzet van interbestuurlijk toezicht voor het realiseren van opvangfaciliteiten verminderd.
Motie van de leden Brekelmans en Van den Brink over het uitlezen van mobiele telefoons ook gebruiken voor het toetsen van het asielrelaas
Asks the government to keep extracting asylum seekers' mobile phones at the start of the procedure and also use the data to test their asylum claims.
requests the government to continue reading mobile phones at the start of the asylum procedure and also use this information to test the asylum claim
verzoekt de regering om de mobiele telefoons aan het begin van de asielprocedure te blijven uitlezen en deze informatie ook te gebruiken voor het toetsen van het asielrelaas
Motie van de leden Brekelmans en Van den Brink over werkinstructies en interne informatieberichten niet meer openbaar maken
Asks the government to stop publishing internal work instructions and information messages that the IND uses in asylum decisions, and to explore a legal basis for not publishing country policy.
requests the government to no longer make work instructions and internal information messages public
verzoekt de regering om werkinstructies en interne informatieberichten niet meer openbaar te maken
Motie van de leden Van den Brink en Brekelmans over strenger toetsen of alleenstaande minderjarigen daadwerkelijk alleenstaand zijn

Asks the government to test more strictly whether unaccompanied minors are really alone and to return family reunification policy to the 2019 to 2021 approach, limiting it to the core family as in the EU directive.
requests the government to test more strictly whether unaccompanied minors are really alone
verzoekt de regering strenger te toetsen of alleenstaande minderjarigen daadwerkelijk alleenstaand zijn
Motie van de leden Brekelmans en Van den Brink over het afschaffen van schriftelijk horen voor kansrijke asielzoekers
Asks the government to abolish written hearings for promising asylum seekers and require physical interviews by the IND.
requests the government to abolish written hearings for promising asylum seekers and ensure the IND always conducts a physical follow-up hearing
verzoekt de regering om schriftelijk horen voor kansrijke asielzoekers af te schaffen en ervoor te zorgen dat IND bij kansrijke asielzoekers altijd een fysiek nader gehoor afneemt
Motie van de leden Van den Brink en Brekelmans over zorgen dat de IND minder vaak en snel het voordeel van de twijfel toepast
Asks the government to make the IND apply the benefit of the doubt less often and quickly, stress individualisation, and place the burden of proof more on asylum seekers.
requests the government to ensure that the IND less often and less quickly applies the benefit of the doubt
verzoekt de regering ervoor te zorgen dat de IND minder vaak en snel het voordeel van de twijfel toepast
Motie van de leden Brekelmans en Van den Brink over het versoberen van de opvang en voorzieningen voor asielzoekers met een kansarme aanvraag
Asks the government to further reduce and tighten reception and facilities for asylum seekers with low-prospect applications and to expand permanent reception locations.
requests the government to reduce and tighten reception and facilities for asylum seekers with low-prospect applications as much as possible
verzoekt de regering om de opvang en voorzieningen voor asielzoekers met een kansarme aanvraag zo veel als mogelijk te versoberen en aan te scherpen
Motie van het lid Piri c.s. over het zo snel mogelijk inzetten van geschikt leegstaand maatschappelijk vastgoed voor de opvang van asielzoekers
Asks the government, with municipalities and the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, to quickly use suitable vacant public buildings for asylum reception.
suitable vacant public property meeting certain minimum requirements to be used as quickly as possible for the reception of asylum seekers
geschikt leegstaand maatschappelijk vastgoed dat aan bepaalde minimumeisen voldoet, zo snel mogelijk in te zetten voor de opvang van asielzoekers
Amendement van het lid Van den Brink c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 16 over het verlengen van de fase van vrijwilligheid

Amends the asylum shelter distribution law: earlier dates for provincial and municipal figures, a longer voluntary phase to 1 November, and postponing the minister's distribution decisions to 31 December, reducing use of interbestuurlijk toezicht.
This amendment enables the Minister to announce the distribution across all provinces and the indicative distribution per municipality before 1 February.
Dit amendement stelt de Minister in staat om de verdeling over alle provincies en de indicatieve verdeling per gemeente vóór 1 februari bekend te maken
Amendement van het lid Van den Brink c.s. over het verlengen van de fase van vrijwilligheid
Changes the asylum reception distribution timetable so the minister's distribution decisions are postponed to 31 December and interbestuurlijk toezicht is less likely to be needed.

Moreover, the taking of distribution decisions by the Minister after insufficient places are offered is postponed, thereby reducing the chance that interadministrative supervision is used to realise reception facilities.

Bovendien wordt het nemen van verdeelbesluiten na het uitblijven van voldoende plekken door de Minister uitgesteld, waardoor de kans op de inzet van interbestuurlijk toezicht voor het realiseren van opvangfaciliteiten wordt verminderd.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Brink, Krul en Inge van Dijk over het niet doorgaan van amateur wielrenwedstrijden

MPs from the CDA asked the ministers why amateur cycling races are being cancelled because police motorcycle escorts are unavailable, and whether volunteer civilian motorcyclists could be deployed, including via a pilot and changes to traffic rules. The minister answered that a study by Antea Group is underway with results expected in summer 2024, that a temporary experiment would need a legal amendment and AMvB taking about a year, and that changing traffic rules awaits the study's outcome.
I expect the results of the above-mentioned study in the summer of 2024.
De uitkomsten van het bovengenoemde onderzoek verwacht ik in de zomer van 2024.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Van den Brink over het bericht dat Europese voetbalclubs sinds het uitbreken van de oorlog in Oekraïne zo’n 40 miljoen euro aan transfer– en huursommen aan hun Russische tegenha

MPs Boswijk and Van den Brink asked whether European football clubs should be barred from paying transfer and loan fees to Russian clubs since the war in Ukraine, and what the government is doing about it. The minister replied that such transactions are not banned under current sanctions, clubs must screen ownership, and the government will not disclose future sanction plans.
The cabinet does not provide information on possible future sanction measures, as this would undermine the effectiveness of the sanctions instrument.
Het kabinet verstrekt geen informatie over mogelijke toekomstige sanctiemaatregelen, daar het de effectiviteit van het sanctie-instrument ondermijnt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Brink over het bericht ‘Jumbo-echtpaar is overlast asielzoekers zat en stopt met winkel in Maarheeze’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a supermarket closing due to nuisance from asylum seekers, including incident registration, action at the station, police capacity, and residence rules for offenders. The State Secretary said nuisance is unacceptable, described COA measures, supervisory teams, HTL placement, and noted that residence decisions follow European and national rules, while committing to continued consultation and cooperation.
I am of the opinion that our hospitality must never come at the expense of our safety.
Ik ben van mening dat onze gastvrijheid nooit ten koste mag gaan van onze veiligheid.

qn: An MP asked the Finance Minister whether De Nederlandsche Bank's view that a capital insurance with a life-annuity clause amounts to two contracts is correct, and whether this blocks Dutch annuity capital from being converted into an annuity for a citizen living in another EU state. The minister answered that DNB's view is defensible under civil law, that the problem lies in applicable law and notification rules rather than in DNB's stance, and that no legislative change is promised; the minister says the notification obligation remains on the agenda.
With regard to the applicable law, DNB however has no competence.
Ten aanzien van het toepasselijke recht heeft DNB evenwel geen bevoegdheid.

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs whether arguments from a newspaper article calling the halving of ING a penalty measure should be included in earlier questions, and how the exceptional financial stability situation should be weighed in the European Commission's market distortion assessment. The ministers answered yes to both questions, stating that financial stability plays no role in assessing market distortion but should be weighed in assessing state aid compatibility with the common market, as the Commission did when approving the ING Alt-A back-up facility.
In our view, this exceptional situation should indeed be taken into account when assessing whether state aid measures are compatible with the common market.
Deze uitzonderlijke situatie dient naar onze mening wel te worden meegewogen bij de beoordeling of staatssteunmaatregelen in overeenstemming zijn met de gemeenschappelijke markt.

Two CDA MPs asked the finance and economic affairs ministers whether EU state-aid and competition policy on banks, as described by Commissioner Kroes, preserves a level playing field, whether ING's criticism is justified, and whether the Commission's decision on ING can be published quickly. The ministers replied that the Commission's approach aims to preserve a level playing field, that its effect cannot yet be assessed, that ING's stricter restructuring is a consequence of its large state aid, and that they pushed for early publication of the decision.
We have worked towards this and expect publication soon.
Wij hebben ons daarvoor ingezet en verwachten spoedig publicatie.

SP MPs Bashir and Kant asked the finance minister how he views a banker's criticism of bonuses in banking, whether self-regulation has failed and binding rules such as a bonus ban are needed, and whether the state as shareholder will act. The minister agreed bonuses created perverse incentives, outlined a package of measures beyond the banking code including supervisory powers and tax rules, and said the ABN Amro board pay policy goes further than the code, while stating self-regulation remains preferred if it works.
It is now up to the sector to prove that things will get better in the future.
Het is nu aan de sector te bewijzen dat het in de toekomst beter gaat.

MP Boelhouwer asks the Finance and Transport ministers about Schiphol's half-year results, including the meaning of a 31 million euro rise in financial costs linked to its 8% stake in Aéroports de Paris, why the stake's fair value (316 million) is far below the 538 million paid, how the 222 million gap will be recovered, realised synergies, and the use of 8.2 million in acquisition costs. The government's answer is only a postponement notice stating that the questions cannot be answered within the usual period and will follow as soon as possible.
The answers to the aforementioned questions will be sent to you as soon as possible.
De antwoorden op vorenbedoelde vragen zullen u zo spoedig mogelijk worden toegezonden.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van leden Albert de Vries en Brouwer over het bericht ‘Geef grenswerkers belastingkorting’

MPs Albert de Vries and Brouwer asked whether the government would tackle tax and social security differences that create uncertainty for cross-border workers and would adopt expat-style tax relief for them. The ministers answered that the government relies on information provision and existing compensation schemes, that harmonisation is not feasible, and that the action team's agenda will be followed up.

The cabinet and the border regions are strongly focusing on optimising information provision for cross-border workers on tax and social insurance differences, so that the differences become transparent.

Het kabinet en de grensregio’s zetten voor fiscale verschillen en verschillen in sociale verzekeringsstelsels fors in op het optimaliseren van de informatievoorziening voor grenswerkers, zodat de verschillen inzichtelijk worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brouwer over het bericht dat veel Nederlanders niet weten wanneer ze 1-1-2 mogen bellen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the public understands when to call the 112 emergency number, and whether misuse should be tackled and public information improved. The minister agreed the 112 rule should be widely known, reported that 35-40% of calls are misuse or non-urgent, and declined a new national campaign, citing the falling misuse trend and existing measures.
In view of the above, I see no reason to start a new information campaign from central government.
Ik zie gelet op het bovenstaande geen aanleiding om een nieuwe voorlichtingscampagne vanuit het rijk te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brouwer over vooroordelen en loonachterstanden vanwege het spreken met een dialect

An MP asked the government about reports that people speaking a dialect earn 5 to 15 percent less than Standard Dutch speakers, and whether prejudice plays a role. The minister cites a discussion paper finding a link between dialect and hourly wages, says the data cannot separate the causes and points to the existing anti-discrimination labour market policy and progress reports.
The study notes that the underlying data do not allow distinguishing between the different mechanisms that lead to the negative wage effect experienced by male workers.

In het onderzoek wordt opgemerkt dat de aan het onderzoek ten grondslag liggende gegevens niet toe staan om een onderscheid te maken tussen de verschillende mechanismen die leiden tot het negatieve looneffect dat mannelijke werknemers ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brouwer en Recourt over ouderen in de gevangenis

MPs Brouwer and Recourt asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about elderly prisoners, including numbers of over-60s and over-75s sentenced and detained, special prison wings for seniors, and a special senior criminal law. The State Secretary answered that no special detention units for over-60s are needed since care follows health needs rather than age, that a vision on sanction enforcement will address older prisoners, and that existing law already allows judges to take age into account, so a separate senior criminal law is unnecessary.
Given all existing possibilities, I am of the view that introducing a special criminal law for seniors would add no value.
Ik ben, gezien alle bestaande mogelijkheden, van mening dat invoering van een speciaal strafrecht voor senioren niet van toegevoegde waarde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brouwer over de aanwezigheid van contrabande in tbs-klinieken

An MP asked the State Secretary whether he knew of internal reports of contraband (drugs, child pornography, phones) in TBS clinics, how it enters, what sanctions apply, and what action plan exists. The State Secretary confirmed knowledge of incident reports from 2012-2016 that are normally not shared with parliament, disclosed them after a Wob request, described the inspectorate-based action plan, and said effectiveness cannot yet be judged.
This type of internal report is generally not reported to your House or otherwise made public.
Dit soort interne meldingen wordt in de regel niet aan uw Kamer gemeld of anderszins openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brouwer en Vermue over een storing van alarmnummer 112 in West-Brabant

MPs Brouwer and Vermue asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a brief outage of the 112 emergency number in West-Brabant on 16 March 2016, its cause, duration, incidents, regional preparedness and prevention. The minister confirmed the outage, said it lasted until about 8 hours, was caused by reduced line capacity, that 112 remained reachable for citizens, and that the cause is still under investigation with possible further measures to follow.
The exact cause of the outage is still under investigation.
De exacte oorzaak van de storing is nog in onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rep over aanbesteding Exportkredietverzekeringen (EKV)

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Finance about the tender of export credit insurance (EKV) services, including which bidders have registered, which stakeholders are involved, and the effects on users and long-term implementation. The Minister answered that the tender documents will be consulted on in September 2025, publication is aimed for end 2025, award is targeted for summer 2026, and the Chamber will be informed again in autumn.
The Chamber will be informed again about the state of affairs after the market consultation is completed and before the final tender documents are published.
De Kamer zal na afronding van de marktconsultatie en voor de publicatie van de finale aanbestedingsdocumenten opnieuw geïnformeerd worden over de stand van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rep over het artikel ‘Brussel wil belasting van €2 op goedkope pakketjes uit China’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the European Commission's plan to scrap the duty exemption for parcels under 150 euro, including the revenue impact and consumer price effects. The government supports the customs reform and a handling fee to fight fraud and level the playing field, though the national gain is limited to a 25% collection fee.
The cabinet is therefore positive about introducing such a handling fee.
Het kabinet is dan ook positief over de introductie van een dergelijke handling fee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rep over het artikel ’Onderzoek naar frauduleuze invoer e-bikes uit China’

The MP asked whether the government recognises reports of Chinese e-bike parts being imported via Poland and assembled in Portugal to evade anti-dumping duties, and what it will do about lost revenue. The state secretary confirmed Customs knows of such assembly practices, said the Netherlands does not lose revenue since duties accrue to the EU, and said anti-dumping circumvention is a priority in a risk-based control strategy.
So it is not the case that the Dutch treasury loses an amount now that the goods are not imported via the Netherlands.
Het is dus niet zo dat de Nederlandse schatkist een bedrag misloopt nu de goederen niet via Nederland worden ingevoerd.
